review_text: We opted for a 45 minute flight in a Twin Otter Vistaliner to see more of the GC instead of going on the Skywalk.  It cost a little more but was sure worth it.  At check in, be prepared to be weighed and then you are assigned a seat based upon weight and balance. You are assigned a colour coded boarding pass and wait until your flight is called.  You then stand in your assigned place indicated by painted footprints on the ground at the gate.  When it is safe to do so, you will be escorted to your plane and a professional photographer will offer to take your picture.  After a safety briefing and boarding is complete you can don your headphones and choose your language for the commentary.  Although the plane can hold 19 passengers, there is a very good chance you will be seated next to a window.  The flight itself was superb with spectacular views of the GC from another angle and there are many photo opportunities on either side of the plane through the large windows.  You also get to see some of the Northern Rim, something that is not easy to do in one day if travelling by road.  The flight does cross over the Canyon itself twice so it is possible to look straight down on the Colorado River and see the white water rafters doing their thing.  A lot of consideration is given to not disturbing the peace of those on the ground but this does not mean that the route flown is out of the way.   Highly recommended.

This tour actually was our back-up choice, and I have to say I was very pleased. The views of practically virgin forest and mountains were breathtaking. Taking a ride in a piece of history was also fantastic. The DeHavilland Beaver is the workhorse of the Pacific Northwest, and the opportunity to take the tour in this plane was great. We took off and landed on the water. We were in the air for about an hour and got to enjoy an all-you-can-eat crab leg feast at the conclusion of this tour. Pricey, but would absolutely do again.

We booked Seawind on the cruise dock since we were uncertain about the weather.  We were assured the views would be good at Misty Fiords, so off we went!  The shuttle to and from the float dock was quick and easy.  Our flight was everything promised.  The views from the plane were almost unbelievable.  The pilot/owner, Steve did a great job telling us about the area and answering our questions along the way.  Our brief landing inside the park provided another fantastic viewpoint of the mountains and fjords as well as a look at some widlife from the ground.  The entire flight was smooth from takeoff to landing.  It just goes to show that a cloudy day at Ketchikan doesn't mean you can't enjoy a flight tour to Misty Fiords!

review_title: A wonderful first time experience on a seaplane
review_text: My family and I booked a package tour with Friday Harbor Seaplanes and Western Prince Explorer Whale Watching. We all had a great and comfortable time on the flight, which felt safe, but also exhilarating. Our pilots were knowledgable and professional as well. During this package deal we had enough to time enjoy Friday Harbor before doing the whale watch tour part. Thank you for this fun tour and I look forward to booking with this trustworthy company again.

review_title: Our West Rim visit was an incredible experience
review_text:
My friends and I -(4) were picked up at the Sedona airport by Colby, our pilot.
He stayed with us throughout the whole experience and we couldn´t have hoped for a more pleasant, good humoured and polite pilot/guide.
The views from the plane were fantastic and the helicopter ride, although brief was amazing. Their organization works like clockwork. Great lunch at a fantastic view point.
Turbulence was an issue on returning to Sedona but Colby did his best to try and make it less rough. Great views, great lunch, great service!! 
Will recommend to all our Mexican friends!!
The crew at K2 are amazing and make the whole experience easy and fun.  If you can plan to go when the sun is out, the trip is just that much more magnificent.

You must take a tour over Denali with K2.  Excellent service, smiling friendly and helpful. Patrick was our pilot and he did a super job of pointing everything out and educating us about Denali and the glaciers, great sense of humor.  This is an experience we will never ever forget,thank you K2

A wonderful trip in Maui. I’m so glad to see the most interesting places including Molokai sea cliffs, Lanai shipwreck and the Molokini. The weather is windy, but it is not a problem for our pilot. Even I could have chance to ride the plane.
This was one of the highlights of our trip k2 were awesome what an amazing thing to do was land on the glacier  thanks again mark and debora andrews
Easy flight , nice pilots, great views, good value wonderful smooth take off and landing I highly recommend this group

review_title: One of the best parts of my vacation!!!
review_text: I was in Kauai first week of Sept. with my wife for her 30th birthday!!!  Wanted to do a fly over of island.  Everyone suggested a helicopter, but I found it hard to pay $175 to $250 per person. Decided to go with Wings over Kauai for $125 pp and couldn't be happier!!!  The couple that owns it Ellen and Capt. Bruce are simply the best! Very nice and personable, much more of a intimate experience!! Capt. Bruce was very soft spoken and knowledgeable of the island and views you would see!! The flight pattern he takes you on really gives you a look of the complete island. It was about an hour, maybe little more, a smooth flight, smooth take off and landing!! It was one of the best things and or hours of our trip! Hard to say what is number one, because the island is so beautiful!!! Ellen and Bruce would definitely tie for the number one spot though! You get a picture of you in front of the plane, a dvd of the air tour, and the ladies get a little present too!!!  Ellen and Bruce we could not Thank You enough for making are last day on the "Best" island any better then you did!!!  So glad we did this!  Thanks again..
This was definitely one of those once in a lifetime experiences.  The staff at the hangar was awesome, our pilot was awesome, the glacier landing was awesome.
We had an amazing adventure. Eric made us feel comfortable & showed us some of the most beautiful sights of Maui, Lanai, Molokai! Loved every minute!!!🤙🌴☀️

review_title: Safe & Competent Operator; Stunning & Unforgettable Scenery
review_text: Kauai really can only be appreciated in its entirety from the air.  Ellen's "Wings Over Kauai" accomplishes the mission with safety, competence, and a keen appreciation for the customer's/passenger's perspective. Every aspect of the operation is run in a timely, efficient, and safe manner. The scenic highlights, running narrative, and even the background audio music, makes for a memorable ride. As a career aviator myself I was looking for subtle signs of safety and regulatory compliance and found the operation completely satisfactory.  Cheaper than a helicopter tour, but just as thorough - fully recommended.

We had Captain Shaydon for our tour.  He was very knowledgeable of the island and pointed out a lot of sites. We left the airport and headed clockwise around the island past our resort in Poipu, the the west side, the canyon, Napali Coast, north shore and cut back across the east side back to the airport.
A great way to get back to the city while enjoying the views and luckily for us spotting a whale or two!

My wife and I had a fabulous flight with Captain Harry in the Waco biplane. It was a really comfortable flight and a super memorable way to see Kauai with views that few get the chance to experience. The open cockpit biplane is far more interesting for sight seeing and the views without any interfering windows are unique and ideal for photos. Great fun.
We had an awesome experience! The best way to look at all the island. The guide was very kind and very informative. I even got to drive a little! What a life time experience would do it again.

Great way to see the beauty of the PNW.  Everyone we encountered at Northwest Seaplanes were accommodating and easy going.  Love the vintage feel and color of the planes. Would recommend to anyone wanting a unique way to travel.

review_title: Glacier landing with a lot of great information from the pilot
review_text: We did the glacier landing tour, which was pretty cool and a good length of time. The pilot was very informative while we flew and answered all of our questions while we hung out on the glacier. He made a point to let each side of the plane see the views he was pointing out and allowed plenty of time for us to take it all in. We unfortunately did not get to see Mt Denali because of the cloud coverage, but I hear that is quite common.

review_title: Hope I can do it again!
review_text: Spectacular experience of the islands and all their beauty.  Would highly recommend this tour and Eric was a great pilot and tour guide.

There was "no" favorite part, the trip exceeded all expectations. Lindsey and her staff were very professional. Steve, our pilot, was informative with his narrations and provided answers to our questions when asked. Would highly recommend!

review_title: Helicopter tour highlight of our trip
review_text: This helicopter trip was the highlight of our trip to GC. I appreciated the safety protocols that they took to keep us all safe (temps, masks, screening). The pilot was informative about the different rock formations - we saw bison which was super cool! Would highly recommend!
The flight was excellent. We were in the air more than one hour! You should see Kauai from above, it was amazing.
Great trip - very professional with emphasis on safety. The pilot was professional and informative. Would recommend to anyone!
My wife and I took a flight with Maui Plane Rides and we really enjoyed it!  We circled the entire island of Maui and the views were spectacular!   Pilot was a pro.

review_title: You're missing out if you don't book
review_text: My girlfriend and I thought this would be the first thing to do before engaging in any activities on the ground.  This tour was amazing and worth every penny!  Even with some clouds and rain, you are guaranteed for a great adventure.  Having experienced this first once we landed into ITO really put a great perspective on the whole island and what it has to offer.  It made everything we done on the ground more meaningful.  Ask for Harry... He's an awesome tour guide with lots of flight experience and all the professionalism one can ask for.

This was a 10 out of 10 experience! Our pilot, Sol, is a native to the area, very experienced, and he had some great stories to tell while we were flying over the Misty Fjords. I can’t thank him enough for being a part of my family’s experience on a seaplane. ❤️
Wonderful sightseeing plane ride. Matt was great pilot and host. Boys said it was the best activity on the trip.

Took the Canyon Adventure tour that consisted of a plane ride early AM over the canyon, walk into Antelope Slot, and float ride down the Colorado River.  Expensive, but hands down money well spent.  All 3 experiences were well guided and customer service was fantastic.  Light breakfast in the AM provided (yogurt, muffin, juice, apple, coffee) lunch in the afternoon (Subway turkey sandwich, orange, chips and kind bar).  Lynette, our Antelope Slot guide was AMAZING.  She was knowledgeable and showed us how to get the best photos of the canyon.  The river guide was also great but it was HOT and a little slow.  He made it interesting by pointing out neat shapes in the canyon and sharing history with us.  Went with a 10 year old and my 70 year old parents.  Everyone loved it.

Bring: 
Sunscreen
Bathing suit
Sneakers
Book or something for bus ride back
Water for AM

I'm a local, and I won this flight off of the radio.
Making reservations was a breeze, they had plenty of seats available. Their webcam made it easy for me to monitor the weather before driving up from Wasilla. When I called that morning, they were able to give me a weather report so we didn't have to drive up if the weather was bad.
Check in was a breeze. I was a little nervous that my weight would be an issue. I'm pretty fat. But it wasn't.
Our pilot gave us a briefing and we loaded up in the Otter. Take off was smooth and we headed towards the mountain. The flight was perfect. There's was some clouds around the mountain, but our pilot worked around them.
The pilot narrated as we went.  I was able to get a lot of great pictures.
I'd do this trip again in a heartbeat, and I would recommend it to others.

review_title: First time in a sea plane - didn't disappoint!
review_text: The folks at Friday Harbor Seaplanes were friendly, communicative, and easy peasy to book, board etc. I would absolutely use them again for a trip to the San Juan's ... no doubt about it!
These guys were great! Super competent, professional and fun. It was clear that this was at the same time a very well organization but also light hearted and relaxed.
This was a last minute add to our trip and will be the highlight.  Pilot.  Plane.  Seeing all the sites.  Beaches.  Waterfalls. Napoli coast.   Perfect.

We had a great flight - very smooth and comfortable.  My husband took lots of amazing pictures and we learned a lot about Kauai.  We saw many areas we wouldn't have been able to see from the ground.  It was worth every penny!

review_title: Great flight for six family members
review_text: I chose this because we had a party of six including three generations. Though the helicopters go lower and closer, we loved the bird’s eye view and smooth ride. The pilot was great and we can highly recommend it.

Though I must say I was not thrilled about the prospect of flying in a small plane (we did the bi-plane) it was an excellent way to see the entire island.  We took the one hour tour. The views were spectacular. The pilot was very informative and personable. We saw sites that were truly amazing; ones we could never have seen from the ground (and we did a lot of hiking!).  My husband says it definitely was one of the highlights of his vacation! I would highly recommend Air Ventures, from check-in through the flight, everything went smoothly. Pilot was excellent! Great adventure!

Our pilot was provided a gentle ride with incredible views. Many of the sights could not have been from the rim. He was knowledgeable about the formations and history. I would definitely recommend this company

I enjoyed our tour over Kauai.  The family run business took care of us.  Unpredictable weather on Kauai caused us to reschedule and we were able to get in the next day.  The flight was smooth and you could hear well with nice noise canceling headsets.

Do not leave Alaska without going on a flightseeing tour with K2 Aviation!  We did a 7 day Alaskan Cruise followed by 4 additional days driving around Alaska and this was the highlight of our trip.  The McKinley Flyer with glacier landing was definitely a great choice, we got to see the famous mountains and walk in knee-deep snow on the glacier.  I am usually afraid of heights and didn’t have any problems or issues on this extremely smooth flight.  Our pilot narrated our entire flight so we knew where we were and what we were looking at.  Make sure to take lots of pictures and walk in the tracks of the plane’s skis if you don’t want to sink into the snow!
Excellent pilot, great views, personal treatment, knowledgeable explanations about the area, would recommend to friends
Thank you so much for great service and lifelong memories! My son is so happy it was more than a week ago, and he can't stop talking about it.

Wonderful!!  First timers and this was the trip if on a short time limit.  Pricey, but there’s a lot of logistics going on to get everything coordinated.  Perfect time of year to go.  No big crowds and no extreme heat.  Everyday at some point I thanked God for such a perfect day!!!  The Grand Canyon cannot be fully captured by photos.  Just breathtaking.  Same for Antelope Canyon!! Amazing natural canyon!  The float was so serene and peaceful.  Just take it in even if it seems a bit long.  On our journey back to airport, a movie was shown, which helped that leg of the day go quicker!  Overall a great day!!!

Flight onto Denali, it was truly amazing! Mike, our pilot was so accommodating, went in between the clouds for us to get a look at Denali and how many people can say they saw the very top of Denali up close and personal. It was a beautiful trip to and from the mountain with excellent commentary on the surrounding mountains, glaciers and rivers.

review_title: Sea Plan from San Juan to Seattle
review_text: My husband and I decided instead of taking the ferry to and from the islands, we wanted a different mode of transportation returning to Seattle. We took the sea plan from Friday Harbor to Seattle (Renton), and it was great! Our pilot was friendly, knowledgeable of the land and history, and told us facts and stories as we flew over different areas. It was a unique way to see the area, and we are very glad we did it. The trip was approximately 45 minutes; it was smooth taking off and landing and felt very safe. We loved it!
Amazing experience, Eric was incredible and made us feel so comfortable and safe. The views were absolutely an amazing, it’s a must do!!!!

We chose plane due to size of the Grand Canyon. Very happy with the choice as plane gives better coverage. Yes you can get helicopter rides covering same distance, which are 2x the price and not as relaxed. Multiple language options are provided and we had a great pilot. We flew in the Cessna Caravan which is smaller and everyone has a window seat. Grand Canyon Scenic Airlines was well organised, punctual.Before booking I read some complaints regarding cost - which I don't think are fair. Pricing is competitive also compared with other locations / countries. People also complained about cancellations. Always book this kind of trips early in your stay. Weather and equipment can cause delays and cancellations, just like any flight you book. We were lucky as the day before the canyon was filled with smoke from a wild fire.So book early and enjoy your flight!

review_title: BOB and CHEF CHRIS GO TO THE CANYON
review_text: Very professional staff, pilots, and attendants. Enjoyable flights and on time all the way and the package includes all ticketing. Wyatt was a great and knowledgeable guide with outstanding piloting skills

Air Ventures is by far the best way to see all of Kauai. Because of the lack of road access to large portions of the island the only way to see those parts is by air or water. Forget getting sea sick in 10 foot chop. Take a relaxing ride with Air Ventures.
We just got done with the ride and Eric was great! Lots of knowledge of the area and the views were fantastic! Such an unforgettable experience!
We had such a great experience with Talkeetna Air Taxi. Highly recommend. Our pilot,Chris, was top notch!

only negative thing was the late pick up. there was a delay of about forty minutes.
other than that the experience was great.
the seaplane was great, something we havent done before. we flew out over the golden gate and then back over the city. the views were superb and the city looked fantastic from the plane.
reccomend this over helicopter trips as the experience is unique.

The views were incredible. A really different perspective on many popular sites. Pilot Nate wa fantastic. Although he looks really young you can feel he knows what he is doing when  he is in the cockpit. The other where crew where amazing also. Super kind and helpful.

review_title: PLEASE ADD TO YOUR TO DO LIST IN MAUI  !!!
review_text:
Me,my wife and my 10 year old daughter booked a plane ride with Maui Plane Rides from New York for the second leg of our Hawaii trip.The plan was that my daughter could learn how to fly the plane.
I booked with Martin who was our flight instructor and what an amazing guy is he.He was so patient with my daughter,he gave my daughter instructions and helped her fly the plane most of the time.My daughter enjoyed flying the plane over the beautiful islands and blue pacific ocean.We circled over Maui,Molokai,Lanai
Martin is a very good guide,he explained each and every story behind the islands.
We had a great experience as a family ,specially my daughter who was happy and ecstatic and actually hugged Martin post our tour.
I highly recommend flying with Martin and Maui Plane Rides.It was money well spent and we had a great time.Last but not the least i want to thank our Flight Instructor who is a amazing person and was so patient with my daughter.

review_title: Prelude to an AMAZING Spiritual Experience.
review_text:
The day before my Air Ventures Hi flight, I had an amazing conversation with a helicopter tour across the street. I was the 1st for the next tour which required 6 passengers. No one showed so my tour was canceled. They suggested I might take a drive up the Waimea Canyon and rebook my flight. I did take that drive. On the way back to rebook my flight, I saw the fixed wing flight with Air Ventures and After speaking at length with the bi plane pilot, chose to took that tour instead. Our pilot was amazing with his historical knowledge of the island. And yes as was suggested, I was able to see the places that I had driven the day before. (As we flew around the point at Poipu, i could literally see the sliding glass doors to my room where i was stayjng.) I hope to return to Kawai in 6 months At which time I plan to take the bi plane tour With Air Ventures Hawaii.
My trip to Kauai was my fulfillment of a dream to return to Hawaii after having been in the military in the Hawaiian Island chain 40 plus years ago. My trip began on Veterans day and i enjoyed my 63rd birthday on Kauai. My 10 day trip to Kawaii involved the drive up Wiamea Canyon, The fixed wing flight over and around the island and a 5 hour kayak tour up the Royal river with a one hour hike into the rain forest to The Secret waterfall. I can only hope the reader will experience the island energy AND the island love from both Thee Island And Her prople the way I did. Again, much about my experience began with the fixed wing flight over and around the island with Air Adventures Hawaii. Yes I will do it again...in rhe bi plane next time....
Aloha and mahalo.

review_title: Beautiful flight experience with a great company
review_text: My sister and I took a flight tour to the Ruth Glacier with Talkeetna Air Taxi during our recent trip to Alaska. We had booked in advance but the day of our flight was rained out. Talkeetna Air Taxi gave us the option of rescheduling for our next available date (they were totally flexible with our itinerary) or completely refunding our deposit. We chose to reschedule and were glad we did! We did the southside tour with glacier landing. I would highly recommend adding a glacier landing to your flight if it's in your budget. Total tour took about 90 minutes from start to finish. Our pilot was experienced, informative, and friendly. He pointed out wildlife along the way and afterwards showed us our flight path on a map in the office. Talkeetna Air Taxi is a professional and well-run operation with great customer service. Definitely check them out!

You've got to give this a try. Kevin made sure we had a great time. He is not only a great pilot and tour guide but will also give you any island information you need. Skip the helicopter and give this a try, Kevin will make sure you have a unique experience. A very different view of the island.

We took the Air Venture tour with pilot JT and had a great experience.  The pilot gave information on the region and sights along the way, and the tour provided cool towels and water for passengers.  My husband and I are celebrating our honeymoon and wanted to do an air tour, and decided this one because it was an airplane and not a helicopter.  We thought this might be the safer approach and were happy that all passengers have a window seat so everyone gets a good view.  We would recommend this tour to everyone for a great way to see the beauty of Kauai.
Very much  enjoyed our fly overbi Kauai.  Justin was very informative and it was a relaxing adventure.

We did the shortest tour (not sure if I labeled correctly on review) and it was epic! We saw tons of nature and plenty of awesome landscapes with Denali. Our pilot was knowledgeable and friendly! Would recommend to anyone as a day trip on the way to or back from Denali!
Flight was amazing and beautiful. Our pilot was professional, courteous and informative. Wonderful time was had by us and friends

review_title: Drop off and pickup in the Amphitheater to stay at the historic mountain house.
review_text: We had a great experience, as always! Great pilots, great staff, reliable and flexible service, excellent communication!

Steve, our pilot was sensational.   We were greeted by name, promptness, and courtesy.  They took our bags and explained the flight procedure.   Steve pointed out areas of interest as we flew over Seattle to the San Juan Island.  He even circled around a pod of playful whales to give us a better look.   It was a smooth flight and a fun day for our whole family!

Beautiful clear skies over the island to see that magnificent landscapes and costal areas of the island.  Great way to see the many canyons and waterfalls. 
Lucky to see some groups ot Humpback whales out to sea and pilot took us down for a closer look.  Excellent commentary from the pilot describing what we were seeing throughout the trip.
Highly recommend the tour and AirVentures.

This is the best activity you can do in Kauai.  Going up in the air lends you access to places people cannot set foot onto otherwise.  I am so glad we booked with Wings Over Kauai.  This small company is run by husband and wife, Bruce and Ellen.  Ellen was so incredibly helpful during the booking of the trip and once we got there, she was so friendly with all smiles.  The flight was so unbelievable personal!  It was Bruce the pilot, myself, and my husband.  We each got headphones to hear Bruce's narration and to ask questions.  We learned SO much from Bruce - he was an agriculturalist-turned-pilot so we learned so much about plant life and planes that I felt smarter when the flight was over.  The other helicopter  companies are VERY obnoxious and overly glitzy.  Go with the real deal!

review_title: This great planet you must see from this perspective
review_text:
A truly exceptional experience to fly above one of out planet's greatest wonders.
They are a highly professional team and courteous to boot.
With trepidation I embarked on the journey on my own and it took a good 30 minutes to adapt to being buoyant over the vastness below.
Helicopters accelerate with their nose downward and that was like the most difficult part as well as the turns! Be forewarned  but do not be dissuaded. It was a fantastic experience and I can't wait to do it again. Especially with Toon at the helm, an experienced and knowledgable pilot who made our tour all the richer. Also the friends you meet will warm your heart.
Tip: Leave a tip to the pilot, he goes beyond his duty to make your visit memorable and safe.
Tip 2: if possible choose the 9.5 hour helicopter / river tour or the Sunset ride. I was left wanting more! 
I've not posted pics because the ones here are formidable.

Best trip ever. You don't want to miss this. To be able to fly so close to the mountains and land on a glazier is just amazing. Pilot is very knowledgeable. The employees are great and so helpful. Plan your trip early on your vacation in case of bad weather you can reschedule. You don't want to miss this!!!

review_title: Incredible, best tour I have been on, would definitely do again!
review_text: Bruce and Patti offer incredible service, an extraordinary experience at a very reasonable price.  My family had 3 adults a 3 year old and a 6 month old on our flight.  Bruce and Patti made all,of us feel comfortable and made the experience great for the kids.  The flight is over 60 minutes of airtime and gives you a view you could never get by driving.  I would recommend doing this early in your trip as Bruce will point out different areas you will want to hit on your trip.  This is definitely worth doing!
No better way to get a feel for the whole island.  The family run business is an outstanding value with a personal touch. A great value - especially compared to the helicopter.

While we missed our Summit Tour with Glacier Landing due to the weather conditions this company was great to work with - both before our trip and once we arrived.  They kept us informed about the status of the flight and we were so disappointed to miss it.  We will be make and make the highly anticipated flight.

review_title: Wonderful tour of Canyonlands and adjacent area
review_text: We totally enjoyed our two-hour flight over Canyonlands and immediate areas.  Our pilot, George, was very informative about the areas we were viewing, history and geological information about them, special sites, the altitudes at which we were flying and general information about the plane (A Cessna 210).

review_title: Maverick Helicopters is a great grand canyon experience - must do in Las Vegas
review_text: We got there, checked in, they were very polite and the Helicopters were very comfortable. Please be punctual, otherwise your transfer will leave without you. 5 stars for Maverick

review_title: The Best of our trip to Alaska
review_text: I wish you had more stars to rate out K2 Aviation experienced.  It was a once in lifetime experience.  We landed on Pica Glacier on a beautiful sunny day.  We even had a marriage proposal on our flight.  It was perfect.  We spent so much money on our trip we almost didn't book the flight.  No matter what else you do in Alaska book this flight.  To top it off there was a young moose crossing the airport runway.  How perfect is that!!!
Views For Days!! Our Pilot Sergio was the best! Definitely Recommend, can’t wait to do it again! The ride was smooth, the weather was great and the company even better.

Great summit trip....with base camp glacier landing.  Visibility was amazing.  Most amazing experience and activity we did in Alaska.  Chris was our pilot, extremely knowledgeable and bvery generous making sure everyone got great views....this was not a quick up and down where you felt like you didn't get your moneys worth.....totally amazing
Beautiful flight from Lake Powell to Moab.  Our pilot, Chip was great, pointing out interesting landmarks. Thanks!

review_title: This is a spectacular tour.  This was the highlight of our trip to Maui.
review_text: This was one of our favorite tours.  The views were spectaular and our guide was very informative about the views we were looking at.  I thought I would be nervous but our tour guide put us as ease.   My daughter, husband and I love, love loved this plane ride.  If you go to Maui you will need to put this at the top of your list of things to do while you are there.   I can't wait to go back and book this tour again!
The views were breathtaking, flight gave a true perspective of the Alaska landscape, and touch down on the water was pure fun!

We had a wonderful experience flying with Chuck when we were in Ketchikan. He calmed our nerves and we could tell he was very experienced. His plane was absolutely perfect. He gave us a lot of information about the area and was great with the kids. My son sat in the cockpit and got great footage on his go pro. His girlfriend was scared and Chuck was very attentive to her needs. She got passed it and had a great flight!! We highly recommend Chuck to fly anyone!!

We had a wonderful pilot (Billy) that was professional, knowledgeable of the history, geography, and very personable. He gave us the safety briefing and kept us informed of where we were flying and allowed us to ask pretty much any question during the flight and on the glacier.

review_title: The only way to see Canyonlands!
review_text: This was an awesome tour! Canyonlands National Park is very large and diverse, so the best way to see it is by air. The plane we were in held 6 passengers which was a perfect size. Also, everyone gets a window seat to ensure you get to see all the wonders if the park. Our pilot, Kim, was a very skilled pilot and knew the area well. We saw many amazing arches, many different landscapes, and learned more about the area. We would recommend this tour to everyone coming to Canyonlands!

review_title: Amazing and very personal sightseeing flight
review_text:
We booked the Combo Tour with Wings Over Kauai. Gina, the lady in the office, is super nice and welcomed us at the airport. You get free drinks and the atmosphare is very familiar. 
Our pilot Captain Doug was outstanding! He showed us all these great valleys and beautiful waterfalls  and you can ask him  questions via headset during the flight. He knows everything about the island! 

If you want a special tour with small groups and see all the valleys of Kauai you can't hike, I can only recommend Wings Over Kauai! 

Thanks again Gina & Doug! We really liked it,

Mona & Selina

Elbert and Jason were a few of the very first pilots I had ever flown with, and they are such amazing men. Amazing pilots, friendly, and they know the bush of Alaska like the back of their hand. Alaska Bush is an outstanding outfit and they always make everyone feel so welcome and right at home.

This was a great experience! We got to tour the island with Desi. She was so fun and knowledgable about the island! The entire staff was so friendly and helpful. We saw amazing views of the island and had a blast! We would definitely do another tour with Air Ventures Hawaii!

My favorite part of the experience was seeing the sea cliffs and water falls. Also, I loved seeing my husband having an opportunity to assist with driving the plane. It was all around an amazing experience. Eric was so accommodating too.

We had a great time on this adventure! Flew with another couple, and the four of us fit well into a small 7 seater plane. Tim was our pilot and guide, a great guy with tons of experience and stories, and a great host. We flew over Arches and Canyonlands and loved every  minute of it. Would recommend this highly, especially if you want to see a lot more than you could hiking.

What an amazing day touring Denali and landing on the glacier!  Truly amazing and beautiful and expertly experienced with our pilot LeAnn. This is an absolute must to really feel the majesticness of this range which also includes Foraier and Hunter Peaks.

We did a tour of the grand canyon via plane, then took a helicopter down into the canyon, did a boat ride on the river then skywalk and had lunch. Our pilot Wyatt was wonderful. Once in a life time visit and it was wonderful.  Highly recommend Westwind .
Awesome experience! The service was top notch and the views were unreal. We even got the chance to fly the plane. I would go again and recommend to anyone!

review_title: Amazing way to see the island - must do
review_text:
I booked the Cessna tour for my wife and I on our babymoon in April. I recommend the private Cessna tour if you only have 2 people.  For only slightly more $$, you get a personal experience.   

Scenery = AMAZING.  Most of Kauai cannot be accessed via car or even foot, so seeing it by plane is the only way to go.  We flew around the western Na Pali coast DIRECTLY THROUGH A RAINBOW.  

The trip finished with a fly through a lush valley untouched by man.  Mountain tops above you in the distance, with multiple waterfalls (like 10+) in sight all feeding into into the valley.  Unreal.

Booking was easy.  Preferred day got washed out because of weather, but they easily rebooked us for another day over the phone.

Overall, highlight of the trip.  A+.

Awesome family-owned operation.  Pilot was great.  Super friendly and knowledgeable about the island and its geography.

review_title: Just go for it! You’ll be glad you did
review_text: It was a great time and unique opportunity. I have tried many other land based services, and this is the first air base service I’ve tried. It’s worth every penny!

There isn't much to say here, except the experience was fantastic. Seeing the landscape from the air was breathtaking, and landing and taking off from the glacier was a hoot. Our pilot, Melissa was superbly qualified and a real pleasure to fly with.  We were fortunate to have exquisite weather. Do this!

They were able to take me last minute and the flight was spectacular as was the weather.   Very competent and obviously experience pilot (and I am one) took us safely very near the peaks and valleys of Denali.    Weather at Denali is very iffy - but if you get a good day go for it!
We had a private flight with Bruce and he was great, very friendly and chatty and so was his daughter who ckecked us in.Saw loads of gorgeous Kauai. Absolutely recommend it!

This is one of the best way to discover the great canyon! We saw it for the sunrise and it was just awesome and so impressive!
The captain was very cool!
Do not hesitate to do it!It worth it!

Chuck the pilot was amazing!!!
We had a early flight and had an amazing day with clean sky . We where super Lucky

K2 Aviation is a super friendly and well-run organization. Views were amazing. So glad my teenage kids got to really see a glacier for what it is. We'd talked about them so much on the rest of our trip but it was all talk until this tour made it real. Breathtakingly real.

K2 picked us up in a shuttle bus from Talkeetna Alaskan Lodge promptly 45 minutes before scheduled takeoff. Belongings you don't want to carry in the tight cabin of the plane are stored in locking bins at the office, one per aircraft. Some of my party are a little squeamish about small planes, but were put at ease by the pilot's safety talk and by the overall clean and competent feel of the place. Our plane had a 1 pilot and 6 passenger capacity, and there were bigger and smaller ones around the airfield. After the 90 minute narrated flight we walked about 5 minutes to downtown Talkeetna for lunch and shopping.

As others have said, weather is likely to mess with your plans. We couldn't do the glacier landing, but it was abundantly clear why. The clouds started at 4000 feet that day and the landing site is at 5000 feet. The front desk staff were super quick and friendly about adjusting the price to match what we actually got to do. Couldn't ask for more.

Highly recommended!

From the very beginning the flight was unbelievable. The sun was shining and the views were beyond spectacular!  A chance of a life time and well worth the price.
Paul made us feel at ease while flying because he was so competent in all aspects of the flight. He was very knowledgeable and informative as well as making us feel comfortable throughout.

After having taken a Denali flight in 2001, I decided I wanted to do a repeat flight out of Talkeetna on my recent visit to Anchorage, Alaska for an airport conference.  With the low ceilings and limited visibility, I decided to wait it out a day for the weather to improve.  On day 2 of my visit to Talkeetna, I decided to sign up for a flight in the early afternoon.  The pilot on my flight was from Alaska and a seasoned pilot that knew the area very well and knew how to read the weather.  We departed Talkeetna in a turbine De Havilland Otter with low ceilings, limited visibility and showers.  This weather was in sharp contrast to my first experience.  The pilot did an exellent job navigating up some of the glacier valleys that were obscured by the limited visibility, but as a pilot myself, I always felt safe and comfortable.  He gave the other passengers and me a good sightseeing ride for about an hour plus fifteen minutes. The pilot also did a great job pointing out significant landmarks and telling us about the history of the area.  I'd highly recommend a flight with K2 Aviation!

We took the Wings Over Kauai flight tour and it was a wonderful experience at about half the price of the helicopter tours.
The flight was as smooth as glass and the views were to die for!
The narrative during the flight was most informative and the hospitality of Bruce and Ellen could not have been better.
When overcast weather was an issue they rebooked our tour and we ended up with the beautiful sunset tour over Kauai.
A 40th anniversary trip to remember!
We can not wait to return the beautiful Hawaiian Islands, the paradise of Kauai and another island flight.
Mahalo Bruce and Ellen!
Marilyn & Jim
from Texas

Our 13 year old was not excited about a helicopter , so we found Eric on here and it was amazing!!!!! So much better than the helicopter my husband and I had taken in Oahu....Not only were the sights amazing from that aerial view, but my teenager was never scared!!!! Eric is extremely knowledge and made sure every second of the trip we were all comfortable and having fun!!! You will be amazed at the things you see you could never view from the ground .....our highlight  were the Moloka’i cliffs !!!! Spectacular!!!!!! Thanks to Eric for An amazing experience for our family of 3!!!

Highly recommend K2 Aviation.  We were scheduled to fly a day later, but woke up yesterday morning to sunny, blue skies so we called K2, and they got us on the first flight out on the McKinley Flyer tour with Ed as our pilot in a twin-engine Piper Chieftain plane.  We were even able to use our Alaska Tour Saver coupon!

It was amazing.  The view of Denali, Mt. Foraker, Mt. Hunter were gorgeous.  Sometimes we felt so close to the mountains that we could reach out and touch them.  We also flew over two climbers' base camps.  It was amazing to see the climbers and their tents below us, and even some of the climbers heading up the mountain.  

Our pilot, Ed, was very informative and kept us apprised of where we were, and what we were seeing.  

If you have a chance to do a flightseeing tour, by all means do it.  Once in a lifetime experience.  K2 Aviation was the best.
We absolutely loved the air tour.  Favorite part of the trip.  Eric was great...funny & knowledgeable.  And he is from Kalamazoo Michigan.  Just an hour from where we live.  Small world!

Company was referred to us by another, who could not accommodate plus size. These folks picked up up at Anchor Cove Mall (free shuttle from cruise ship), fast ride to airport. 
Eric was our pilot, and he did not disappoint. He was very in tune with the three of us with him in the cabin that day. He saw my friend have a very momentary stomach blip- checked in wit him. Saw me wiping eyes, checked in with me. I was just teary from the awe-inspiring views. Extremely responsive. Directed each of our attention to views we'd have, but also maneuvered expertly so that we all got the views! Reacted quickly to changing conditions, taking advantage of opportunities to go after sights that unexpectedly came up. Some of the most superlative beauty I have ever beheld. Anyone who says you "can't see anything" from a small plane... is trying to sell you a helicopter trip, lol. 
I'd be back up in a heartbeat. 
Then our driver back responded to unexpected traffic backups by taking the scenic route- and it really was! Nobody on it, either- he knew his back roads. Also liked that they worked as a team- our second driver was also a pilot.

Great way to see the napali coast and other highlights from the island. Bruce does a great job explaining the history of the island and answering any questions you may have. He has a very calm,  pleasant, comforting demeanor

Pros:
Half the cost of a helicopter ride
Guaranteed a window seat
Minimal turbulence - which is great for someone that gets motion sick on helicopters or boats
Runs on time
Friendly service

Had a great and personal experience with owner/pilot Bruce.  Bruce pointed out all the sights and engaged each member of the family by name in conversation.  We had a smooth and beautiful flight that enabled us to see parts of Kauai that we wouldn't be able to see by any other means..  Highly recommend Wings Over Kauai to any first time or repeat traveler to Kauai.
The flight was amazing, we had great view of the islands and we got to see some whales. Eric is very friendly and punctual.

Although we had to reschedule the tour to a morning due to high wind, this tour exceeds all my expectations. Canyonlands is notoriously inaccessible due to the lack of paved roads and connections between three major districts of the park. The flightseeing tour gave me the ability to see parts of the park that requires either high clearance 4x4 vehicle or hours of strenuous hiking. The view was so unique that I burnt through 100GB of storage on my camera in just 1 hour.

Amazing experience all around.  Tony, our pilot, was a great guy and went out of his way to make sure everyone had a fun trip.  The next time I get a chance, I will basically go out of my way to take another trip with them.  Thanks again!!

My family and I had the great pleasure of taking this flight this past October.  Bruce and Ellen made us feel truly welcomeas soon as we arrived.  The flight itself was perfect.  Bruce is extremely knowledgeable about the island and it's history.  The pictures I was able to get were beautiful.  The cost of this was less than half of the price for the helicopter tours.  The surprise gifts at the beginning and end were just icing on the cake.  I have told all my friends back home that after that tour in the air I spent the rest of my time looking for a job in Kauai.
It was amazing!! Highly recommend! The views were immaculate & the pilot was so knowledgeable! Would go again!

We thoroughly enjoyed our Grand Canyon Aerial Tour with our pilot Carla. 
The plane was comfortable and air conditioned! I highly recommend this company for your tour! They are timely and communicated well prior to our tour!!
Great experience. Awesome views. Highly recommend going on this tour. Safe flight and knowledgeable pilot.
Perfect conditions, wonderful views, and interesting commentary.  We couldn't have asked for a better flight.  Different to a helicopter and equally good.

Fantastic way to see the Golden Gate Bridge and Alcatraz from the air in a seaplane especially sat next to the pilot. A 20 minute journey was just enough . Conditions were very calm so the ride was serene and the pilot was very informative. Well worth the money.
We had Adam as our pilot and he was amazing! It was such a beautiful flight and Adam was great as a tour guide. Also, if you have the opportunity to be the copilot, it is a must do!

At the spur of the moment, my friend and I️ decided to take a helicopter tour of the Grand Canyon with Maverick Helicopters. While on a day tour, with Detours of Phoenix, to Sedona and the GC the option to view the canyon was offered (for an additional fee) and we jumped at the chance. Having never flown in a helicopter, and always fearful, I️ decided “I️ only live once, so why not?!” 

WOW!!! What a ride! We couldn’t have asked for a better view of this beautiful natural wonder. Sean, our pilot, is professional, friendly, and reassuring. He is a former military helicopter pilot, which in my book is big deal in terms of skill (and Sean, thank you for your service). Before taking off, Sean told us about the helicopter, went over safety procedures. The ground crew assisted us in buckling up and with our headphones.  Sean is quite knowledgeable of the Grand Canyon’s animal life, history and it’s many special sites, answered all our questions as we flew. 

The helicopter itself is top-notch. We were told that Mavericks fleet is the youngest in the area flying the Grand Canyon. Seats are comfortable. Large viewing areas to give the best views possible. We were fortunate to have had two of the front seats, and were able to take some great shots. 

The flight is 45 minutes in duration and we loved every minute of it! Thank you to Maverick and Sean for a great experience. 

(A side note... I️ really enjoyed the flights playlist - Top Gun’s theme song was among some of the tunes played as we flew. Nice touch!)

Diane and Lynne

review_title: Air Ventures Hawaii - Kauai - Loved It!
review_text: Our flight on a sunny Sunday morning was awesome.  It was a great way to see the beauty of the entire island, from a different perspective than we could see by land or sea.   The pilot was great, sharing lots of interesting information as our guide, and giving us a very smooth ride.  The staff was great, reservations were easy to make, and they provided simple directions so we could readily find their site at the airport and we were well prepared for what to bring and what to expect.   We took advantage of the package pricing, doing the Air & Sea combo, and loved our dinner cruise around the Napali coast as well.

Our flight over Denali with a glacier landing was fantastic. The ride was the smoothest I have ever experienced on a plane and the glacier landing was breathtaking. It was beyond beautiful. I would highly recommend this trip to anyone in the area.

We booked after we got off the ship and saved a bunch of money!!! The ship price was 280 and we got the trip for 230... Naomi took us to the plane and Mike took us flying. It was wonderful even on a rainy day. We saw a whale and felt very safe....family run business that makes you feel welcome.  If you want to be sure you get them I would call ahead. From the time we left the boat to in the air was 15 mins....

review_title: Most memorable day of our trip
review_text: Highly recommend this excursion and this provider. Top notch outfit. Professional without being stuffy. Fun & engaging pilot with lots of great info for his passengers. Totally amazing once-in-a-lifetime experience. Worth every penny (and this from a penny-pincher).
This was a Phenomenal experience! Eric our piolet was very accomadating and made sure everyone had a good view of valcano! Highly recommend this plane ride.

We had an amazing time on our Flights! Grew up out here but haven't been able to take in the gorge scenery fully until not. Professional and personable pilot. Definitely will be back. Never flown before, and he was happy to explain what to expect any why. I can't say enough good things about this company. Good job guys!

My family of 5 recently took an AirVan ride touring the island of Kauai. We got there early, and were offered books to peruse while we waited. Josh was our pilot. He was very knowledgeable, educating/entertaining us the entire way, and we each had our own window seats! The ride was rocky, but that was not Josh's fault - It was a windy day. Besides, there are water and juices available onboard, as well as "bags" at each seat.  (At one point, I thought I would lose it, but it didn't happen! Thank goodness!) We got to see places we would not otherwise see by land -- the NaPali Coast, where our boat tour was cancelled because of rough seas -- and beautiful waterfalls everywhere! Seeing the island by air was fantastic! It gives you a whole new perspective. I highly recommend the owners and Wings Over Kauai. (Give Billie the dog a pat on the head from us! What a low-key, nice dog!)

My husband and I did the Cessna tour today with Wings Over Kauai. This is an amazing trip - we saw waterfalls, canyons, coastline and parts of the island that you can't see from the car. Marcus, our pilot, explained what we were seeing and answered questions. The highlight was Na Pali Coast - it was so incredibly beautiful that I had tears in my eyes. Total thumbs up for Wings Over Kauai - this is a must do when you're on Kauai.

This is a wonderful experience we will never forget. We did the Glacier landing tour and it was amazing! Landing at the top of the mountain surrounded by snow/glacier mountains is an unbelievable feeling.  
The staff are really nice.
Will do it again if I get the chance! 
I definetly recommend this tour to everyone!

I am very afraid of flying in anything so I was extremely apprehensive to go on the tour. Even before we got onto the plane, our guide began to erase my fears. He did his best throughout the flight to keep me engaged even while telling us all of the rich history of Kauai. I would definitely go again and use Air Ventures Hawaii to do so. Mahalo!

review_title: A must do when you visit Kauai.
review_text: What great hosts Ellen and Bruce are for this flying excursion. They obviously enjoy what they do. A fab way to see they island and learn from a local about the history and what it has to offer. Highly recomend it to any age. Thanks.
This flight was the most beautiful thing I have ever experienced. Our pilot Andy flew great and the glacier landing was fantastic.

My family and I took a plane ride with Air Ventures in August 2013.  If you are visiting Kauai, I would highly you recommend you see it by air.  Or you will be missing most of the beauty of the island.  We originally picked the plane due to weight restrictions on the helicopters.  The planes do not have any, but afterwards I was glad we choose the plane.  The pilot was excellent and very professional.  He gave a very informative narrative as we flew around the island.  It also included the sea tour with our package, which was also worth it and together, was a well rounded tour of what Kauai has to offer by sea and air.  Go with Air Ventures, you won't be disappointed.

review_title: Fabulous views of Alaska Range and Denali
review_text: Expensive but well worth while flight from Talkeetna with glacier landing . We were surprised how despite the clouds around Talkeetna, we had almost prefect blue sky above the mountains. Excellent pilot - Thank you Matt.
James was our pilot and guide, he was great. Being able to see the vastness and beauty of both Park's from the air with no long lines was incredible. I highly recommend this for adults and teens.

This was a chance of a lifetime experience! Every part of the adventure was easy and so worth the money. To see the Grand Canyon from above was something that my kids will remember forever. We each had our own viewing window with great narration to enhance the experience. Captain Jack was awesome!

Our first float plane flight. The tour was great. The takeoff and landing was very smooth. Excellent pilot/tour guide. They picked us up at our ship and dropped us off at a restaurant that we wanted to go to. The owners and family were very outgoing and nice. They made us feel right at home. The tour was great. I would definitely do it again.

This trip around Mt Denali was breath taking and our pilot was awsome on knowledge and making sure we all had great views for pictures. The sky around the mountain was clear but the weather that day was unstable and we were not able to land on summit. They were great about the refund. Everyone was so nice. This is the best way to see Mt Denali. I highly suggest it!
We were not able to fly due to weather and they were gracious to book us the next day and we had a wonderful time. Beautiful sights and fun to land in the glacier!

Took a 1 hr flight around island of Kauai around noon with 4 other family members during our stay on 4/14/2010. So glad we decided to do this as a family. Saw so many waterfalls and,of course, the "Grand Canyon of the Pacific", plus other areas that are not accessible by car. Staff was friendly, courteous and enthusiastic. Donna was born and raised in Kauai and you could see she was definitely proud of her little island. Plane was quieter than expected, and we were all able to converse with each other during the flight! Landing was sooooo smooth. I would do this again!!

We had questionable weather with heavy clouds and some rain, Josh gave us the option to cancel but also gave us some knowledgeable insights about what to expect, noting the cloud deck was high enough to ensure great visibility and numerous waterfalls due to the weather pattern. Boy were we glad to keep the flight! My wife and I, and two young boys had the absolute best experience, exceeding our already very high expectations. His knowledge of the island, insights that varied from Kauai history to agronomy to geological facts, just fantastic. Viewing what may be the most beautiful place on earth from above, was matched with the quality of the people we met with Wings Over Kauai. What a collection of expertise and character. We enjoyed meeting Bruce, Dori and Josh. If you are planning a trip to Kauai, this tour is a must. Everything else in your schedule will stop short of this experience. Mahalo Mahalo Mahalo!
Fantastic views and great experience! Easy, convenient to get to. Terrific, knowledge and friendly pilot. Do it!
Beautiful tour around the islands and we even saw a few whales. Friendly and professional pilot. I highly recommend the tour!

What a great excursion!  Our pilot Eric made this experience a great one with his tips and knowledge of the island.  Bonus that he was able to point out 2 whales for us to see!  The plane was very smooth and comfortable with great views from every seat.  I highly recommend this trip!

I highly recommend to take an early morning flight over the Grand Canyon as it will give you an idea of how huge it actually is. The pilot was German (Martin) and he was very nice and told us some interesting facts. They are well organised and everything went smoothly, the flight too.
The flight was amazing and the pilot was so entertaining and the views wrte spectacular and i had a great tine.

This was a great option as it was more affordable than a helicopter, more environmental, AND I was able to bring my toddler who slept through the entire tour with his headphones on.

I must admit, the first few minutes on the plane were a little scary.  The plane is the smallest I've ever been on.  Luckily, the pilot's narration and background Hawaiian music put me at ease.

I was also worried because the sky seemed cloudy over the Waimea Canyon, hence I wondered if we would see any nice views.  Well, the views were amazing, and the Napali coast was completely clear with views of a beautiful blue ocean.

I am so glad this was part of my trip to Kauai!
The Flight was Amazing !  Our Pilot was Friendly & Professional ! He pointed out Many Interesting Sights.....I will do this Again ! AA ++

JT the pilot was great. Everyone is super friendly and helpful. The flight path took in the whole of Kauai and was gorgeous. We were beyond happy with the whole day. Highly recommended for your sightseeing pleasures.

What a great way to see Kauai! It was absolutely stunning, the people who work for the company are very caring and accommodating. The weather hadn’t been on our side during the week and we were still able to go the day we were leaving! Absolutely recommend!
Amazing flight, great entertaining and informative pilot. Went at 10 in early January, not too many clouds and only a bit of turbulence.
absolutely first class service and worth every cent.Ely our pilot was a very good host and guide

We had the privilege of doing the Grand Canyon West Rim Adventure Tours.  We will never forget this AMAZING experience!!!  From the welcoming staff to  the incredible views, this is worth every single penny.  I am so glad that I decided to invest in this experience!  Our pilot/tour  guide, Colby, absolutely made the trip the best that it could be.  He was friendly, funny, knowledgeable - what more could you ask for???  We loved this guy!!!  If you are debating about whether or not to book, JUST DO IT!  You will be so glad you did!!!

review_title: Not gonna lie, I was nervous...
review_text: I was absolutely nervous to fly in a tiny plane, but our pilot Marcus was AMAZING! He absolutely put us at ease and showed us some incredible sights and breathtaking views. The ENTIRE experience was unforgettable and I loved every single minute of it!

Great trip, really informative pilot, he took us all over Miami including the port and beaches, great fun taking off and landing on the water, very enjoyable view of Miami, highly recommended and not expensive either.
Highlight of our Alaska trip.  Wonderful views, recommend for all ages!  (I will be 80 in Dec).  Very nice folks too.

My friends, my husband and I had the most wonderful "Bird's-eye view" of Kaua'i! Being able to go around the whole Island and seeing the beautiful terrain from the air made our visit here complete! Our pilot was very knowledgeable and informative. We got lots of amazing pictures! I would heartily suggest making plans to include a flight in your vacation. It's an experience you will never forget!

Simply unbelievable flying above the plateau, incredible views and our Captain Craig was informative thorough and extremely proffesional.  Would recommend as a must to see the canyon by fixed wing aircraft!

review_title: K2 Mt Denali flight and Glacier landing
review_text:
Great trip. Skillful pilot, gave lots of commentary. Showed us base camp and 11 000ft camp. The stillness of the glacier was only broken by the sound of an avalanche. Spectacular to see. 

Expensive but the rewards more than cover the cost. A MUST DO

We loved our Base Camp Tour with a Glacier Landing $350.00 pp. Alex was our pilot and did a great job giving us views of Mt McKinley from all sides of the mountain. Landing on The Ruth Glacier and walking was also a neat experience. We were very blessed to have an evening of beautiful weather and Alex ranked our flying conditions as a 10. We took a 6:00 flight which lasted two hours which was the perfect time of day and amount of time. Trip is well worth your money.

review_title: Best way to see Napali Coast!
review_text: We wanted to visit the Napali Coast, but it's only available by air or boat.  We looked into the boat cruises.  The one we looked at started at 8am and would take 5 hours.  There were mixed reviews on TripAdvisor, and we decided we didn't want to spend that much time on a boat, especially since we both got sea sick on the last boat we were on.  Many people reported sea sickness in their reviews.  Also, the price was $150 per person.  We decided to go with the #1 choice on TripAdvisor---Wings Over Kauai.  It costs $125; you get to see the entire island; and it only lasts 1 hour...not an entire day event.  It's also much cheaper than a helicopter, and I'm not sure what the disadvantages are.  My husband and I went with 1 other couple that we didn't know and the pilot.  Booking the trip was easy.  I called Bruce and reserved over the phone.  He was very polite.  Our pilot was knowledgeable.  We absolutely loved the trip and agree with other reviewers on TripAdvisor that this is definitely the best way to see Napali Coast!  They also take a picture of you outside the plane and email it to you, and they gave the girls kukui leis.

We had an excellent experience with Wings over Kauai.  Bruce and Sophie were super friendly and accommodating.  They went above and beyond to make sure we felt welcomed and attended to.

The flight itself was phenomenal.  All of the "Kauai highlight" areas were hit and Bruce did a great job talking about each one.  He was also good at engaging each of us in conversation throughout the flight, which made for a more personalized experience.

If you are looking for a fun way to see the gorgeous island of Kauai for literally half the cost of a helicopter tour, make sure you check out Wings over Kauai!

Mahalo!

review_title: The Best in Grand Canyon Helicopter Tours
review_text: We looked  into other tours, but chose  Maverick Helicopters because they offered the most for the cost and flight time.

This was not in my plan when traveling to Denali via talkeetna. I had a free afternoon and decided to check it out and was very glad that I did! I did the flight seeing tour with a Glacier lading. The views were so magnificent and spectacular all over..  The glacier landing (on Ruth glacier) was very exciting and we spent about 20 mins on the glacier.  I spent the entire time just sitting on the snow and staring at the pristine beauty. The experience was surreal , in the next possible way, and would definitely recommend adding a glacier landing to your alaskan adventure itinerary.

Our pilot was fantastic,  very informative and we had a great landing and sightseeing tour!

The only thing I would recommend is doing the trip on a clear day and they are really good about letting you know about the weather before you head out.

review_title: First Class Flight Tour of Kauai
review_text: How often do you get a chance to fly in an open cockpit biplane? Our pilot, Harry, was friendly and very experienced. The plane is quite new, and in great shape, the intercom system was Bose, with noise cancellation feature. Biplanes don't offer photo opportunities like other aerial platforms, but I got some good pics, and great memories. This is a very professional outfit. Harry treated us to some mild aerobatics with stalls and wingovers on request. The Napili Coast is beautiful. Our flight was 1 hour & less expensive than a helicopter ride.

review_title: Fear of flying?   Well, my door did pop open as we were taking off.
review_text: We booked a half hour flight with another couple that told us the gentleman was flying on the recommendation of his psychologist.  He got pretty nervous after takeoff, Pilot Fred turned back with grace and good humor.  Upon the second takeoff the starboard door popped open. No biggie, Fred settled the plane back down into the water and we got the door secured. After that we had an amazing and wonderful flight.   Super views and deep knowledge of the SF Bay Area, a great tour for locals or visitors alike.   We highly recommend this ride!

review_title: Soaring at a Gentle Pace Over the Canyon
review_text:
We took the air tour on the STOL (short take off and landing) aircraft and were not disappointed.  We did the Grand Discovery Air Tour, a 45 minute narrated run about the Canyon that was just right. We saw immense parts of the Canyon, including the North Rim, from such a wonderful vantage point and without the crowds that swarm over the South Rim.  It was a real treat! 

Note on seating: the rows are two-by-two on the right side of the plane, but single seats on the left. We did not have advance reservations so we had what was available, which meant my boyfriend and I did not get to sit together.  I was not happy about this as the agent did not inform us of the seating arrangements when we purchased the tickets.  We naturally assumed the seats were together.  The company needs to stress to agents that they be clear about the seating so passengers know what to expect.  Hence I was frowning when they took the official photo of us just before boarding!  It worked out o.k., since we were behind each other and we both had window seats this way, but we should have been informed of the seating and choices on other flights. 

All in all, a great ride.  The plane only goes 100 mph, and it's altitude is low for sight-seeing, so you really get a great view and great ride.  The Colorado River is up pretty close that way, you can even see the rapids!

A great way to see the Canyon.  Thumbs up!

review_title: Our 2nd time with Wings Over Kauai! But not our last!
review_text:
As you can tell, we were so thrilled and excited to be able to book our second flight with WOK!  Once we booked the cruise, the very first tour that I booked (20 months in advance) was Wings Over Kauai!  
I took on the task of coordinating this excursion for our Cruise Critic Roll Call group.  When all was said and done we had booked their Van 8 and Cessna tours full for the entire day!  That was 5 flights for the Cessna and the Van 8.  Everyone that took the flight was thrilled and excited that we had the opportunity to book such a great tour on our 28 Day Hawaii, American Samoa & Fr. Polynesian Islands Cruise.  
Working with Ellen and Bruce was as easy as falling off a log, as they are truly professionals and provide a wonderful tour.  In your wildest imagination of what to expect you will come up short.  It is everything that you would expect and so much more that I can honestly say that on our next cruise to Hawaii, (yes there will be another) we expect to book the WOK Flight again.  Could you ask for a stronger recommendation?
Just Mike

This was the first stop on my Alaskan vacation and it was by far the most memorable.  A Talkeetna Air driver picked me up in this picturesque town (think Northern Exposure) and dropped me off at the airport a mile away.  There I was greeted by a friendly representative who cautioned that the questionable weather could impact the views of Denali and the possibility of a glacier landing.  Lucky for me, Leanne (the pilot) assured me that we were going in the opposite direction of the the thunder and lightning.  Having donned the headphones hanging on the strap, Leann explained what we were seeing and the gave us an unforgettable tour. We flew around the Denali summit and came in for a smooth landing on a glacier where we took lots of pictures and videos.  I highly recommend doing this if you are anywhere near Denali.

I have flown with K2 several times over the years and all have been lifelong memorable experiences.  Great staff and pilots with good headsets and audio.  The pilots have always made the flight safe and awe inspiring with great talks about the mountains, glaciers, and history.  I hope I will get a chance to do another trip.
We had a wonderful time - amazing views of Kauai that you can't get from any other means of travel.  Our pilot was personable and knowledgeable.

I must come back again to take pictures 
Muny things i can find in the sky
As a photographer, I would love to visit again! Thanks
Let me add my 5 star comment to those before me, if you are going to see Kauai by air, this is the way to do so!  Everything about the experience was top notch, from check-in to goodbyes.

We did the summit tour on June 15, 2012. I preferred K2 because of their summit tour flight path that is posted on the website and recommendations on TA and Cruisecritic. We were fortunate to be able to book two seats on that morning when we saw that skies would be sunny and fairly clear over the Alaskan range. I liked K2's flightpath on the summit tour. We spiraled around Denali (McKinley) and flew around Mts. Foraker and Hunter. This is a must see tour when the skies are clear. Close up views of the mountains were awesome. We also enjoyed the flights over the glaciers. K2 uses a 7 passenger twin engine plane for the summit tour. My wife volunteered me to sit in the co-pilot seat, and I was very happy. Ed was our pilot. He was very thorough on the safey briefing especially on wearing the oxygen mask. He was very friendly and gave a good description of the terain. He was also good at picking out climbers on the mountains and showing us the location of base camps. Because of the good weather, Ed was able to stick to the planned flightpath. We loved this tour and given the opportunity would do it again with K2.

Best way to see and learn the history and information about the island and her people. Paul, our pilot was the best! We had someone who was getting a little airsick, he was very calm and spoke to her often and kept her focus where it should be. He was also very diplomatic with another flier who was difficult and mouthy. So glad we made the trip ;)

Our first experience with small aircraft in Alaska was fantastic. The flight was so magnificent and the views defy description. Shiloh was our southern dream. From Jacksonville, he was very welcoming host and although new to flying in Alaska, we would have thought he was local and had flown the area for years. Both self assured & confident as well as reassuring to his passengers, he was a delight! He encoraged questions and answered all expertly. We would certainly fly with Talkeetna Air & especially, Shiloh again.
Very friendly pilot. Definitely a 5 star experience.  It was exactly what I was looking for when planning my trip.

review_title: Fantastic view of the island that can not be missed.
review_text: I was able to get amazing photos with my telephoto lens of places we had been before. My favorite was the Napali Coast and Kalalau which we had hiked a number of years ago. It was wonderful to see it from the air. I recommend this flight to everyone  - smooth, comfortable a ble to see everything.

Bottom line, don't pay $250-300 to go on a helicopter tour.  This much more personalized tour is great and Bruce is very knowledgeable of the island.  He does a good job with the plane and with his explanations.  He always make sure you are included in all of the conversations and the whole crew makes you feel right at home from the first moment you walk up.  We really enjoyed it, although my wife got a little nauseous in the air...not to fret, they have peppermint and other things that help with that once you're in the air.  I would definitely recommend Wings Over Kauai - the island is beautiful!

I'd been hoping to rent a single engine airplane during our recent trip to Kauai.  I'm a private pilot, and my wonderful wife was looking for a way to see the island while allowing me to indulge my flying passion.  We found Ellen and Captain Bruce searching on line, and are glad we did.  I logged the flight time as "pilot in command" with Bruce in the co-pilot seat, and my wife-family photographer  in the back seat.  

Bruce and Ellen's late model Cessna 172S is spacious and clean.  What I appreciated most was how stable the aircraft flys around the beautiful mountain palis.  And with it's high wing configuration, you get to see everything around and below you.  My wife took over 100 photos during our 70 minute adventure.  

After circling the island and flying over Wiama Canyon, we contacted the Lihue tower for a clearance to land.    The entire experience was excellent, providing an up close  view of areas otherwise inaccessible.   As a private pilot, it was a real thrill for me to land the aircraft on the same island runway that the large commercial jets, including the one we had flown in used.  Whether you're a pilot, or  you let Captain Bruce do all the flying for you, I'd recommend Wings Over Hawaii...for anyone wanting a safe, slow ride around the Garden Isle!

We just flew with Capt Bruce this week...a wonderful experience.   Being fearful of flying, Bruce put me at ease and made me feel safe.   The views were phenomenal, the service was very friendly and professional and the tour vey informative.  Definitely recommend  Wings  over Kauai

Absolutely incredible experience flying over the stunning landscapes of Kauai! From breathtaking views of the Na Pali Coast to the vibrant greenery of Waimea Canyon, every moment of the flight felt like a dream. The pilot was knowledgeable and passionate, sharing fascinating insights about the island's history, geology, and culture, which added so much depth to the experience.

The flight was smooth, and the small plane allowed for amazing panoramic views—you truly see parts of Kauai that are otherwise unreachable. That said, I did feel a bit queasy during the flight, likely from a combination of motion and looking down at the dramatic scenery. But honestly, it didn’t detract from the overall experience—it was well worth it!

Despite a little motion sickness, this is a 5-star experience I’d recommend to anyone visiting Kauai. Just be prepared if you’re prone to getting queasy, and you’ll have an unforgettable adventure!

We had a pleasant flight around the perimeter of Kauai and took lots of photos.  Due to the rain that day, there were too many clouds to fly safely into the interior.  Harry, our pilot, gave us interesting, colorful, informative commentary throughout the flight.  His love for the island was clear and added depth and meaning.  Nicole was very helpful and friendly.  We'll be back!  Thank you!

An awesome way to see the parts of Kaua'i that you can't see by car.  Friendly staff. Maximum 6 people on the tour. Our pilot, Paul, did a great job telling us about all the landmarks we were flying over. We saw the Na Pali Coast, the Little Grand Canyon, all the beaches, where certain shows were filmed, and where some of the stars live. The highlight was the pod of Humpback Whales just below us!!! 

Do this trip early in your visit to get a good overall perspective on the whole island.

Flight was excellent.had been postponed at 8am due to forest fires but we got in the air at 3pm.only 30 mins but still worth it.i had bought a maverick hat that morning and after the flight I got staff discounts on 2 posters and a photo from the staff when they saw my hat!Very generous and friendly people!

We did not get the experience we booked. The cloud cover and fog prevented us from seeing Denali and landing on the glacier. Those were the top 2 things we booked the trip for. BUT...they did take us up on a shorter trip that was still amazing AND refunded the difference promptly. I believe they did the best they could do considering circumstances beyond their control.  What more can you ask for? I recommend this company 100%. They are organized, care about the experience and the safety of their guests. The operation was well run and worth the cost.

Communication regarding the weather was excellent.  I went by myself and found the entire experience from start to finish was superb.  The staff and the pilot were outstanding.  I highly recommend this adventure on Kauai.  Marcus the pilot was very good, and the narration was interesting and informative.
My family and I had the privilege of landing on the Ruth Glacier. Would highly recommend a glacier landing. Patrick was our pilot he was fantastic, very knowledgeable and we had so much fun!

This truly was the highlight of our time in the Grand Canyon. No we can confidently say "We have seen the Grand Canyon"! Worth every dollar! 

We had originally booked for Wednesday afternoon, but the trip was cancelled due to heavy winds. This made us feel very safe, as we were slightly concerned in the morning.. Our tour was rescheduled for the next morning. Great service

We were all very impressed with the entire experience, from our welcome greeting to our well wishes when leaving. Our pilot was amazing - he obviously loves Kauai and is excited to share the most beautiful areas.

This was maybe the best experience we had during our three weeks in AK. We were concerned that the flight would be cancelled due to a heavy smoke haze from several fires. I emailed the day before and was told they were taking it hour by hour. When our driver picked us up at the lodge he gave us a couple of options.  We decided to ride over and wait on the pilot to decide. The pilot assured us once we reached a certain altitude we would be out of smoke, but safety first. I certainly questioned our decision until we reached about 9,000ft. We had a clear view of everything. Absolutely amazing, I’m sure my jaw was on the floor for at least 45 minutes. I have few words to describe the beauty and feeling of awe that we both experienced other than ‘do not miss this flight!’

We had an awesome flight with Leanne - such a smooth flight and take off and landing and our trip around Denali was simply breathtaking! No bad seats on Leanne’s plane as she ensured everyone had a good view from all seats. So glad we did this and Mother Nature gave us an awe inspiring and simply amazing display! I booked this trip thinking it wouldn’t be much but how wrong I was!! Thank you Leanne, your flying and narration were fantastic! Mum and I had the best time!!!
