Wings Over Kauai has small airplanes that fly over Kauai.  It's a great alternative to a helicopter!  There were 6 of us so we chartered the plane as a group.  Bruce, the owner and pilot, made us very comfortable and was very professional.  The flight was smooth and the scenery was spectacular!

review_title: Awesome Experience - Great investment for the experience
review_text: We did so many amazing things during our time at the Grand Canyon, but this was by far the best.  Our pilot, Dave, was fantastic.  He really took the time to point out the many points of interest in the canyon.  He was great with our kids (ages 10 and 13), and you could tell he really enjoys what he does.  This is the best way to take in the vastness of the canyon in a short period of time.  I highly recommend!

I never really thought of flight sightseeing as an attraction. Our guides suggested TAT so we decided to do the green route and land on the Tokositna Glacier. We flew in a Twin Otter and our pilot was great. There were amazing views of Denali, the rivers, and glaciers. We flew around the summit and got closeup views of the surrounding mountains. I have never seen anything so beautiful. When we landed on the glacier there was sparking snow, and we romped around for about half an hour. The landing is really worth it. This is definitely one of my favorite activities in Alaska. DON'T MISS IT!

If you're on the fence about a flightseeing experience, you must take the plunge. This was, by far, the best part of our trip to Alaska. The glacier landing was the highlight of our tour. I thought I'd be scared on the small plane, but it wasn't scary at all. We had a smooth ride and the views were just surreal. Having the opportunity to see Denali up close was such a privilege. This is a must do! K2 Aviation is awesome!

This was a 3 week retirement vacation in August for my husband and Talkeetna Air was one of our excursions and it was our favorite thing we did! We did the tour over and around Denali and our pilot was extremely kind and explained all details of the beautiful mountain! We will do this again when we return hopefully next year! Great tour and worth the money!
It was awesome! The scenery was breathtaking, and our pilot was fantastic. The glacier landing was unbelievable. So warm up there with the sun shining, I left my coat in the plane.

This flight was amazing from the greeting at the airport to the DVD of the flight. Dad and Daughter greeted us and we were soon on the plane. It was roomy, cool and a nice ride...unlike the helicopters. The price is about a third of the copters for two to three times more flight time. Gorgeous smooth ride. All captured on a DVD which is worth the small price. Go Pros on each wing! A definite must with a great family business. Kauai from the air is not to be missed.

We originally booked the Denali Grand Tour with glacier landing but the weather was not cooperating. We rescheduled for a few days later on our way back through the area. Unfortunately, weather came in and it was too dangerous to fly beyond some of the glaciers. We never saw Denali the whole trip but that was just bad luck with the weather. August is the rainy season.  K2 was very accommodating and made it possible for us to enjoy the Experience flight which our party of four loved. The glaciers are amazing!  We got fantastic photos and my husband got to be the co-pilot. All of the staff at K2 were so nice and easy to talk to. The pilot, Lou, was experienced and very knowledgeable. He shared a lot of information during the flight.  The front desk issued a refund very quickly and they even shipped my sunglasses to me which I had left in the back pocket of the seat in front of me (for the price of postage.  If we are ever in the area again, we will fly with K2. P.S. we flew with K2 8 years ago and had the glacier landing and saw Denali!

review_title: Great tour!  We would reccomend this to...
review_text: Great tour!  We would reccomend this to anyone looking to see the hidden Kauai as well as the not so hidden Kauai.  Harry,the pilot,was very informative and all staff very personable.

We were only spending 3 days on Kauai, so we wanted to see the most we could.
Air Ventures was just a fun, easy experience from start to finish.
We had mentioned some things to the pilot we were interested in, and he pointed them out when we were in the air!

I had wanted to fly in a biplane most all of my life, I'm 60 years old, but I just had never done so. While researching for a trip to Kauai for my wife and me I came across Air Ventures' “YMF-5 Super” Waco  biplane and knew that was the ride for me. My wife was a bit apprehensive about riding in a small, open-cockpit airplane. I assured her that she would love it, and boy did she!
Our pilot, Harry, briefed about the airplane itself, and about the flight that we were about to leave on. After a few photos we were strapped in; the headphones plugged in and working, and we were off.
The day was a cloudy one, with the clouds clinging to the ridges and mountaintops all the way around the island. It mattered not one bit. The views were still incredible. I knew the plane would not be the best photography platform, but we still got numerous good photos. I would not recommend taking a tele- of any kind. Shoot wide-angle with a long focus. For us, though, this was not a photo trip, photos were an added bonus, but a ride of a lifetime.
The ride in an open-cockpit biplane just can't be beat, and to do it over and around Kauai was even better than my expectations. The roar of the American-made rotary seven-cylinder engine, and the wind ruffling about provided a very tactile experience, such as I have never experienced in small planes or helicopters.
All along, Harry kept us informed as to what we were seeing, and he was able to give us pieces of the histories of the Hawaiian peoples associated with them. 
If you want close up to the waterfalls and cliff faces, or are looking to take the ultimate photograph, then maybe a ride in Air Ventures' “YMF-5 Super” Waco may not be for you. But, if you want to have the biggest grin that will fit on your face when you climb back out of the plane, then this trip fits the bill.
Thanks to all the employees of Ventures for their attention and kindness, and a special "Mahalo" to Harry for the ride. Aloha!!

review_title: One Hour Air Tour of Kauai
review_text: A fantastic flyover of the island.  A beautiful land with mountains, waterfalls, plantations, golf courses and the Napali Coast.  JT, the pilot was excellent and provided insight to the island.  He took a jog to view two whales swimming along a boat.  4 visitors on the plane without any viewing issues.  The couple that joined us took a helicopter ride earlier their trip at Hilo.  He was stuck in the middle back and was not pleased with the outcome.  Thus, the subsequent plane trip at Kauai.  He was very pleased with our tour.

The experience was great! Everyone treated us well. The ride was not only fun but the pilot had lots of good information through out the ride. We took a helicopter ride a couple days earlier. I recommend this ride over the helicopter.

We took the Pride of AMERICA Cruise around the islands and this was far and away the best of the five excursions we took.  Our pilot, Kevin, was fantastic.  I would do this again tomorrow if I was still in Hawaii.

Due to all the closures of the National Parks we had to do some last minute re-arranging and planning. Westwind was very helpful and assisted us in getting our trip back on track. We did the adventure tour and it was worth every penny spent. We really enjoyed the helicopter ride into the Canyon. It was a great way to see all the different perspectives of this magnificent natural wonder in one short visit. The company is very professional and from the moment you enter through the doors you are in great hands.

We’ve done plane and helicopter tours on vacation before, but nothing compares to riding in an open cockpit biplane and doing wing overs! What a memorable experience. Our pilot was Harry, who pointed out all the points of interest with a little history of the area. So fun!
Excellent experience, our pilot, Eric, did an amazing job of showing us Maui and Molokai! Do it!!!! Do not miss the trip, great time!

This was the best value and awesome way to see this island. Harry wa a great pilot who made sure we were all doing well on our flight. He was good at answering any questions we had. I would very much recommend anyone going here to visit Air Ventures.

Great experience, John the pilot was superb and his knowledge during the tour was exceptional. On the day the shuttle service broke diwn and we was asked to get a taxi and the cost would be reimbursed ( still waiting 3 weeks later)  On our arrival we asked if was a chance of a coffee and was told no but if we went into town we could get one . This didn't distract that the experience was brilliant but it is just the little things that let it down

Whether you are short on time or want a birds eye view of the Grand Canyon and Las Vegas this is a must do trip.  The flight was smooth and we had great views on an amazingly clear day.  Landing in the canyon at our own picnic table overlooking the Colorado River with several other choppers was a sight to behold.
Flew around and landed below Denali.  It was an amazing adventure.  The people that work at K2 are great!  Worth every dime.  We even had a BBQ lunch on our return.

We were very lucky to have an excellent pilot who took us over the misty fjords.  We saw humpback whales, waterfalls, no bears I’m afraid, but it was a wonderful experience.  We were lucky as we were told other flights had to be cancelled.  So glad we picked early morning for our one hour flight.  Even had the chance to stand on the floats of the plane.  Thank you team!

Totally worth the price. We went over the island for over an hour, and as promised got to see many Rainbows. Kevin was an amazing Pilot and gave us many interesting facts about the island. We covered almost the entire island and looked at the places that we were not able to drive to. 
The staff was overly friendly, especially Kaycee!

We took our six children on this flight, and Dan was not just a good pilot. He was knowledgeable, had a witty personality, and educated us a lot about the landscapes, logging, and just about everything we saw. This small family operation are just good folk. Their sweet teenage daughter picked us up, Lesly hosted us well and kept safe the personal items we didn't want to take on the ride. They work hard and are just the kind of people/business we love to support.

An incredible, unforgettable experience!  Clay, our pilot, was the best.  He kept us at ease the whole trip and shared some great stories and information about the  Park and the Mountain.  The views of Denali and all the other majestic mountains were simply amazing, and the glacier landing was spectacular.  Customer service was professional and the team who work there are friendly, helpful and top notch all the way.  This is a must do if you visit Talkeetna!  Loved it so much I bought a t-shirt:)
Fantastic from start to finish. Just fantastic.  Best trip I ever did. Money well spent. Bryan you are a legend. Nothing more to say.

review_title: Amazing! Wonderful! One of top 3 highlights of our trip. Loved it!
review_text: Great staff. Nice young pilot. A little hot up there. We would have appreciated knowing that we didn't have to dress warm. Otherwise, just awesome.

review_title: Grand Denali tour with glacier landing - must do
review_text:
Great place. Had wonderful flying experience.

Took the grand Denali tour with glacier landing. Views of Denali was amazing but the glacier landing was the top icing on the cake. 

Definitely recommend.

We were in the Denali area for three days, but the cloud cover prevented us from see the full mountain.  On our last evening there, our host at the Airbnb provided us with some discount coupons and helped us arrange a last minute trip for the next morning.  We finally got to see the top.  Top notched pilots and friendly staff.

review_title: Fantastic View of Arches National Park
review_text: My son and I took the air tour on the last day of our vacation in Moab, the day after we had been hiking in the national park.  We both agreed that the air tour was an excellent way to end the vacation.  Our pilot/tour guide was retired from the National Park Service, so he was very knowledgeable.  He was also friendly and provided a great deal of information on the park, the community and the area.  We took our cameras on the tour and got some great aerial pictures of the arches and the other features in the park.  The plane ride itself was very smooth, considering the plane was a four passenger model.  I would really recommend taking this tour if you want a bird's-eye view of the park.

This trip was incredible. The glacier landing was definitely worth it. We had a wonderful pilot who provided interesting information and was very safe and knowledgeable. It was so worth it to take this flight tour!

This was a once in a lifetime experience!  If you are considering doing this, I highly recommend you do it, you won't regret it!  Lou was an excellent pilot and explained a lot about what we were seeing. Landing on the glacier and seeing Denali are something we will NEVER forget.

amazing experience thanks a lot.
highly recommended 
max was amazing 
very romantic 
the view was perfect

review_title: Great way to see Mt. McKinley!
review_text: This was such a bucket list experience!  Take off is smooth and so was our ride over to, around, and landing on the glacier at Mt. McKinley.  I am prone to motion sickness, and I had no issues ascending or descending on this type plane.  I took no medication as well.  We were blessed with a blue sky the day we chose to fly.  Our original day was rainy and overcast, but the friendly staff at Talkeetna Air Taxi worked with us to choose a better day.  The views are unbelievable!  Thank you for such an awesome experience!

review_title: Do not miss this. The best attraction in the Hawaiian Islands.
review_text: My husband was so excited about this flight as he has his Pilot's License, but I have never had the nerve to fly with him in a light aircraft before now. Bruce, who flew the little Cessna was wonderful and put me at ease straight away, gave me confidence and allowed me to relax and enjoy the whole thing. The scenery over the Na Pali Coast was awesome and the weather was perfect with blue skies, very little cloud and not much wind. We flew over some amazing mountains, ridges and valleys, with numerous waterfalls, sandy beaches and deep blue sea. Seeing it all from the air was so much better than from offshore.  The whole experience was smoothly run from being picked up from the cruise ship and driven to the airport, signing in and boarding the aircraft, the personalized flight, photos and free DVD, and return to the ship. Bruce was so easy to get along with, was interested in our family and made this flight one we'll never forget. It was over much to soon but will remain as the highlight of our holiday in Hawaii. I can honestly say that this flight was real value for money and worth doing even for some-one who feels scared of flying in a small plane. My husband is still talking about it and wishes we could do it all again. He even said he'd love to take a few more lessons with Bruce as the instructor.  Pick this one if you are in Kauai you won't regret it.

Three of us took their 70 minute flight tour at the end of January and it was a great time.  I've taken small plane tours in other parts of the world and a helicopter tour on Maui and this flight was probably the best of them all.

We had perfect weather that day and had a turbulence-free flight with great view of the Na Pali coast, Waimea Canyon, and the Waialeale Crater.
Absolutely amazing experience, with great views and perfect service. Can recommend this to any visitor of the island! Completely worth the money.

It was a bit of a drive to get here from Anchorage (where we were staying) but it was worth it!  Seeing the glaciers that have been there for millions of years and to even land on one and take it all in is amazing!  Our pilot was very good at pointing out what we were looking at and even takes photos of you with your phone when you land on the glacier!  Although we booked the Denali experience, we were not able to go around it as the clouds were very thick, so we landed on a different glacier.  And while this was a big disappointment, the company gave everyone a partial refund because of this and it was put in before we even got back to the airfield!!!!    Great company...

This place is professional and my sons had the flight of their lives!  We did the basic flight(no glacier landing) on a really clear day.  They saw Mount McKinley and enjoyed the whole experience,  Staff was wonderful!

review_title: Amazing air tour of the whole Island!
review_text:
Air Ventures air tour is excellent. If you are looking for photo graphing make sure that you are sitting in the 3rd row as 2nd row has the wing as obstruction. 
Rey is very nice , ask him prior to flight so that he can show the Na Pali beach from both side.
Pilot was great.  Knowledgeable on the history of Hawaii.  Views were great.  A lot of great pictures.
The flight was very good and enjoyable. Saw many sights that you cannot see from the ground. Pilot Bryan was very good.
Our pilot was great, very informative throughout the flight and did a wonderful job flying the plane. 10/10 would recommend this to others, very cool experience.
This was one the best things I’ve ever done in my life to date. Would 100% recommend & our pilot was also amazing. Expensive but worth it.

review_title: Flight over Denali and Glacier Landing
review_text: Flight cancelled due to weather but rescheduled for next day.  Next day flight was delayed due to scheduling but K2 worked to make it right.  I think K2 understands this is a once in a lifetime trip for most people and do their best, and keep that in mind.
Such an amazing experience!  A must for anyone wanting an exceptional, memorable time! Definitely worth doing on my return trip to Maui.
Amazingly beautiful scenery. Mike, our pilot, was very friendly and knowledgeable.  I would definitely recommend.

review_title: Flight Seeing Trip Around Mt. Denali plus Gracier Landing
review_text: Excellent trip. Great views & a fun experience! Weather was outstanding! Also a great group of people including the pilot.

Our group had bad weather (flash flood warning) the day we were supposed to do the plane ride. Fortunately, the rescheduled day worked out and we had an amazing view of the island on the tour. Our pilot, Paul, was fantastic. We loved our experience! It was perfect!

Several friends from England recommended that we take this helicopter tour if we were going to visit the Grand Canyon, and we are sure glad we did.  It is fairly pricey, but we can't imagine there's any other way to get an overview of the vastness and beauty of the Grand Canyon.  We did a 3pm tour, so the sun was not directly overhead but the shadows were not so long as to hide parts of the canyon.  Make sure you do the 50 minute/1 hour tour and not a shorter one -- it's hardly enough time to take it all in.

My husband and I recently flew in the Cessna with Bruce on day 2 of our vacation.  We took the afternoon flight and had amazing lighting on the Na Pali coast for photos.  Bruce was engaging, with plenty of interesting facts about Kaua'i delivered with a great sense of humor.  I would recommend doing this early during your stay, as you'll probably want to visit some of the spots viewed above by car/hike as well.  We liked the Cessna since we wanted a private flight, but know that the Airbus will give you better shots with the bubble windows (allowing you to aim your camera down).  Also, only the Airbus has a mounted camera, so you cannot purchase the video of your own tour if you choose the Cessna.  

They have a great website with online booking available, but Ellen will get back to you right away if you have other questions.  Definitely recommend!

review_title: A lot packed into a short time
review_text:
We were visiting Phoenix and wanted to catch Grand Canyon without the long drive.
Charter flight was smooth and we immediately boarded helicopters and then boats.
Choppers back up and then lunch on site before seeing skywalk and another rim viewing site.
The air views from plane and helicopters are priceless.
Karla was our pilot and she ushered us throughout the day to maximize time.
A great way to see the Grand Canyon.
We were with 7 other folks we did not know from all over US which made it even better, all nice folks.

We had a 2 1/2 hour plane ride over the national parks and the rivers and lake Powell. Our pilot Dave was great, He gave us lots of information about the landscape and history of the area as we were flying. The flight was smooth and amazing.

How do you describe something that takes your words away and leaves you speechless?  This was meant to be a Floatplane and Alaskan Bear excursion.  We definitely saw the floatplane.  :)  If you ever read my reviews you know that heights aren't my favorite thing - so the idea of being in a small aircraft way up high in the sky was shall we say - intimidating.  However, the folks at Taquan seem on the ball when it comes to safety and preparing you for the experience.  Our pilot was fantastic - he has been flying since 1968!  It really gave you a boost of confidence that you were in good hands.  The views were breathtaking.  Sadly, our group didn't see a single bear.  I'm not sure if the location could have been better chosen and/or monitored and rerouted based on activity - but the floatplane views and experience alone were worth the time.  Here's what made this an Excellent! experience... when our pilot heard that we had not seen a single bear he made every effort to help us find one from the sky! And we did.  We saw a bear!!
An awesome view of the whole Island. Our guide and pilot Desi made sure that everyone had a good time and she had a great knowledge of Kauai. Would recommend to anyone visiting Kauai.

review_title: Neets Bay bear watch and flight
review_text: The float plane trip was amazing as we stayed very low over the scenery. When we arrived at the Bay we went with a good guide to see the bears. We saw lots of bears feeding near the hatchery. Not sure it is worth the money, but to see black bears feeding in the wild was worth it.
New and good condition aircraft, smooth flight and expert pilot commentary. I don't hesitate to recommend...

review_title: Highlight of the vacation; once in a lifetime experience!
review_text:
I've traveled all over the world, spent 26 years in the Navy and flown on many aircraft but never in my life have I seen such beauty. This is a tour that is worth every penny, and is very affordable when compaired to other tours. Bruce is a safe pilot, and the ride is super smooth. Its not easy to discribe but I would be safe to say its near heavenly up there. 
Donnie

Picture perfect day to take a flight around Mt. Denali and experience a glacier landing and takeoff. The experience is tremendous and the mountains phenomenal. Our guide, Leanne, was awesome and a really skillful aviator. You’ll remember this excursion forevermore.

From start to finish, our flightseeing tour from Talkeetna to Mt. McKinley, landing on Ruth Glacier was jaw-droppingly wonderful. I've lived in Alaska for almost 40 years and thought I'd seen its beauty, but this trip showed me sights I hadn't even imagined. It was well worth every penny, and I'll remember it as long as I live. The best compliment I can give is to say that the minute we landed, I wanted to go right back and do it again. The staff at K2 was very helpful, and Al the pilot was very safety minded and also extremely knowledgeable about the terrain over which we were flying. And landing on the glacier. By all means, be sure and do this. Standing so near the peak of the highest mountain in North America was awe inspiring. Yes, I'm gushing, but you would be too if you'd taken this trip. I highly highly highly recomend it.

Just want to complement Ellen and Bruce and staff for a wonderful experience.  Had a great flight and very knowledgeable and pertinent commentary from Bruce during the flight that brought out aspects of the Island that one would not read about.  They were able to rearrange some other customers schedules to be able to accommodate me as I only had Saturday Morning to fly (was on the Norwegian Cruise Lines , Pride of America which was leaving that afternoon) after poor weather cancelled our scheduled Friday Afternoon flight.  Can't thank them enough for that, otherwise I might not have been able to fly in Hawaii at all.

I might also mention that the noise level was very low as they have Top-End BOSE Noise cancelling headsets.  Not sure if a helicopter ride would be this quiet.
Thanks Again and if I ever return will be knocking on your door again..

Cheers
I got to fly the plane and it was just a lot of fun  the views were amazing  the host was fantastic and I highly recommend this  thanks

For a great experience we recommend this adventure. Our pilot Bruce was very friendly and informative. We recommend you start your experience of Kauai with "Wings over Kauai" flight. You will have a good feel for the island and places you will want to visit. 1/2 the price of helicopter tours and smooth as silk.

Outstanding and reasonably priced (compared to the helicopters). We saw all of Kauai, especially the Na Pali coast. Try morning tours, weather is always foremost. Only 6 people per plane so everyone gets a window seat. Approximately $170 per person which includes taxes.

We took their "McKinley Flyer" 'flightseeing' tour and we were very impressed.  This tour gets you as close a 1/4 mile to some of the formations and being in a 6 seat Piper, the views are incredible.  Our pilot, Dallas, was very knowledgeable and provided insight on the mountain, its glaciers, and its history.  He took good care of us, a very young man (3 years old), and his parents. We had an spectacularly clear morning for our trip and Denali / McKinley stood and welcomed us in all its glory.
Definitely some unique views and a personalized experience.  Super friendly pilot.  Windy weather but get safe .

review_title: seaplane tour around San Fransisco Bay
review_text: I took the hour tour around the San fran Bay area with my father and my 2 kids(ages 12 and 14). We flew over the sonoma vineyards, Alcatraz and the Golden Gate Bridge.  The pilot gave us great info about what we were flying over. it was an amazing experience. We felt very safe.
Definitely one of the highlights of our honeymoon! Larry was an awesome pilot. Really entertaining, and we felt very safe. The scenery was beyond spectacular.

Our flight around the Alaskan mountains including Denali was awe inspiring. The pilot, Chris, was very informative and a lot of fun. We were fortunate enough to be able to land on the Glacier and to see Denali in all it's glory. It's an adventure we will never forget.

We had a great flight. It was a beautiful sunny day and Harry, our pilot and a very knowledgeable person, gave us lots of information about Kauai and pointed out so many highlights of the island. He even pointed out a couple of whales off the coast of Lihue. The plane was comfortable and everyone had a window. When necessary, Harry circled around special areas so all could see from a different advantage. The ground staff were also very knowledgeable and helpful as we prepared for the flight. I realize that helicopters can get closer to see some things but this plane ride was amazing and I would highly recommend Air Ventures if you want to see beautiful Kauai!

review_title: Must do for your bucket list
review_text: The town is one you want to stop at, we were lucky to have such a beautiful day for a flight the staff is so friendly and the ride is amazing

I decided the day of to take this trip. My husband and son had a reservation but I was too scared. I changed my mind and went. The pilot was great. Very thorough going through safety before flight. He gave us good narrative of what we were looking at. I had a hard time hearing it at times cause I didn't turn up my headphones, my mistake. The view was spectacular. We saw Denali pretty well. We landed smoothly on Ruth Glacier and had fun standing on it and taking pictures. I'm so happy I did it. Yes, its a bit expensive but all of the companies are similar in price. Not sure when I'll be back to Alaska so I'm glad I did it. You should too!!

You cannot go wrong snagging a flight to the Alaska Mountain Range and Denali up close. While it seems like a scary thing to do, I felt safe 100% of the time. The reward was the closest views of the mountains you'll ever have. spectacular. Andy and Clay were great pilots. Cannot wait to return!

Unforgettable!  Views stunning, excellent pilot. We were captivated by all of it...views of Denali and surrounding mountains, glaciers, moose, sheep, trumpet swans. Landing on glacier was amazing. Loved it all! Thank you!!

review_title: K2 Aviation Grand Tour Denali Flightseeing
review_text:
We are long time Alaskans and have viewed Denali from the air as well as the road system on several occasions.  Our K2 Aviation flightseeing trip topped them all. 

The phone reservation was quickly arranged, the agent worked to fit OUR schedule.  We receiving an email confirmation with all details including what to bring.

We used a gift certificate for this trip, the value was towards the "Denali Experience" a 1-hour flight.  However much to our delight we treated to the Grand Tour", a 2 hour flight that included a complete circle of Denali, Ruth Glacier, Wickersham Wall, Kahiltna Base Camp., basically a grand tour of the entire Denali National Park.  We were in the air for just under 2 hours!

Our pilot Samuel was well-versed in the history of the park and the geology that has formed this area.  He was obviously an experienced and professional Denali pilot.

I don't have a single complaint or recommendation for improvement.  K2 Aviation is professional from reservation to landing and they know how to do it right.

I took the 30 minute San Francisco Bay tour on August 28th at 3:15.  It was a spectacular day with some fog around the Golden Gate Bridge.  We flew around and over every major tourist site and the view was just spellbinding.  The pilot was very informative and did a great job maneuvering above and around the Golden Gate Bridge, Bay Bridge, all the SF sites, Mt. Tamalpais, Stinson Beach, Muir Woods, Timuron, Alcatraz, and more.  There are not enough adjectives in the English language to say how fabulous and thrilling this was.  5 stars is an understatement!

If you are in the Denali area, do not miss the glacier landing tour offered by Talkeetna Air Taxi. It was an experience of a life time. The kids loved the snowball fights they had on top of the glacier. The views of the glacier was breathtaking.

My wife and I were very worried that our flight would be cancelled due to inclement weather but after a few telephone calls from the very helpful staff, the flight was brought forward.  Our pilot was excellent, both knowledgeable and caring.  It was cloudy and at times bumpy, but he did everything possible to bypass the rough areas and still give us great views of the island.  This was the best possible way to see this beautiful island and I would recommend Air Ventures to everyone.

review_title: Do NOT Miss This Amazing Opportunity!
review_text:
We arrived in Talkeetna on a sunny afternoon and took a chance on getting a flight out with TAT.  They say only 30% of travelers actually see Mount McKinley, well we not only saw it... we saw it from "close up" because of the great team at Talkeetna Air Taxi.

My wife was chosen to fly co-pilot and enjoyed the best views, although everyone gets a chance to see evrything as the pilots turn frequently.  The plane was a DeHavilland Otter and was in excellent shape and obviously very well maintained.  Our pilot (Will) was informative and answered all of my wife's nervous questions with ease and skill.

The landing on the Ruth Glacier was smooth and when we got out and walked around... it was life changing.  The beauty and shear size of the mountain peaks and the glacier was breathtaking.  I wish we could have stayed longer.

This was clearly the highlight of our Alaska trip and the first thing we talk about when friends ask about our vacation.  Do NOT miss this amazing opportunity if you visit Alaska.  And give TAT your business, they are the best!
Great team and crew who deliver a great experience.  usually drive from Seattle to Anacortes, but no more........Will just take flight and be there for Happy Hour!

review_title: Denali area flight seeing with glacier landing
review_text: We scheduled this trip in Talkeetna, and drove a short distance to the airport, and boarded the plane with 3 add'l

review_title: A wonderful way to view the Grand Canyon & Colorado River
review_text:
We booked the River Adventure with Scenic Airlines, which consisted of a flight over The Grand Canyon, a jeep trip to Antelope Canyon, and then a gentle river raft down the Colorado River. 
The day started at The Grand Canyon Airport around 6 am for check in.  We were then given the included continental breakfast in a transportable container which included cereal bar, muffins, yogurts, fruit, cheese & crackers - better than expected! We then took a flight across the east side of the Grand Canyon up to Page, which lasted approx 50 mins. It was a very smooth flight with amazing views. We then took a coach for a 15 min ride to the Jeep for a tour of Antelope Canyon, which was also amazing. A further short coach ride took us to the River raft, which took us on a gentle ride through Glen Canyon along the Colorado river. This took approx 3 hours and we stopped at a beach area halfway through to eat the lunch provided, which again was better than I expected. There was then a 3 hour guided tour coach ride back through the Grand Canyon to the airport, arriving back about 5.30pm. It was a long day, but a great way to experience the areas visited. There were plenty of restroom stops and a little waiting around, mainly due to people taking the tour arriving late. Overall it was a very smooth, and well organised day.

I booked a flight-seeing trip and was surprised after paying to be told that we were upgraded to a glacier landing and theGrand Denali Tour.  I was leary of this as I had thought a crevasse might open under the plane and swallow us into a bottomless pit.  I was assured this would not happen and I am here to tell you I make it safely off the glacier.  The pilot (Richard) was great and provided us with great information about what we were looking at and details on where to look for mouton climbers.  Solid trip.

We did the McKinley Flyer with a glacier landing for our wedding anniversary. It was worth every penny, and left us speechless in awe of the Alaska Range. We had great weather, the pilot was extremely knowledgeable and nice, and overall, it was an experience that can't be beat. Thanks for making our anniversary adventure so memorable! It was truly first class.

While a helicopter tour of the island would be ideal (been there, done that), my ears can't take the pressure changes that come with lightning fast altitude changes. This airplane tour, is a great way to see the island for me. They had a mount on the wing for my GoPro and I ended up with 2000 incredible pics of the island.

review_title: Best money I've spent all year!
review_text:
My buddy and I did the 45 minute helicopter tour and it was simply amazing. The pilot (Danny) was knowledgable and super nice. From the Tusayan Airport, it's less than 10 minutes at 300 feet before you go over the edge....wow! Then one photo op after another. Very near a spiritual experience for me. 

One thing that I saw mentioned in other posts is the middle seats. We had 5 passengers; 3 in front with the pilot, 2 in the back, 2 empty middle seats in the back. Sitting in those seats would definitely not be ideal.

We flew with Will from K2 Aviation, and it was an awesome experience! Even though we weren’t able to safely land on the glacier, we still got to see a lot of amazing landscapes, including Mt. Denali! 
I would highly recommend this to everyone!
Great views of islands you’ll never see any other way plane was a nice perspective over a helicopter enjoyed our time thank you.

review_title: "Denali Experience" was a great (and safe) experirience
review_text: We made an ad-hoc reservation whil staying overnight in Talkeetna. The crew at K2 was professional, explained everything well pre-flight. We had booked the flight with a glacier landing. Our pilot did an excellent briefing and gave everybody a sense that this will be a safe experrience. We got to see some magnificent scenery with interesting and relevant explanations by the pilot. He had to cancel the glacier landing due to light conditions, which was the right and safe thing for him (as pilot-in-command) to do. Being a pilot myself I was impressed and felt reassured by the flight operations and pilots of K2. Highly recommended
Such a fun and unique experience. Stellar service. Our pilot was great; very attentive and informative. Excellent views and photos.
Piper was an incredible pilot! She made sure everyone had phenomenal views and shared so many facts about the island. I would definitely recommend doing this on your next trip to Kauai!
We booked the mountain voyager tour through Talkeetna Air taxi on our recent trip and it was a great experience! The pilot was really nice and it was a smooth ride.

First time in a small plane but wow! what an experience. Very friendly service right from the emails with Ellen that arranged the trip, through the free pick up and drop off service from and to the dockside (thanks again Ellen) to the reception from Bruce, Dori and Josh (not forgetting Millie). The flight was all we wished for and more. Magnificent scenery and expert pilot and commentary from Josh. this must be the best way to see all that Kauai has to offer. AND at the end of the flight we were given a free DVD of the flight highlights plus two photos taken by Dori before the flight were emailed to us. Excellent service from a company that really cares about its customers.
Highly recommended.
Excellent experience. Davis was a fantastic pilot and the whole thing far exceeded my expectations. Highly recommend.

We arrived very early and because of a customers' error in booking the Biplane was available immediately.   Wind was to get rough later, so everything turned out on time.    Keven was our pilot/guide.  He was very personable and knowledgeable as was the greeting and support staff.   The flight was very smooth and the biplane was almost new , very clean and smooth running.  Keven provided much information, This is our 4th visit to Kauai so we knew some of it, yet learned so much more.  We have a favorite beach that was not on the route, Keven rerouted a little and gave us some great Arial views.  Confident that we were in good hands, we loved everything about it!

I was very fortunate to take a glacier landing flight with Talkeetna Air Taxi - the premier Air Taxi service in Alaska.  The people are friendly and very knowledgeable about Denali and the mountain ranges. It was a beautiful experience and I highly recommend that anyone take a flight with Talkeetna Air Taxi. This is a no brainer.

There are so many reasons to go with WOK vs. a helicopter tour. But the top reasons are:

1. Personalized service!! We chose to do the small cessna tour for my husband and I, along with our 9 mo old daughter. We got a private tour with Capt. Bruce. If we had booked a helicopter tour, we would have been sitting on top of other strangers. We also received a FREE digital picture in front of the plane before the tour. Most companies would charge you for this type of thing. 

2. Price - for half the cost of a helicopter tour, WOK is really a great bang for your buck! We also appreciated the fact that we didn't have to pay for our daughter either.

I would without a doubt recommend this tour for anyone! Save your money and go with WOK. You won't regret it at all. 

Tip: Book this at the beginning of your time on Kauai just in case the weather is less than ideal to fly. We did this and I am glad we did because we had a lot of flexibility when the fog was really bad one day.
Really enjoyed our trip with Maui Plane Rides! Beautiful views of all five islands and we also got to see several whales. Eric is a great pilot and our flight was nothing but smooth!
We had a fantastic flight with our pilot Eric! Funny guy very informative. The wind was less than smooth yet he handled it very well and kept it gliding and soft. Highly recommended!
Awesome views, knowledgeable and friendly pilot who was very professional. Will be back again for more tours!!

review_title: Everyone should start their Kauai adventure with AirVentures!!
review_text: For a first timer, nothing tops a fly over the spectacular sights of this island. And AirVenture did it best thanks to their exceptional ground and air staff. Our pilot Eric, who could pass for the crooked CBI director in The Mentalist, was a great pilot and stand up guide, keeping us laughing as he flew us safely into tricky spots to give us the best views. The top topper was when he gave me the wheel for 2 minutes as we came in to land. Simply unforgettable!
Outstanding service. Very safe. Our family felt very safe on their helicopter’s. Amazing pilots. Highly recommend them.
Excellent service- the pilot was very knowledgeable (and patient with tons of questions from our 10 year old). We'd definitely recommend this trip!

review_title: Fantastic way to see the whole Bay Area in its breathtaking beauty
review_text: I am a native to SF, but seeing the bay area from the air was a special way to connect all the places I know and love.

review_title: Took the seaplane drom San Juan Island to the main land .
review_text:
Our flight was pleasant, even though I am usually afraid of flying- I was not scared at all. Our pilot was a gentleman who seemed like he really knew what he was doing.

We had to make 2 stops to pick up 2 more people. thus we got back to the mainland ( renton ) a bit later than scheduled, which we didnt mind at all as we were headed to Seatac after and we had over 3 hours of wait time.

Overal loved it and would do it again , I would choose this method of travel vs the ferry that took forever.

The staff was very helpful and accommodating. The pilot was great and we had just enough clear weather to see the top of Mt. McKinley. This was the highlight of this portion of our trip to the Denali National Park. The #1 ranking for this place on tripadvisor is well deserved. Highly recommend. We took the Summit Tour with the Glacier landing. Loved landing on the Glacier it was definitely a once in a lifetime experience.

review_title: Perfect flight on a perfect morning
review_text: We booked the morning flight over Canyonlands NP before leaving Moab for Mesa Verde. It was a perfect October morning with clear skiy and no movements in the air. Our pilot was very knowledgeable without being overy catty. Not cheap, but well worth it.

Take the otter and land on the glacier. You will not be disappointed. It is so beautiful! No better way to see Denali. Our pilot was outstanding. Expensive but well worth the money! Highly recommended.

We took a tour of the Grand Canyon with these folks, and we very much enjoyed it. The weather was perfect the day we flew and the ride was so smooth. Our pilot was enthusiastic and friendly and did a great job. Love to try a helicopter ride next time!

The front desk recommended the Denali Flyer your with a glacier landing. We were not disappointed! Take-off and landings were so smooth we could not feel them. We felt safe and entertained the entire time!
Amazing experience. Captain was great. Plane went around Denali and other peaks very close and then landed on a glacier. It was a perfect day and we enjoyed breath taking views.
The views were amazing and it was really cool to learn about all the unique facts. It was also cool to be able to fly.

We had the most amazing trip seeing Kaua’i thanks to our wonderful guide Parker. We couldn’t have imagined a better view of this beautiful island. Parker not only shared the island visually but also so many wonderful stories, facts and recommendations about the island and ideas for enjoying our time here. Flying with Wings Over Kaua’i was the highlight of our trip!
Even though weather was not on our site we had an amazing time and saw beautiful glaciers and our pilot was so nice and told us many interesting facts about the area.
Informative.  Everyone enjoyed.  Great take-off and landing.  Smooth flight.  Even the one nervous passenger enjoyed it!

Wow! This is literally the trip of a lifetime. The flight was a little bumpy but the views are absolutely incredible. The pilot was very knowledgeable and very friendly and very helpful. We landed on a glacier, had a snowball fight, made snow angels, and picked up some mountain climbers then came back. It literally was the trip of a lifetime our children will remember this for the rest of their lives. Amazing.

Our second time to Kauai.  Should have done it the first time.  And the second time.  The company is a husband and wife team.  Ellen takes care of the office and Bruce does the dirty work.  Bruce is a professional botanist as well as an experienced pilot and he's knowledgeable about the many movies with segments that were shot on Kauai and he can show you where it all happened.  As anyone knows Kauai is a beautiful place but from the air we saw a lot more of it.  We got out of the airplane with a new perspective on the island.  It's awesome.  Seeing it from the air with Bruce’s oration was the highlight of our trip.  The ride was smooth and airplane comfortable.  Noise cancelling headsets kept noise down and allowed two way conversation between everyone in the airplane.  Just go do it.
We did the flight to Molokai and had a great experience. Our son loved it. Eric is passionate about his work and it shows!

Great way to see the island of Kauai. Booked this for the first day we got there, Bruce is a great host typical of Kauai hospitality. He shares his knowledge of the plane, places to eat and the best places on the island which keeps you entertained for the whole time you are on board. Considering it was a cloudy and windy day Bruce did a good job minimising bumps and dips so no need to worry about motion sickness. A good way to start or end your holiday on Kauai

What an AMAZING, once in a lifetime experience. The staff was incredibly friendly and accommodating — we came on a whim and were up in the air in 30 minutes (they took an early excursion for us).

I was a bit terrified, but the ride was smooth and perfect.

Paul was a fantastic pilot, incredibly knowledgable of flying, mountaineering, the route, Alaska and much more. He gave great insights into the spots and answered every question (I asked a lot).

5 star experience, wholeheartedly recommend.

Professional, engaging pilot- unsurpassable views of one of natures greatest wonders along with fascinating detail.  Our tour began in Sedona and included a Pink Jeep tour of the canyon.  All I can say is - do it.  Life is short and this experience is one you'll want to maintain in memory.  We could not have asked for a better way to spend a vacation day or to view and educate ourselves on the canyon.

Had a beautiful flight aboard from Ketchikan, AK to Misty Fijords In a well cared for DeHaviland Beaver Airplane.  The entire staff at the Ketchikan office took very good care of us from pickup at our cruise ship to our return.  The pilot was extremely knowledgeable about his route of flight and gave us some beautiful scenic moments along to the route and return.  The takeoff and landings were so smooth it was as to make it difficult to know when we were actually on water on in the air. 
Thanks Seawind Aviation,   great job!

review_title: Awesome flight in the Denali area
review_text: On my first trip to Alaska I had an amazing flightseeing trip with the folks at Talkeetna Air.  The flight and glacier landing were 2 of the coolest things I have ever done!

This was the best thing we did on our whole trip! I cannot recommend it enough. Our view was so much better than the helicopters that were below us darting in and out of canyons. We had a beautiful and peaceful ride and Bruce is entertaining and delightful. Every person on the plane had a window seat. There for 4 of us on the plane that can take 6 but they keep groups small for this reason. The plane is half the price of the helicopter which helped us make the choice but now I would go with the plane even if the price were equal. We went on a ocean cruise and while that was nice if you do one activity, do this! Thank you to the Wings Over Kauai family! Rick and Brooke from WI

review_title: No question - best way to see Maui
review_text:
Eric gave us such a wonderful experience this morning on our flight seeing trip between Maui and the Big Island.  It was a gorgeous flight and we got to see Haleakala, Waipi’o Valley, Mauna Kea and Mauna Loa.  We also were able to view the site of the latest lava flows from 2018 and could even still see steam rising from the fissure.  What a wonderful way to see both Maui and the Big Island - even for those like us who have been visiting for almost two decades.  We felt safe and secure the entire time and can’t wait to come back out on another trip.  If you are trying to decide between a helicopter tour and a fixed wing - I would recommend going with Eric in a fixed wing every time - it’s a much faster way to get to the sites, and far smoother than any helicopter tour we have done on Maui with other providers.  

Mahalo for the great flight!

We booked this for a few friends. While the price seemed high, it was definitely worth it. The flight was maybe a little over an hour. The views were beautiful and we got some great pictures. The pilot was very friendly and even helped us take pictures afterwards. The flight was comfortable and overall an amazing experience. Would highly recommend.
Loved this flight! I can’t stress enough how majestic these sights were. It was an amazing experience!
It was super fun great views spetacler virws. Made our trip. I recommend this to everyone. The pilot was a great guy that knew everything there is to know.
This is a rad way to get a real understanding of the land surrounding Moab.  Also, Dave, our pilot, was competent, knowledgeable, and entertaining.

High marks for this tour. The mountain was open ( no clouds ) we booked on the spot and where in the air within a half hour.  One of the best tours we went on. The price was 60% YES 60% lower than a air tour we booked through our cruise line. Call direct and book this one ,or stop by there booth in " Down town" Talkeetna.

Tour was beautiful and everyone had their own window.  The landing was fun and we all got out to stand on the deck and enjoy the scenery.  We had great weather and both landings and takeoffs were smooth.  A special trip.
Fantastic experience. The whole tour was very well organized & the Pilot (Andy) was really knowledgeable and friendly.
Excellent experience! Truly recommend to other travelers! Despite it was a bit late due to windy weather, everything went smooth and friendly!
We had a delightful experience and a really fun pilot.  Our views were spectacular and easily visible from the airplane.  Our pilot pointed out many interesting aspect of the island of Kauai!

Our pilot, Mark, was excellent.  He was very personable, and gave us lots of information about what we were seeing.  The views of Denali and its glaciers were amazing.  I would absolutely do this again!  This was the highlight of our trip to Alaska.

We did Wings Over Kauai on our first day on the island.  Bruce was an excellent pilot and shared lots of interesting information about Kauai.  The clouds passing over allowing the Na Pali Coast to come into view is a moment I will always remember!  I often suffer from motion sickness (as on similar flights in Alaska), but on this occasion it was minimal.  We were very happy with the 11 am time slot and the photographs we took.  We received a lovely souvenir at the end.  All in all, I feel the cost was very reasonable for my family of five and the experience was well worth the money!

We took the excursion to the Misty Fjords.  It was wonderful!  I can highly recommend the trip.  At the cruise ship dock, there is a building where all of the local tour companies have a representative.  We booked our flight there, Taquan Air  had a shuttle van take us to their dock, we waited a little while in their building, and then, we were off.  It was easy!
      The flight was fun.  What really impressed me was how smooth the landing in the fjord was.  The scenery was spectacular.  I cannot imagine a better way of seeing the fjords.

We flew with Wings Over Kauai last week and had such a wonderful experience!  Last year we did the helicopter tour with Blue Hawaiian and a good trip, but not great because we were seated in the middle which made it hard to see.  This year we decided to try Wings Over Kauai and was very happy with our decision.  We thought that the flight was way better than the helicopters in what we saw and our experience.  We got a much more individualized experience than the helicopters and the price was much cheaper!  If you are trying to decide over the two experiences, I would definitely go this way!
Eric was really calm and enjoyable. Volcano and sunset was the best ever! Easy ride there and back. Landing was smooth as butter

review_title: Don’t miss this experience! Life changing!
review_text: This was absolutely a dream come true!  I could not have asked for a more amazing experience in my life! I literally cried with joy and awe at the beauty I took in from the back of that shiny, beautiful red Beaver!  I can’t thank our pilot Ryan Kerby enough for his knowledge and in depth tour of the beautiful Alaskan Range. Highly highly recommend to all!

review_title: Flying the Friendly skies, for real!
review_text: Timely, safe, knowledgeable!  We'd never done anything like it before and feel we were able to experience, in a short time, areas we otherwise may not have ever been able to see.

My cell phone photos look like I work for national geographic.   Most impressive, unbelievable.  Captain Steve was excellent with the geography lessons, too.   When they offer the chance to sit co-pilot,  take it!

Bruce and Ellen provide an unsurpassed customer experience.  They were extremely flexible and customized our tour to fit our schedule.  Everything was great from the booking to the setup to the flight.  Wings Over Kauai's safety record, Bruce's touch at the controls, and his knowledge of island history, geology, and flora made for a very interesting flight with breathtaking views.  They took care of us every step of the way.  What an experience! What a value!  Highly recommended.

review_title: Only one splurge...then this is it!
review_text: We arrived on our cruise ship Thursday and took the free shuttle (although it's just a 5 -10 minute walk out the cruise terminal gates to the road on the right) to the Anchor Cove strip mall where the ABC store is located.  Maren called my cell to say they were a couple of minutes behind and arranged to pick us up in front of the ABC store (there is another discounted tour booth there if you also want to book other excursions the cruise ship offers at discounted rates).  We booked the 1pm tour for 2-people and glad we did!  We did notice two helicopters along the way which sometimes flew below us and also flew right into the gorges that we flew over.  Although they may have had an up close feeling, their helicopers couldn't fly at our elevations and see the wonderful expansive view we had of such things as the the forest and waterfalls used to film the "Tropic Thunder" movie.  Bruce was a great host! This was the highlight of our many shore excursions.

We stayed in Talkeetna for two nights, planning on a flight seeing on our first day there. We were scheduled for the first morning flight. The morning was very overcast and the flight would have had a low ceiling. We canceled with the hopes of an afternoon flight, still a low ceiling but improving. We signed on for the following morning and were rewarded with almost perfect conditions! Talkeetna Air Taxi worked with us to afford us the best experience of seeing Denali and glacier landing. Our pilot, Chris was excellent and my husband had the opportunity to ride in the co-pilot seat for part of the flight.

review_title: Perfect adventure, well worth the price!
review_text: Planned a ride for my son's 12th birthday in April. I am a bit late getting around to writing my review and have since forgotten our pilots name, which is a shame because he was WONDERFUL! We took a short flight as I had no idea if my son would enjoy the experience nor how uncomfortable the plane might be. We all had an amazing time! You couldn't wipe the smile off of my son's face for at least an hour after. We allowed him up front to enjoy the view, see the controls, and ask about 1,000 questions of our patient and professional pilot. Sitting in the back was surprisingly comfortable (better than my husband's sports car!) We can't wait to try some longer trips to view the beautiful PNW from the air. I HIGHLY recommend Envi adventures!

Our early morning departure was canceled due to weather but we stayed near the airport in case there was an improvement. Lucky us - we got a call as we finished lunch went though a smooth checkin at the airport. I was impressed with the ability to take off and climb above the clouds on instruments to clear weather around Denali. The landing was outstanding. Return flight smooth in clear weather.

review_title: Grand Denali Tour with glacier landing
review_text: This is the one thing you have to do before you die. It is absolutely fantastic! Words cannot describe it and photos are inadequate.

GREAT experience.  Worth the price, as this is likely a once in a lifetime luxury.  The trip to the glacier provided amazing scenery that alone would have been worth the ride.  Then, the glacier itself--- magnificent.  Our pilot was knowledgeable and gracious, making this a fun and memorable experience.
Fantastic experience, very professional and a great pilot/guide. This was my children’s first experience in a helicopter and there were some nerves but we all had a great time. Loved it

We saw the most awesome sights today on our Mavericks helicopter flight!   

Our 17 year old son had never seen the canyon and we are on a short trip.  We figured an overhead perspective might be his best introduction to this awesome US landmark.   

We booked the tour by phone. Arriving at Grand Canyon airport, we found Maverick to be well organized and professional.  We were weighed and paid.   Then we waited a few minutes before meeting our pilot, Brett. 

We got a quick safety lesson and were fitted with flotation devices.  Then we were seated according to weight.   Brett is very experienced so we were following a less experienced pilot for training.   Soon,  we were airborne. 

Helicopter rides are always special.   But there's nothing like flying over a ponderosa pine/juniper forest a few hundred feet over the land and abruptly being 5000 feet ( 1 mile) above the awesome Grand Canyon! 

The mighty Colorado river was beautiful.   Brett pointed out lots of geological formations and types of strata in the canyon walls. He also pointed out some sacred native locations.   The whole experience was fabulous!

The tour lasted about 1 1/2 hours.   You can buy dvds of your flight for 39.95 and photos of you for 19.95.  

Tip about tips:  pilot school is expensive and the pilots appreciate gratuities.

review_title: Kauai is even more beautiful from the air
review_text: First time to see Kauai from the air and we so enjoyed the breathtaking views of this beautiful island. Carter (Bruce's son), & Thomas (friend) got us all checked in & prepared for our flight. Also took pictures of our family.  So very nice! Then we were off on our flight with Bruce, our outstanding pilot and so very knowledgeable about the island. He made us feel so comfortable. I got some outstanding pictures. Thanks Bruce and we hope to fly again with you someday!
Had an excellent flight with local pilot Makana.  He was very knowledgeable about the island as he grew up there!  We felt safe and saw some awesome sites.  Great trip, highly recommend

Kauai is our favorite island. There’s just something different about it. It has a different feel, a different vibe. Maybe it’s the chickens everywhere, or the cattle or the more mature landscape. Just not sure. From the air, it’s gorgeous. We flew Wings Over Kauai. Very, very nice people. We were very lucky in that the other people on our flight cancelled, so we had the entire Caravan to ourselves. Bruce, the owner, was our pilot. We took off on 30, NW, turned right and circled the island clockwise. Got great pictures during a flyover of the Crown at dock. The day was partly cloudy with clouds and rain over the center of the island. The water was pure aqua blue, the coastline just picture perfect rocks and white spray and the green of the trees contrasting with the red of the soil could not be done justice in a photo. We cut inland up Wameia Canyon, saw the Jurassic Park waterfall, flew inland of the Pacific Missile Test Range main base, but cut back out over the ocean just before we go to the northern most telemetry radars sitting on top of one giant cliff. 

Flew along the Napoli Coast. Saw the trail wind its way through the cliffs, on top of huge sea caves and along knife edge ridges of rock. Broke back over the northern coast over the resorts and golf courses and the locations they filmed Jurassic World. Cut around the NW part of the island, flew a circle around the Fantasy Island waterfall, saw the cattle grazing in almost chartreuse meadows, flew back over the ship and landed back on runway 30. The whole trip was about 70 minutes, at a ground speed of around 90mph. Judy filmed the whole thing with the action cam, and I took about 160+ stills. We also ordered a video of the flight. They had GoPro’s on each wing. 

This was one of the best value excursions we’ve ever had in Hawaii. Judy did get a little queasy coming around the hills to the NW of the airport. The air was a bit bumpy, but not bad at all. Nothing like the helicopter we took in Juneau in 2001.

review_title: DENALI SUMMIT with GLACIER LANDING WORTH EVERY PENNY!
review_text: The most amazing thing we have done so far in Alaska. We took the summit flight tour with glacier Landing and we were able to see all of Denali with a few clouds. Then we landed on the glacier and oh my it was beautiful and breathtaking.  Captain Liam was great with sharing stories with us and keeping us safe 10 out of 10 for him.  Everyone at Talkeetna air taxi were great. Because they were able to move our flight one day earlier because the weather was better. Thank you so much!  Highly recommend you use Talkeetna air taxi to go and see in Denali.  It’s well worth the money spent a lifetime of memories.

review_title: Only Way to Truely See the Grand Canyon
review_text: All I can say is Wow!!!!  I was amazed when I viewed the canyon from the South Rim, but I was blown away from what I saw on this tour.   The majesty of the canyon is brought to the forefront when viewed from this moving platform.  If you can afford it, I highly recommend.

We had a wonderful flight seeing natures wonders from the air
Our pilot Desi was bubbly and friendly even at the last flight after a long day
I recommend this air adventure to anyone

Such a great tour. Extremely professional. Nicholas got us all set up and then Brooke, our pilot, took excellent care of us in the air. I’m only posting a few photos because otherwise I would post them all! The weather really cooperated and we had amazing views. Brooke did a great job as a pilot and as a guide, making sure we had history and context to what we were seeking. We also saw whales! It was amazing! Would fly again!

We LOVED seeing the gorge from above. Such a beautiful & unique experience being able to fly with Envi! We've been visiting the gorge for over 12 years but this was a breathtaking new perspective. Don't let the fall + winter weather keep you away! We're already planning our next trip once the leaves start to turn. The Envi crew is knowledgable and we felt totally safe. CANNOT wait to get up in the air again!
The views were absolutely stunning, and the staff was amazing as well. Definitely the highlight of our week in Ketchikan. Pilot has some fire aux skills as well!
We didn't get to do the Grand Denali due to clouds but Our pilot, Coy, did a great job giving us a memorable flight.

We were not able to take the Denali flight due to weather but they arranged another flight south to a glacier. Our pilot Lou was fantastic flight was smooth hopefully one day we can get back and fly around Mt. Denali
What an incredible end to our Maui vacation! We saw the most beautiful views of the island we were so blessed to see. It was an incredible surprise for my sweetheart of 35 years! Mahalo!

The staff is great and views are spectacular!  I would recommend this trip. If you have motion sickness take something beforehand it can be rough at times but staff is great to help prevent it and if you do they are great to help you recovery.  But the view of the island is definitely worth the trip.

Bruce and Ellen run an exceptionally personal, friendly, but professional business.  Ellen was responsive to email inquiries and let us add an additional passenger last-minute.  This was also one of the only flight options that allowed us to bring our 1 year old and hold him in a lap rather than purchasing an additional seat.  Bruce was a great pilot and really induced our confidence.  Overall a terrific experience, and one of our favorite memories from Kauai ... glad we didn't miss it!

review_title: Vintage de Havilland Flyover of San Francisco
review_text: In spite of the seasonal fog bank over Labor Day, we had an amazing time flying over the San Francisco Bay sights in the second row seats of a spacious vintage de Havilland Beaver floatplane. We originally reserved the one hour flight over the Bolinas  coast and back over the Bay. At the 1:00 pm take-off time the fog was still spilling over the coastal mountains, so John, our pilot, circled Mount Tam , crossed over the Golden Gate Bridge and down the north bayfront of the City to the Bay Bridge and Treasure Island. Seaplane Adventures credited back the difference between the one hour and the  half hour tour to my credit card even as we were in the air. Great response to the vagaries of San Francisco weather.
Pilot was skilled and friendly.  Loved the ride even though I am afraid of flying.  I highly recommend it.

Had a wonderful with a very experience pilot and guide. He gave a great historical and biological narration. Would definitely recommend this tour to anyone.  Flew in a 1956 dehaviland Beaver.  Great fun with great photo ops.

From the front reception area to preparing for take off to our amazing pilot from the Arctic, this tour was astonishing. We were blessed with a beautiful sunny day with big white puffy clouds as we were escorted around "The Big One" and the surrounding ranges. Our pilot was so informative and skillful as he gently landed us on one of the many glaciers (couldn't even tell if we were down?). Definitely a trip of a lifetime! I'd recommend this to anyone. #33daystoalaska

Talkeetna Air Taxi came highly recommended by our Knik Glacier Tour guide Randy. I am glad we listened and added this to our itinerary. 

Yes, it is expensive, but the stunning views are worth every dollar. 

JUST DO IT!

If you visit Alaska, this is a must do!   Everything was well organized from the check-in process to the flight.   The pilot pointed out all of the features and answered all of our questions with expertise.    Furthermore, the flight was very smooth and we were impressed on how smooth the landing and take off from the glacier was.    Visiting Denali was like being transported to another world.     The glacier landing was well worth it!
Clay was so friendly and great with instructions. The take off and landing were so smooth. Views are incredible!! Definitely worth it.

Pilot Nate was great! His air tour was informative and interactive yet not overbearing or scripted like some other tour guides. The views from the sky looking down at the island was breathtaking. I did get a bit queasy from the ride but at no fault to Nate. It was the breakfast I ate before the flight. Overall a great experience and affordable too!

We had a fabulous flight with Nate on the Private Luxury Air Tour.  Nate showed us everything and even circled around when he spotted whales near the shore for us to get a good look.  It was a very special day and we truly appreciated Jill picking us up and driving us back to the ABC store near the port.  We had a wonderful time, I just wish my photos did it justice!
Great way to see an amazing island.  Felt very comfortable with pilot Josh.  They also don't cram the plane so everyone gets a great view.  The price is excellent as well.  Highly recommend!!

Sure, it's insanely expensive (2 seniors cost $650+) but it is even more amazing than we thought it would be. Flying through - as it, way close -  snow covered, mountains is fantastic.  You'll see things you never thought you'd see, - the sheer cliffs, the vista, the glacier.  And a very smooth and (reasonably, it's a small plane, after all) quiet ride. Everyone is next to a window, so looking out, and down, is no problem.  The glacier itself, well, you're standing on snow, and snow is snow; The surroundings though are the thing.  Highly recommended.
Our tour with Bubbs was amazing!  We got a wonderful overview of the island and it was the highlight of our trip to Kauai. Highly recommend!
Daniel was our captain, we really enjoyed our tour. The weather was not great but it did not effect the visibility

The experience of a lifetime!!! Recomended to everybody, got to see amazing views of the volcano and many more things, will definitely come back the price is completely worth it!! Spencer was a great pilot and gave great information!

What a spectacular flight!  Our captain was a great tour guide, very knowledgeable about the people, culture and history of the island. So much of Kaua'i' beauty can only be seen from the air and it is amazing!  The rugged west coast and variety of rock colours up the valleys was a wonderful surprise.  Well worth the adventure. 
Wendy C.
This tour was such a fun & awesome way to see the Napali coast by plane! The views were truly breathtaking! I highly recommend it!

review_title: Great way to see the Canyon from above!
review_text: Our family loved this tour of the grand canyon from the air. It our first view of the canyon and they had headsets to listen to music and information about the canyon. The pilots were nice and it was a great experience. Not as sexy as the helicopter ride but less money and for a family of 5 it was perfect.
Chris our pilot did a Great job!! Amazing views and Great explanations!!  Very safe planes and courteous staff! Would recommend!

review_title: Best way to see it ALL!
review_text: Wonderful experience, highly recommend it. Best way to see the islands. Felt safe and secure the whole time.

Perfect weather day made for a perfect trip! Asa was an excellent pilot and tour guide. Get super safe and comfortable in the plane (not always a thing for me!) Views were amazing and he made sure both sides of the plane saw all. Landing on the glacier was a highlight of the trip. If your flexible, check in frequently to get a good weather day!

Bruce and Ellen and very personable and engaging.  What a terrific job of making you feel a part of the process!  For those who have not flown on a small plane, Bruce does an excellent job of involving you in why and what he does from taxi to return.  Not hard to see why they are #1.  We have done both fixed and rotor wing tours and this was the friendliest and best priced yet.
The time will fly by...no pun intended (well maybe).

Flight tour of Grand Canyon; checked off the bucket list!  
I have ALS and Captain Jack and Grand Canyon Scenic Airlines were great and very accommodating. The flight was comfortable and truly amazing views.   My family and I are blessed to have Team Gleason @TeamGleason 
#nowhiteflags #teamgleason supporting us and making a difference in the lives of ALS families.

review_title: Excellent Experience-Glacier Landing is Worth It!
review_text: We had a full flight and everyone had a window. My husband was the co-pilot and had a great view, but couldn't take unobstructed pictures because of the propeller. The flight was amazing and our pictures are breathtaking. Our pilot was knowledgeable and explained to us what we were seeing. On the way to our landing strip, At least on our trip,The Denali Flyer, I sat on the left side of the plane and had a decent view. I recommend sitting on the right side of the plane because they have a better view of the mountain. Ask the pilot to see what they say. The glacier landing was amazing! We were fortunate that we went on a day that we could see Denali. It was definitely worth the extra money and we would do it again. We would definitely go again.

We did the flight over Mt. McKinley along with the glacier landing.  This was definitely our favorite part of our trip to Alaska!  It is really the only way to fully appreciate the beauty of this state.  Do not hesitate to pay the extra amount to land on the glacier.  It was incredible!!  Our pilot was top-notch...such a smooth flight!
Eric is very good. I enjoyed the flight it was amazing and awesome and I think all should try it out

review_title: One of the most incredible experiences of my life!
review_text: Captain Ray, Jill and her employees were incredible. It felt like a family-run operation with decades of experience in the aviation industry, so it felt personalized and safe. I can’t even begin to describe how beautiful the views were. Captain Ray knew so much about the island and was so skillful. We got to see tons of waterfalls, hidden beaches, cliffs, canyons and places we would never see via land. Jill was also wonderful. She made sure everyone felt comfortable and answered any questions we had. This flight was such a deal in my opinion. I’ve done similar tours in other places and this was the absolute bang for your buck. I can’t wait to go back and do this tour with my boyfriend, family and friends. I’m recommending this to everyone!

This was the best Bday gift my wife could have ever given me!!! Our pilot BJ, was cool, the helicopters were perfect, every seat is a great view, the tour was not to long but certainly not to short either. We got an incredible view of the canyon, so much so that we decided not to spend the extra cash to hit the park. I've been in many helos and if I could afford one I'd copy the Maverick style. I was afraid it was going to be a cheese ball 15 min run with a 30min preflight check,,, not so. It was the best money I've seen spent on tour to date.

review_title: Once in a lifetime - do it!
review_text: Absolutely beautiful ride!!! Steve was so calm and reassuring the whole ride and let us know what was going on the whole time. The views were stunning, definitely a once in a lifetime experience. 10/10 recommend.

Wow! What a great experience. They worked with us because the weather wasn’t good for our morning flight. Rearranged pilots so we could go in the afternoon with Lenny of time to return to ship. The scenery was so unbelievable. We landed on a lake and was able to stand on plane pylons. It was so serene and beautiful. Great company and people. We booked directly with them.

My friend was visiting from out of town and wanted to experience some of Alaska's glaciers up close and personal.  She booked up a flight on Sunday night and as luck would have it Denali showed up in full force.  The incredible views and knowledge we gained from Bill's narrative of the ride were priceless.  The entire staff from Paris, the ladies at the front desk, and Bill, were friendly, courteous, professional and a joy to be around.  I live here in Alaska and sometimes I experience a certain gruffness from certain businesses but I found none of that with TAT.  They are an awesome outfit and I will most certainly send others their way.  Thank you all for showing us how it should be done!

We booked the airvan tour directly by Ellen (owner of WoK) and she was very helpfull and aswered all my email. Bruce flew us over Kauai and we had an amazing time! There are no words that can describe the beauty of this island!  Thank you /mahalo Bruce for the video and picture you gave us, it was a fantastic!!

review_title: One of the greatest experiences in my life!
review_text: It’s not cheap, but really worth it! It’s a once in a life time experience. Friendly staff and very friendly and informative pilot. And you see a lot in 45 minutes! Many different aspects of the area, but most of all: the Grand Canyon and the Colorado river. .A really amazing place!!!!

Lindsey picked me up from the Boulders.  She was enthusiastic with a wealth of information.  Meg one of the staff at Westwind was enthusiastic and accommodating.  

Brett was my pilot. The reason I say "my" pilot was I was solo ~ for a while.  They asked if I minded if we made a stop in Sedona to pick up a small family of three, which was a nice extra.

The family was from England, Gilford on Thames in Surrey to be exact, and they were a pleasure. The red rock formations were spectacular.

The narration was excellent, and choreographed perfectly for the flight.  Although the Cessna looked small in photos, it was very comfortable for the four of us.  Brett took us over the South rim, then the East and North rims of the spectacular Grand Canyon.  This was definitely the ideal introduction to this natural wonder.

The return flight was smooth because he took us above the turbulence.  I was impressed by the skill and professionalism of everyone I came in contact with at Westwind., and would strongly recommend this rather than an arduous drive from Scottsdale.

We were undecided as to a fixed wing flight or a helicopter air tour over kaua'i. We are very pleased we chose Air Adventure Flights Tour on a small engine plane. The day had perfect visibility and the air was calm. Harry was our pilot & tour guide. He obviously knew the island and enjoyed the scenery as much as we did. Special bonus was watching the whales from the air. Very cool. Thank you Air Adventures for the amazing memories & the complimentary picture of our group!

review_title: A Great Time Was Had By All
review_text:
We had a group of eight in our party.  Everyone had a wonderful experience.  Our pilot was terrific.  Everyone especially enjoyed playing in the snow on Mt. Denali in June.
We've flown with other companies to Mt Denali.  This was the best experience of them all!
