It was a girlfriends weekend and we were visiting a friend who has a beautiful home on Shaw Island. We flew from San Jose to Seattle. In Seattle we boarded the sea plane which would take us to Friday Harbor and from Friday Harbor we would take a ferry to Shaw island. Everything was a wonderful experience but the most fun was the sea plane. The pilots were fabulous informative and the view was amazing. It was really a wonderful experience. I would highly recommend it to anyone
From booking our tour to exiting the plane, the experience was unbelievable! Front desk to pilot, amazing customer service. We can't wait to come back to Alaska to do this again!

I had a great treat flying with Envi Adventures on my birthday. The small plane seat 4, so my group of 3 was a perfect fit. I was able to sit in the co-pilot's seat. Our pilot Rick was friendly, knowledgeable, and provided a great ride. We were able to see the Columbia River Gorge and multiple waterfalls, as well as beautiful fall foliage. Such a unique and fun experience.

We took the K2 Denali Flyer with Glacier Landing a few days ago. Fortunately, Denali was mostly visible which we understand is not typical. K2 runs a very efficient and effective operation out of Talkeetna. We flew in a group of 9 in an Otter with an excellent pilot. Smooth as silk!

Our flight around Denali national park was one of the highlights of our trip. Our pilot was amazing and explained so much about the park, glaciers, etc and was quick to answer any and all questions we had. Check-in was effortless and the whole process was easy going. 100% worth the money!

review_title: A must do specially after visiting the parks
review_text: We did the Canyonlands and Arches flight. Larry was our pilot and his knowledge and love for the parks shows as he tells you stories and gives you information about what you see. The flight gives you a different perspective from what you see on land, plus you see many things you will not see any other way

review_title: Beautiful Island, Beautiful Airplane, Great Tour!
review_text:
As a pilot, I heard about Air Ventures from another pilot friend and made my plan based on that recommendation.  This was definitely the way to go. Call them direct and make the reservation vs. the web site.  You can get all the details and work out the best time and expected best local conditions (there is always some kind of cloud activity on every island's mountains).
They offer several ways to tour the island but there was no doubt I wanted to go in the Cessna 182 (they may call it luxury tour but for a few bucks extra you get the plane to yourselves and can get personal with your pilot).  I own my own plane and have been flying for 30 years, but this was the nicest Cessna 182 I have ever been in.  Fully equipped with G1000s, Bose noise cancelling A20 headsets(the best there are), and even an air-conditioner.  My pilot was Eric Johnson, a CFI with 8000 hours of flight time.  Really fun guy and exceptional pilot.  I knew right from the start I had picked the right company, plane, & pilot.
We circled the island as well as flew up thru the mountain passes enjoying the scenery and waterfalls. Way better than in a helicopter or the C208 caravan.
My wife is used to flying with me, but Eric went out of his way to make sure she was comfortable and enjoying the view.  I've flown with lots of pilots and CFIs over the years and it is a rare breed that can be fun, informative, highly competent, and safe at all times. 
All in all a really fun and informative flight experience I would recommend to all.

My family of four and two friends we were traveling with had the very enjoyable experience of taking an airvan flight with Wings Over Kauai on Sunday April 3.  The weather was perfect (though Elaine offered to switch the date if we had to - glad it was not required), the check in experience was fun and the flight was wonderful.  Bruce is an excellent pilot/tour guide and we are very happy we did this tour early in our trip!  Thanks again for a lovely experience.
Well done. Jeep and airplane personnel very knowledgeable and caring. Would use your services again.

The flight was above and beyond all that I expected. To land on a prestine lake, step out Ona small island and experience the peace and tranquility was outstanding. The staff are to be commended on the service provided.
What a great time! Loved seeing the whales and the island from a totally different perspective. If you want a unique adventure this is it!

We took the Grand Canyon Deluxe tour to the South Rim of the Grand Canyon.  The view from the plane was amazing.  The canyon is much more grand at the South Rim vs the West Rim.  The bus picked us up for a 15 minute trip to the National Park where we were dropped off for 1.5 hours at the first stop.  It was cold so we were glad for the heated restaurant and gift shop!  We had plenty of time to take pictures before heading to the next stop.  Our bus driver was great and very knowledgeable about the canyon, thanks Bob!  The flight back was a little bumpy due to wind and going to a lower elevation, but the pilots were great!  Well worth the time and money.  I highly recommend this tour!
Our flight was cancelled because of bad weather. W revived a full refund. The crew was so kind and let us go into the air plain to have some pictures. Next time we will book them again.

review_title: Fun and safe way to enjoy Denali
review_text: We took the Grand Tour on July 5th and it was a bright and wonderful day. Our pilot was fun and gave thorough explanations, the weather was surprisingly warm and we got to land on the glacier and enjoyed the views wearing a simple long sleeve. Though there were many wildfires, we were lucky and experienced no smoke during our flight. There are so many mountains and glaciers that it is humbling to realize how small we are. The boots that K2 Aviation offers for people who might get cold or wet worked admirably well and they really looked clean. The check in process was very well organized.

review_title: Worth every penny! This was an extraordinary experience!
review_text: We flew up to Denali, and landed on a glacier. Luckily, we had a beautiful sunny day, and Denali was out of her clouds to see. The only real way to see Alaska is to fly over her. I now know why people pull up stakes at home, and head to Alaska to live. It just feels like freedom. Every safety precaution was taken to make this a safe flight, and we checked with locals to see which service to use. Everyone told us that Talkeetna Air was the best.

What a fantastic tour. We were signed up for the Denali Grand Tour with Glacier landing. Due to the wildfires near Fairbanks, the north side of the mountain was smokey. It was a beautiful clear day we flew very close to peaks and the glaciers. The pilot and the staff was very professional and informative. Landing on the glacier was impressive and we were able to appreciate the grandeur of the mountains. There even is a Chalet on the glacier that you can stay at for $2,300 a person a night. I highly recommend K2 Aviation.

review_title: Beautiful scenery, smooth boat ride and flight.
review_text:
Our Misty Fjords tour was a boat ride from Ketchican to the fjords, with a return by small plane.  The guides on the boat were informative and nice.  

The pilot seemed highly skilled -- I wasn't sure we had taken off or landed, they were both so smooth.  A few air current bumps going around mountain peaks, which is normal.  We had a high degree of confidence in the pilot, who handle the plane superbly. 

Incredible scenery with a memorable boat ride and flight.  

Highly recommended.

Thanks, Taquan Air and staff!

I had a flightseeing tour with glacier landing with K2 Aviation and it was AMAZING. That was the highlight of my Alaska trip. Seeing the mountains so close as if you could touch them and landing on the glacier was once in a lifetime experience—and the K2 Aviation delivers.

Patrick, our tour pilot, was very good. He was calm taking away any of my fear of flying in a small plane. It’s obvious that he is an experienced pilot, told us what to expect on the flight, will tell us in advance if he will make some turns and the time to
land. He also shared his knowledge about the area and Alaska mountain ranges. Thank you, Patrick, for a safe, smooth and once in a lifetime amazing tour.

The staff of K2 were courteous. I had my original scheduled tour cancelled due to weather, given a choice to be fully refunded or move to another day which I did and it turned out to be gloriously sunny the next day when the elusive Denali showing its glory.

The plane is clean and safety is well practiced. Their color red planes look so beautiful against the snow covered mountains and glacier on the pictures. Also, if you don’t have snow boots—they will provide any sizes that you can put over your footwear. Their facilities are clean too. I think their restrooms were the cleanest among all the public restrooms I used during my trip in Alaska.

The money I spent with this tour is all worth it. It’s a tour of a lifetime. I highly recommend K2 Aviation.

review_title: What a Thrill for My Visiting Niece (and Us)!!!!!!!!
review_text:
This was my second time flying with Envi and once again, WOW!!!!! What a perfect way to introduce my visiting niece (who'd never been to Oregon) to the wonders of our fair state. Our pilot Daniel was very personable and experienced and we really enjoyed seeing the original interior of the 1957 plane (to be remodeled, we were told).

We did the one-hour "Figure Eight" flight which took us east over the Columbia River, where we circled Beacon Rock and saw hikers climbing to the summit. Though we started with cloud cover, the sky cleared the farther east we went, and we were able to see ALL the mountains (Hood, Adams, St. Helens, even Ranier). It was neat to get a birds-eye view of Multnomah Falls as we headed west towards downtown. It was cool to listen to Daniel communicate with air traffic control at PDX as we banked over the runways. We saw the many downtown bridges, passed over the zoo and Forestry Center, and the Pittock Mansion, and Mt. Tabor in my old SE Portland 'hood. 

This was my niece's favorite part of her visit and I agree. We highly recommend!!!!

I have to share my experience this morning. I took my Very First Flight Ever a couple of hours ago and did it through RedTail Aviation in a 6 person plane. I was so nervous before I got on the plane and then I met the pilot (who is very young) which made me a bit more nervous. We board the plane and before long I was having the time of my life. I'm giving a very high compliment to the pilot Neil! He was so calm through turbulence and made me feel very comfortable. He controlled the plane with expertise, confidence and precision and is a great narrator for the trip. I had an amazing first flight and it's all thanks to Neil and RedTail Aviation. I will be seeing you again in the future and will recommend you to everyone I can!

review_title: Flight Around Denali is a MUST!
review_text:
K2 was amazing! Their wonderful reviews led me to them. Their competitive rates/discounts were a big factor as well. 

Our flight was canceled the morning of due to wildfire smoke but they worked with us , keeping us in the loop, and were able to get us booked for later the same day!

Absolutely stunning views!

We took the K-2 Aviation Denali Grand Tour based on recommendations from two of our friends.  Both of the friends said it was the highlight of their trip to Alaska.  We did the flight on a clear, sunny day in September, and it was absolutely fantastic.  In fact, I took so many pictures and can’t bring myself to delete any of them.  Our pilot, Kevin, was very, very knowledgeable.  He knew when to talk and when to let us enjoy the beauty and grandeur of the flight.  I would highly recommend paying the extra money to land on the glacier!  It was especially a highlight for these Floridians that never see snow!

review_title: Great way to see the Grand Canyon and save time
review_text: A full day adventure visiting the west side of the Grand Canyon. Ryan, our pilot and guide, was very knowledgeable and super nice. Seeing a part of Arizona from above was interesting. I saw pine forests, desert, lakes and canyons everywhere. It would’ve taken me a few days of driving just to see what I saw in the hour and a half time flight. Visiting the Grand Canyons with Westwind Air Service also allows you to beat the crowds arriving by bus from Las Vegas. We left our hotel in Carefree at 6:30 and had returned by 17:00. A full day but well worth the cost. Next time I’m taking the East Grand Canyon Tour.
Although a bit costly, the Glacier Landing tour of K2 is the highlight of my trip to Alaska. Professional captain and staff. Beautiful red planes!

The day was perfect from the moment we checked in everyone was organized, ready to go, and on time. The staff were all professional and kind and the pilot was great. I could not say any more about our experience except it was AWESOME!! Thank you all for making our vacation one to remember!

review_title: Great pilot, talented beyond his years!
review_text:
Our young pilot was Makoa and he was awesome! He was very good at making sure everyone was having a great time and to share the views as best he could with both sides of the aircraft. He did everything in his power to give us a smooth ride. 

The views were exceptional and we had a nice cool morning. I work on the water around Kauai and would have to say that seeing both angles on our coast and canyon really enhanced my love for this place! Everyone should take a flight!

We flew around the top of Mt. McKinley on a beautiful day then landed on a glacier.  We then got out, walked around and took pictures for about 15 minutes and the plane then took off from the glacier and brought us home.  The entire trip was done in a professional manner with the utmost concern for safety.
I will guarantee that this will be a highlight of your trip.
What a fun trip! the flight to the Everglades was visually stunning. Our pilot was extremely friendly and informative. The airboat ride was amazing. The captain was very knowledgeable.
Great flight, great views. the pilot was very informative and tried to get evryone a good view of the area
My teens loved this adventure!   Enough said, teens are hard to please.   It was awesome.  Staff was awesome.   Absolutely beautiful.  We did this as part of the Best of Kauai tour.

What a great way to see the Island ! The flight was great, the pilot  did a wonderful job and the staff was very plesant and professional. It was really nice to see the Island from the air and get the places we visited in prospective. I would recommend Air Ventures as a must when visiting Kauai.

review_title: Beautiful tour of the misty fjords
review_text:
We visited the misty fjords today while on an Alaskan cruise.  We had a beautiful sunny day today.  We did the float plane tour this morning.

I really enjoyed the tour but I would have enjoyed a little more comments from the pilot but the beauty of the fjords mad up for his lack of communication.

This tour is definitely worth the money.
Amazing trip, well worth it. Once in a lifetime opportunity to fly above the clouds and see the mountains up close. Would recommend, pictures do not do it justice!
Eric was a wonderful tour guide. This ride was one of the best things we experienced in Maui. Highly recommend this!

review_title: I'd come ack here to do this again
review_text: Eric was very knowledgeable during the flight, the sights very absolutely stunning. I'd recommend this to everyone.

review_title: Don't Miss this Chance to See Denali
review_text: This is a very special experience, if the weather cooperates.  The team at TAT was great at finding a time to reschedule us so that we could make it happen.  The pilot was great, the ride felt safe at all times, and the chance to see Denali, the glaciers, and so on was fantastic.  That we landed in about a foot of fresh powder snow was a blast.  Did not anticipate being able to have a snowball fight in September.

review_title: The best view of the Golden Gate Bridge possible
review_text: A really good way to see the bay area, and a very professional and friendly service. Cannot recommend highly enough!

We were deciding between a helicopter or plane tour and decided to go with the plane tour after looking at the cost and reading reviews on TripAdvisor.  Bruce, Ellen and their daughter Mary were very warm and friendly and made us fee very welcome. Bruce and Ellen got us strapped in and ready to go up in the air with Bruce.  Bruce was very accommodating and knowledgeable of the island terrain. Bruce's demeanor put us at ease and his knowledge made for an educational and fun trip,  We highly recommend this trip to any one who wants to see the island form the air.
John and Debi Brewer
Great time in the air. Jaw dropping views that can’t be scene from anywhere else had a great and safe pilot and a great family adventure I can’t wait to do it again

I highly recommend this tour -- it provides a spectacular view of the entire island (including Hanalei Bay, Waimea Canyon, and the Napali Coast, among many others) which really lets you appreciate how beautiful Kauai is. Our pilot, J.T., was excellent, as he provided the group with a very smooth ride and entertaining/helpful commentary while also being sure to point out notable features in the landscape for photos. Definitely a trip worth doing if you have the opportunity!

Thanks J.T.!

- Daniel and Nicole

P.S.: It will probably be fairly warm inside the plane, so show up to the tour hydrated and not on an empty stomach to avoid motion sickness!

Our pilot was Great… the views over Miami were stunning 
It was a gift for my girlfriend for the valentines and everything was as promised.
Definitely will repeat it again.
Thank you 100/100

Eric is a fantastic pilot and tour guide. He took us on tour of Molokai and presented us with some great views of the Island and the tall waterfalls. The ride was a little rough on the way back due to the winds on the west side of Maui. But Eric ensured that we all were safe. Highly recommend it to anyone visiting Maui.

So glad i decided to do this tour at the last minute ! It was A-MA-ZING !!! The pilot was awesome ! Friendly staff :)  Highly recommend when in Talkeetna. 
Bucketlist checked :)

My cousin and I flew to a remote lake with K2’s Beaver on floats. The weather wasn’t great at our scheduled departure time so we delayed our trip. Jen was very friendly in making sure we had enough food and fuel for our float out, despite the fact that they would not be picking us up or be responsible for our safe return. Chip, our pilot, inspired confidence and was friendly and helpful getting our gear in and out of the plane. He knows the area and gave us useful background on campsites in the area. K2 is a professional operator that I would book with again.

We couldn't have had better weather!! There were no clouds and minimal wind, it was an amazing flight and an even better experience. Thank you to K2 for getting us up there to share the beauty of Denali Nat'l Park! Definitely recommend to our friends and family.

review_title: This was a truly awesome experience!
review_text: This was my 4th or 5th time visiting Kauai but my very first time from the air.  I had always wanted to see it from the air and was not disappointed.  One must honestly see it from this view in order to truly experience Kauai's beauty.  We even saw a few whales - what an extra treat!

review_title: Plane vs Helicopter or Catamaran (if you have to choose)
review_text: Given 80% of Kauai it's not accessible by car, this is a great way to see the island. Much cheaper than a helicopter tour and without the day commitment of a catamaran tour, so if you're limited on time and money, this is a solid choice. Great staff, knowledgeable pilot and phenomenal views. Mahalo!

review_title: Great experience, very glad we did it.
review_text: Good experience. The ride was smooth. The pilot was competent and offered information on what we were seeing. A good experience all around. We even saw some whales.
This was a great experience. Our pilot Chris was very knowledgeable about Denali and the glaciers. We paid the extra $100 for the glacier landing. WORTH IT. Flight was smooth and lots of fun.

What an amazing experience. Totally worth the money. Safe flight and experienced pilot. Views were amazing from Friday Harbor to Seattle. Door to door excellent service. Even saw him back whales on our flight over. One of my top 10 experiences! ITS A MUST DO!

Amazing unforgettable experience. Glacial landing is incredible and pilot is super capable and reliable. Would do this a million times. 
K2 has a long line checking in but were very helpful and rescheduled my flight for weather reasons a couple times. It does have a relatively small parking lot for RV so be mindful for parking there
Such a cool experience. We did an hour tour and I would highly recommend the hour. Seeing the coast of Northern California and the city were incredible.
Aviation has been our life so of course every place we visit we must make a trip to the airport!  So interesting to see all the planes and visit with the locals
Great flight even if you live in this city. Bob’s am excellent pilot and guide! Highly recommend this adventure.

We were 2 couples traveling on the Pride of America. Pilot Marcus took us on a spectacular flight over Kauai. It was a highlight of our cruise. His commentary was very interesting and the flight itself was smooth - important for someone like me who is prone to air sickness. Everything from first contact to landing was seamless and perfect. The plane affords great viewing for everyone regardless of where you sit. These people are pros. Do not hesitate a moment to book.
Best glacier landing experience during the fall season. Visited during October for northern flights but got to know the winter explorer is open. This was once in a life time exp for us

The K2 Aviation team went above and beyond tommake sure we were able to have the full experience, even though we booked a little last minute. The flightseeing tour was awesome and they made sure we made it back to our hotel shuttle on time! Great outfit and we endorse them 100%.
Jeff was a great guide and this was a beautiful ride, loved it!  The crossing over the south rim was breathtaking and we even saw bison below

First time for my wife in a helicopter. She loved it. Seeing the canyon from up there was just wonderful. The pilot was very informative. He tried to show us a little of everything. But the wildlife did not cooperate. The flight itself was very smooth. Flying out over the edge of the canyon for the first time was absolutely spectacular.
Amazing time with views that can’t be beat.  Our pilot was knowledgeable and great trivia about the islands.
I have done this trip twice now. It's an absolutely stunning experience. Try to give yourself a couple of backup days, because the weather can be pretty unpredictable.
We absolutely loved our sunset trip. I was overwhelmed with how much the lady was willing to help me set up our trip. I had lots of scheduling issues and they saved the day!

The Air Ventures plane tour was amazing & the staff was the best! The staff was so friendly & the pilot was funny & made our tour fun & informative. My husband also got motion sickness horribly bad & the pilot & staff were very caring & accommodating to him & our family of 5. I would recommend this tour over the helicopter tours I have been on in the past & recommend this company because of there incredible staff!! A+++

review_title: A very safety oriented tour operator.
review_text: When I started researching Denali tour operators last fall I narrowed it down to two.  Talkeetna Air was my first choice, having lived in Alaska, both my choices have been operating in the state for many years.  Over the winter I spoke to many locals who confirmed my initial thoughts.  Our pilot was very patient with the preflight briefing making sure all our questions were satisfactorily answered before we boarded.  The trip over to the mountian range we had a very smooth flight.  The pilot's commentary across and working up the glacier was well balanced with geology, history and a little bit of lore.  We had a good landing at upper base camp.  Spent our fifteen minutes on the glacier.  He had to go to plan B and was very good about explaining what we would need to do and what he was going to need to do to get us back to the hanger.  Do not believe anyone in the group had any cause to question the pilot's decission and concern for our safty and that of the equipment.

review_title: Highlight of our trip! Worth every penny!
review_text: This was an awesome way to see the whole island of Kauai!  Our Pilot, Eric, was awesome.  Great info about the island as we flew.  Beautiful waterfalls, canyons, beaches.  A great way to get a unique view of it all.  Combine this with some hikes and a water excursion and you'll get to experience Kauai from many viewpoints.  Much recommended.

Best Birthday Flight!    So happy I decided to celebrate my Birthday with Aero Adventures!  Thank you Marylee, Anna, John and Ren for making the day so special.   Nothing can compare to flying over SF and the Golden Gate.  I have sailed under the Golden Gate but there is something truly special SOARING over the Golden Gate!  Floating along the Bay preparing to take-off (engine ROARING) is magical.  I can't wait for my next Flight!     -E.A.H.-Lockhart a.k.a jumpjet

You can't go to Alaska and not experience a floatplane trip! Both K-2 and Rust's Flying Service are GREAT! Informative, friendly pilots and staff. They are very honest with people regarding flight conditions and visibility...so you don't have to worry about wasting your money because they won't fly if conditions are not good. Flightseeing can be expensive but it is lots of fun and very scenic...we loved our experience!

In late Jan I took my wife on this tour for her BD. While I’ve spent numerous hours (military’s & law enforcement) aboard helicopters, she had never experienced it...
nor had she ever been to the Grand Canyon. Our pilot BJ, was to say the least ‘spectacular’!!! The informative info he passed along about the Canyon, combined with the visual scenery made this a trip my wife, or I will ever forget. BJ’s handeling of the aircraft was so professional that on my return home I joked with some law enforcement pilot friends that they needed to consider lessons from him (😱😆). Yes, a limo ride with rotor blades it was !! As another review mentioned, it is expensive BUT, it is truly well worth the cost. The sights of the Canyon that you will see will burn a picture in your mind for a lifetime. 
While we just heard the tragic news of a copter crash in the Canyon, 2 points to ponder; #1) when a car crashes you don’t stop driving, #2) when you consider the number of flights vs the number of accidents, your much safer in the air, especially with Maverick Air where everyone, not just the pilots, went out of their way to ensure we enjoyed our moment. 5 thumbs up to all of them!!

We recently returned from a land and sea vacation in Alaska. Our K2 flight to Mt. Denali with a landing on Pika Glacier was the highlight of our entire vacation! The views of the Alaskan Range as we flew between the mountain peaks, into the valleys, and over numerous glaciers was fantastic. Flying around the summit of Denali was breathtaking; unbelievable how awesome this mountain is. The weather cooperated and we were able to land on Pika Glacier and walk around on the snow covered glacier. What an experience! Chris, our pilot, was wonderful and gave us very informative commentary throughout our flight. Many, many thanks to K2 and to Chris for such a wonderful flight! Would highly recommend this tour to anyone visiting Alaska.

Talkeetna Air Taxi has over a thousand glowingly positive reviews, and they're all true. This was one of the most amazing experiences of my life. The flying was smooth, the landing was smooth, the sights were incredible. Landing and walking on that glacier was one of the best tourist experiences I have ever had in the 47 states and 38 countries I've been to. 

Just note that like any domestic flight, they ask that you come 45 minutes before your departure time and masks are required in the terminal and on the plane. We could take our masks off on the glacier so long as we social distanced, which was not a problem as the glacier is massive.

Had a great time and a great flight. The entire experience was flawless from booking to checking in and the flight itself. Very professional, organized, and fun group of people. Highly recommend to everyone considering a flight with Envi. Enjoyed the entire flight and the views were top notch,

We had a wonderful time. Maka was our pilot and he was very kind and informative.

I was concerned at first that I wouldn’t be able to see well and I was very happy that I could see everything I wanted to

review_title: It was overall a happy experience.
review_text: It was our first time doing flight seeing tour. Had a great time. My kids slept during the flight. We were doing the Denali experience. It was beautiful seeing the mountain views. Would recommend.

We booked on the Grand Denali Tour with the Glacier landing, and it was worth every cent! We hesitated about the glacier landing because of the cost, but it is definitely worth doing if you can. To be able to stop in amongst it all, and take it all in, is an awesome experience. TAT are a very professional company. From the moment you book the flight till the moment you return, you know you are in good hands. We booked with TAT because of all the positive reviews - if you are doing the same at the moment, the best advice I can give is to trust what has already been written, and just book it! You won't be disappointed with your choice.
It was amazing a real thrill.  My pilot was very experienced & professional. We enjoyed it immensely  definitely want to give it a go

The morning of our scheduled flight it was pouring...Jason reassured us that it was safe to fly and we had a wonderful flight.  The views were amazing.  I would highly recommend this to anyone visiting the talkeetna area.

Words cannot describe how amazing this tour is.

From the office staff, to the ground crew, to the pilot; these people are fantastic.  The pilot went over all the emergency necessities before we took off; first aid kit, sleeping bags, signals.  I was a little leery about flying in such a small craft, but once we were in the air, I forgot all about it.  The views out both sides of the plane were just amazing.  The pilot pointed out different points of interest.  We took tons of pictures.  He maneuvered in/out of the mountains with the greatest of ease.  It felt like we could just reach out an touch the mountain.  If there was any turbulence, I never felt it.  

You HAVE to do this if you're in Talkeetna.
We had a wonderful trip flightseeing Denali on K2.  The plane was immaculate, the pilot was skilled and the scenery was awesome.  The glacier landing was a plus.

Awesome flight! Eric was very informative! As a fellow private pilot, I observed that Eric is an excellent pilot. Very safe and smooth ride!

We flew the 5 Island tour which was full of amazing views! Do this flight! Skip the helicopter tour and fly with Maui Plane Rides!!

Though trip and views limited by clouds and rain, it still was an amazing trip. Pilot was informative and clearly skilled. Will definitely take another flight when we come back in different weather conditions.

review_title: Excellent tour with view of Grand Canyon
review_text: Enjoyed the entire package of guided tour and ride over Grand Canyon. Lots of different angles and explaining of waterfalls

Arrived at the location and there was a scheduling snafu.  Most likely my fault, but it didn't matter -- they called in another pilot just to make sure things went well for us.  The tour was great, the pilot was great and very informative, and everyone was very friendly.  Would definitely recommend this.  I do have to say that I got a little bit queasy towards the end, so take a dramamine!

Wow! A must do when you are even near the Miami area. I moved to Miami in 1984 and I now live about 90 miles north of Miami. This is a must do and do yourself a favor and take the one hour tour. It is totally worth the money and you will see so much more. No wonder I fell in love with this town way back then. The tour was phenomenal. Tony was outstanding, fun and informative. And so SAFE!!!! Better than flying commercial for sure! If I could give Tony and Miami Seaplane more than Excellent, I would. What a fun, adventurous experience! Do not miss it. It is worth every single penny! I love Miami and Miami Seaplane rides. Will do it again and charter a flight with them as well! AWESOME!

There is no way to see Alaska as well as by air.  This was one of the highlights of our trip and we would recommend it to everyone.  This is a family owned business, maybe that is why the service was so nice.  Our pilot was awesome, he made sure to circle and let us all see from different angles.. The scenery was breathtaking and the flight was smooth and you could tell the pilot was excellent at his job.  We would recommend them to everyone.

The staff at family owned business is very friendly. Bruce, our pilot is very engaging and made sure to engage us all and check that we were all comfortable. The headsets allow us to listen in on the chatter, as well as talk to each other, while keeping the engine noise to a minimum.

We got a private tour in the Airvan for our party of four. My son got to sit in the co-pilot's seat and read of the flight checklist. the rest of us got the 3 seats on the right side, which is the view-side. If you can, try and get a group of 4 together.

The take-off and landing were smooth, and the weather was nice for us to have a smooth flight (although my daughter did get air-sick before the end).

The views are great. Bruce provided a steady flow of information and history of the various areas we flew over.

At the end of the flight, we got a DVD of the flight route, made by the pilot's son. The video is quite well made.
 
Now for the downsides: Apparently, the passengers are greeted with a lei - we were'nt. We saw several helicopters flying lower and closer to the Napali coast and in the Waimea Canyon. So, if your party can handle the bumpier ride and higher costs of helicopters tours, you may want to consider those too. The hour long ride does feel too short. I wish it were atleast another 20-30 minutes longer, so that we could have spent more time in Waimea and along the Napali coast.

Still, it was a good experience.
We took the Vista View tour just to give our 12-year old a taste of flying. Beautiful flight and a great pilot. We will be back for a longer tour.
Amazing experience. Eric was informative and very flexible. We visited Molokai on a whim. Highly recommend!  Once in a lifetime experience.
Such a great experience. I can only recommend it. The view of Alcatraz and the city was amazing. Must do!

When I asked the activities agent “how can I see most of the island in a short amount of time” he quickly suggested: “take a plane ride, it’ll be unforgettable.” He was absolutely right. The view was breathtaking! Seeing the Na Pali coastline, Waimea Canyon, and the 800 foot waterfalls left us in awe. I would highly recommend this wonderful company. The owner herself picked us up from the meeting point and drove us to the airport where we were to board the plane. The pilot and all the staff members were friendly, informative, and made sure we had an amazing adventure to remember. Thank you Airventures!

My first time in a helicopter and it was a great experience.  Everyone at the facility was helpful and very friendly. It was amazing to see the Grand Canyon from an aerial view.  However, book directly through Maverick, it's cheaper.  Trip Advisor did not email me confirmation and that was a big hassle.
JT did an excellent job of narrating and showing us the island of Kauai. He showed us all the beautiful areas on the island.

The flight was amazing.  Pricey (cost more than our airfare from San Jose to Fairbanks-round trip), but the best part of our vacation!  The most memorable thing we did!  We would do it again!!!  Awesome pilot!
Eric was awesome! Very cool to see Maui from the sky! Definitely highly recommend everyone do it once
Plan ride was awesome, the view was spectacular, our pilot was great and full of information on the area.  Highly recommend to others

Heather at the front desk did everything she could to get us a flight seeing trip to see Mt. McKinley. She was great! Also our pilot Greg Sanoski gave us a wonderful trip. We can't wait to do it again.

Steve the pilot was awesome! Excellent views and experience. We felt greeted and welcome when we arrived by Erik and Steve. 

You cant see in the ground what you see flying. Molikai views are breath taking, as well as seed Molokini from the sky. We love the experience and will come back.

review_title: It will take your breath away !!!
review_text: We were on a cruise and wanted to book our own day trips.  Looking over the options for Ketchikan, this seemed to be a fantastic choice.  And it was !  After Leslie picked us up at the cruise ship dock, she drove us to the water's edge where we were greeted by her husband, Steve, the pilot.  He took us on a breathtaking trip in his sea plane over the area and we actually landed at the Misty Fjords so we could explore this national landmark.  Seeing the area by air actually gives you the unique perspective of how vast and gorgeous the area actually is. As we were going back to the cruise ship dock, I asked Leslie where she suggested we have lunch, and she actually dropped us off at the restaurant!   I would highly recommend Seawind Aviation for your trip to Alaska!

Knowing my love of flying my wife got me the 1 hour instructional flight over Kauai for my birthday. This was the perfect birthday present, combining an opportunity to fly with the beautiful scenery of Kauai. Wings Over Kauai was a wonderful experience. Ellen helped my wife set up the appointment and even sent her a special certificate that she could present me prior to the flight. When we arrived, Marin was warm, friendly and helpful in preparing us for the flight as we waited for pilot Bruce to bring the 4 seater around. Once in the aircraft Bruce was very thorough in instructing me how to taxi and generally operate the aircraft. He even got my wife involved, having her go through the pre-departure check list. (She thought she was only along for the ride.) Bruce was very helpful and helped me taxi, takeoff, and let me fly a good portion of the flight. When we got to Na Pali he took the controls allowing me to fully enjoy the scenery. Bruce was as good a tour guide as he was a flight instructor pointing out the unique terrain, sites and nature of the island.

I can not say enough good things about Bruce and Wings Over Kauai. I would highly recommend them for either a tour or an instructional flight.

review_title: The best experience of Grand Canyon
review_text: Thank you very much. We loved the flight, the views and the commentary. This is the best way to do Grand Canyon. We highly recommend it, very professional company.

review_title: South Rim Grand Canyon with Maverick
review_text: We signed up for a plane tour - 19 seat plane. The flight to South Rim from LV took 30 minutes plus 10 circling around to take pictures. Well organized. We had families from Australia and Korea on our flight. Cameron and Todd (our 2 pilots) were very professional and friendly. Beautiful views! The tour was very well organized and our tour guide Bruce, very knowledgeable and friendly. Grand Canyon is even bigger than you imagine! Excellent experience! Thank you Eric (our trip advisor)

We flew with Eric on the DeHavilland Otter. Our group of 5 was joined by 5 others, which was fine with us. The bus was easy to find and the ride was short. Lesley got us checked in right away. Our larger bags were stored safely behind the desk.
The flight was absolutely breathtaking, it is hard to describe in words. The plane was well maintained and we felt very safe. This is a do not miss experience in Ketchikan!

Wings Over Kauai was an excellent tour of the beautiful island of Kauai. It was also at a reasonable price. It was definitely one of our highlights of our trip. Bruce the pilot was very friendly and landed the plane so smoothly. We saw breathtaking views and really didn't feel like we missed ouit on a helicopter ride at all. They gave me a beautiful lei necklace, a flower for my hair, and a wonderful DVD of Kauai as a gift. I would highly recommend this tour!!!!

review_title: Fantastic Company to Fly into the Alaska Range
review_text: Excellent Customer Service and very willing to work with our climbing team schedule. They also provided us with transportation around Talkeetna. The employees were very kind and showed interest in our endeavor. The flight staff was very professional and the ground crews were very accommodating and helpful.

My sister and my mom and I flew to Bimini with Tony on Sunday morning for a mini beach day...what an excellent experience we had going and coming.  Tony, the pilot, was FANTASTIC--made you feel just like family from the moment he greets you.  His flying skills are superb...the landing was flawless-- both times....What a great experience, if you are ever in Miami and want to do a quick tour or a mini get-a-way, this is by far the way to go!
Once in the lifetime experience, the view was just amazing. Had a really good time. Pilot was friendly and knowledgeable.

A visit to Talkeetna would not be complete without doing a flight with K-2. they have a number of options for flights, from a fly around the range to landing on the glacier. In the past, we have done the summit flight at 22,000 feet. To fly between the peaks of Denali and look down is something to remember the rest of your life. Their pilots are very professional and have a lot of flying time which is what you would what if flying in this area. This trip we chose the fly around with with Eddy as our pilot. He made us very comfortable from the start. He and Dale are very friendly and will make your trip even more memorable. 
John & Susan
This one hour flight was great!  Harry is an excellent pilot.  It was a comfortable flight and he provided interesting commentary.  I highly recommend this flight service.

Lived in Marin all my life. Always loved seeing the Dehavilland Beaver flying overhead. I finally snapped out of it and scheduled a ride for my wife and me for our 17 year anniversary. WOW, what a blast. Our pilot Will, was very experienced and really interesting.  You haven't seen Marin and the Bay Area unless you've seen it from 2,000 feet above on one of these aircraft. Magnificent! This will be an annual event for us in the future...

I have flown over Maui many times, in both helicopters and fixed wing craft, but I have never had an experience like this one.  Eric has a passion for what he does, and you can feel it the moment you meet him.   I can promise you that this will be a flight you will never forget.  Not only will Eric make sure you get to see everything you want, you also get the chance to fly the plane yourself if you want to!  No one else will let you do that!
Best experience! Great for whole family. Went with kids ages 10 & 12 - a day we will never forget. Space for RV parking & easy walk into town for lunch afterwards

Flying over the entire Mountains was an unforgettable experience in an 8 seater plane ( individual seats with windows) viewing Mountains, waterfalls & beaches with an impressive m. Informative documentary by pilot Marcus. By far the best way to experience the Island!
This is an amazing experience, great customer service really enjoyed it seeing all of Miami from above highly recommend it.
Brilliant service even though we had a little too much luggage. Relaxed and caring pilot and a fabulous flight from Friday Harbor to Renton. Worth every cent....

We took the Grand canyon Airlines scenic tours from the Papillon Helicopter rides.  We opted for the all day airplane ride vs the helicopter as we wanted to be able to walk around the Grand Canyon.  It is about a 1 hour plane ride there and an hour back.  They give you plenty of time to walk around at 2 different areas, and a boxed lunch that was pretty good.  We enjoyed the airplane (although a little cramped) if your a big person don't get on this plane.  They give you headsets to listen to music and info on the Grand Canyon.  The bus ride at the Grand Canyon was also good.  Big bus, holds over 30 people, with knowledgeable people.  The only thing we didn't like was the waiting!  After picking us up at 7:30am, it takes about 1 hour to get to their airport as you have to pick up many people.  Then wait in line to check in.  Then wait an hour for them to call your color (the helicopter rides run much faster).  At the Grand Canyon, wait for the bus, wait on the bus.  Coming home the same, more waiting around for buses, planes.  On return they don't tell you you have to check in with the man at a little desk to get a ride back to your hotel.  So, more waiting.  We are glad we did it, got some excellent pictures, & all in all did enjoy the day, although it is exhausting.

review_title: Great way to see the Grand Canyon with limited time
review_text: We stayed in Scottsdale for our vacation and took Westwind from the Deer Valley airport only 20 minutes away. Our family of five (kids 13, 10, 3) had never seen the Grand Canyon. Flying up there in 1 hour was such a treat over driving for 3.5 hours. Our two older kids really listened to the narrated history on the headphones the whole way up, and even our three year old looked out the window as we started to fly over the Grand Canyon itself. The view is absolutely stunning, and the flight was very smooth. Once we landed, the Pink Jeep tour guide did a great job telling us the history and getting us to each view point quickly and efficiently. They also added an Imax movie viewing of the Grand Canyon river tour as an added surprise, which all of us enjoyed. On the way back, our pilot Jameson had my 10 year old in the front as co-pilot, and he LOVED hearing all about the airplane and the landscape below the whole way back. The whole day was a great experience.
Great service, friendly pilots, riding a seaplane iS a must do experience.   Strong recommendation to sTop and take in the scenery

review_title: Probably the best part of our trip to Kaua'i!
review_text: The pilot was super friendly and knowledgeable, the flight was smooth and the views were amazing! The video of our flight was very reasonably priced! The staff was also very accommodating and willing to reschedule our tour to make sure we had the best time possible. Highly recommended!
1n 2015.I tried Summit twice. No luck.Denali decides. August 3 2016 morning rain subsided..Summit flight Bluebird perfect

Incredible. Tough to capture in words. It was a magnificent experience: the views/landscapes/Denali & the Alaska Range; plus Talkeetna Air Taxi was top-tier at accommodating our interest, even w/ weather delays. We’re very thankful all aligned to make this experience so special. Highly recommend!

Our McKinley tour with a glacier landing with Talkeetna Air Taxi was the highlight of all the many things that we did on our visit to Alaska.  We chose TAT because of the reviews we had read and because they work with you on letting you choose to go up if the conditions are less than favorable and rescheduling if necessary.  We were fortunate that our weather was perfect the day of our flight so off we went.  All the TAT team were friendly and welcoming and our pilot, Tyler, took very good care of us and made sure we were all comfortable.  The flight was smooth and we felt very confident that we were in good hands. And what we saw!!!! WOW! The flight allowed us to see so much up close and we were amazed at the beauty and magnitude of the mountain range. Mt. McKinley was amazing!  Tyler shared many interesting facts with us and pointed out different highlights that we went by. You must add the glacier landing to your tour!  There is nothing like being able to get out on the glacier and walk and look around and get pictures while high up in the mountains.The glacier landing and take off was smooth and we never had a worry about anything.  Sadly, we had to return but the memories will last us a lifetime.  This is a must do if you visit Alaska, well worth every penny.  (look for deals if you have a group of four or more).

review_title: The highlight activity of Alaska!!!  My pictures don't do it justice!
review_text:
There are a few places in the world where pictures just don't work.  The Grand Canyon, the Sistine Chapel, the Dancing House of Prague to name a few.  What you will see on a glacier landing flight might top any of your lists, it certainly tops mine.

The easiest way to explain just how MASSIVE these mountains and glaciers are can be summed up by a question we asked our pilot.  It appeared that he was flying extremely close to the mountains, so we asked him how far away we were from the mountains.  He said about 1/2 a mile.  The mountains are so huge that our normal perception of distance was off by a magnitude.

Landing on the glacier on the plane skis was phenomenal.  Getting outside, walking on some of the world's thickest ice, and realizing how tiny we all are to this expanse of nature was awe-inspiring.

I enjoyed every minute of this adventure.

A hint to those who want the best views...ask to sit in the co-pilots seat.  I did on the way back and being able to see out of the cockpit window was spectacular.

Now that I am writing this, my words are barely doing this activity justice.  Stop reading! Book it!

As one might imagine, flightseeing in  Denali National Park is always breathtaking but what made our experience unique with K2 Aviation was their responsiveness.  It was a cold, clear, sunny morning on November 1.  We knew it was last minute but we took a chance anyway and called K2 to see if they could take our party of 3 out that same afternoon.  Sarah was most pleasant, helpful and accommodating on the phone. When we arrived in Talkeetna, we discovered a new, clean and welcoming facility.  Our pilot, Chad, was friendly, safe and very informative.  We were safely back on the ground within 5 hours of making our initial call.  This is a very safe and efficient operation offering spectacular flightseeing tours of Denali.

We were treated well when we arrived and were told that the original tour planned would not be available due to weather moving in. Constantly monitoring the conditions made me feel safe. 
Wonderful views, good photos, narration was informative.  We loved the glacier landing. Just being in among the mountains was spectacular and realizing how large the mountains are. This excursion was worth every penny!
Fantastic trip! Wonderful views! Great pilot and tour guide. Highly recommend doing it. Well worth the money.

review_title: Fabulous and a Must Do in Alaska
review_text: This was the most exciting tour we did on our Alaska vacation. This is a definite  MUST DO. You won't regret it!! Worth every penny.
This was a great time. It was just marvelous and we felt safe. We recommend this one hundred percent!

At the last moment, I got talked into taking the flight tour around Mt McKinley. We had driven up to Talkeetna for the day and it was cloudy, so no views down here. Signed up. As we took off the clouds cleared and we had the most amazing views of this magnificent mountain. The pilot was great, gave us lots of info during the tour as we flew. Took about 90 min. Bring video and still camera. So glad I went. K2 Aviation does a terrific job. Nice folks, too.

A much smoother and enjoyable ride than I had anticipated.  The views were breathtaking, and Harry was a skilled and informative pilot.  There is no better way to see beautiful Kauai than with Air Ventures....this was an unforgettable tour.  Thanks to all of you!

The views were fantastic,  The weather was great, so visibility was great.  Saw several whales.  Our trip was most  was enjoyable, our pilot's professionalism, informative narrative & pleasant manner added to that enjoyment.  My first trip on a fixed wing plane for sight seeing.  So much quieter than a helicopter.  Would definitely reccomend.

We had an awesome flight around in a helicopter for an arches area tour. Michael was an awesome tour guide, he talked about all the areas of interest along our flight. Got to see a few of the awesome arches around Moab.  Thank You Michael for a great flight for our Anniversary!

Bruce and Josh are excellent pilots.  I'm a rated pilot and we were able to fly the 172 with Bruce along as tour guide and radio operator.  The team is very good at ensuring passenger comfort and are engaging with the passengers during the flight.  Bruce and Josh are not just "bus drivers." We were on a cruise ship and Ellen gave us a ride to/from.  Easy. Both aircraft are excellent sightseeing platforms.  Very good value.

Although we had to re-schedule our original reservation because of constant rainfall after having driven an hour to the destination, we were accommodated with a different date and time that fit our schedule after we moved around some other excursions in our itinerary.  This was the best attraction during this trip to Kauai.  The views and sights were absolutely amazing!  The staff were quite friendly and knowledgeable.  The pilot wonderfully described everything we saw while he adeptly flew the plane.  The plane is small and cozy, they sat four of us all comfortably on the right side so we would all be ensured a great view to take great pictures.  They provided small bottles of water during the flight.  The free gift of a highlights DVD and photos of us in front of the plane are a super added bonus!

Where do you start? We were fortunate to have Bruce as our Pilot and Guide for our flight over Kauai, We chose a plane because the better half has a issue with motion sickness, Bruce was very attentive to her needs as we flew over Kauai, the cost is about 1/2 of  a helicopter and worth the savings if you want to see the island from the air but done have the 300.00 + to pop for a helicopter then this is the way to go. We also had pictures taken before the trip and sent to us via E-mail as well as a video on CD of the flight we took.Every part of the process from Reservations, questions asked via E-mail were all handled promptly and professionally, I also got to be the Co-pilot, what a blast!!!!. The information Bruce gives during the flight on the history of the Island, the flora and Fauna is out standing to say the least, I highly recommend taking this tour while on Kauai.

Indescribable beauty and experience, landed in a remote lake with waterfalls got out on the plane floats for pictures, it was awesome our pilot Chuck was a True Pro and a class act he had a great music play list and narration during our ad venture truly breathtaking scenery!

What a great way to see the island.  The views are stunning.  This should not be missed.
Wings over Kauai as a company is 5 stars all the way.  From the welcoming greetings, to the great pilot to the free dvd of the trip. 
What an awesome morning touring the island.  The views, the views, what can you say?
So glad we chose to do this tour, and do it with Wing over Kaaui
Wonderful trip. Just absolutely amazing. So many beautiful views an absolute must. Absolutely recommend!
The flight was excellent!  It was an incredible experience of Maui from the heavens.  It is more beautiful than expected.

Booked a flight excursion from a cruise line and ended up with this company.  Was impressed with their clean, modern flight facility and safety procedures. Excellent flight into Tongas National Forest.  Hats off to our pilot Chuck.  Gave us quite a show ..... and played some excellent tunes along the way!!  Would highly recommend the company and Chuck!

review_title: An awesome tour of Kauai from the air!
review_text: Our pilot, Kevin, is an outstanding, seasoned pilot and a fantastic tour guide for Kauai.  He demonstrated an excellent knowledge of Kauai and it's history, and constantly showed concern for the passengers' comfort and safety.  I would highly recommend Air Ventures Hawaii - and Kevin for an introduction to all that Kauai has to offer.  I recommend the flight early in your stay on Kauai.
If you are looking for an alternative to Kauai helicopter tours I would highly recommend this - the view was fantastic, and the commentary excellent. A highlight of my holiday on the island.

We had a great time and saw a bunch of things we never could have imagined seeing. Highly recommend taking going on this ride as you will see things that many others never get to see. Michael was informative, professional, and a great pilot. Thanks!

Harry was the best! The staff were warm and friendly. I felt safe and my daughter was able to do her first flight lesson with Harry. I also flew on the biplane in Oct for my 50th bday and was an experience of a lifetime. I highly recommend Air Ventures and it wasn’t as expensive as most other activities are on the islands so it was worth every penny!!

review_title: Can't do Kauai without an air tour
review_text: We heard so much about how beautiful Kauai was, but after driving around the entire island, we weren't that impressed. Mind you, we had just seen all the major sights of Maui, so we were a bit spoiled. Things finally clicked when we took the air tour. It can be seen as somewhat of a splurge for some, but it's necessary to experience Kauai to its fullest. Wings over Kauai is a more reasonably priced option, but the service and experience were great. My wife and I enjoyed it, but unfortunately my infant daughter and grandma couldn't really handle the motion sickness, so prepare yourself.

We were scheduled to do a different tour and ended up not being able to do it.  (Due to bad knees).  We came across a brochure for Wings Over Kauai Air Tours.  We decided to try it.  It was awesome!  So glad we did it.  The flight was excellent and Bruce was very informative about the island and everything we saw.  
We felt very safe during the flight and were able to take GREAT pictures!  A must do if you are in Kauai!  I am claustrophobic but did NOT have any problem in this plane.  It was just my husband and myself and the pilot.  An excellent tour!! 
We highly recommend Wings Over Kauai Air Tours!!

Booked 4 on the Grand Denali flight. The weather was great, and the views were unbelievable. Our pilot, Sean, did a great job of making sure everyone got a good view and told us lots of interesting information throughout the flight.

We really enjoyed landing on the glacier, getting out to look around, and dreaming of staying at the Mountain House.

Through expensive, this is one of the coolest things we've ever done , and I would recommend it to anyone. We used a 25% off coupon from the Northern Lights coupon book.

We drove past Alaska Bush Plane on our way down to Talkeetna so came across them purely by chance as opposed to researching them first which is what we usually do but what a find they turned out to be! The weather was really changeable but we could be a bit flexible with our plans and Molly in the office was brilliant at keep us updated on the weather and what flight we could do. In the end, we did a 1 hour wildlife tour because it was too cloudy for Mount McKinley but the 1 hour was awesome despite the mountain staying hidden. Our pilot Jason was really knowledgable and an excellent spotter of wildlife! Black bears and a whole heap of moose on top of the mountains were the highlight. Great experience!

My wife and I enjoyed a spectacular flight to see the majesty of Denali on a clear day. Our pilot was very informative describing the mountains and glaciers during the flight. It was very smooth from takeoff to landing. We highly recommend K2!

Looking at Kauai from above was a wonderful experience.  One of the highlights of our Hawaiian trip.
My husband was fearful of the helicopter ride, and chose the plane and he was so happy he did this trip. I would recommend this to all.
It was amazing! Eric was the best host ever,  lots to see. It was once in a lifetime!! Best pictures!

review_title: Amazing Float Plane Trip.  Very accomodating for handicapped person
review_text:
The float plane ride over the Misty Fjords was incredible.  One amazing view after another.  Our pilot/guide, Mike Hudgins, was very informative and executed a flawless water landing on a large lake, where several of us got out and walked on the plane floats.  A must do for anyone visiting Ketchikan.

I am handicapped. I walk with two crutches. Mike and his crew were very helpful and accommodating dealing with my handicap and enabling me to board and exit the plane, allowing me to enjoy this incredible experience.

review_title: 1 hour Mt Hood and Columbia Gorge tour
review_text: Had an amazing time getting a closer look at Mount Hood and seeing the Columbia River Gorge from a birds eye view. I’m a travel nurse working in the Portland Oregon/Vancouver Washington area so this was a great way to see all the beautiful landscape and changing of the leaves. My parents came out to visit from Pennsylvania and loved that we got to see so much in so little time with this tour. Had some slight turbulence along the way but our experienced pilot handled it like a champ. Couldn’t recommend this more! Very fun ☺️
Spectacular views and lots of interesting information! Definitely a must do! Super easy and comfortable. Loved getting to see everything we wouldn't have been able to by land or helicopter.

This was a wonderful tour and view of the island.  We did the tour on our first full day on the island.  It was great way to see so many beautiful things and to become familiar with the island.  We would highly recommend this tour to anyone.
SO worth it. My only complaint is that the trip was too short. I could have easily stayed up for another 30 minutes. Great, personable pilot. Good tour. So beautiful.

My wife wanted to go on a helicopter tour so I obliged. The facility was top notch and the helicopters themselves were well maintained. We met our pilot and he briefed us on safety and what to expect. We got a grand tour and then landed in the rain forest for some champagne. Our pilot was so knowledgeable and you could tell he loves what he does. I would definitely recommend this tour.

Had a wonderful flight over Kauai with out pilot Harry.  He was very knowledgeable about the history of the island, and had lots of recommendations for beaches and other island highlights.  We actually saw a few whales while flying over the ocean outside of Lihue.  The Napoli coast was amazing - secluded beaches and amazing canyons.  Will never forget this adventure!

This was one of the highlights of our trip.  The staff and pilots were overly helpful in preparing for your flight.  They were honest about the wind conditions and that it may be a bumpy ride, you could have canceled with a full refund.   They advised on what to where for the glacier landing.  
Our pilot was great - informative of what we were seeing - great info related to the hikers climbing McKinley & base camp.   We had a great group & we had a lot of fun.  Landing on Ruth Glacier was absolutely amazing -  beyond words.  We are so glad we saved for this.

review_title: How to Experience Kauai via Air
review_text:
When you pick an aerial solution to fly over Kauai, you have basically two choices - helicopters or fixed wing aircraft.

Air ventures represents the best solution on Kauai for the fixed wing option.  

We chose to take the 8:30 AM tour, on our first day after we arrived on Kauai.  While it would seem somewhat early in the AM to rally the troops after getting to the island, the 8:30 AM flight worked well, from the time adjustment perspective.  Winds in the early AM are somewhat calmer, and temperatures cooler than later flights.

We were able to grab a light breakfast prior to heading to the airport @ 8AM for our flight. 

This aerial solution offers a great overview perspective of Kauai from a 1000-3000 ft perspective, permitting great photographs, a more stable platform, with more visibility for each person, with oversized window seats, at a reasonable price structure.

Everyone has a full window seat in an “air van” like setting, with noise cancelling headphones to communicate with the others, or the pilot. We chose the 6 passenger option, however, smaller two - three seat aircraft options are available.

Make no mistake, we saw a lot of helicopters flying at lower altitudes, however, the fixed wing perspective offers fuller vistas, and covers similar territory over a longer flight experience.  For our group, this worked best...as weight restrictions are more lenient in a fixed wing aircraft, and air sickness concerns were a consideration in our choice.

We saw a lot of the island from Napali Coast, many of the interior canyons; the vibrant blues of the ocean, sea turtles, and dolphins; several waterfalls, Hanalei and Princeville areas.  From our group, this provided the overall perspective and island layout we were looking for.  

By going with Air Ventures, we saved several hundred dollars from a comparable flight alternative via helicopter.

We highly recommend this alternative to see Kauai by air.  This was our second tour with Air Ventures Hawaii.

Pilot, Erik, was very knowledgeable, professional, experienced in a relaxing manner that permitted  the others he travelled with to also feel more comfortable.

We were so lucky with a wonderfully clear day and had amazing views of Denali. The glacier landing was our favorite part and was stunning! There were views of Denali. Our pilot was friendly and informative. The right side of the plane has better views of Denali if you have the option to choose your seat. We traveled with about ten other people. 

That being said, my husband and I have both decided we are not made to fly in tiny planes. If you have any anxiety around flying or have any propensity for motion sickness, this will not be the most enjoyable. We don’t regret booking this as the views were incredible and glacier landing was unforgettable, but we will never be going on such a tiny plane again.

review_title: Highlight of our 2 weeks in Alaska
review_text: Amazing views of Denali- we were fortunate to have a clear day. Leighan, our pilot, was amazing. The flight was smooth, landing on the glacier was awe-inspiring, and her commentary was interesting and tailored to the group. She eased the young guest who was anxious, was personable and professional. This is a don’t miss experience.

The pilot John did an excellent job flying the plane in a way that we can see all the sights!  I am a pilot, so I know.  Also his demeanor and knowledge of the area made it a real treat for myself and the three kids along for the trip.  This was an absolute highlight of our little road trip.

We were picked up at our cruise ship dock by a driver with a van and taken to the take-off site.  Senior pilot Mike took us on an approximately 70 minute round-trip into the fiords, providing commentary on what we were seeing.  He set the plane down on the water and invited the passengers (the plane holds six maximum) to step out onto the airplane float.  Cameras were encouraged on the flight. The pilot was knowledgeable, friendly and willing to assist passengers into and out of the plane.  After the flight we each received a certificate attesting to our adventure.  The driver took us back to the cruise ship location.

We took a sightseeing flight near Mt. McKinley, Denali. They adjusted the flight slightly to fit the weather and it was great. I did not know if I wanted to take the trip but now am very glad we did. We saw the major peaks and lots of glaciers and other mountains. Even the flight from Talkeetna to the mountains over the river is interesting.

Kauai is incredible from the air!  Harry, our pilot, gave us a spectacular tour of The island. We went down Waimea canyon, wove through the Na'pali coast and circled back around many of the dozens of waterfalls we came upon. Our bonus round of aerobatics was especially fun and it gave us a taste of barnstorming that left us wanting more. Harry's knowledge of the island, including local hideaways and great hiking ideas added to our list of things to do here.  We enjoyed this tour more than the helicopter tour.
Beautiful scene and a really great flight. The waterfalls were excellent along the cliffs and we felt very comfortable.

10/10 HIGHLY RECOMMEND 
Captain James was a fantastic host. 
The views are unbeatable. 
Amazing experience at a very affordable price for a private experience also 
Thank You

I was blessed to be able to send my husband, and my boys, on a flight that they never would have treated themselves to. The pilot arrived on time, let me snap some pictures, and answered all the usual mom/wife questions (how long you’ve flown, you’ll bring them back to me) silly questions like that. They then taxied, and flew off. Out on a flight, that I’ve heard about for days. Growing up in a small town, thinking life is small, makes you think your world is small. This flight, as they saw all the waterfalls, the mountains, the ground from above, and listening as the pilot knowledgeably explained the area, began to fill my 3 guys, full of gratitude for life, amazement that such beauty is taken for granite, and excitement to do other adventures. One of my guys, had never flown before, one wants to be a pilot, and my husband celebrated (he has health issues) that he got to mark something off his bucket list. So, thank you Envi, for giving my 3 guys the memories of a lifetime! I can’t thank you enough. We will be referring you to all of our friends, and family!
We had so much fun here with Eric!  Beautiful view and great service. Wonderful weather and clear sky, windows seat was nice.
One of the highlights or our trip!! Our pilot was very friendly and knowledgeable regarding Mt. Denali and the surrounding areas. Could not ask for a better guide.

review_title: Amazing views of the Alaska Range
review_text:
Outstanding pilots and service!
Flying is the best way to see the Alaska Range and Mt McKinley (Denali). To top off this incredible experience only a landing at one of the glaciers. I did it all, and even leaving here in Talkeetna I don't take for granted the views of the mountains, and every time possible I fly with K2.

review_title: Start your vacation with Air Ventures Hawaii!
review_text: What a wonderful way to start a week in Kauai with a flight over the island in a stable, roomyAir Ventures Hawaii Airvan plane with a super pilot who provided a wonderful, informative commentary!  Additionally, he had a great personality!  We learned so much about the Island's history and culture.  The stability of the plane was wonderful not only for possibly queasy stomachs but also for ease of photography!  It was a super experience!!  Thanks, Air Ventures!

The experience, the people and the sights were amazing.  Over an hour of wonderful landscapes and shorelines, with full descriptions by our pilot.
Cheaper than the helicopters and great views.
We had a very comfortable, safe and fun experience with K2. I would highly recommend them to anyone wanting to try a flight. We did a glacier fly over and it was just absolutely stunning!!

review_title: The GREAT ONE... Was Definitely GREAT!
review_text: HAPPILY checked off an item on my Bucket List!  I have been blessed to get to fly to many areas in Alaska in small airplanes and to enjoy the float plane we have in Seward.  BUT, to get to fly near to Denali and do a glacier landing was outstanding!  Definitely, in my top 5 best Alaskan and International flights!  I’ve known for years that when time permits in the summer and the weather looked good.... it would be a go for me!  All good things came together (except for the COVID-19 giving all Alaskan’s time to explore our state .... ) made it work for us to do my dream flight.  Would be tough to be more PERFECT!

Our flight last month (August 11) with Talkeetna Air Taxi was spectacular.

Starting with our making the reservation back in March, their friendly service made everything easy.  We really appreciated that they worked with our schedule to meet us when our train arrived and scheduled our flight shortly thereafter (the competitors I contacted didn't offer that flexibility).  After discussing the various options with T.A.T. staff, we chose the McKinley Base Camp flight with a glacier landing (1 3/4 hours).  By booking early we had already saved $50 per person and since our flight was after 4 PM, they accepted a Northern Lights discount coupon which dropped the price for our group of 4 by 25%.

The flight was smooth and the weather was perfect!!!!  Brad, our pilot, was very knowledgeable about Denali and all the nearby mountains and glaciers, was able to answer all of our questions, and altered the route slightly from time to time to assist our picture taking.  Our views of Denali, Mt. Foraker, Mt. Hunter, other nearby peaks and numerous glaciers were magnificent and our landing on one of the glaciers was awesome!  If you are going to take the flight, make sure you add the glacier landing.

I can't recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi highly enough for a wonderful flightseeing experience.

We had an excellent tour in their 6-seater plane. Check-in was ontime with lots of perks- free CD and necklace!  The tour was very smooth and the view is breath taking.  Their Bose Noise Cancellation headsets helped so much to reduce the noise and hear the pilot clearly.  Highly recommended!

My wife and I went on this trip with a touchdown in the rain forest. It was spectacular. Jake was our pilot and he was awesome. We had confidence in his abilities and he put our minds at ease right away. He was friendly, informative and helpful. 

We touched down in the rain forest and met "naturalist", Edwin who was colorful and informative. 

We would highly recommend this trip. It is not cheap, but well worth the money. Go for it.

Talkeetna Air Taxi treated us professionally and very well, the pilot (Leighan) was exceptional, and the experience (Denali flight see with glacier landing) was out of this world - truly a top 10% experience of our trip.
Wow!  Just absolutely stunning views!  Amazing customer service!  Would go every day if I could!  Worth every cent!

What an amazing experience.  Not something I will probably ever get the chance to do again, so highly recommend this if you are looking to experience Maui from a different point of view.  The waters and colours of blue and the scenic landscapes were breath-taking.  Eric, our pilot, ensured that we felt comfortable and at ease the whole flight, and was very knowledge throughout about the island of Maui.  He even let me take control for ten mins or so.  Cannot recommend this enough.

We were on a cruise and decided to schedule this sightseeing flight with only 2 days advance notice.  They were able to work us into the schedule with no problem.  Our pilot Eric was awesome.  He was friendly and funny and genuinely seemed to want us to have a good time.  And the rest of the staff was also friendly and professional.  The AirVan offered incredible views and Eric tried to make sure that both sides of the plane could enjoy the scenery.  He even circled around a couple of times when we spotted some whales playing in the ocean.  Overall this was one of the top highlights from our vacation and we would do it again in a heartbeat.  Cannot recommend enough.
Very good experience, incredible pilot and very efficient service. Without a doubt I would do it again.

review_title: The highlight of our Alaskan trip!
review_text: We had a free day on the last day of our trip to Alaska.  The weather gods were smiling that day and provided us with partly cloudy skies.  An early morning phone call to TAT from our hotel in Healy got us a reservation for later in the afternoon.  We took the "Mountain Voyager" flight and WOW!!! we were not disappointed.  The entire experience was first class all the way.  The staff of Talkeetna Air Taxi was friendly, knowledgeable, and helpful.  The flight itself was phenomenal with jaw-dropping views of the Alaskan mountain range and glaciers.  A very well run operation.  Two thumbs up, five stars, highly recommended - what more can we say?

Pilot was awesome, he made sure we enjoy to our fullest extent.He made sure we got enough time to have fun on the glaciers. He was very professional, personable and excellent communicator in explaining things. We would recommend k2 aviation team to everyone out there wanting to visit beautiful glaciers.

Just spectacular! If you're undecided about doing this trip (like I was), just do it. I truly think it was a once in a lifetime opportunity for me. I mean, how often are you presented with the chance to ride a plane through mountaintops, then land on a glacier? Our pilot was great (sorry, I don't remember his name) and he narrated what we were seeing with great precision. The views from the plane were just amazing, especially when looping through mountaintops. We landed on the glacier when there were already a couple of planes there, so we were lucky to be able to watch them take off ahead of us. No seat on the plane is a bad seat -- every seat is both an aisle and a window, as the pilot pointed out. Tiny plane, but I felt completely safe. Amazing.

Perfect day, perfect flight, perfect take offs and landings....very engaging pilot/guide and the most breath taking views of Denali.  If you are saving your $$$ to do something that will absolutely rank near the top of your list of the best things you've ever done....go for a walk on a glacier at 12,000 feet! Awesome inspiring!
So glad we decided to take this tour!  AMAZING views in the canyon. Our pilot, Vern, was knowledgeable about everything related to the Grand Canyon. Add this to your to-do list!
Great trip, fantastic pilot. So much fun. Could not habe been happier and will sure come back with my whole family. Definitely recommended!

I am glad that my friends and I went in December so that the water falls were fuller and the green was greener.  Harry was very informative about what we were viewing and Air Ventures very responsive to the needs of our party  (crutches).

review_title: McKinley Summit Tour- a must to-do in Alaska
review_text: We originally scheduled the flight in Talkeetna. But due to the weather, our flight got cancelled. The people in the office were very patient and tried to help us to re-schedule. They have another office in Delani NP. We ended up being rescheduled to the next day in Denali NP office. So get prepared for the weather change and think of some back up plans in advance. The flight was awsome. I got a little bit dizziness toward to end. Maybe we were sitting at the back row seat. But the up-close view to the McKinley Summit outweights everything. This is a must to do in Alaska. You will never regret it.
