The helicopter tour was so memorable and such a good experience that it is definitely worth the price! Words can describe the whole experience, but I guess it really did make a deep impression!

Went on the helicopter with just my family, and we just toured around the Grand Canyon! Not sure whether we saw everything, but it was enough already for sure! The staff were friendly, and explained clearly what we were going to do etc...

review_title: Great way to see the parks
review_text: We took the morning flight to see Canyonland and Arches National Parks.  It was great    We we’re saying “wow” the whole trip.   Our pilot was James and he was courteous and even with a windy day kept the flight very smooth.  He showed us great views of Needles, Maze, and the river confluence.  He would tip the wings so we would get a perfect view. I would highly recommend and ask for James to be your pilot.

review_title: WOW!!! Best excursion we did in Hawaii.
review_text: Amazing, this was my first helicopter ride. Nick did an amazing job flying and sharing about the sites we saw. We flew over a rainbow, how cool is that. The rainforest was beautiful. Loved seeing the North Shore and all the waterfalls. Well worth the money!!!

This a must do, seeing the Grand Canyon from above is an amazing experience. I loved every moment of it, it was well worth it.  The ride is pretty safe and staff makes everything very easy to follow through. I would definitely try this again!

The Seaplane Adventure was a magical ride. We did the Golden Gate tour and I highly reccomend it!!
The ride covered much of Marin, the coast up by Muir the Headlands the city ,The Golden Gate, much of SF,  Bay Bridge, part of the harbor in Oakland and Angel island. Worth every penny!!

review_title: THE most AMAZING scenic flight seeing we have EVER had!
review_text: K-2 Aviation is the best.   They are friendly and fun, while being professional at the same time.  Making a reservation was easy, and I called back a couple of times to confirm, since I had made the reservations so early, and they cheerfully answered my questions.  The flight was amazing and our pilot, Chip, was not only an obviously experienced pilot, but also informative and friendly.  To top it off the good Lord gave us perfect weather to see Denali in all its glory!  A memorable experience that will last a lifetime!!!!

Wow! What a beautiful experience! We had the most amazing views, we felt safe! Our pilot was thorough and informative! Seeing the Grand Canyon from the sky is far more breath taking than from the rim trails!
JT was our pilot.  He was informative and lots of fun.  He had smooth take-offs and landings.  He also took us where the winds wouldn't affect the ride.  Smooth ride, great fun.  I'd do it again.

We hiked the parks two days and then took the tour! The air tour was the best part of the parks. The parks took on whole new perspective! The best part of our national park vacation was Redtail! If you can't hike I highly recommend the flight!

review_title: Great trip with a reliable  and experienced company
review_text: K2 Aviation s a first class company in every way. We were scheduled to go up on one of their tours over Denali on June 30th. We were told that it was clouded in and we would not see very much and were offered our money back or to wait for the next day to go up. The next day was a little better but we were told that we would only see the bottom part of the glaciers. We chose not to go up that day also and were refunded the money for two of the three who were going up.  was coming back trough Talkeenta the following week on the way  back to Anchorage. When we came through he weather was much better.  went upand saw a spectacular view of many of the glaciers and was very pleased with the overall experience. They are obviously a very ethical company who care about their customers safety and overall experience of a good trip for the money paid. Would do it again in a heartbeat.

review_title: Amazing Float Plane and Bear Excursion
review_text:
What better way to go view bears feeding than by float plane?!!!

Awesome experience flying in a float plane. We were all very tentative at the experience. Our pilot had a great sense of humor and was very reassuring. The cabin itself is noisy, but the head phones help a lot. The take off and landings are very subtle and better than that of a commercial airliner.

Our pilot was awesome and even circled back when he saw a couple of humpback whales near the surface, giving us a very unique and awesome view of the whales.

The bear excursion to Tongass National Forest was amazing. The bears were in full feeding mode at the man made salmon ladder. There were several eagles around the area. On our walk down the path to the ladder, we spotted a bear on the edge of the path. We cautiously walked around to get to the viewing platform by the salmon ladder. FYI, these are all black bears. In total, there were five bears, and a mom with two cubs. Awesome family experience!

We arrived late one evening and had booked an early helicopter flight for the following morning several months ago
Maverick were easy to find, very friendly and delivered a wonderful service. 
It's worth noting you need a passport on arrival but all you can take on the flight is water and a camera, so lock the rest in the car!
The pilot was excellent, full of knowledge and with a sense of humour too. 
The first time you go over the rim is so awesome it is almost indescribable! The views from up there are just fantastic and you get to see quite a lot of the canyon. I didn't want it to end! Would recommend to anyone...
The views from the plane were great and the pilot was super friendly.  Highly recommend the glacier landing, its breath taking!
Great tour!!  I highly recommend!!  We flew over the waterfalls on the West Coast and saw the volcano!!

I would highly recommend Seaplane Adventures for a truly unique Bay Area experience! Where else can you fly in a classic seaplane over the stunning natural beauty of California and see the most famous bridge in the world, the Golden Gate, from a vantage point few others get to experience? Seeing San Francisco from the sky gives a wonderful new way to experience and appreciate this fantastic city! The pilot, Fred is exactly the kind of knowledgeable, experienced, and steady guy you’d expect and really made the experience great! Perfect for a wonderful birthday or anniversary date and then visit the amazing waterfront of beautiful Sausalito! 10/10

review_title: Awesome alternative to helicopter tour, in seeing Kauai from above
review_text:
Great way to see Kauai, via small plane (we already tried helicopter ride many years ago)…
Highly recommended.

Got lucky that we were the only ones so it became sorta private tour for us. Our pilot Josh was fun & awesome. Their ground crew (new hires) able to join us as well since seats were open.

We have taken the air plane tour including Horseshoe Bend, Glen Canyon Dam and the Rainbow bridge.
Tour duration around 45 mins.
Our pilot was Keep; he was really welcoming. 
From above, all looks very nice and very impressive.  
It was a really good experience and I recommend it!!!
This was fun Eric was great!! Very informative and gave us an experience we would never forget!! Please be sure to do it.

Love our float plane trip to the Misty Fjords. Very professional experience with Taquan Air. Our pilot was very informative and answered all our questions while we stood on the floats in the beautiful Misty Fjords. Don't miss out on a float plane trip and I highly recommend Taquan Air.

I've been to the Grand Canyon a few times - always to the South Rim, like most people.  When my wife said she'd never been and it was on her bucket list, I started planning.  I figured this would be a once in a lifetime trip, so I planned big.  Maverick came highly recommended by our Sedona concierge (see L'auberge de Sedona) and I'm so glad!  Maverick was excellent.  Even on a breezy day, the whole crew made us comfortable.  The tour was amazing and there is simply NOTHING like coming over the trees on the North Rim to the wide open view of the Canyon - NOTHING.

Although a premium price, the service was beyond anything you could imagine.  Booking was simple and easy.
On arrival, we were welcomed personally by Lindsay and offered coffee and treats.  Homemade brownies were excellent.  She introduced our pilot Brandon and he went to ready the plane.
We were escorted to the plane, given safety instructions and on our way.  The flight over Sedona and then over the canyon was amazing and Brandon was great with telling us a few things about what we were seeing.
After returning in the allotted 3 hours Lindsay asked questions about us and our stay.  It came out that I have stage 4 kidney cancer in my bones and she hugged me and my wife and shared her victory over cancer over 30 years ago.  Then in the parking lot, Brandon came to us.  We thought we forgot something, but he said Lindsay had shared our story and he had just lost his mom and previously his dad to cancer.  He is now working limited hours to care for his brother battling stage 4 cancer.  We all cried a little and Brandon commented he was meant to take us up today.
The people at this company truly cared.  They were not just kind and doing their job.  I know I have two more people praying for me in my battle.  I could not say more about these people.
Please know this is a business with a quality product that you should support.  You will not regret it.
Thank you Westwind.
Amazing views of Molokini and Maui.  The  low wing made it easy to take pictures.  The pilot was very knowledgeable and made us feel very safe.
Eric and Steve were great. Very professional and informative. I was allowed to take the yoke for a bit. Off the charts experience. Full circle island. Must do!

review_title: Awesome views with landing at Base Camp Denali
review_text: Our original reservation fell during a cloudy evening, so the company advised delaying (without any fees) until the next morning.  It turned out to be the clearest day in weeks.  Our pilot checked ahead & found there were some clouds on the glacier we supposed to land on, so he took us to Base Camp (for the climbers) which was mostly shut down.  For the 2 climbers in our group, it was a dream come true & the views were incredible.  The glacier landings are free on certain flights (early am & late pm) and completely worth the experience.  Stay in Talkeetna (cute town) & give yourself a range of days to attempt the flight to get the best weather window.

review_title: Flight on the Air Ventures Biplane
review_text:
This was a trip of a lifetime! What a fabulous way to really see the island of Kauai.  The Biplane provided a unique opportunity to experience aviation the way it used to be. We were so impressed with the  helpfulness of all the staff we encountered.. Our pilot, Kevin, was very competent,  knowledgeable  and fun to be with.  We can highly recommend this tour for all.
Brian and Barb Beary

They say that less than 30% of Alaskan visitors get to see Mount McKinley.  If you don’t, you’re missing a truly amazing natural spectacle.  There is no better way to see the mountain than with a flight-seeing tour like the one we took with K2.  (You can’t drive to Mt. McKinley, and if you hike, better plan to walk for weeks).  Tony was a fantastic pilot, getting us great views, gentle on the controls, and letting us know any time he was making a big turn.  We flew between the peaks of the mountains and over the glaciers, and were lucky enough to have one of those days where it looked like you could reach out and touch the mountain from the plane.  Incredible and very worth the price!

I rented 2 helicopters for my family of 5. This is the only helicopter touring company in Kauai that I know offers window/door seat for every passengers. Most helicopter tours offer a back row that seats 4 and are assigned by weight distribution.

Mauna Loa allows for doors on or doors off experience. We chose doors off and loved it. I thought my wife, who is less daring than the children or I would opt to keep her door on, but she went doors off also. I highly recommend doors off. Pilots were great constantly checking to make sure everyone was doing well and we always were,  

They provide straps for phones and cameras in order to have them secured for doors off flights. Doors off allows for amazing views and picture opportunities. With doors off it can become chilly. A sweater or light jacket is needed.

Had a first class trip with Marcus. Great pilot. Seems young for a pilot but he knew his stuff. Smooth flight, great views made tons of pictures. Would recommend this flight for everyone who wants to see the island from the air.

Very friendly, accommodating staff!     Cloud cover was sketchy (can't control the weather) so they gave us options to fly, reschedule, or cancel for refund.  We are glad we chose to fly. Our pilot, Shiloh was great. He provided an inspiring glacier & area tour.  His skill, knowledge, & persistence ultimately resulted in being in the right place just as the clouds parted & Denali appeared.  A bucket list flight!

Had a great time with Talkeetna Air Taxi! Took the glacier landing tour and it was really worth it. You can see everything and it's very awe-inspiring to see the breadth of the glaciers and crevasses from up in the plane. They talk about everything you see, so you get some education on the area too and you can ask questions. Good service and good people.

Amazing experience. So much information and a must do in Maui. 
Highly recommended. 

Thank you Eric

review_title: A "must do" in the Phoenix/Scottsdale area
review_text:
We took the south rim tour on December 29th,2013. Westwind Air is a first class operation all of the way. The hangar and lounge area were very comfortable and complimentary coffee and snacks were offered. the check in process was fast and efficient, and then we met our pilot Chris. Chris is a great guy and wonderful pilot.  he was very happy having our kids sit in the co-pilot seat and explaining how airplanes fly. He was also a great tour guide in the air and on the ground and alsways so willing to share his knowledge and great stories.
The tour left Deer valley airport around 8:00am, we flew north over Sedona and then spent 30 minutes flying over the Grand canyon. Hard to explain the feeling you get when you first see the Grand canyon from the air for the first time, but lets just say it is breathtaking. We  landed at Grand canyon airport and quickly boarded a comfortable shuttle bus for a quick ride to Grand Canyon national park.
 We spent a few hours at three different locations exploring the canyon and facilities. After a short ride back to the airport  we boarde the plane again, and within an hour landed back in Scottsdale.
Aeesome trip, great pilot, excellent company.

review_title: A perfect flight, must to do in Portland
review_text: We made Quick sand triangle at 8 pm. We had beautiful light. Flight was very nice. The pilote is very good. We landed with wind, but He made a very smooth landing !!!
Great trip and tour guide.   I would recommend this tour to others.

We took the biplane tour over Kauai, and it was awesome. Kevin was our pilot, and he was very personable. There were a lot of showers in the area that day, and he gave us the option to rescheduled should we wish or still take the tour. We went anyway (a big part of the excitement was simply flying in a biplane)  and it actually gave the flight an authentic feel to fly through the showers. But the view of Waimea Canyon in particular was incredible. And Kevin narrated the flight with a lot of great information about the island. It was an amazing flight and the service was great, so I would definitely recommend this trip!

K2 does a great job!  they are profissional and flexible working with climbing teams.  Lots of space in the hanger to rig for an expedition.  friendly and knowledgeable staff.  safe and well maintained airplanes.  Thanks K2

My wife and I took the Grand Denali with Glacier landing flightseeing trip with TAT and loved it!  We had a great pilot, Chris. He was very friendly and informative guide pilot and flew the Otter we were on with great skill. Great ride and landings. We had awesome up close views of Denali and others on a perfect day. I climbed Denali 15 years ago and TAT was the service that flew us in and out of basecamp, so I knew the quality of their pilots, equipment and operation. Chris pointed out several of the now abandoned (out of the climbing season) camps and routes and explained a lot about the climb. He was right on all accounts from my personal knowledge having been there and done that. He took us through the always exciting one shot pass at my request. Awesome!  He landed us on the Eldridge Glacier where we deplaned and everyone had a great time taking photos. He explained many things about the Glacier systems, etc.. I have now flown on all three types of planes that TAT has, the 185, Beaver and Otter. Great equipment with a very well run operation!  I cannot recommend TAT highly enough!

The pilot did a great job!!!!! We were amazed at the beautiful views from above the canyons…….absolutely a must do in order to see a lot of the arches that are not visible by walking to them.A little pricey but well worth the money to see.

When visiting Talkeetna going on a flightseeing tour is a must, and having selected Talkeetna Air Taxi was an excellent choice. The weather could have not been better. This absolutely magic day yielded grand views of the range, and of course in particular Denali. I travel through Alaska since 2010, and I go on a flightsee every time I visit, and I visit twice a year. It's simply magic, and Talkeetna Air Taxi ensures that every trip is special. Just awesome!!!!!

An excellent tour to see all the beauty the island of Kauai has to offer. Our pilot, Paul, and the entire staff were very professional and personable. I would highly recommend this trip to anyone visiting the island of Kauai. Mahalo Air Ventures Hawaii for an awesome memorable experience.

review_title: Amazing trip to see Mt. Denali and surrounding mountains and glaziers!
review_text: Our pilot was very qualified and my husband has always wanted to fly in a Beaver! Hi-light of our trip to Alaska! It's the only way to see the beauty of the last frontier!

One of the highlights of our trip! We went on a day that seemed cloudy, but above the layer in talkeetna, it was incredible! The pilot was very knowledgeable and offered to take photos when we landed on the glacier! And they provided free boots to keep our feet warm! Worth the money!!

review_title: Air Ventures gave us a wonderful, professional, informative and safe air tour of the island of Kauai.
review_text:
Check for bad weather before leaving for the airport.  We booked this in combination with Best of Kauai Tours. This resulted in significant savings. We really enjoyed a full day of activities with lots of variety.
It was very exciting to be able to see the hanging valleys and crater up close.

review_title: Flight to Grand Canyon and hike
review_text: The company was professional, courteous, and the entire day was so much fun! We walked in and immediately they explained the itinerary, introduced us to the pilot and guide, presented us with Panera lunches, and answered all questions. We flew over and learned about places like Flagstaff and Sedona, and landed near the Grand Canyon. There, a van took us to the place we would hike. All 6 of my family members enjoyed the day immensely and we were all so pleased with the company!! I wish I could remember our guides name, she was great!

review_title: Worth every penny for a once in a lifetime trip
review_text: We were in 2 minds whether to spend so much on a trip but it was worth it.  Our pilot was great and the trip brought tears to our eyes.  Definitely worth going for the 45 mins, as you get to go all the way from the south rim to the north
Best way to see Kauai. Kevin was a great pilot and tour guide, very knowledgeable and entertaining. Jill (the owner) went above and beyond to make our trip memorable.

Short bus ride from our ship, the NCL Bliss, to the intercostal airport for Taquan. We received a safety briefing & then met our pilot. Our group of 5 included a young lady that has a fear of flying. The pilot assigned her the seat next to him so she could see first hand what he was doing which kept her very calm.  The flights were smooth, 2 flights as we landed in Misty Fjord. The scenery is majestic, pictures & video do not do it justice. I hope to take this tour again.

Our Air Hawaii flight was totally amazing!  Seeing Kauai by air is a must and our pilot, Harry, was very informative and friendly. We felt very safe and world definitely recommend Air Ventures Hawaii!

I did the 1 hour Ultimate Miami and Beaches Tour, and it was absolutely amazing. We got the opportunity to fly over Key Biscayne National Park and see wildlife such as manatees, fish, and more. I have lived in Florida all of my life and never had a clue how amazing the city of Miami really was until this wonderful experience. Not only was Tony Anderson a great pilot, he did a fantastic job filling us in with information on everything we flew by. This flight was one I will never forget.

We chose Air Ventures for our air tour recently based on recommendations on Trip Advisor. We arrived to the airport early for our tour, checked in, weighed in with everything we were planning to take on the tour, and hung out until it was time to go. There are several other companies housed in the same building as Air Ventures. There are restrooms nearby as well. Our pilot, Harry, introduced himself to the four of us taking the tour with him that day. He was very nice and reassured us the strong winds would not be an issue. He said he had four years of experience and thousands of flights under his belt, so we felt at ease. We took a group photo with him and the plane in the background (they e-mailed it to us right away!), then he strategically seated us in the plane, most likely to even out the weight. It was nice having such a small group. The plane is newer looking but had a few small tears in the seats. Otherwise, nice but small. We were each provided head phones so we could hear Harry's narrative tour of the island. I took lots of photos and they turned out great! Make sure you wear a dark color shirt if you're a shutter bug. It was more amazing than we ever dreamed, and we had been on a cruise around the island previously, and driven from one end of the island to the other several times. The air tour really put things in perspective, and it was neat to see things we would have never seen by car. We learned a great deal about the island from Harry, and even though we were pre-warned parts of the ride would be very bumpy (and they were) we would not hesitate to go again, or recommend this trip to anyone!

Excellently organised, from pick up, tour and drop off. Booked afternoon Delux tour 1055-2000! Pick up via bus to Bolder airport (30 mins), flight over Hoover Dam and west Rim (I think), then a bus to two spots on the south rim, Angel Bright and Matherson. For the flight book a window seat for one if you are traveling as a couple so you can sit together. I get air sick on small planes, I took some medication to assist with this and had no problem. As you are flying over the Canyons it can be a little bumpy however, well worth it when you see the amazing scenery. Seats 7A and 7C were the best for me right at the back plenty of leg room for my husband who is rather tall. Listen to the bus drivers for tips for the best photos. They provided a pack lunch consisting of salad roll, apples, water, cookies and Pringles. Please state if you have dietary requirements. Would do this again, but would like to stay over at the Grand Canyon.
Was an amazing experience flying over the islands. The colors and contrasts were beautiful. The best way to view the islands is from the sky!

I would highly recommend AirVentures to anyone wanting to see Kauai "from the sky". We had contemplated a helicopter trip, since it was recommended by many of our friends, but decided on a plane instead. 
REASONS: 1. Though the plane flies higher (1000 ft vs 500 ft), it goes slower and you have more opportunity to see what you are there to see and to capture it on camera.  2. The plane was eco-friendly, using much less fuel  than a copter.
Great service, first good weather in weeks and still managed to accomdate us. Kids still talking about it
Andrew did a great job on a partially cloudy skies showing Denali and all the glaciers. Awesome trip!!

I would definitely recommend K2 flightseeing. Our pilot was Stan. He was informative and made us feel comfortable. Our plane was a bright red de Havilland otter. It looked  beautiful against the mountains, snow and glaciers - our pictures turned out great. We landed on Ruth glacier and enjoyed every moment of this magnificent, majestic place.

We chose the South face Tour with Glacier Landing. The check in was fast and easy. The staff was super nice. You have to weigh yourself and your belongings and they determine how to distribute the passengers, even where to sit so the plane is balanced. Several groups leave at the same time, but it is orderly. John, our Pilot was very nice and knowledgeable. It is evident that all the staff enjoy what they do. The scenery was incredible, and landing on the glacier was really cool. You are surrounded by mountains with McKinley towering above. Lots of photo ops. Don't let the cost scare you off, it was the best thing we did all trip. We would regret not doing it, had we not.

Super trip to Maui for 8 days.  Stayed in Kihei and found the island incredibly interesting and accessible with a nice van for the four of us.  Rented a nice condo with excellent access to beaches and shopping.  Maui Banyan.  Food wasn’t cheap but was very high quality.  Highly recommend going to tip of Haleakala, and to the sought side if the National Park to hike up to the waterfalls and bamboo forest.  regardless of weather.  Up Country is gorgeous and peaceful.  The beaches are great everywhere and the turtle beach south of Paia is not to be missed.

As a family with three young children (all under 6) and another on the way, many of the exciting things to do in Kauai were not practical so we decided to take a plane tour. To be honest I was a little concerned that our kids would be a little scared, but they loved the adventure of wearing headphones and walking on the tarmac. The plane ride was smooth, and touch downs and take offs where much less jarring then the US Air flights we came and left on. Our pilot Josh, was excellent, he was good with the kids, showed us all the interesting things on the island, and as a result of some of the points of interest he recommended we explored some things we might not have otherwise done.  Not only did we get a wonderful flight, they gave us a beautiful DVD and even e-mailed us photos all before we were out of the parking lot, without the up sale. I know there are other operators on the island but if you want a truly personal and intimate experience this is the group for you.
This was an absolute highlight of our trip to Oregon. We would definitely recommend to anyone visiting to check out Envi. Worth the time and the money.

By taking the Air Ventures tour with you I was able to see spectacular scenery, views that I could only imagine.  I would recommend this beautiful experience to anyone that wanted to see what couldn't be seen any other way, land or sea!!!  Thanks so much.  

Aloha,
Cynthia L. Rec

I have 2 young children, and this day trip to the Grand Canyon was the highlight of our week in Scottsdale. The ease of travel, shortened travel time, condensed trip that included all of the Canyon highlights, and yes, we were back in Scottsdale with enough time to get the kids to dinner and even a night swim.
We absolutely loved this tour of the island.  Riding in a biplane over beautiful Kauai is an experience we will remember forever.  Make your reservation today, you won't regret it.
The flight was excellent and the pilot provided great site seeing information during our tour. The tour has a great price and everybody has window seats. I highly recommend this tour.

One of the great travel adventures in a lifetime! Short, a bit costly, but a marvelous floatplane trip with 'landing' at Misty Fjords, even in drizzly weater. Magnificent scenery and info all the way there and back. Our pilot was Larry, who was extra helpful and knew all the answers.
Don't tour this part of Alaska and miss this!

This truly left me speechless today...  
First of all, the views were outstanding...
Our pilot, John was awesome & did a great job 'narrating' everything we saw!
Would do again in an instant!
No hassles whatsoever with getting a refund - Denali's weather didn't play ball today (low cloud and rain), but that's not Talkeetna's fault!

I had a very memorable flight with Ray on the stick and sights of a lifetime viewed out the window.  Both Jill & Ray were extremely friendly, informative and accommodating.  With Ray in control, I didn't feel at all apprehensive, which is something, as I was somewhat hesitant when we booked the flight, as I am not a great lover of small aircraft.  But all was well and the sights were fantastic and matched with Ray's abundant knowledge of both aircraft and the story & history of the sights as we flew over and next to them. Unfortunately, despite the best efforts of Jill beforehand, and Ray when in the air, the missus was a little airsick, which is not a surprise as she tends to be a sufferer of motion sickness in general; she'll be queasy just sitting in the back of a car.  I think she would've been even more affected in a chopper, so if you are a little on the queasy side, I suspect the small airplane would be better.
The flight around Maui was so special! I would recommend it to anyone visiting. My wife and I were super comfortable during the flight.
There was nothing else in the world I have enjoyed more. Fun, very informative, made us feel like there was no one in the world more important.

Had a great time....We had  an early morning trip scheduled,but it was really cloudy when we arrived.The ladies at the counter explained to us that if we went later on in the day it would be better. We checked out the island for a few hours  ,then returned later.It was awesome,the sky had cleared and the views were spectacular...Our pilot Harry was great,very knowledgeable and fun.He also let my daughter wear the Red Baron hat and goggles..

Loved this! The concierge at our hotel recommended this tour, the planes launched 7 mins from our hotel so we gave it a go. Certainly not something I do every day-highly recommend! Pilots were super nice and fun.  Very safe, go for it!

We will never forget the experience we had as Eric sailed us through the skies over Maui while the setting sun illuminated the beautiful colors cascading all around us. Eric was passionate about providing us the best possible experience, and he succeeded!

The view and service on Air Ventures Kauai was wonderful and I highly recommend it for anyone.   The staff were great and very patient and took the time to explain everything in detail.  They were not rushed and made every passenger feel special.
Our pilot was very knowledgeable about the area, and we had a great time overall. Hands down best way to experience Denali, right behind climbing it.

My whole family (including three teenagers ages 13,16 and 19) really enjoyed the seaplane ride. It was the highlight of our trip. The pilot was funny and informative. They took us right on time and were helpful with directions when I called to confirm. Must do while in San Francisco

review_title: This is a MUST in your Kauai vacation plans, I'm so glad we did it!
review_text:
First, this business is one of the best examples of great customer service that I've ever seen.
They make the tour an amazing experience, from the very moment you step into their counter. The air ride is unbelievable, and Josh (our pilot) makes it super fun and informative. We are a family of four and we all loved it!!!
Hats off to Bruce and Ellen, you guys could do trainings on how to provide perfect customer service!

review_title: Any day is special when you are flying over Denali
review_text: Yes it was cloud and rainy. This however was our grandsons first trip in a small airplane. And we whispered that to K2. They made this trip so special for him. And therefore for us too. Our thanks to the young lady who placed the three of us on a small plane like we had ridden two times previously with two other grandchildern. And our biggest shout out to Will, our pilot, who let him feel like a copilot in the front  seat of the plane. A great trip, worth every dollar.

This was a fantastic experience for our family! Such great views of the range from the air that will remain with us for a long time. Because of the weather we were not able to do the glacier landing but despite that it was breathtaking. The staff is professional and very friendly. Highly recommended.

Having come to Moab on and off for 40 years we finally tried an aerial tour last year as a great for my 79 year old dad.  It was a spectacular trip then.  So much so that dad paid for it this year.  Not that it is NOT cheap, but definitely worth doing once.

Thus year our pilot detoured out to Castle Valley and that extra 15 minutes made me feel so much better about the trip.  The left side of the plane is the best place, though you can crane over and see most of the tour from the right side.

Cannot recommend this tour enough!  We spoke via phone and then went to the airport to book our flight with Robin directly. She advised us of a discount coupon offered by the hotel we were staying at saving us money.  Thank you Robin!  Due to poor weather, our first flight was canceled, but they were able to rebook us prior to our island departure.  Paul was very knowledgeable of the island and a great pilot. Very smooth landing Paul!  We have toured Kauai in the past via car and on foot but the views from above are breathtaking. This is a must do if visiting Kauai! Air Ventures Hawaii staff won't do you wrong.

We were a little apprehensive about the weather but the contrast between dark clouds and sunlight peeking through was beautiful.  Our flight was perfectly smooth and our pilot knowledgeable and friendly.  As well traveled locals we still spotted areas along the Marin Headlands we had not explored.  Wonderful views of the coast and the city.  A must do for locals as well as visitors.
No favourite part - the whole trip was fascinating.  Ray's knowledge of the island and it's weather (he avoided the rain) is quite amazing.  Check in was a breeze!

review_title: Fun personal tour of the island
review_text: For a family of 3 this was a great alternative to more expensive and less personal helicopter tours.  The 3 of us squeezed into Bruce's plane and he gave us a very friendly overview of the island he's called home for many years.  He obviously loves it and makes for a very good guide.  It's fun to see how the plane works too.  I wished we had flown a little bit lower for better views in a few places, but overall had a great time.  We also got a great recommendation from Bruce on where to buy a ukelele: Costco (we would never have guessed)!

We did a flight-see over Denali and actually landed on a glacier! Wow!   Our flight was originally scheduled for the third day of our trip, but due to bad weather had to be re-scheduled (two times actually) so that we took the trip on our last day.  Staff was very helpful in getting this accomplished for us.  Our pilot was very steady and knowledgeable.  We appreciated his expertise as he flew us in for some fantastic, indescribable scenery.  We had a beautiful day for flying and are so glad we drove the extra 6 hours it took to make it work for us on the last day of our tightly scheduled vacation.  We loved it!

review_title: Great views and a great time!
review_text:
This was a great trip around the island.  Our pilot was knowledgeable about both the sights and the history of the island, and also was great about offering a smooth ride and answering all of our questions about the airplane.

Would highly recommend!

A wonderful experience! Even though at first the weather seemed to be not the best for flying (it was cloudy and it rained a little too) but our pilot Bruce made us realize it was even better that way as besides being able to witness breathtaking views of Kauai we could see the rainbow over the waterfall from the sky! Also thank you so much for a warm welcome from your great staff! Absolutely recommended as one of the best things to do while you're in Kauai!!!
I wasn't sure what to expect, but was absolutely delighted with the flightseeing experience, will do it again in a heart beat!

review_title: Wings Over Kauai Saved the Day
review_text: The hotel booked a flight for my Husband and I through another plane carrier.  We arrived at 11 for our 11:30 departure to find out they had engine troubles at 8 that morning and couldn't fly until later that afternoon.  They did not bother to call and let us know so we drove an hour to get there to find this out.  We wanted to fly just not waste the whole day to do it.  We went to Wings Over Kauai and they made room for us.  Bruce brought out the small Plane just for us, they were $10 cheaper and we had an amazing experience.  He knew so much about the island and the things to look at.  They gave us a free CD of the Experience and a picture of us with the plane.  It was a fantastic experience and they saved the day!!  Thank you Bruce great operation!

As an Alaskan resident, I don't do many touristy things in our beautiful state. The other half and I went on the Denali Experience tour and it was AMAZING! The pilot was fun, interactive and very informative. The office staff were pleasant. I wished I had done this a long time ago! I have driven this area and by these mountains hundreds of times but nothing compares to the up close and personal view of a flight seeing tour!!

We were on the sapphire princess and they met us on time. Great flight and pilot. He pointed out all of the sights and info about the island. After the flight, they took us on the fern grotto tour. They were waiting for us when we finished to take us back to the ship. My wife left her cell phone on the plane, and they went back to retrieve it and bring it to us. Excellent company and service. I highly recommend them.

review_title: A great adventure worth every penny
review_text:
K2 aviation is a great company
Our pilot/tour guide did an amazing job providing history, not only of Denali, but Alaska as well.  Landing on the Kahiltna Glacier was very exciting. The Turbo Otter is a well maintained, purposes built aircraft made for this type of flying. Our great adventure was worth every penny.
Surprised my guy with a flight by the Molokai cliffs and wow! We had so much fun and enjoyed Eric’s knowledge of the islands. Great views and a fun way to see some hidden gems of Hawai’i!

Bruce and his daughter were great. The tour was exciting and had great views of the island. I'm so glad we didn't pay over $300 for the helicopter tour.  I highly recommend this tour and the Na Pali Experience to get the the best of both land and sea on Kauai.

review_title: Stunning views!  Friendly staff - great time.
review_text:
This flight is a must-do!  We booked the Grand Denali with the glacier stop.  The views were stunning; once in a lifetime experience.  I highly recommend adding this to your itinerary - you won't be disappointed.

The crew, Andy and Liam, were knowledgeable and friendly.  It was easy to tell they enjoyed their jobs.   The office staff were very friendly and helpful.

We had a great time and wouldn't hesitate to book again; it doesn't get old.
I highly recommend the experience and Talkeetna Air Taxi.

No need to read any further -- just book a flightseeing trip with Talkeetna Air Taxi and if you can, make sure you do the glacier landing by Mt. McKinley. My family and I went up on one of the first clear days of August -- the views of the mountain, glaciers and valleys below were beyond description. It was the most incredible experience of our lives. 
Our pilot was fantastic and provided running commentary so we never had to wonder what we were looking at. He circled around all the sights so everyone could get a good look at all the amazing peaks too!
Landing on the glacier was one of the most incredible things I've ever done. The small plane skidded to a stop on Ruth Glacier. It's a surprisingly massive glacier surrounded by rocky granite peaks with an amazing view to a different glacier below. Being in the glacier and tossing snowballs with my 7-year old and then hiking up a bit to take in the quiet and serenity of our location were moments that are burned in my memory and will remain with me forever. How could you regret a moment of an experience like this? It's worth it. Check out some of my photos and book your trip!

This trip was absolutely amazing, the views of Denali and surrounding peaks were stunning, and quite unlike anything you can experience from the ground.  Landing on the Ruth Glacier was a truly amazing experience.  We have some nervous fliers in our group, but the pilot and company made us very comfortable and safe.

review_title: Float plane ride to Misty Fjords
review_text:
The flight with Steve to Misty Fjords was the greatest experience a person could ever ask for. Steve and Lesley are the most gracious host we have ever had on our many trips.
If you are planning a trip to Ketchikan,Ak I would strongly recommend SeaWind aviation for my number one adventure.

Loved the opportunity to see different topography and weather, viewable only by air.

Loved the opportunity to see all of Maui in one fell swoop. 

Take the trip!
seaplane adventures offered a great flight and breathtaking views, we loved every minute of it! will absolutely fly again upon our next visit to marin.

We ended our Alaska cruise with a flightseeing trip around Denali. What a finish! Talkeetna Air Taxi is by far the company to use. Two reasons: IFR and pilots. Denali is frequently obscured by clouds and VFR pilots cannot get above them. TAT is IFR and we went above both layers. Our flight was 2 hours with great views all around Denali and a landing on Peter's Glacier at the foot of the Wickersham Wall. Incredible. Tyler, our pilot, was great. Focused on safety and providing the best possible experience. He positioned the plane so all passengers got equally great views.

We had originally thought about doing a helicopter trip of the Canyon, but several people who'd visited suggested the airplane tour was better. We decided to go for it and weren't disappointed.

We managed to book for 11am the following day which suited our schedule perfectly and arrived at their smart reception area at 10:20 as requested.

We were met by the pilot at 10:45 who showed us out to the waiting Cessna Grand Caravan. This is a perfect airplane for this type of trip since it is high-wing and affords an excellent view. Each of the comfortable seats was equipped with good-quality headsets so one could listen to the commentary throughout. The airplane was not too noisy, and it was still possible to hold a conversation with someone on the opposite side of the airplane (after removing the headset of course).

We were soon in the air and flying over the rim of the canyon. It takes a circular clockwise route and covers around 100 miles of the north and south sides of the canyon with excellent views including the Colorado river.

We returned for a very smooth landing around 40 minutes later.

Overall, this was an excellent experience at a reasonable price with plenty of opportunities to take great photos and videos. I would highly recommend it.

One minor gripe - we were asked to pay a $15 per person fuel surcharge at reception and I consider it would be better to incorporate this into the published price.
It was a great flight.  The pilot was great.  The views were spectacular and the commentary was great.  The pilot was very acommodating.

Eric is incredibly kind and the way he flies and interacts with the family is pure Aloha. Maui and Eric both have much to offer. Though I've lived here a year and a half, I was able to experience views I did not believe possible. Even saw a whale jump out over the ocean!

As part of our overall Alaska experience, our vacation group (2 couples) did the Denali Experience Flightseeing Tour.  We loved every minute of it!  Our pilot, Ryan, was very personable, knowledgeable and fun during the trip.  He offered lots of information during the flight and explained what mountains/glaciers we were seeing.  I would recommend this tour to anyone interested.  Well worth the money!!

review_title: The best thing I have seen on earth
review_text: We were lucky to have flipped out your which we were supposed to take tomorrow. It was a perfect day and with a clear sky , our pilot landed on the Ruth glacier and made this a life time experience for us. We are extremely happy with the service received and a big thanks to the entire team for making this experience truly a life time memory for us. I would rate this experience 10 out of 5

Excellent customer service from beginning to end. Our pilot, Felix, was extremely professional, competent and lots of fun. He explained every step of the safety procedures and was a great tour guide, answering questions and he knew every detail of the areas we flew over. Landing in the rainforest was so much fun, and the spot where we landed was like the Garden of Eden. I loved the Awapuhi plant and the lovely moisturizer it produces! We snacked on bananas and toasted with champagne. This was the trip of a lifetime for me as I have a fear of flying and I am now over it!!!

I was able to easily arrange a complex vacation involving 3 destinations and tours w the help of their incredibly flexible staff, particularly Lindsey but all helpful and accommodating of any request. Our pilot Aaron was prompt and professional and the ride was spectacular w stunning views of the Arizona landscape and the incredible Grand Canyon. It must be seen from the air if you can. In 32 hours we accomplished a weeks worth of sights all because of Westwind Air. Vacation of a lifetime!

Highly recommend them if you're in this area and need to get somewhere far fast.

review_title: Beautiful View with a more than capable pilot!
review_text: My wife and I had an amazing flight of the Miami skyline. What a breathtaking view of the ocean and city. The tour was highlighted with some great facts of the city and surrounding areas. A highly recommended adventure in the sky!
We had the best time, would definitely recommend! Beautiful views, awesome pilot! All around amazing experience!
Really a great time, very unique view of the island and surrounding area. Would recommend to friends.

This was the trip of a lifetime! Very professional, accommodating, friendly staff. We were blessed with excellent viewing weather. Landing, then walking on Ruth Glacier looking up at Denali was breathtaking. 
Our pilot/guide, Liam from New Zealand was awesome!

review_title: Beautiful Scenic Flight to truly appreciate Mount Denali and the Alaskan Range
review_text: Phenomenal flight experience in a small Cessna 185. There were 4 of us and the pilot. The morning had perfect view of Denali. It was incredible how small the planes that had landed on Denali appeared from the sky. Due to a fire north of Denali, there has been a lot of smoke in the area, but it had cleared for the few days I was around Talkeetna! Would highly recommend on a clear day to go up!

review_title: Talkeetna Air Taxi took us up for a peek into heaven.
review_text: We had a perfect evening flight, all conditions were great to see the mountains and we were able to land on a glacier.  Jonathon was a super pilot, warm and friendly and full of fascinating information.  He welcomed our questions, made a flawless landing on the glacier and made is feel safe.  Flying up above the clouds was truly like having a peek into heaven.  We took loads of pictures and videos and love to show them off.  We had to talk our niece who lives into Anchorage into joining us for this ride.  Luckily we were successful and had the trip of a lifetime with her.  Life is couldn't be sweeter!

review_title: SeaWind Aviation trip to Traitors cove was awesome !
review_text:
Having done the trip to Traitors Cove recently I have no hestitaion in recommending SeaWind Aviation. I was made to feel welcome by Lesley right from the outset. A real family business with a great friendly atmosphere.
Despite it being a misty day the pilot did a great job managing to highlight things during our flight. Riding in the co pilots seat was a real buzz.
While the forest is not a zoo and bear sightings can't be guaranteed I was lucky enough to see 3 bears including one beautiful black bear who entertained us for 15 -20 minutes performing salmon catching duties. In a word the experience was awesome !
Coming from a country that has no large predators  (NZ) its something I will never forget. Thanks Lesley and SeaWind Aviation for being part of the experience.

We were super impressed.  They weren't going to just take our money unless they could deliver a super experience.  We were scheduled to fly to Denali on Tuesday but it was too cloudy to see anything and they matter-of-factly informed us that it was not worth going and that we should reschedule if our schedule allowed.  It did and the next day was clear and the views were amazing.  The glacier landing was always worth the extra bucks.  We were treated so well and everybody was very professional.  Highly recommend them but have a flexible schedule if possible.

From start to finish this was by far the best tour I've ever had!  Our pilot was incredibly kind and informative.  We had no long lines, not rushed , nor crowded,experience was perfect! He timed everything perfectly. I enjoyed the flights, the hikes, the boat...absolutely everything ❤

Great company, great people, excellent service!  We booked round trip from Seattle to Friday Harbor and back. Delayed due to fog on the return flight and we thought we would miss our connection at SeaTac. They rushed us in their shuttle right to the terminal. It was super close but we made our fight!  Very Grateful!  Thank you!  Jason our pilot was awesome too!
Awesome tour on a spectacular day by Talkeetna Air Taxi. The landing on the glacier was unforgettable.

review_title: Grand Denali and Ruth Glacier landing
review_text: I can't say enough about this experience. We took the Grand Denali tour AND landed on Ruth glacier on June 15th with (I think Chris). The day was sunny and gorgeous. The tour was informative and exciting...I'd call it the experience of a lifetime, and I've had a few. Highly recommend TAT.

review_title: Wonder Waterfalls and A Beaitiful Sunset
review_text: Absolutely AMAZING tours. The waterfall tour was gorgeous at 6:00pm, flying back with the sunset was phenomenal. Our pilot was Taylor and he was superb, made us feel safe the whole way through, and had absolute control over the plane to give us the most amazing aerial shots possible. 100% ask for Taylor if you have the option to! Eagle-eyed and sure-handed, you'll get great pictures and amazing history info. (Plus he spotted Elk and a wedding from 2000ft. and got us great shots of both.

The moto for our trip was just say yes and do it so when the chance to ride in a helicopter over the canyon we jumped at the chance and wow was it worth it :D 

The pilots are all really friendly helping you get ready for the tour and then make excellent tour guides over the canyon the views were stunning a completely different perspective from hiking the canyon. That first moment when you fly over the edge and the canyon drops beneath you is amazing. 

You can take as many photos as you wish and even make videos if you wish, the tour last approx 45min and if you are considering it then just go for it u will love it :)

We just got back from our Wings over Kauai tour with Captain Bruce. It was absolutely the highlight of our trip.  As an airline pilot myself, I am very cautious about safety, that is why I chose an airplane tour instead if a helicopter tour, and I have to say that I would highly recommend this outfit. Captain Bruce was safe, cautious, smooth, professional and an overall excellent pilot. Not to mention an excellent tour guide with a wealth of knowledge about the island. We brought our two young children with us and they treated all of us very well and went out of their way to make all of us comfortable. I highly recommend Wings over Kauai! You will love it too!!
I was both terrified and excited when we went up to see the glacier. The pilot was very knowledgeable about all the places we flew! Very happy
This flight was an amazing once in a lifetime experience that was scenic as well as informative. The experience was amazing.

review_title: What more can you say  - really it is after all THE Grand Canyon
review_text: No better way, to she vast expanse of the canyon if you do not have much time or can't walk very far or are just too darn old to float down the river. Great seats great view, excellant pilots

This was my 3rd flight with Wings Over Kauai. As Always, the flight was wonderful. You can read my previous reviews which reflect the same as this one. EXCELLENT tour and personnel. 
This year I took my girlfriend and she had a wonderful time. From the Front Desk, the pilot and finally meeting Ellen, the tour and time there was GREAT. I don't like wasting my time nor my money and I promise you that you will LOVE this tour. This IS the BEST tour on the island. Best Wishes in 2018 to Bruce, Ellen and all the WOK  family.
Absolutely amazing experiences, both my children got to fly the plane and it made for an unforgettable vacation. Eric is so friendly and clearly enjoys showing people the beauty of Maui.

We flew in a little Cessna plane with Jacob our pilot who was very professional and extremely competent. He explained everything landmark we flew over and gave us ideas on where to explore on land. The views were spectacular! Thank you Jacob!

We debated cancelling this excursion as we had done so much flying already, but I am SO glad we didn't!  The first day we were not able to go as the weather wasn't clear, but they rescheduled us to the next day and it was perfect!  Wow, what a fabulous way to see Denali.  Gorgeous views the entire route.  Not a cloud in the sky.  We landed on the glacier and had the opportunity to get out and walk around and take some pics.  Wow, what an awesome experience!
The weather cleared earlier in the day and our flight was late afternoon. The views were stunning. We got to see Denali.  Our pilot was great.
This is a must do while on Kauai! Staff is fantastic!  So amazing to see this beautiful island from the air.

Originally signed up for the Summit Tour with Glacier landing but due to clouds, couldn't be done. But thankfully, the Denali Experience could happen. Something was better than nothing. We were able to see the top of Denali which pictures don't do this justice. Our pilot was so knowledgeable and had a blast flying around in a tiny plane. All the staff of K2 is very friendly. Definitely recommend for sure!

What a great experience!  Not only is the island incredibly beautiful and unique from above but Wings Over Kauai really go out of their way to make you feel comfortable and safe.  Our pilot told us interesting facts about the island during the flight and Mary packed us a cooler full of cold beverages and towels.  I love that it is a small family ran company that makes you feel right at home from the beginning.  I would highly recommend this amazing experience!

Took my father as a 70th birthday present.  We both had a incredible time. An easy day trip from Anchorage. Took the 8:30am flight and had amazing views of the North side of Denali.  They seem to adjust the flight to get the most out of the weather.  Extremely capable, friendly and informed pilot (thanks Clay).  Glacier landing is a must.  Staff at reception were great.  Had us checked in and ready in no time.  Would definitely recommend TAT for this.
Everyone's pretty much said it.  I loved it too!  It was a fair bit of money but definately worth it.  One piece of advice, don't forget your sunglasses when you get out on the glacier.

Eric was so friendly and knowledgable. Our 7 year old got to fly a plane for the first time, and he was thrilled. The views are amazing and nothing like we’ve seen before. We even saw whales spouting right under the plane! Truly the highlight of our trip.

review_title: Maui Plane Ride is a "Bucket List" type experience!!
review_text:
Setting up our appointment was a breeze!! We did the Sunset plane tour and WHAT AN EXPERIENCE!!
Eric even offered for me to take the controls at various times of the flight... Most definitely worth the time!!
We absolutely will do this again!!

Like many, I read TA a lot but don't often feel the need to post. Flew in their smaller plane, the Cessna 172, recently on the standard around-the-island tour. Excellent narration and as most everyone else has already said, wonderful scenery. All I have to add is that I was impressed at this operator's excellent attention to safety details. The aircraft was clean, well equipped and obviously well maintained. Pilot knew his stuff. No worries at all. Having retired after 40+ years flying for a major airline, I think I'm qualified to say "great job". Nice landing, too, 
The three Gopros on the aircraft are recording all flight and, yes, it is very well worth it to order the optional DVD or Blu-ray [or online download] to show your friends and family back home how great Kauai looks from above. No stock footage. It's all recorded on your flight.
On a clear day, there is absolutely no better way to experience the size and scope of  Denali and the surrounding mountain range. It was spectacular!

we booked this through the Princess land tours group. We arrived at K2 aviation about 30 min before our flight, the very helpful and happy staff weighed us all and offered glacier boots, as well as allowed us to store our extra baggage before leaving. When our pilot arrived from his previous flight, everyone who got off the plane had huge smiles on their faces... after our flight, we all knew why! A MAZE ING is the only way I can describe this trip! One of the best things I've ever been able to do, and I travel frequently! I would recommend everyone take this flight if you're visiting Talkeetna, you won't be disappointed!

If you are visiting San Francisco then this is a must, it is a beautiful city looking from the harbour, getting a birds eye view is even better.
Fog delayed our flight for 3 days but finally we got on and well worth it.
Smooth take off and landing, great city view flight.

It was perfect and we would go again with this same company. A small fixed wing plane seating a pilot and 2 riders. Things to keep in mind if you pick this small plane-If you are very tall say 6’3 or  over you may be cramped for leg space and if you are quite roundly overweight it might feel a little squeezed. Arrive 1/2 hour early,no jacket needed, you get weighed in and instructed on safety. Short walk to plane and have picture taken. The excitement begins,we were like co-pilots ,we had a brief explanation of the gauges and levers,took  part in the business of checking instruments and preparing for take off . Our pilot Bruce was very knowledgeable about the island and an excellent pilot. We have done helicopters before it was fast ,loud and all about the helicopter . We booked this not just for the incredible affordable price but for the feeling of soaring,peacefully through the skies. The trip seemed longer than an hour,  slow enough to see everything very well,no need for risky zipping in closer like the helicopters do. This experience is about being in the air above beautiful Kaua’i and having the island coastlines and spots of interest pointed out to you. There was very low music in the headset,Bruce narrated just enough so there was quiet to enjoy being above Kaua’i. Highly recommend this experience.

review_title: The best thing I have done in Alaska
review_text:
The family and I took the Denali flight which landed on the glacier near the pilots house on the mountain. Stunning views of course and we got lucky with a beautiful sunny day. 

The rule of thumb is 1/3 get to see the mountain so try to schedule around the weather. The mountain is roughly 20,000ft above the town of Talkeetna, AK. 

Definately do the landing it is worth the extra charge. My 70 year old mother with limited mobility was able to get out and walk about a little too.

review_title: Great Way to see the Island!
review_text: I had a great experience with Wings Over Kauai.  They treat you like family, and are honest about the weather and flying conditions.  Totally professional, yet informative and friendly.  Ellen and Gy, my pilot, were outstanding.  This is a "must".  Recommend them most highly.

Awesome.  Simply awesome.  We rode over the Grand Canyon.  We were seated by weight distribution and I was lucky to be seated next to the pilot.  I was very scared before we took off and truthfully, it was a bit scary since I could see straight down the front window, but I am so glad I did this ride.  You cannot see how large the canyon is from the ground.  It was a 45 minute ride and was enough time to see much of the canyon.  The pilot gave us lots of information as we rode over the canyon.  We were given a talk before we took off to explain safety measures.  Very professional staff.  If you can afford it, I recommend this experience.  You will never forget it - I know I won't.

My husband and I thoroughly enjoyed our flight. Kauai is a beautiful place, and Wings gave us the opportunity to see parts of the island that cannot be seen any other way. Marcus was friendly, knowledgeable, careful, and we had a great time.

review_title: One of my favorite experiences in 20 years of Moab
review_text:
I'm from Utah and have been visiting Moab for over 20 years, but always from the ground. Flying over the landscape for the first time brought a life's worth of experiences into one grand image. Our pilot explained the geologic history of the landscape in a very detailed and cohesive way. The employees all seem happy and proud of their work, I even got the chance to meet the grandson of Tim Martin, a.k.a. The Arch Flying Cowboy of the Canyonlands.

Overall 6 out of 5 experience, perfect for any Moab explorer.

The stuff is so nice even though we came late, the pilote was very professional
Awesome experience 
I highly recommended

review_title: The Best Part of Our Trip was the biplane ride on the last day! Awesome!
review_text:
We had seen advertisements for air and helicopter tours. But never expected to see a biplane tour. We took both the standard plane tour, which was wonderful also. Then we spotted the biplane sign, I had to do it! We made an appointment and my brother-in-law Joe and I went for the ride with our pilot Nick DuBay. He was fabulous, also a flight instructor as I found out. It was like climbing into the Red Baran's plane to look for Snoopy!
We chose the duration and area we wanted to fly over. 45 minutes seemed enough, but I could have spent the whole afternoon wit Nick. We saw everything we saw from ground level, from an open cockpit, the pictures speak for themselves. Nick asked how daring we wanted to be, and we told him to 'go for it!'. We did several 'wing overs' pulling several 'G's' each time, we flew into the crater as far as Nick deemed to be safe. His flying skills kept any sign of air sickness out of the question. The price was right, it topped off two wonderful weeks in Kauai. If anyone misses the chance to fly in a biplane, they missed one thing that should be on anyone's 'Bucket List'. Great flying with you Nick! Mahalo! If anyone wants a more personal or in depth review, please feel free to contact me, Jack from Chicago, at chgoipa50@aol.com, happy to speak with you!

The trip was amazing! Our pilot, Chris Wilson, was super nice. The view was amazing! Everything was super clear and it looked like we were in a movie. We did not even notice we were off the ground at take off. I would do this 1 million times and still not get tired of it. The trip was spectacular!

Ian McGrath from Belford New Jersey

It was a great experience. It is absolutely worth the price. The pilot was fun and really professional. We got to see all the beauties in Kauai. The view is breathtaking, I just recommend it to everyone to try Air Ventures.
It was so amazing to see Maui county from the air!  The colors were only visible from the plane!  As our very kind guide said, this is once in a lifetime folks!

I've taken two trips to view Denali, both were awesome.  The Pilot was safety-minded and very knowledgable of the area.  On the first trip we landed on Ruth Glacier, on the second we landed at base camp, both were terrific.  They provided all the gear you need, boots etc.  It was the highlight of our trip.

Excellent service and very friendly family run business.  Well organised. Wonderful experience seeing the beautiful scenery and although it was early in the season and a hot day the pilot did his best to find us some wildlife. Excellent bald eagle spotting at the start point of this flight too.  Felt safe and confident. Highly recommend doing this tour with Seawind Aviation.

review_title: Great Waterplane Flight to the Florida Keys
review_text: Great flight over the Florida Keys with stopover and lunch on 'Loreley' Island. The trip starts and ends in Miami, a short motorboat ride through Miami Harbour to and from the seaplane is included. Overall a great experience and highly recommended!

Took a one hour trip with a glacier landing - K2 McKinley Experience. Weather was mostly clear and we saw Denali, it snowed a little when we landed on glacier. Pilot was great and explained what glaciers and mountains we saw. Great trip

review_title: viewing Denali by air and landing on a glacier the most amazing experience
review_text: My husband and I were one of the last flights of the day and we flew in the tiniest Cessna and I felt like I was knee-to-knee with our pilot. The Cessnas are specially modified to land on glaciers and fly at these altitudes and in Alaskan weather so it was all very safe and our pilot experienced and professional. Talkeetna Air Taxi have other larger planes but we were the last ones for the day and we were pleased to experience a 'private' Grand Denali tour with glacier landing. If there is inclimate weather, see if you can wait another day or try to be flexible in your travel itinerary because it's worth it to do the glacier landing and get views of Denali. The weather was iffy on our day so we chose to wait around and then were in luck to be able to land on one of the smaller glaciers. You see so many glaciers that it really didn't matter to us which glacier we landed on as there are so many to view. I'm glad we chose to go with Talkeetna Air Taxi as it was nice to do the flightseeing from Talkeetna itself. And we did get intermittent views of Denali despite the not-so-perfect day. Well worth the money.

Fun, friendly, a little less formal than the published brochure. Photography through a window is tough do to glare off glass - you will wind up with a reflection of yourself in most photos. Bring a polarizer if you can.
Eric was absolutely fantastic! Great customer service. Working towards PPL and nothing like having PHOG in my logbook!!! So excited and ready to come back again!!
It was awesome experience.  Must to do.  Very very very enjoyable highly recommend for everyone.  Enjoy the ride great views of miami.

Seawind Aviation will not only provide you with a great scenic trip their customer service goes beyond excellent this is one company you need to visit for a lifetime memory no matter which tour you reserve

This was by far the best activity we had on our 10 day trip to Oahu and Kauai.  You cannot digest the amount of beauty we saw in just a little over an hour.
Pros:1- amazing staff, starting from Val, the nice lady who welcomed us to Markus our amazing pilot who not only pointed out to us all the interesting sights of Kauai but also answered all our questions 2- The plane is very comfortable and airy. 3- wide windows allowing for excellent viewing. 4- The plane tours the whole island, the helicopters only show you some of the island and don't get high enough.

The cons: I wish we had a video of our flight

review_title: Fantastic tour, a must do in Kauai
review_text: We had a brilliant time on our Cessna tour, we're still talking about it in awe. From the moment we arrived and received the warmest welcome and smoothest check-in with the lovely Mary, we were taken on an amazing flight around this stunning island by our wonderful captain Marcus who pointed out everything to us with great explanations, details and anecdotes. The flight was really smooth and enjoyable, the cessna tour was fantastic, we always felt in great hands and safe, we got to see everything and were able to take so many photographs. We both came out thrilled, it is an exhilarating experience and we highly recommend Wings over Kauai Air tours, Mahalo =)

Not a typical I loved it review. But I was very impressed with K2 and the way they run their business. We were booked for a glacier landing tour today but unfortunately the weather was not ideal. They gave us the option of changing to a different flying location, postponing to another day or getting a full refund. We were very bummed about the weather and not being able to fly but it was so nice knowing they weren't going to take us up in unsafe conditions.... And they they would refund our money no questions asked. What a great way to keep people happy and safe. We will definitely be returning to K2 for a later flight and will recommend them to our family and friends.

This is our third time with this company.  We have done the helicopter tour and this is the second seaplane ride we took.  First one for our daughter.  We all had a fabulous time! Well worth the money for a different type of excursion!

There was a plane crash (not a Seawind Aviation plane) on Prince of Wales Island four days before we arrived by cruise ship in Ketchikan. The pilot of that plane, which had 10 passengers on board, safely landed on top of a mountain and nobody was seriously injured. However the accident made our cruise company, Regent, nervous and there must be of course some potential liability issues until the crash is fully investigated and the cause is determined. 

So our cruise line canceled any excursion in the Ketchikan area that had to do with flying. We did not want to miss the Misty Fjords so we got online and saw the great trip advisor reviews for Seawind Aviation and booked our tickets the night before for the next morning. A married couple owns and runs the company, and the husband, Steve, was our pilot. We liked everything about our experience with Seawind and the couple that run it, and we highly recommend!

In June 2010 4 of us took the Grand Denali Tour.  Booking this tour on our own separate from the cruise line was a bit tricky but saved us a great deal.  Elaine from K2 was most pleasant & helpful.  The flight left right on time & we were fortunate enough to have the plane, a 4 seater to ourselves.  The pilot, Randy was excellent, very detailed & thoughtful . . .so much so that numerous times he would bank the plane so I could take better pictures.  Randy was also very informative in telling us what we were viewing at any given time.  While this was our first & only flightseeing experience in Alaska I cannot imagine how any operator could top K2!  Highly recommended!
Booked a late afternoon flight and glacier landing.  Great staff to work with and pilot.  The scale of the area is only appreciated when you are in the air and seeing it.
It was a great tour. Unfortunately, I got motion sickness and did not feel good. If u take this tour, I highly recommend taking Dramamine before you go.
Amazing trip around the island! Our Pilot was incredible and made us feel at home. Would definitely recommend to anyone!

We strongly recommend this as one of three must do routes (sky, water and land) for Alaska tourists.   Swing by Aurora Dana to get Aurora info and a coupon for this flight.  
The sky view is gorgeous and magnificent.   Glacial landing is another new life experience.   To see is to believe, you need to do it yourself to fully understand how wonderful this trip is.
The flight was amazing, pilot was extremely competent and showed us a great time. Saw a lot of waterfalls!

review_title: Flight over Grand Canyon, Glen Canyon Dam and Monument Valley from Page
review_text: I cannont recommend this trip more highly.  The Grand Canyon was spectacular, but the Glen Canyon dam and Monument Valley was such a suprise.  Do the full trip, spend the money the scenery, geography and flight are MORE THAN WELL WORTH IT.  DO IT!

Extremely scenic flight, and longer than I expected.  Our pilot was knowledgable and skilled.  We landed on a lake in the middle of the misty fjords- so serene and beautiful.  Definitely a great excursion!!

This company is top notch. I called a few times with questions and they were always polite and helpful. The trip itself was spectacular. The pilot was so knowledgeable and flew the plane like an absolute pro. The landing was one of the best I have ever experienced. They give headsets so you can ask questions and everyone had a window seat on the plane we flew in.

review_title: Amazing instruction, one of a kind flight.
review_text: Great!!! Steve was very active and responsive, and catered to my aviation interests. Molokai sea cliffs are one of a kind, must-go experience.

review_title: A treat for eyes and soul ! You have to do it !
review_text:
On a beautiful and sunny day, our pilot Paul, provided us with equally perfect service. We took home memories and pictures of unmatched beauty and they will stay with us for a lifetime. You MUST take the glacier landing option or you will miss a wonderful experience. Thank you Talkeetna Air Taxi, thank you Paul and happy upcoming birthday, 
Ziggy from New York

Highly recommend!

My wife and I are passionate about the outdoors, mountains, and hiking but are not mountaineers. Rather than booking through the cruiseline, we booked directly with Talkeetna Air Taxi. Not only did we save a few hundred dollars, but we got a summit flight with a glacier landing. It felt like being in a BBC nature documentary. The staff was friendly and competent and the pilot was great (we lived to write the review). They also had us back in time for the last shuttle from town to our hotel.

If you are on the fence: give it a shot. I'll zero balance the credit card next month, but we will remember this experience for the rest of our lives.

review_title: Family trip perfect for all ages.
review_text: Amazing trip! We got there early so Kevin our pilot took us out early. Would recommend to anyone our first small plane flight and it was smooth and perfect! They also had cool towels if you got to hot, or felt sick. Kevin was so informational and had fun facts, you could tell he really loves his job. We went up into the volcanos and saw TONS of waterfalls. Overall one of the best things we did on the island!!!

review_title: Excellent service and an even better tour
review_text: This tour was one of the highlights of our trip. Excellent company and great service. Very professional in how they handle their tours. Very efficient and organized.

Here's something that's not on offer everyday in big tourist cities. 
What a treat. 
You have a choice of three trips from 30 minutes to an hour and get a guided tour of the city, from the air. 
Our pilot/guide was brilliant and it was really good to see the city from the air. 
We've travelled a fair bit and have learned the best way to really enjoy a city, is to do some sort of guided tour when you arrive. 
If you can afford it, I'd recommend this one. 
You get collected from Pier 39, so you should get there early and wander around a bit, if you haven't seen it, as it's less crowded. A 20 minute drive over The Golden Gate Bridge to the plane gives you a quick tour of some of the suburbs. 
We combined our trip with Alcatraz as we then had guaranteed tickets. 
This was a highlight of our time in San Francisco.

review_title: Great Day! Unbelieveable, worth every penny
review_text: My family and I really enjoyed this trip. The flight was flawless . Ben was an excellent pilot and we enjoyed our ride . The views were amazing and your really can't see the canyon from a better angle. You can take a thousand pictures but it wont do justice to the canyon from the air. If you can you must do this trip!

review_title: Don’t miss SF from the air!!!
review_text: Amazing flight over SF and yes, the city is even more beautiful from the air!!!! Our French speaking pilot was amazing, he had a lot of little stories to tell and was great with the kids on board. Everyone had a great time, I would definitely recommend this flight...

Lesley, Steve and Dan provided top notch service as we explored Traitor's Cove Bear feeding site with their professionally run organization!

The experience is amazing, Dan's knowledge of the area and nature that surrounded us was superb, and Steve's flying confidence and sky-tour of Ketchikan and surrounding area was extraordinary. 

Per their plan, we were able to see a handful of bears feeding on the live salmon in the river leading inland...

We would do this again in a heartbeat!

PS Shelby was wonderful on the very personal shuttle service!!  :)

review_title: AMAZING - a highlight of our trip!
review_text: We were on a cruise and found AirVentures independently while in port on Kauai.  Intended to join a group flight but (fortunately) ended up on an private flight on the Cessna with Captain Eric who was very knowledgeable and took great care of us!  What a spectacular way to see the Na Pali coast and Waimea Valley!! Was my husband's favorite part of our trip.  Thanks AirVentures!

Thank you to all those at Talkeetna Air Taxi! I had a remarkable time. I felt very safe. I was co pilot in the landing on Mt. McKinley when we went. Great energy from the pilot. Friendly staff. Everything went very well. This is one of my favorite memories of all time, so thank you!!
Was amazing glad we went!  First trip on a plane here at Maui. Flying the plane was exciting.  Hang loose.
Helicopter Rides! Michael was great, so was Amanda!  Two great trips, both with teenagers!  Highly recommended!

The views from this air tour were amazing!!! The pilot was very knowledgeable about the history of the Napali Coast and he even checked on me (a couple of times) to make sure I was comfortable (I think he could sense that I'm not a good flyer). The tour was so smooth and comfortable that I was able to take a lot of beautiful pictures. I would definitely recommend this tour to all of my friends!
