This excursion was memorable and worth the money. The best way to see Misty Fjords. The staff was friendly and prompt, and the pilot was experienced and knowledgable. We even landed in the water halfway through the trip and took pictures. Absolutely breathtaking. A once in a lifetime opportunity.

Bingo! We came on perfect day for Mt. Denali viewing!  Martha was wonderful to deal with by text and was very patient & prompt in responding to our questions and giving us all the info we needed about the weather & flight. Everything was better than expected. The weather was rainy in Anchorage and Wassali, so we were worried, but in Talkeetna it was partly cloudy and perfect for viewing the mountain! Paul was a fantastic pilot, very expert, making sure each side of the plane got a commanding view of the Mt. Denali and surrounding mountains.  Highly recommend!

Wonderful day trip from Phoenix to the Grand Canyon with family for daughters birthday.   Great friendly folks in the office, free candy bars and snacks while we waited and confidence inspiring pilot.

Met Bruce in the morning and he drove us to the airport. He's extremely personable and even tho he wasn't our pilot he put us in very capable hands.  That  of Marcus. My husband and I are both pilots so we knew what to expect flying wise. The scenery was exquisite and it was a very smooth ride. Clearly you have a little bumps because of the clouds but Marcus had full command of the situation. Also the smoothest takeoff and landing I've experienced in a very long time. Well worth the $$$ we even ordered the raw video that was shot. Would do it again. With this company in a heartbeat

This was one of the best birthday experience!  The views are unbelievable. To see the landscape with my own eyes from the plane was beyond beautiful! Steve was great! He is very knowledgeable and made it very comfortable. I am looking forward to experiencing this again! Thank you so much for the great time!

We took two trips with Maverick Helicopters. One to the Grand Canyon and one over the Las Vegas strip at night. Both trips were outstanding! The views of the strip, Hoover Dam and the Grand Canyon were amazing. We also landed at the Grand Canyon and I would highly recommend this option for your trip. Staff were very friendly and professional.

The weather cleared on our last day in Talkeetna, so we were able to take the flight around Denali with a glacier landing.  WOW!  It was an awe inspiring, breath taking, spiritual experience. Don't miss it if you have the chance.  Talkeetna Air Taxi did an outstanding job.  Thanks to all.

This was one of the highlights of our Alaska trip. We did the grand tour plus landed on the glacier. The views were stunning! Our pilot Daniel was so informative and full of information. The people that worked there were helpful and nice.

review_title: Great way to see the island!
review_text: We had a great time on Wings Over Kauai.  The tour is very personal - it was just us and one other couple on the plane, and Bruce wrote down everyone's names and made a point of checking in with everyone individually during the ride.  His knowledge of the island is very strong so you could ask questions during the tour and he also had a good sense of humor.  Overall, felt this was very good value for the product offered and were very happy not to have paid twice the price for a helicopter which would probably have been quite similar (though haven't done a helicopter so can't say!).  Not Bruce's fault at all, but it is easy to get motion sickness in a small plane - so be prepared if you're prone to it!

The schedule was a bit backed up after a few days of bad weather, but these folks handled things with professionalism, courtesy and good humor. We never felt out of the loop while waiting or rushed when the weather finally cleared.  First-rate equipment and pilots (I'm a pilot, too, so I'm picky about such things).  You can book a flight here with confidence that your safety, comfort and enjoyment are paramount.  Spendy, yes; but you'll have absolutely no regrets -- only great memories of a phenomenal flight into stupendous scenery. Go for it!
The pilot which we flew with was very knowledgable and very interesting to talk to! Had an amazing anniversary experience!

It was the highlight of our trip!  Amazing views, and we were given 20 minutes or so to walk around on the glacier, which was incredible.  Plus, we got to see Denali right up close.  Phenomenal!  Also, great service overall too.  The day we had planned to go was cloudy, and Talkeetna Air Taxi called 3+ hours in advance to let us know we likely wouldn't be able to land on the glacier, so they gave us options to do just the flight or try to rebook the next day.  We had availability in our schedules the next day, so we booked for 6pm, although I had let them know it would be ideal if something opened up in their schedules for earlier in the day.  Fortunately, there was an opening that popped up at 3:30pm, and they called to get my group moved earlier to the ideal spot.  Great customer service and communication!  The ideal excursion and well worth the money.
Wonderful views and much cheaper than cruise ships.  The take off and landing on the water is a once in a life time opportunity. Steve was our pilot and a great tour guide
It was awesome, can't wait to do it again! I may try the helicopter ride next time with my wife who gave me the gift certificate.  Thanks!!

review_title: Best way to see Golden Gate Bridge and san Francisco
review_text: Seaplane adventure provide a unique was of experiencing main of San Francisco's landmarks through planes. It provides knowledgable pilot and also if you are lucky enough to be only two people on the plane, you will have the whole place to your selves. It was cover Golden Gate bridge, Alcatraz prison as well other landmark such as beaches nearby, stadiums and most of san francisco

Thanks to our pilot, Will, we arrived at out starting camp site on Clear Creek for a 3 day float/fish trip with Dave Fish Alaska. Will was watchful and pointed out wildlife as we traveled, even in the rain. He even turned around so my son could get a good look at the moose near our landing area.

review_title: The best way to see Denali!
review_text: Well worth the cost! We didn’t walk on the glacier, but the trip through the mountains was truly awe inspiring! Pilot was great, smooth flight! Our pilot taught the owner how to fly! 40 years of experience. Loved every minute and got some great pics. The best way to see Denali and the Alaskan range.
An amazing experience and excellent pilot and incredible amazing scenery we love to do again I hope son
fantastic, breathtaking fixed wing Ariel flight of five islands in Hawaii. Two more batteries in a helicopter tour. Captain Eric rocks big time!

Excellent trip. Snacks and drinks before takeoff. Used a Cessna to fly up. 2 hour narrated flight and went right over the valley! Tour company was waiting. Had a nice lunch at the local restaurant and then a van tour of the valley. Epic once in a lifetime trip. Less than 2 hour flight back. Learned a lot, souvenir photo, and memories to last a lifetime. Thank you for an amazing experience!
My favorite part of the ride was seeing all the waterfalls and flying the plane. Taking off was scary at first but it was easy as Steve was coaching me through it. Steve was excellent tour guide.

We really enjoyed our tour! Staff were very friendly and our pilot, Doug, provided us with a safe, interesting and enjoyable flight. We would definitely recommend Wings Over Kauai. Great price, fantastic service and an experience we will cherish forever. One of the highlights of our holiday. Thank you so much for a wonderful time. Becky and Tom (U.K.).

review_title: Once in a lifetime experience that far exceeded expectations.
review_text: Went on the Grand Denali Tour yesterday. Beautiful day to fly and it was FANTASTIC!  Our pilot Chris was great. Skilled, personable, informative, and generally a really friendly guide. I cannot stress enough how much you need to go on this trip. And Talkeetna Air Travel was professional from beginning to end. Would give 100 stars if it was an option.

So happy Tim (Denali Outlook) recommended Air Taxi for flight up to the glaciers. What an experience. Pilot was GREAT. Process at the desk was seemless. Highly recommend this flight if you are ever in Talkeetna.
This was the top fun activity of my 10 day stay in California, with no doubt. John was an excellent guide and pilot, and me been a pilot myself loved the DHC-2, simply amazing.

A helicopter tour of Kauai was on our wish list for Hawaii, but we don't at all regret this great circuit of the island by airplane.  So fabulous seeing beautiful beaches and waterfalls (dozens!!) from the air.  Take a good camera!

Flew to and back from Friday Harbor.  What a cool experience.  They give ya a tour as you go over the islands.  We were fortunate enough to see a Trident sub on the way back.  Very cool.  Sadly no whales.  Great flight - smoothest take off and landing we've ever experienced.  The fly low enough for great views.  They even went out of their way to mail back my hat!  They picked us up at Sea-Tac and took us back.  Well worth the little bit extra.  Definitely a great part of our trip out to Friday Harbor.

We had a great experience with Wings over Kauai from check in to landing.  Bruce and Captain Josh made us feel very welcome.  Josh was very knowledgeable about the island and shared interesting facts and history during our flight.  He even pointed out a group of whales and circled around them a few times so we could get some great views.  Sights included spectacular NaPali coastline, gorgeous Waimea Canyon and numerous amazing waterfalls. The Bose noise canceling headphones were great!  We were able to talk with each other and Capt. Josh during the flight.  We were with our two children ages 9 and 11.  They couldn't believe how fast an hour went by and wished they could stay on board longer.  Thank you Bruce and Josh for a memorable trip.  We highly recommend this trip!!

review_title: Great way to see Rainbow Bridge
review_text: We had a fantastic flight touring Glen Canyon, Rainbow Bridge and the surrounding area. Such a fantastic way to see the area and so different from on the water. Cannot recommend this enough!

Amazing views! Incredible experience for our family 
The pilot was great and showed us the most beautiful scenery’s
Awesome!!! Steve was an excellent guide and pilot! The cliffs and views were once in a lifetime. Well worth it!

We had a wonderful experience with Air Ventures Hawaii.  Harry, our pilot, did a great job giving us a great flight even with windy conditions.  His commentary was knowledgeable and informative.  We definitely would do it again and would highly recommend Air Ventures Hawaii.  What a great and beautiful experience! John, Patty and Ryan Forkenbrock
Worth every penny.This was the highlight of our Alaskan trip and that's saying quite a bit considering that the whole trip was awesome! TAT was great , pilot was friendly and very informative.

review_title: Do not pass up this opprotunity!!
review_text: Before we came to Kauai, my husband and I did a lot of research on the helicopter and light plane tours.  It became obvious, by reading the reviews in TripAdvisor, that THE tour to take was WINGS OVER KAUAI.  Everyone was so right.  We were both a little apprehensive when it comes to flying in small planes, and when the competitor landed minutes before we took off and the passengers said their flight was rough (one was even sick the entire flight) that did not help.  But with Bruce as the pilot, we had absolutely no problems what so ever, a very smooth flight (a testament to his 26 years of flying experience).  The scenery is gorgeous and Bruce made sure he pointed out all of the scenic wonders of Kauai, and gave us a little history lesson as well.  Bruce made sure that he gave us the best positioning for pictures that he could.  Bruce and his staff made sure everything was done right and that we were comfortable and enjoying the ride.  If you are ever in Kauai, make sure to take a flight with WINGS OVER KAUAI.  Absolutely THE BEST!

We were so blessed to have a beautiful, clear day to fly up to Denali, see it in all its glory and land on Ruth glacier. K2 was wonderful to work with in every way and we would highly recommend this trip to others.

We chose the Grand Denali Tour with a Glacier Landing and it did not disappoint--it was the highlight of our vacation! We departed at 8:30 am with sunshine and blue skies which gave us the perfect opportunity to clearly see all of Denali National Park's beauty. Our pilot, Ian, entertained us with Park history and interesting stories during our flight. It was a wonderful tour and we would definitely go again. Thank you to everyone at K2 Aviation for an unforgettable adventure and for putting safety first.

Would highly reccommend this tour! The only way to truly see the best parts of the Grand Canyon in a day. I loved every minute and guide was super educated and made our whole day so special!! A must do tour!

Took the Misty Fjords tour whilst in dock on a cruise. Loved it, loved it! The family run business has a great vibe about it. Friendly and professional. The flight was sensational and my husband and I still talk in wonder about the "infinity" lake high up in the mountains and the waterfall falling from it. Landing on the lake and taking in the beauty of the area was an experience we won't forget. In fact it's my dream now to come and stay in one those little remote cabins by the lake. I couldn't imagine a more unique holiday!
We had a wonderful flight around Denali coupled with a landing on Ruth Glacier.  Our pilot, Rusty?, was informative, professional, and a great guide.  One of the high lights of our Alaskan trip!

review_title: Maui Helicopter with Rain Forest Landing
review_text: This is a fantastic way to see Maui from a whole different point of view. You will see some incredible waterfalls that would never be seen unless from the air. I have done this flight twice, and being in the travel industry, I will be selling this to my clients in the future. If you get a chance to do it, DO IT! You will not regret it.

I traveled to Alaska for my 50th birthday and my experience with K2 sits on the top of my list and we did ALOT. We flew around Denali Mtn. on the 2 hour glacier landing trip. I loved it so much i did two different flight tracks in the same day !!!  The 1st trip we were lucky enough to have a picture perfect clear day to go around the mountain. The 2nd trip had some cloud cover but it was still amazing and just as satisfying. Stan and Chip were my pilots, both great guys and extremely knowledgeable with the history of the area. You could ask them any questions glacier, Denali Mtn, you name it they had the answers. I would say this is a MUST do on everyones bucket list, worth every penny. And spending a couple of days in Talkeetna what could be better. Such a quant town with great food, the Roadhouse for breakfast is a must. Oh yes, the staff in the office very friendly and helpful guiding you on the trip thats right for you. Next time i want to do a drop off hiking trip !!!

I'm so glad I decided to book this tour, it truly was an experience of a lifetime. Kauai is one of the most stunningly beautiful places in the world, and seeing it from above allows you to take it all in and capture some amazing pictures. Everything about it from start to finish was outstanding, including our entertaining pilot. Next time I go back, I'm doing this again!

Quality and affordable. It was more than we expected. FYI: the crawl into the plane may be difficult for anyone when bad joints. Mom just had a hip replacement and it was a little hard. But she still loved the ride! Great views for everyone. You get your own window. Two to a row.

Our tour guide, Eric, was very helpful and informative of history and other fun facts about Kauai.  The views were spectacular, and we got to hover directly over a few waterfalls!  Excellent way to see the entire island!

review_title: An Amazing Experience. Well worth the purchase.
review_text:
This was always going to rate highly for me. I love flying, I love nature, so I had high expectations. All of them were met and exceeded. 

Rivers, the pilot, was a professional through and through. It was a beautiful smooth ride, with a great narration of the canyon.  His music choices perfectly complimented the trip as well. 

The staff from Maverick at the airport were amazing too. Super friendly and helpful, and added greatly to the pleasant experience. 

I will, without any hesitation, recommend all family and friends to use Maverick Helicopters from here on. 

Thanks for a great flight.

The air tour was great.  Our pilot J. T. did a great job.  We’d done a helicopter tour years ago, but this was better, as the tour was longer, and went around entire island, instead of just the touristy hotspots.  And this Australian AirVan goes nice and slow, so you get lots of time to see the sights.  Thanks J. T. and Jill!
Awesome trip and amazing views.  The pilot was amazing and made the trip spectacular. We even did some whale spotting and watching from the air!  Highly recommend!
The flight was a great experience. a real once in a lifetime snd id recommend it to anyone visiting Maui.

We thoroughly enjoyed our airplane tour of Kauai. We flew in a Cessna, 2 seater plane. There was an amazing view of the mountains, valleys, waterfalls, beaches, and the Napali coastline. We took a lot of wonderful photos. Wings Over Kauai was a great company to work with. They were very caring and helpful. I would highly recommend them for an aerial view of Kauai.
Great flight! Experience of a lifetime! Highly recommend! Eric did a great fly over of all the islands! Totally thrilled!

review_title: WINDANCER TOUR- HANDS DOWN BEST TOUR I'VE DONE OF CANYON
review_text:
I have been to the Canyon now 3 times, once with Pink Jeep (great land option), I drove once and stayed overnight and then I did this tour operated by Maverick. I took a group out for my 40th birthday. I love helicopters. IT was my Mum's first time.
Our pilot and guide was incredible. The helicopter amazing. Safety first with this company. The chopper holds 7 and everyone gets a chance to sit in the front. You each get a set of headphones and a microphone to chat. We flew over the dam and then across a magnificent landscape and then to the Canyon floor near the mighty Colorado River where we had champagne, soft drinks and snacks. Was just lovely. We spent about 30 mins or so there? IT was time to go but that was ok. Helicopter back with a cruise down the Las Vegas strip from the air!!! Just amazing.
They take photos of you in front of the chopper, and I bought one- and for me the price was ok. You can also get a video, but we didn't bother with that.
Totally worth the money. I am an agent and had been selling this for quite a few years as THE TOUR to do. Now I've done it, I know I was right in saying that to them. 
Do it- you won't regret it.
Note when booking: Do not leave this until your last day, sometimes weather prevents the choppers going up or if the President is in town, the airspace can sometimes be closed. Book it for your first available day/time, so if you do have to change, you can.

This was our second flight with Wings over Kauai and when we come back will do it again.  It's the best way to see the island and Ellen, Bruce and Josh make it such an enjoyable experience as well.  Highly recommend!

review_title: The best way to see San Francisco
review_text: We made a spur of the moment decision to take this trip - it was the BEST! Extremely experienced pilot gave us a fascinating tour of the city. Got the most fabulous photos and videos of the city. So grateful.

I have been coming to Kauai for the last six years, but this is the first air tour and it was awesome.  I highly recommend it for the most comprehensive and complete tour of the island.  Desi was an awesome pilot and guide and thoroughly an asset to the tour.  It is a tremendous review of this beautiful island.

My husband and I flew this morning with Eric and it was amazing! My husband even got to copilot the plane! We got to see aerial views of the crater and whales! We also got to fly over all of Maui seeing the valleys and Haleakala! Spectacular. Mahalo Eric!

review_title: Sunny, clear day to see Denali in all her splendor!
review_text: My husband and I thoroughly enjoyed our flightseeing tour with the glacier landing.  The weather could not have been better, blue skies and sunny.  We could see Mt Denali from Talkeetna upon take off.  Randy, our pilot, is a delight person and very knowledgable about the area and flying this DeHavilland plane.  I strongly recommend doing this tour to anyone that wants to see the landscape from a bird's-eye view and be so close to the peak of Denali, you feel like you can reach out and touch it!  AMAZING experience!  Thanks K2 and Randy!

The most beautiful flight ever! Got to see some of the sights never seen or accessible from the ground or on most helicopter tours. Pilot was very informative and really knew the island. Couldn't have  had a better day for sightseeing; we even got to see Mt. Waialeale clearly. In 17 years of coming to Kauai, this the first time to actually observe the mountain and the Alakai swamps. And the Napali coast was just spectacular; one gets a different perspective from the air - stupendous!!!

This was my first time to Alaska and K2 aviation was hands down the highlight. We had clear views, blue skies, Patrick our pilot was awesome and the crew was friendly and accomadating. Would recommend to anyone and everyone visiting!

review_title: Airplane flight tour of Kauai Island.
review_text: This trip was absolutely terrific. We usually take a helicopter tour around the island so this was the first trip in an airplane. Ray (the pilot) was absolutely terrific. Great since of humor and a lot of knowledge about the island. This was definitely a different perspective of seeing the island from the helicopter. It was totally different. Actually slower and more informative. I will definitely do this trip again the next time I return.

Amazing views over the Canyon with new helicopters and company has great safety record. Can highly recommend this tour company. We did the Grand Canyon spirit tour and the experience was awesome! Pilot commentary was also super so worthwhile best way to see the Canyon and flight does circle round whole canyon. I get motion sickness but had no problems at all

review_title: Denali Weather Socked - Knik a great option
review_text: Unfortunately Denali was socked in with weather. Also the glaciers had degraded to the point of no landings. We were very sad. K2 offered us an option to Knik. It was UNBELIEVABLE!!!!!  Clear skies and late day sun gave us spectacular views!  Mark was an amazing pilot and guide. Nobody can control Mother Nature but K2 will find you a memorable safe alternative. I highly recommend K2 and Mark!

review_title: Would give it 10 stars if I could!
review_text: Our family took this flight with a glacier landing. I wrestled with whether to do the landing or not and decided to go ahead and book it knowing that many times they get cancelled. The day of our flight was cloudy but had no rain. When we arrived they told us that the earlier flight had been cancelled due to visibility, but ours would be able to fly. Since there was a lot of cloud cover in the lower elevations we would not be able to land though. We were given the choice to cancel or reschedule, but it would have been difficult to fit it into our schedule on another day. Besides, the next time might be worse. We decided to go ahead and go and were assured that we would still have good views once we got above the clouds.  We seemed to be flying in complete clouds for a few minutes and I thought it was going to be a bust and then we broke through the clouds and wow! As we flew around up there the clouds seemed to dissipate and the next thing we knew the pilot said it had cleared so much that we were going to be able to land!  It was a very smooth landing on snow and we landed at base camp where the hikers start their journey to climb Denali. It was absolutely amazing to stand there among those majestic mountains. Words cannot even describe it. We had plenty of time to take photos and walk around. You could go pretty far if you wanted and there were cones set up that you were not to go past. Then back on the plane and were heading down the hill and rather than the plane lifting up it was like the ground just falls away from the plane. You feel so close to the huge mountains, but they said we were still 10 miles away at least! The pilot was very experienced, the flight and landing very smooth, and pilot communicated with us through headsets. Facemasks are requred due to covid. It was an amazing experience for our family and in my opinion a must-do in Alaska if you have the funds.

I wasn't sure at first if flying over Kauai was for me, but with encouragement from my friend Sheila I signed up. It turned out to be one of the best things I did on the Island...after hiking, and visiting much on the ground it was truly great to see it all from a different perspective in the air.  Bruce is a seasoned pilot that make you feel very safe, and does a great job in narrating the overall experience with his extensive knowledge. If I only had one word to describe the experience....awesome.

Dan
Huntsville, Alabama

We flew out of Talkeetna over Denali in a small plane. This is an experience of a lifetime. Words can not express the magnitude of this mountain range, experiencing it from above and so close. I would highly recommend K2 Aviation.

I have had the pleasure to fly with Bruce as a co-pilot in the company C172. It was the best activity I have done in Kauai. 
Wings Over Kauai has very friendly staff. The pilots are very professional and all aircraft are really well maintained. 

Great job! 100% recommended.
Outstanding tour led by Mel who was extremely knowledgeable about volcanoes and Hawaiian culture. Every part of the trip flowed smoothly and was informative and enjoyable.

review_title: A must-do for all Kauai trips!
review_text:
My new husband and I were in Kauai for the second half of our honeymoon. My one thing that I had to do was go on an air-tour of the Island. Honestly what initially drew me to Wings Over Kauai was the price...most helicopter trips were almost $250 per person! I called up this co and Ellen was so sweet and helpful, the instant I talked to her I told my husband that I really felt comfortable & that we weren't going to regret going with them (being a tourist you never really know what you are paying for). When we arrived we felt so welcomed and at ease. I even got presents from them! The ride was amazing! Smooth, wonderful views, comfy seats, and we could all talk to eachother on our awesome headsets (Bruce did a good job on buying top of the line headsets!) 

Bruce was a great guide. He gave us tons of history & info we didn't know from the typical 'tourist' books we read, which made the flight even more enjoyable for us. We shared stories (and  tons of jokes) the whole way.

Another plus to consider...if you or another person in your party are afraid of flying, this is the plane to take! My husband is terribly afraid to fly (you practically have to knock him out to get him on a plane!) But Bruce handled the flight so smooth and was always checking to make sure my husband was ok and feeling alright. That little touch meant so much. 

In the end, I can't say enough about this company. They really made our vacation. I said that the price is what drew me in, but honestly after the service we got, I would have paid 3x the amount they charge to get such a wonderful experience again!!!   Mahalo Bruce & Ellen!

This was an excellent experience! It was a little cloudy when we were flying so our pilot gave us the option to see another mountain and observe the waterfalls. We ended up still seeing Mt St Helens and it was well worth it!! Our pilot was John and he was informed and able to point out all of the sights.
The weather was perfect, and the views were outstanding. The pilot was great ! She was well informed and funny.

I booked this as a 50th birthday treat for my Husband, and we both enjoyed every minute. From being met at the ABC store (where our driver removed the WOK sign from the car, because it was a surprise for hubby) to the CD of highlights of the flight at the end, it was an absolute delight.

The island is truly beautiful and Josh, our pilot was well informed about the history and stories of the island. The 65 minute flight seemed to vanish much too soon, but we have many photos to remember it by. 

One of the highlights of our Hawaii visit!

We agree with previous reviewers that this is an absolutely wonderful tour!  We only had a few hours to spend on Kauai since we were there on a cruise ship, and I can't think of a better way we could have spent our time there.  I talked to Ellen on the phone before we went to Hawaii and she gave me alot of great ideas of  things to do before and after our tour.  She even picked us up near our ship and drove us to the tour and back again afterwards.  The flight was amazing!  It was smooth and the views were just beautiful, and Bruce's knowledge of agriculture and the island made the trip all the more interesting.  The price was very reasonable too.

We absolutely loved our flight with our pilot LeeAnn. I was nervous about flying in a small plane, but she was so experienced, confident, and knowledgeable. Her narration was perfect. The glacier landing was phenomenal and we got to hang out for about 10 min to take in the experience. Our pilot did everything she could to get us the best views of the mountain as possible and helped each side of the plane get a good view. We are so happy we decided to book this activity. A final note, we had to make last minute changes to our booking because one in our party fell ill the morning of the event, and the company went above and beyond to help us out. Highly recommend! Do it!
Professional and attentive airline crew.  Hummer tour was outstanding!!  The tour guide Alice was so knowledgeable and she made the trip exceptional.  Highly recommend this tour.

I had an excellent experience flying around Denali and surrounding mountains with K2.  I had average expectations for just another "touristy" type event.  The trip far, far exceeded my expectations and was truly a highlight of my 10-day trip to AK.  Very grand.  Our pilot was a great guide.

The flying trip around Denali was Ok, but we were not as close as I thought we would be and we didn't get to see all sides of Denali "because of smoke" our tour guide said. But the glacier landing was truly amazing. It was just breathtaking, the scenery, the glaciers, the snow, walking around on a glacier with snow everywhere in July. I am so glad we took this tour! Certainly the highlight of our vacation in Alaska.
A great experience to tour the Grand Canyon from the sky. Exhilarating and breath-taking. No one this is one of the Seven Wonders of the World.
This was the best tour!!!!  Our pilot was so friendly and explained everything so well. The time just flew be. Definitly recommend.

The flight was an unforgetable  experience!!! We had great weather and enjoyed the flight very much. 
Don’t miss it, when you are in San Francisco!!!
Eric was very knowledgeable and friendly.  Made us feel very safe and he is an excellent pilot to boot.

It's quite a few years ago since my wife and I did this flight but it was so memorable that it seems like only yesterday. After being picked up around teatime and taken to the airport everything was looking good and we boarded the small plane on time and off we went. A bit of a storm was brewing as we took off and the turbulence was quite bad, worsening as we passed Lake Mead and drew near to the Canyon. The views outside were spectacular and there was an informative commentary about the history and culture of the Canyon via the earphones provided.
Sadly, because of the turbulence, many of the passengers were making good and frequent use of sick-bags, instead of marvelling at the incredible views. However, the turbulence could hardly be blamed on the company and both pilots were very sympathetic and trying to be comforting (though for some this was in vain). The general feeling was that if the airplane had landed at or near the Canyon, then no-one would have re-boarded for the flight back to Vegas, so bad was the ride.
That apart, the trip was amazing and the memories, of the entire trip, are priceless and timeless.

review_title: Excelence flight with Glacier Landing and time in the snow.
review_text:
Flew in a 12 passenger Otter over Denali National Park . Wonderful views of the 600 mile mountain ranges.
Landed in 16' deep[ snow at a glacier base camp. Pilot was wearing Short Sleeve Shirt , but passengers were in coats with shoe covers.  Do not get too far from the plane as  snow is not compacted.

review_title: Best Helicopter ride thru the Grand Canyon!
review_text: Took the 9:15am flight this morning and it was Amazing, Spectacular, Wonderful and all the other words to describe a great flight.
Sea cliff was beautiful! Eric was friendly and provided a smooth ride and awesome tour experience. We flew across oceans and maui.

Great day on k-2. Full view of mountain, young energetic pilot. Did a great job of informing us, taking r pictures and being a gentleman. Such a great experience seen the mountain in full, beautiful day

Pleasant staff and pilots. Really enjoyed the 1 hour tour in the Avro Van. Pilot "Josh" was professional and very informative. The plane is comfortable and quiet. Probably the best value tour on the island. I'm ready to go again.

Steve was our pilot and did an amazing job navigating us with strong winds which made me feel safe! The views along the Road to Hana on the 30 minute photo flight were lovely, it was amazing to see Maui from up in the air. I was worried about not being able to get good pictures from the airplane but it was not a problem at all. I would love to come back and do another tour during my next visit!

review_title: Great experience and way to view the grand canyon
review_text: They picked us from our Hotel in LV, took us to the airport and from there we started our journey - great experience

review_title: Amazing Aerial Views with Wings Over Kauai - Awesome!
review_text:
My husband & I were visiting Kauai from New York.  We were extremely fortunate to fly in a comfortable but small plane to view the luscious island of Kauai.  When we arrived for our flight Val was there to help us and handle all of our questions.  Our pilot Josh was extremely knowledgeable, friendly & provided us with a wonderful tour!  The enthusiasm Josh had definitely matched mine!  We had another couple on our flight & it took Josh much energy to get us speaking especially since the other couple was a little quiet. Flight skill was superb!  We noticed the little things, especially the coffee fields, & we came away feeling like it was such a worth while experience.

We highly recommend this trip!  You get a different view of Kauai, in that, while you don't hover over the valleys like you would in helicopters, you get up close to see the valleys and the surrounding lush island. In other words, a definite better perspective of the surrounding natural environment of Kauai. Wings Over Kauai really put in small touches to make it a better experience for your trip.  This trip is longer than most helicopter excursions in Hawaii & you don't bounce around as much.   This is a must do in Kauai!  :-)

review_title: The Only Way to See the Grand Canyon
review_text: I cannot recommend Maverick Helicopter tours enough. The views were spectacular and our pilot was very knowledgable of the canyon and its history. Easily the best way to see the Grand Canyon and understand the sheer scale of it.

A fantastic sea plane trip around the San Francisco Bay, with a flyover of the Golden Gate Bridge and the city.
Exceptionally friendly staff and pilot.
Highly recommended.

review_title: Great, awesome views, great customer service!!!
review_text:
It was one of the best experience i ever had. 
The mist beautiful views, you can catch. 
We will do it again, when we come back to miami.

review_title: Favorite thing we did in 18 days in Alaska...and I hate flying
review_text: I gathered my nerves to do this and am so glad I did. Add landing on the glacier...it is the best! Incredible experience! Tell them if over 60 and get a discount.

We booked Tour C and were completely satisfied with everything. Our pilot Piero was highly professional, very polite, courteous, customer-friendly and service-oriented. The airport where the tour started is so remote that we took an Uber.

We enjoyed this tour of the entire island. Different views than a previous helicopter tour. Higher and more expansive. The Napoli coast is breathtaking! Pilot narrated during tour and landed smoothly. Highly recommended!
Extremely enjoyable island tour flight with Maka. As a pilot, great to get to fly the Cessna Skylane, thanks to Maka for your confidence!

I was recommended to Maverick by my co worker and I have to say it definitely lived up to its review. From booking a tour online to the easy check in and straight forward requirements made planning very hassle free. Our pilot was great and the entire experience is unbelievable. We were speechless as the floor dropped beneath us and we had a breath taking view of the canyon. This is a must do if you are visiting Grand Canyon. I highly recommend it!

Nice and friendly staff. Our pilot tho wasn't really talkative. Views were amazing and plane really goes close to the mountains! We had the luck to be able to land on top the the tallest glaciers of Denali National Park. (Prior planes couldn't land due to lack of visibility...)

I really recommend it!

Highly recommend using Talkeetna Air Taxi for trips to Denali.  This is a first class operation that clearly puts safety first, communicates extremely well, and truly wants to make sure you have a fantastic experience.  I was especially impressed with Leslie as our pilot - it is clear that this is her passion.

We loved our plane ride, half  the cost of helicopter and so much better.  I was a helicopter nurse for twelve years and I knew this would be quieter. Bruce was so friendly and informative. We all loved it, weather looked iffy but we saw everything and got all the pics we wanted.  The company was very safety conscious which was a priority for me.  Mary and her Dad Bruce made us feel like friends within minutes.   Would definitely recommend it.

Landing on the glacier was amazing!! We had beautiful clear weather and very little turbulence. There had also been fresh snow the day before.  This of course were ideal conditions but our pilot was great and very informative too!

We booked this trip for my brother's 50th birthday what an amazing day it was we were picked up from hotel and driven to airport where we were weighed, as there were 5 of us we shared trip with two others. Our pilot Tony put us at ease and gave us great commentary and jokes on the flight over, we landed in the canyon where we had a snack and drink and we all sang happy birthday! We changed seats for the flight back so everyone had a great view. Yes this trip is expensive but worth it for the experience it was out of this world and we still talk about it now and watch DVD which we purchased highly recommended couldn't think of a better way to celebrate your 50th if you go to Vegas make sure you do this trip,

What an amazing adventure. Eric made such a wonderful experience. The ocean, the sunset, the mountains, the valley, and the volcano were best viewed from 1,500 feet with Eric pointing it all out to us. Would absolutely do it again!!!

review_title: The best way to see Miami Beach without the crowds
review_text: We hired the plane for our family of four. Great experience to fly up and down the beach and the pilot was very friendly and informative. Be prepared to get your feet a little wet though, as you get on and off. Sailing or swimming shoes would be ideal.

review_title: Good way to see the island
review_text: We took the flight and I realized that I should have done this the first day of our vacation.  We waited a week for our relatives and they got the benefit of the overview that would have helped us during our first week.  The staff are very helpful and courteous.  The ride was good for a small plane and the views were spectacular.  My only quibble was my window (left rear seat) was slightly crazed and, when the sun struck it, my pictures suffered.
Amazing plane ride around Maui and surrounding islands. Highly recommend over any helicopter or other plane rides!

Fantastic Trip! Must thing to do in Alaska, Flightseeing.  No other way to appreciate magnitude of Denali and Talkeetna Air Taxi was great company to take us to see the summit.  Friend of mine recommended company and they delivered. Very accommodating and provided the highlight to our Alaska trip.

The flight was smooth and incredible. Steve made us feel welcome and prioritized our experience. The flight itself was awesome with Steve pointing out cool natural features and giving history tid bits!
Fantastic aerial view of the island. Great opportunity to see the landscape and appreciate the beauty of the island.

The Denali Experience was the highlight of our Alaskan trip! Thank you Patrick for a smooth and informative flight! Seeing the glaciers, Denali, Mt Hunter, Mt Dickey, etc up close is second to none! Denali is so majestic!
We had a great time flying over Kauai and seeing the beautiful scenery.   Also, the entire staff is super friendly!

This is the most spectacular thing we've ever done.   Our pilot, Chris was very informative and made sure both sides of the plane got to see the sights.  Words cannot describe the views and pictures do not do them justice.  Landing on the glacier at Denali base camp was just the best.   DO THIS!!!!

My family went on this as an excursion during our Alaskan cruise. I had called a few months before and the customer service is great! They helped us plan out the best times according to the cruise schedule and even gave us a discount for our large group (10).

They gave me a call before we got off the cruise and I had their phone number on hand, just in case. When we got there, everyone was super friendly. We split into two groups and took two planes.

The scenery is just gorgeous! We flew between mountains and over several bodies of water. In one area, the pilot spotted orcas and landed our plane near them so we could get a closer look. It was such a unique experience. My nephew was super happy during this part. We later landed on a dock for a break and took some pictures in the Alaskan wilderness. My cousin spotted jellyfish here! When we took off again, we spotted bald eagles but were unable to see any bears this time around. Still, I was so happy we got to see the orcas at such a close range in the wild!

The only thing I would caution anyone about is motion sickness. The planes are small and you feel a lot of movement (especially when the plane turns). My nephew got sick but the pilot was prepared with bags and paper towels. He was very nice and understanding. The rest of us were fine. So, please make sure to take medicine if you need it!

Overall, I would definitely recommend this activity to others. You always hear about lots of wildlife in Alaska but it still surprises you when you actually see it. We also had great weather, so it was a memorable and fun time.

review_title: Hightlight of the trip to Moab!
review_text: I am so happy that I went with Redtail Air Adventures for my unforgettable experience in Moab! The pilot pointed out the popular places at each National Park and we found out some great local information about the area. Moab has so much history and is breathtaking! I definitely recommend choosing Redtail Air, it’s an experience I will never forget!

Amazing!  This is the #1 way to see The Grand Canyon!! The service was exceptional..from the pick up at the hotel, the check in procedure and the pilot were very efficient. The view is amazing and the snacks were great too! I will be recommending Mavericks Tours to others. Thanks for making this a highlight of my first trip to Vegas!

First off let me say that taking an air tour in a small airplane is much better than doing it in a helicopter. It's quieter, smoother and much less intrusive to the spirit of Mana. The Wings Over Kauai airplane tour of the island is an absolute must-do when visiting Kauai. The island is an absolute gem when viewed from the air, but it is the company that makes the experience special. The staff are exceedingly helpful and courteous and go out of their way to provide an intimate and fun experience. Bruce, our pilot, was informative and pleasant which made the trip memorable for us. We were the only two people in the small airplane and Bruce had my wife help him with the checklist before take-off, which she thoroughly enjoyed.  After the flight, the company provided us a free dvd, made by his son, that included the highlights of the tour. The dvd had a cover with a personalized photo of us that their photographer had taken prior to the flight. They also gave my wife a very nice everlasting lei and provided free soft drinks during the flight. The family run atmosphere created by Wings Over Kauai, and the extra little touches made for a wonderful experience that has provided us with what is sure to be lifelong memories of Kauai from the air. Thank you for helping to make our vacation a memorable one.

This was something we wanted to do the entire trip and searched long and hard for the right one. After doing our research, we decided on Air Ventures and we were not disappointed!! Our pilot Eric was very knowledgable about the island and the tour was well over an hour. Compared to other tours prices, this one was comparable but a firm believer in you pay for what you get and we got a great guide and amazing views of the island! Highly recommend

Always wanted to go on a helicopter ride and also see the Grand Canyon so decided to do both together and it was so worth it.  Our pilot DJ was entertaining, they play music to listen to in the headphones that fit with the ride (will always remember this trip when I hear Ride Into The Danger Zone!) and the views are spectacular.

review_title: Action packed adventure at the Grand Canyon
review_text: Our family had a great time on the combination tour including a flight over the Grand Canyon, a walk through Antelope Canyon, and a float trip down the Colorado River.  The trip was not cheap, but it was worth every penny.  We packed everything we wanted to see in to one day.  I recommend getting a seat on the port (left) hand side of the aircraft for best pictures.  We arrived at Antelope Canyon early before the crowds started to arrive.  Our native guide as fantastic.  I recommend giving your phone or camera to the guide throughout the canyon and ask them to help you with pictures.  The float trip down the river was very calm with no rapids.  You will not get wet so you don't need a bathing suit, unless you want to go swimming.  The river is only 50 degrees so it is not for the faint of heart.  Don't forget a hat, sunglasses, sunscreen, and lots of water.  It's hot out there.  Enjoy!

We had a great trip!! We are a family of 4. Our kids are 15 and 12. The staff at west wind was excellent with communication, making sure we knew exactly what was going on and when. They confirmed a few days before. Bruce was our pilot and led us around and was full of great information. Overall, we had a blast and would use west wind again.

Great way to see the Grand Canyon and get there quickly from the Phoenix area. From our communication before the tour with Lindsey to our Flight there and back with pilot Brendon and our tour on the ground with Miss Gigi this was an all around spectacular experience. We would highly recommend this to anyone visiting Arizona and would absolutely do again. This was well worth the price paid!

review_title: great trip for the Austin group
review_text:
our pilot was great!!
the attractive "seasoned" lady behind the counter who seemed to be running the young ladies there was excellent.  She was warm, friendly and efficient.

review_title: Fantastic flight through the Alaska Range With Landing on a Glacier
review_text:
This was a spectacular flight! We had a sunny day and Denali was out in all it's glory.
Our pilot Stan started off with all the safety features and then after we were securely in our seats with head sets on he took off and narrated our flight with many interesting details about the area. It almost felt as if we could reach out and touch the mountains. Simply awesome and I couldn't stop taking pictures and videos. We had a smooth landing on the glacier and got to frolic around in the snow for awhile before heading back. I highly recommend this trip! K2 Avaition was efficient, friendly and I felt like I was in good hands with their very experienced pilot. The office is at the edge of downtown Talkeetna so you can walk to town and browse around or eat and drink before or after this trip. Also at their office is complimentary coffee and some nice hats and T-shirt souvenirs to choose from.
What an amazing experience!  This should be on everyone's bucket list. The folks at K2 are very professional and they have excellent equipment. Don't hesitate, do this!

Let me begin by saying this is something I do almost every time I visit Alaska (at least yearly). The flightseeing over Denali is absolutely breathtaking! The views cannot be described and do them justice. On top of that, the pilot was extremely knowledgeable and accommodating.  I can't wait to go again!

review_title: My Favorite Activity While Visiting On A Cruise!
review_text: We had only one day in Kauai while visiting the islands on a cruise.  I had read these reviews and so booked the flight for our group of 4.  I am so glad I did!  They could not be friendlier, the flight was amazing and was truly the greatest way to get a good overview of the beautiful island of Kauai.  Our pilot, Josh, was personable and really just great to fly with.  They are cheaper than the helicopter tours and frankly, I think I prefer this whole experience.  I can't wait to visit Kauai again, and I would happily fly with WOK again.  THANKS for such a great and memorable experience!

Our tour guide Jeffrey, was absolutely amazing! Jeffrey was very funny and knowledgeable! Jeffrey was very patient, kind and helpful, especially with our parents (both in their 70's). Jeffrey also made sure that everyone in our tour group had plenty of time at every stop and that we saw everything plus extra stuff on our tour.
Also, Jeffrey had his driving companion (Luna) she is an 11 year old Chihuahua and she is so sweet, friendly, and got oddles of attention and even got pictures!
Jeffrey, was top notch the best tour guide and id highly recommend Jeffrey every single time!

Great overall experience! Reviews speak for themselves, these guys know how to do it! Personally, I'm an airline pilot and can say with confidence that SAFETY is there number one priority and execute it perfectly.  Friendliness, safety and attention to detail is all a perfect 10.

If you want to really see what Kauai has to offer, book this ASAP as it books up fast!

review_title: Fantastic once or twice in a lifetime experience everyone should do!
review_text: I did a GC flight 26 years ago (can't remember who with) & it was amazing & 2nd time round with my wife, still amazing. The colours, light, shade, shadows, contours etc. change every second. The aeroplane was very good value & cheaper than a much shorter helicopter flight & we must have been in the air, excluding take off & landing for a good half an hour - well it seemed like it anyway. Fantastic experience & would definitely recommend.

We had an amazing time! The best excursion we’ve ever done. We were in awe the entire time of the natural beauty of Alaska and Ketchikan. Getting so close to the mountains and seeing goats grazing plus the lake landing was beyond words!

We tried to arrange a glacier landing while we were visiting Haily but the weather prevented us from flying there.  So on our way back to Anchorage, we stopped by Talkeetna Air Taxi to see if they were doing glacier landings.  They said that they were and that we should sign up for the 3:45 flight, which we did.  

First of all, Talkeetna Air Taxi did not require a down payment.  The other service that we tried to fly with wanted a credit card deposit and would not let us cancel in the event they were not doing glacier landings.  Talkeetna Air Taxi, on the other hand, was very clear, if no glacier landing was possible before we took off, we could cancel with no penalty.  That sealed the deal because the glacier landing was what we really wanted to do.

Our pilot, Tyler, was great.  He gave commentary of the area during our flight and made us feel safe.  The takeoffs and landings were smooth as silk.  

I would highly recommend the glacier landing.  It was well worth it.

Seeing Kauai from the sky is spectacular.  The mountains are breath taking.  there is no other way you could appreciate its beauty so completely.
Air Ventures was prompt, courteous and knowledgeable at a fair price. Our pilot and guide was friendly and knowledgeable.
All in all it was a great attraction.

Amazing experience. The staff and crew made us feel super safe and they were super fun to chat with. In addition, they would tell us when we were flying over something interesting which made for an enjoyable flight. Totally worth the money if you are heading to Friday Harbor!

review_title: The vastness is amazing from the air
review_text: Picked us up on the dock and drove us to the seaplanes. Absolutely seamless take off and landing -- and the views from the air are amazing.  Our pilot landed us in one of the fjords and we walked off onto a pontoon.  So quiet, majestic and awe inspiring. The headset commentary had an unusual assortment of music; I would have preferred something classical, but that's perhaps just my taste. Worth every penny.  So glad we got up into the air to see a tiny portion of this vast wilderness of Alaska!

We booked through viator.com and everything was amazing.  The gentleman who checked us in was extremely friendly and the pilot was great... he let our 16 year old sit up front with him.  I highly recommend this tour.

Matt U was the most accommodating person as we prepped for our trip into Denali. We stayed three nights at kantishna roadhouse (which was lovely) but we might just stay at the KAT lodge next time given the friendliness of everyone there. Sean was our Pilot and made us comfortable right away. His knowledge of the mountain was incredible. We had to fly out early so we hung out with Matt U in the lodge as well as the owner’s dog named lucky. We were the lucky ones. There’s also a guy who looks like Jon Snow at TAT so you might as well go just for that reason. Lastly, if flying from talkeetna, bring them a few slabs of spinach bread as a treat—-they will be thrilled. Oh—and check out Matt U’s  art studio while you are there; amazing one of a kind pieces.

We flew with Air Ventures late in November.  The scenery was breathtaking. Seeing the island by plane gave us a great view of the canyon, the beaches and many areas we were unable to explore by car.  The pilot was very knowledgeable.
We saw much more than I expected. The pilot was friendly and knowledgeable and even made a detour to view a particular waterfall we were interested in seeing. Smooth operation and smooth flight.

This experience was amazing.  By far my favorite thing we did in Alaska!  Everything was great!  I felt very safe with our pilot, and he was kind and professional.  We had a clear day and could see so many mountains and glaciers!  It was so amazing I was almost crying.

We added the glacier landing and it was 1000% worth it!  I wanted to save some money but my husband convinced me to add it on and I am so glad we did!  

Seriously- book this.  You won't regret it!

We took the Grand Canyon landing tour for our anniversary and it was a fantastic experience. They are a quality company using modern helicopters. This tour takes you over the Hoover Dam en route to the Canyon before working its way back. There are 3 legs in total but the first leg is the hero of the tour and if you can be up front for this segment you will be well rewarded.
Truly an unforgettable experience, thank to Adriel Anderson and his team. His knowledge and passion are the reason for us wanting to come back soon!

Since over 80% of kauai is only seen by air, this tour is a must do on your vacation to this
beautiful island. Our pilot was very informative and we felt safe from the takeoff to the landing. i highly recommend AirVentures!
Fred our pilot was a really nice guy. Loads of information all through the flight. Totally worth every cent very memorable.
Absolutely beautiful aerial tour around the entire island of Kauai. The pilot was an excellent tour guide too. Loved seeing the rugged coastline and mountain valleys from the air.

review_title: Take the Tour & Buy the Video
review_text: Visiting the Grand Canyon National Park has been a bucket list item forever, so once we knew we were going we immediately decided on taking the Canyon Spirit helicopter tour. We are so glad we did! Flying from the south rim to the north rim was thrilling and exceeded all expectations. From the jaw dropping scenery to the excitement of it all, it was a true once-in-a lifetime experience. The staff at Maverick were very accommodating every step of the way. Our first scheduled tour had to be canceled because of bad weather. But gladly so, because safety is obviously paramount. Luckily we had one more day in the park, so we were able to reschedule our tour for the following morning, which turned out to be beautiful, rather than take the refund that was offered. Our pilot, Jesse, was awesome too, and to include very experienced, as he was a former pilot in the service. He was relaxed and personable, knowledgeable about the Grand Canyon and its surroundings, and focused on us enjoying the tour. This was our second helicopter ride (first was years ago in NYC; very cool/different), and by far our favorite between the two. The moment you first fly out over the canyon after traversing several miles over land and trees is simply breathtaking, as is when you fly over the confluence of the Colorado and Little Colorado rivers. Do not hesitate to take the tour. You will not be disappointed. And make sure to purchase the video of your tour. It’s a great keepsake.

We love adventure. This was the Coolest thing we have ever done. Alex was our pilot and we flew through the mountain peaks like a bird!!! The sun was out. Denali was stunning. THEN we landed on a glacier field.  So worth it.
Our pilot was very friendly and knowledgeable. Sergio went above and beyond to make our experience great. I would definitely recommend a trip with Sergio.

Incredible, as I thought it must be, to be that close to something so huge when stll 50 miles away on the ground. Chris was my excellent pilot, adding facts and figures, history and smiles throughout our 90 minutes in the air. DO NOT MISS this experience should the weather cooperate with your travel plans!

review_title: No luck getting into the air, but Wings is still the best!
review_text:
My husband and I were rained or otherwise "bad-weathered" out of every adventure we planned on Kauai.  Couldn't hike Kalalau due to the river crossing being flooded. 
Couldn't kayak or sail the coast due to 24 ft swells.  Never got to fly in the Cessna with Doug due to high winds the first day, and low cloud cover and/or rain the other three times we tried. Luckily, we had booked our flight through Wings over Kauai, and originally booked it for our first full day on the island, which ended up giving us the most shots on goal in terms of chances to reschedule and hopefully get up there.  Each time we arrived, Doug walked us through the weather, visibility, turbulence, and gave us the choice of getting up there with the limited visibility/bumpy ride or reschedule.  We rescheduled three times, and while it never worked out, we still appreciated the customer service and flexible policies of Wings.  Our last chance was the AM before our flight off island, and when it became clear the weather still wasn't going to cooperate, we were promptly issued a refund.  One thing both my husband and I noticed was that every time we went to the terminal to try to get into the air, the helicopter tours were still going out.  So, my guess is they have a limited refund policy and therefore people opt to take the flight even if you don't see anything and/or it's potentially dangerous.  Doug and the rest of Wings were incredibly helpful, friendly, and clearly interested in making sure everyone gets the best and safest experience flying over Kauai.  I can't wait to go back to Kauai again to accomplish all the adventures we were denied our first time out, and we will definitely be re-booking our tour with Wings over Kauai!  We've already passed on their info to three other people we know are heading to Kauai in the next few months.  It's so rare to encounter such amazing customer service in this day and age.  We can honestly say Wings was a highlight of our time in Kauai even though we didn't even get to fly!

Jim was our pilot.  This flight is everything you read about.. but it is the way that Jim did it that made you feel like you were experiencing what Alaskans see and do every day.  He was relaxed and told of his experiences flying mail and even delivering pizza in Alaska by plane. We landed on the remote lake and on our return he asked what time we had to be back.  He added in a fantastic view of mountain goats high up on the mountains.  He tipped the plane (which did not freak me out even though I don't fancy flying) so I was looking right on them.   It was truly spectacular.  Thank you, Jim.
It was a great time. Loved seeing the birds eye sights of Maui. Steve did an awesome job making us feel safe. Smooth take off and landing

review_title: No better views of the Grand Canyon than this trip.
review_text:
What a totally special and insanely fun way to see the Grand Canyon.

If you are not sure what part of the Canyon you want to see on your trip, and I know a lot of you are think "Do I want to see the North? the West? The South? The river?!?!?" How about seeing almost all over it in like an hour....that's what you get to do in by plane on this tour.

I took the tour, departing with our first class pilot pilot Karla, from Sedona. It was a great view of Sedona and it's geography, the trip up to the Grand Canyon, the Canyon and the return. Totally awesome.

The trip also includes are few hours of driving between photo locations on the south rim. Got to see some of the great views and I really enjoyed our guide Jerry.

I was able to book everything on short notice, which was really fantastic (Thanks Covid!!!!), great communication and a fun time all around.

review_title: A Must Do Adventure in Kauai
review_text:
The wife and I would rate this experience was one of our all time bests. Air Ventures is very professional and appreciative and treats everyone like royalty. We did a helicopter tour on another island a few days before and this experience blows them away.
A very smooth ride that isn't as jerky as the helicopter ride and very comfortable and warm in the open air cockpit. The open views with the nostalgic helmet and goggles was astounding. We covered every part of the Island.
Harry is a tremendous pilot, tour guide and enjoys himself every time out. We would do this every time we are on the Island. Pictures cannot do this ride justice. Awesome.
Organized, Informative, Gracious hosts. Our tour was brilliant. Highly recommend the gang at Seawind Aviation.

Our entire experience was fabulous!  From Austin, our shuttle driver who took great care of us and our backpacks to and from their site (and had us laughing with his jokes), to our pilot Riley (also entertaining with his dry humor filled preflight briefing) to the folks at the desk, K2’s staff was professional and very courteous.  We did the glacier landing and we were awestruck by the peace and beauty up on the glacier.  Riley is a great pilot and we had a smooth and beautiful flight as we wove our way through the peaks. He also was great at answering questions and narrating the trip.  This was an experience we will remember!!  Thanks K2!

What a great experience. We took an early morning flight on the biplane with Harry as our pilot.  Harry showed us all around the island,  pointing out all the beaches and canyons.  We saw at least a dozen rainbows.  A surprisingly smooth flight.

review_title: One of the most awe inspiring experiences of my life!
review_text:
I'm visiting Alaska for the first time and have really been blown away by the scenery and wildlife, it is quite simply amazing. I'd been here a few days and caught some good looks at Mt. McKinley from Talkeetna, when I decided to take a flightseeing tour. There are a couple options in town, but after visiting the airport it was obvious to me that K2 had a top notch operation. Their facilities are well maintained, they've put a lot into their visitor's center and have some great people working there. Stephanie was super friendly (and patient!) as I got signed up asked a bunch of questions. Once our group was all ready, Chris (our pilot) got us all situated and we were off. In the air Chris explained the sights and made sure both sides of the plane got good views. I lucked out and happened to get the co-pilots seat, which gave me a great view. Just when I thought I had a grasp on the scale of the mountains Chris pointed out some climbers. My eyes struggled to find the tiny specks and I realized that these mountains were far larger than I thought! My flight landed at a base camp for climbers and I have to say that if you have the time you should definitely include that. It was great to get out and take pictures, but just walking around on snow at 7200 feet was an experience in itself. 

A couple that was in my group said it was their third trip and they loved it just as much as the first time. I can see why. I'd definitely like to visit Alaska again, and a trip with K2 will be at the top of my list.

review_title: Absolutely Amazing Trip End to End
review_text: We did the Grand Canyon Scenic Airlines "Scenic Canyon River Adventure" 12.5 hour full day tour with the entire family. The all day adventure from beginning to end was incredible. Our 9 year old son had a blast as did my father-in-law who commented it was the BEST tour he had ever done. It's a great way to see the Canyon by air, car, and boat without having to lift a finger (literally). The guides and facilitators do everything for you so that you can just sit back and relax. Only advice is that the complimentary breakfast is a bit lacking (too sweet for me) consisted of a muffin, yogurt, OJ and fruit cocktail. If you're not into that much sugar for breakfast maybe grab something like a breakfast sandwich on your own instead. The weather for us was great (98 degrees) but we heard that it does get brutally hot inside the canyon (on the River) so bring lots of sunscreen and make sure everyone wears a hat. They stop often at restrooms and you can get in the water to cool down (great experience!). Lunch was delicious. Turkey sandwich, chips, fruit. They also provide cold water along the way down the river. Antelope Canyon was magnificent and most importantly the tour gets you into the Canyon BEFORE all the other tourists come and it gets too crowded.

review_title: Breathtaking views of Denali and surrounding mountains
review_text: The plane ride we took around Denali and landing on a glacier was the highlight of our 2 week vacation in Alaska.  The views out every window were amazing.  Our pilot, Richard was very knowledgable and shared interesting facts all along the flight.  I highly recommend the Grand Denali tour with glacier landing from Talkeetna Air Taxi.

The staff is very friendly and helpful. Our pilot, Chuck, was absolutely amazing. He truly loves showing off the beautiful places. His commentary was fantastic and, at points, verging on the poetic. His skills as a floatplane pilot was without question. So smooth and fun. I wish I could have spent a lot more time with him.

This something everyone should do when coming to Alaska. You won’t find a better view of the Denali mountain range. I had initially booked k2 for the wrong dates they quickly and efficiently resolved my mistake and were able to reschedule me for the correct date. All in all I would definitely fly with them again

Wings Over Kauai gets 5 stars in my 4P categories. 

We began planning our excursions for this vacation several months ago and decided to use independent third party operators in lieu of the expensive ones offered through the cruise line.  For Kauai nothing was booked in advance - not usually a good decision considering all the good tours on the ship were sold out.  

Professionalism:  Upon arriving in Kauai on 4/15, I decided to call Wings Over Kauai to see if they have any cancellations.  Using the local number, I did not reach them on the first try and figured I was out of luck.  Immediately after hanging up, I received a call from Ellen, she was very friendly and said they had some openings to accommodate one passenger and I booked a flight on their 8 seater for 11am.  I received email confirmation within minutes ... outstanding customer service and I was a happy camper.

Performance:  I read many of the Trip Advisor comments and let me tell you they do what is advertised, and more!  Ellen picked me up at precisely the right time and shuttled me from the ABC Store to the air terminal.  Her daughter Mary took care of the reservation paperwork along wth weigh-in to make sure they balance out the seating.  Mary said Marcus was our pilot and he would be arriving shortly, and sure enough, he was just landing from a previous flight.  Mary and Marcus escorted the 4 of us to the plane, photos were taken by Mary as a souvenir and she said she'd email them after the flight. I felt like the lucky one with the co-pilot seat (Marcus probably didn't feel as lucky)...guess they needed to put me up there for proper weight distribution.  Views were absolutely incredible -- from take off to landing, and it was great to fly over the harbor and see the cruise ship at the pier.  Marcus' narration of the landmarks, simply outstanding and his piloting skills phenomenal!  Very little turbulence, partly cloudy skies and a very smooth flight allowed for some spectacular photograph.  The beautiful island music playing through the headsets was a great touch!

Pride:  Upon landing we were greeted by Mary and she helped Marcus with getting us off the plane.  Bottled water or ginger ale was offered and it sure was appreciated.  Marcus asked us to come inside because he had a parting gift for us.  Each of us was presented a CD with the Hawaiian music played on our flight and a color picture that was taken at the beginning of the flight as the jewel case cover.  It was no charge!  A simple gesture that goes a long way in my book, and the kind of thing that will bring me back to them the next time I visit Kauai.

Price:  I highly recommend Wings Over Kauai should you want to take advantage of the spectacular Pali Coast scenery not viewable by land.  Their price is cheaper than several others I checked out, so please call the (808) local number to discuss your adventure of a lifetime.

I have taken many, many excursions through various cruise lines and bar none, this was the best ever in my opinion.  Many thanks to Ellen, Mary and Marcus - and Mary, thank you for bringing me all the way back to the terminal.

My flight with Garrett was the highlight of my trip as he expertly navigated to what seemed to be the top of the world. Spectacular views of Denali and surrounding area. Very skilled, informative and personable.

Looks like most people agree, this is a must do. We circled to see whales and waterfalls.  Customer service was awesome and the price was very reasonable.  Go for it, you won't regret it.  Your are in a plane with 3 other tourist so pictures are easy.

I can't say enough good things about K2. We booked the flightseeing glacier landing tour but the weather was iffy, so we didn't land, which was fine. I had a little anxiety about the flight, having never been in such a small aircraft, but it was clear from the outset that this place is professional and I had no cause for concern. There were about 9 people on the plane. The pilot inspired complete confidence, and we flew over glaciers, between mountain peaks, were treated to informative commentary, were able to ask questions, and my traveling companion even got to ride in the cockpit. It was amazing.  Reasonably priced. Do not miss the opportunity.

A great trip starting with a short float plane hop to Traitors Cove.   Mark met our flight and took us to the bear viewing platform where we saw half a dozen black bears fishing for salmon.  A couple of bald eagles joined in the eating.  Mark was an excellent guide, he's very knowledgeable about the the bears and the area.  A highly recommended trip and guide.

We knew this would be good but it exceeded our expectations. Maverick Helicopters is a very professional company and our pilot Billy was friendly and welcoming. He shared an enormous amount of information about the Grand Canyon and surrounding areas. I felt rather emotional as we flew over the rim for the first time - the canyon is unimaginably vast and incredibly beautiful. It was our first helicopter flight but, surprisingly, I did not feel at all nervous. Do not hesitate to take this trip, it was worth it!

Our family recently took a trip with Seawinds and were very impressed with not only the sights, but the customer service as well. Steve and Lesley were great to work with and very friendly. Steve was an amazing pilot who offered a lot of information about what we were seeing. We landed on a remote lake and were able to get out and take some incredible pictures. We can't say enough great things about this company and we thank them for a memorable trip!

Talkeetna Air Taxi was more like a Limo.  Great service, very experienced pilot and overall concern for the guests.  We were scheduled to go up and weather forced us to reschedule for the following morning.  The next day we actually were the first to go up and thus we went up not knowing if we were going to be able to see Mt. McKinley or land on the glacier.  Therefore, they were not going to charge us until we got back from our flight and they knew we landed or not.  Our pilot Richard was very professional, friendly and safe.  As we cut through the clouds the great Mt. McKinley appeared and he immediately began surveying the surroundings and relaying it back to headquarters for the next groupings that were flying out.  We flew all around the mountains and he told us about each one and then we swooped down and landed smoothly on Ruth Glacier.   Richard's landing was so incredibly smooth it felt as if we floated on to the Glacier. First ones to land on the glacier that day and had the whole place to ourselves.  It was fabulous!   Overall, this once in a lifetime opportunity was definitely worth every penny and one that you should definitely do if your are considering.  Enjoy and make it a great day!

review_title: Birds eye view of Kauai in an hour!
review_text: We had a private tour and Bruce was our captain - with a doctorate turned his passion of flying into a profession. During the flight he explained quite lot about the Island with tons of humor. It's a family run business and they run it professionally. Great value for money!

My husband and I were so pumped with our private Cessna adventure with Kevin as our pilot!  The flight was beautiful and informative and a super value - probably our favorite excursion of the whole week!  The entire staff was great to work with, but Kevin and Chelsea went out of their way to accommodate us on our last few hours in Kauai😃

Forrest and his Beaver - awesome!
We did the Misty Fjord flight - couldn’t have asked for more. Great company with fabulous team, especially Forrest

review_title: Best way to see the Grand Canyon
review_text: A helicopter trip is the best way to really appreciate the scale of the Grand Canyon and Maverick are a very professional outfit. Our pilot, Mike, was friendly, amusing, knowledgable and of course highly competent. You need to take the 50' trip to get a decent amount of time over the canyon itself. It is not always the case that heavier people sit next to the windows as claimed by a previous reviewer - it depends on the mix.

I know there are going to be individuals who are reading this review who are considering their options in exploring the island of Kauai. So when you read this please consider this way of flying as the only possible way to get the view of Kauai that you otherwise will not, especially with the expense most of us are currently involved with while visiting the garden island. Kevin was "The Man" when it came to not only the knowledge of the Island but the flying skill set you would want while cruising over this magnificent canvas that the Lord drew for us to view. Some of you might have some hesitation in getting in this plane, but let me put that idea at ease. It's the safest type of plane you would want to take while cruising over Kauai. Please consider this your "only" option in seeing the Island the way it was meant to be seen. To Kevin and his team, it was a blast and we will be back to do all over again soon. 

Until then,

Merlin and Rhonda

review_title: One of the Best Experiences of My Life!
review_text:
Wow - what an experience! I had the opportunity to take two separate flights - one in their Cessna and one in their incredible cherry red biplane (the only one on the island). 

On both trips to Air Ventures, I was greeted warmly by the staff and owner, who really goes above and beyond to make sure you enjoy your experience.

My pilot, Kevin, has been on the island for 25+ years and, is full of interesting history and tidbits and also makes your flight incredibly fun! You can tell he loves what he does, and it made my experience(s) all the more enjoyable! 

I've always been a fan of flying, and I feel lucky to have experienced not one, but two of their tour offerings. Any of their options will give you a great history and layout of the island (great to do at the beginning of your trip so you can get a best idea of where to spend your time there, and what to do), but I HIGHLY recommend the Biplane flight - it will be worthy every penny!

No matter what, Air Ventures will show you an incredible time and delivers a very unique adventure that really rates as a bucket list item in my book. 

Special thanks to Jill and Kevin. You truly made my weekend, and I'll definitely be sending all travelers to Kaua'i your way.
