I booked this tour on-line a few months before leaving home. Ellen returned my inquiry Right away and gave me the directions for our pick up site at the Anchor Cove Mall which was just a short walk from where our cruise ship was docked.

We had a sunny clear day for our pilot Bruce to take us around the entire island. Much of the spectacular scenery on Kauai can only be easily seen from the air. The Napali coast and the waterfalls that appear on the side of luscious mountainsides was incredible. We were only in Kauai for one day, yet we're able to see the entire island on this tour. Everything was a-one, you can't find any better customer service than what is consistently provided by this family run business. I highly recommend this tour.

review_title: A very professional and fun outfit
review_text: We took a flight with these folks around Kauai, and everything was perfect. The weather, the scenery, the pilot, the plane. Just loved the professionalism, yet fun attitude.
We took the Grand Denali with glacier landing on a beautiful sunny morning.  It was the highlight of our trip.  I would recommend this tour to anyone who wants  to see Denali up close.

Our Talkeetna Air Taxi pilot Michael was a great pilot who narrated our flight and our glacier landing, took pictures, and answered questions in a very professional manner. We felt safe and in good hands throughout our 2-hour flight. I would highly recommend this company to anyone who wants to take an unbelievable flight around Mt. Denali.

Last Wednesday on a day with a few highish clouds we flew on a tour with Air Ventures of Kaua'i, the most westerly of the tourist-visited Hawaiian islands.  Unlike the standard helicopter tour that last 45 minutes and can be a rushed experience, this trip in a fixed wing aircraft was over an hour in duration, allowing for a more leisured experience, with time for whale watching as well as a more detailed look at the south of the island and the famous Na Pali coast on the North West.  The pilot was experienced and knowledgeable and without the roar from the helicopter rotor blades overhead, sound was much clearer via the headset that was issued to each of us.  Everyone gets a window seat, making for easier photography sith reduced distortion from the curved surfaces typical of helicopter windows.  All-in-all at US165$ each, this experience was excellent value and we will be choosing this option in the future.

My first helicopter ride and first time seeing the Grand Canyon in one incredible experience. It was everything I hoped it would be and more. Our pilot Joel did a great job of describing what we were seeing. Highly recommend this tour
It was a fantastic flight, and I even flew the plane! Thank you Pilot Spencer for giving us such a memorable experience! Highly recommend if you're in the Protland area.

An hours flight to and from Grand Canyon airport, then a 10/15 minute bus ride to the rim of the Grand Canyon itself. Amazing, breath taking views! Another 10/15 minute trip further round the rim to more outstanding views. Also get views of the Hoover dam as you take off and land from Boulder City.

Expensive trip but well worth it versus sitting on a coach/car for 9 hours.

Please note that it is a tiny plane that is subject to a lot of turbulence. If you are not a good flyer like me be warned that it may push you to your limits!

review_title: An amazing day!  Both my husband and I loved out tour.
review_text:
We had an amazing day with Westwind Air Services.  We loved Phoenix, found it quiet and peaceful and also clean.
We were collected from our hotel and the day was wonderful from that moment.  We felt we were amongst friends.  Loved the Grand Canyon from the air and the ground.  I will recomment Westwind,  Lyndsay made booking easy and looked after us from the moment we arrived.
The pilot was great and the Pink Jeap Tour was so easy, friendly and informative.
Westwind is the way to fly.
Thanks for everything guys.  Penny and Wayne

We had gone to Denali National Park the day before and got a glimpse of this spectacular mountain. But we had also booked a flight seeing tour with TAT to get a closer look. This was my first small plane experience, and I was a little nervous about getting into a 5-seater Cessna. But our pilot, Will, made me feel very comfortable, answering all our safety questions, letting us know whenever we were going to feel a bump mid-flight, and checking in to make sure we were ok. The ride was very smooth and incredibly peaceful.

I agree with all the rest, the glacier landing is a must do! The entire 1.5 hour experience - getting a glimpse of peaks and mountains not many people get to see, landing on glacier 11,000 feet high, and being surrounded by wondrous beauty - truly changed me. If you want to be inspired, in awe, and have an experience you'll remember forever, book this trip!

This experience was awesome! We had a lot of fun seeing the 5 islands from 1,000ft. Eric was an excellent tour guide and pilot and he even let us take the controls and fly along the coastline. Would recommend this to anyone who was considering a helicopter tour. This was a better way to see the island!

review_title: Even better than the helicopter tours!
review_text: Booked the flight and luau package on the phone (super easy to book), and got a reminder email and phone call the day before the flight. Location is easy to find (right after LIH main terminal) with ample parking. Checked in with Liz (who I booked with on phone), and she was just as pleasant and funny in person during the quick check in process. After ten minutes or so, out pilot Brian came out and led us to the plane (with a pre flight picture). Plane holds max of 6 passengers, but since I'm 6'4" I had to (got to) sit in the "copilot" seat (for let room). Takeoff was as smooth as could be, and we saw all of the sights (and doubled back on most so both sides of the plane could get perfect views/pictures). Brian was extremely knowledgeable, funny, and an even better pilot (warning us before any potential turbulence). Landing was even smoother than takeoff. I was worried that I would see less in the plane than I would in a helicopter, but we in fact saw much more, for much longer (cheapest helicopter tour I found was about $245/person, and I got the 60 minute flight and Smith's Luau for $199/person). In short, I recommend Air Ventures Hawaii/Kauai to anyone looking at a helicopter/air tour!

This was truly the flight of a lifetime. The staff was friendly & helpful. Andy was our pilot and he gave us the Grand Tour. We felt safe, he gave warning if there were going to be "bumps", changed course a bit if needed for a smooth ride with the best views. This was a glacier landing flight & so glad we did...amazing! Andy was knowledgeable and encouraged questions about area history, mountains, climbers, etc. You will not be disappointed!

review_title: I was a wonderful and breathtaking experience our words don’t fully describe what we saw and felt.
review_text: The pilot was very fun and enjoyable, he made the trip even more exciting and he took us places and we saw things that were just wonderful and words cannot describe.  I believe that all waterfalls is what really captivated us the most and the Hawaiian Grand Canyon.

I was apprehensive but it wasn't long before I was taken in the the breathtaking views. Open air cockpit, the sights and a knowledgeable guide, this makes for a memorable trip. We did a complete loop of the island and the interior too. Thanks Harry!

The best view you can get of the Grand Canyon, the location lays on the way and is therefore super easy to find. They started a few minutes earlier and flew a little longer for that matter. Definitely the right company to choose, everything was very organized. Beautiful view and beautiful tour

The flight was the most unbelievable experience!  If you have the opportunity to do this, I absolutely recommend it.  The circle island flight allowed us to see Maui in a manner that not many can.  Maui Plane Rides was 5 star from start to finish, a memory that I will never, ever forget!!!

review_title: Awesome!!! Highlight of my trip! Must do! Chance of a lifetime.
review_text: Karo the office ticket lady was so nice and helpful. Then our  shuttle driver over to our plane there was the nicest young man telling us about our flight. To our pilot Tim who was super nice and a great pilot. Everyone was so nice and that made the experience so pleasant. As for the sights and the flight. It was AWESOME! Highlight of my trip by far. Breathtaking views of the mountains and glaciers. I can’t express how great of a company and flight this was. I highly highly recommended this to everyone. Spend the money!!! It’s a chance if a lifetime and worth every penny.
5 Star experience with Eric. Incredible views and a very knowledgeable pilot. Highly recommend! Mahalo

Really a great tour.  The flight was longer than the helicopter tours and we got to see everything from a window seat.  I've been on helicopter tours which I think are better if you actually land somewhere, otherwise the plane is just as good and much less expensive.  Our pilot, Desi, was a real trip, super enthusiastic and a lot of fun to be with.  Our flight was the afternoon after a heavy rain day so there were an unbelievable number of waterfalls.

Our flight over Kaua'i with our charming, skillful pilot was the best experience of our island vacation. She gave a most interesting and helpful account of what we could see below, and smoothly took us over all the promised natural wonders of Kaua'i. I strongly recommend Air Adventures.

This for sure was a once in a lifetime bucket-list experience! For starters, working with the office was so extremely easy as they had to move our tour 2 different times, and they eventually upgraded us to the Grand Denali tour with glacier landing for no additional charge! The tour itself - words cannot describe how amazing it was! We must have hit the jackpot because there was not a single cloud in the sky that day, and to be able to circle Denali and the surrounding mountains with unobstructed views is something I will never forget. Landing on the glacier was such a memorable experience that words simply cannot explain it! Our pilot was so great and so very knowledgeable, it was just the cherry on top of an already amazing tour. If anyone is visiting Alaska this is a MUST DO with this company!
Highlight of our trip. Really nice people and Desi did a excellent Job. She gave a lot of background information

What a wonderful experience we had on our floatplane excursion with Seawind  Aviation.
Steve went out of his way to make sure we had a safe and personalized experience.  Instead of a taped narration Steve talked with us about where we were, the history, geography, wildlife  and highlights of the area.  The areas he took us to were breathtaking.  Leslie met us at the doc promptly and with a warm smile, it was great getting a feel for the area from the perspective of a young mom. 
They made us feel so at home.  This will be our first excursion we will book when we go there  again.
Best time ever!!!

I surprised my boyfriend with this tour. We are Floridians and we had never experienced Miami this way. It was so amazed and surprised. The crew was wonderful and the view was breath taking. Thank you for helping create an amazing memory in our hearts!

My sisters and I took the helicopter tour over the Grand Canyon, and it lets you get a 
Great appreciation for the amazing Canyon you do not get just from seeing it on the lookout points.
Very fun and great opportunity. Well worth the money.
Our guide and pilot Daniel was very good
Ryan was a superior pilot.  Great experience!  A must-do AK experience.  Staff helpful, kind.  Would recommend for sure!

What a brilliant experience we had doing this flight. Our pilot Marcus was really informative about all the sights we were flying over, it’s a brilliant experience, would highly recommend this trip. Thank you Ellen for picking us up and dropping us off, great friendly service.

My husband & I were in town for the week from Bartlesville, OK. I'd bought our tickets as a Valentine's Day gift for my husband. It was a great experience & we will definately do it again if we are ever are down there again!!!

review_title: Absolutely the best thing we did on our whole vacation!
review_text: I was blown away by how spectacular this flight was! I am very nervous about small planes but Bruce is simply the best. The flight was so smooth and I actually felt very safe. His altitude is low and I think that makes it so much better. I wish I had done this sooner. Photos I got out the window were the best photos on our trip. This is a must for photographers.

review_title: Breathtaking Views of the Grand Canyon
review_text: Our pilot Matt was excellent.  He was skilled, personable and reassuring.  The helicopter was first rate - comfortable, with huge windows.  The views were spectacular.  And as a former DJ, Matt treated us to a great playlist of music during the ride.  There is no better way to see the Grand Canyon.

review_title: The best way to see Alaska
review_text: I was hesitant at first because of the cost but It was the best part of our trip. The flight was smooth the views where amazing. Go for the glacier landing. You only live once!  Johnmeisterrealtor.com

review_title: A small plane fright around Denali  mountain, landingand walking on a glacier
review_text: More than two months before our visit to Alaska we researched Denali mountain flights and scheduled a flight with Talkeetna Air Taxi. Major considerations were their generous rescheduling policy reputation. The day we arrived for our flight, the weather was clear and as soon as we took off  the view of the mountain was amazing. Our pilot, Alex, was wonderful and was full of very interesting and knowledgeable information about the mountain and the area. We flew all the way around Denali mountain, between many of the peaks, down through several glacier filled valleys, and spent about a half hour playing in the snow on a glacier nestled among giant peaks all around us. We saw groups of mountain climbers just beginning their arduous trek up the mountain from their base camp. The Talkeetna Air Taxi flight around Denali was one of the true highlights of our 24 days in Alaska and recommend them most highly.
OMG , No trip to Alaska is complete without taking this flight. The pilot was great flying the plane but also a great tour guide explaining everything we were seeing. Worth every dollar and more.

review_title: Amazing! A 'must do' on bucket list for visit to San Francisco
review_text:
If you're on a visit to San Francisco then a Seaplane Adventure is a definite must do. 
Situated about 30' minutes from central San Francisco (pre-booked Seaplane taxi pick-ups available from Pier 39) the company operate various pleasure trips affording customers fantastic views over San Francisco Bay and beyond.
Easy to book on-line and operated by very friendly staff.
My trip was last Sunday (6 May) and chose morning 10.45 30' minute flight with the added pick-up from Pier 39. Pilot (John I think his name) was very friendly and provided informative commentary throughout the flight. I was lucky enough to have front seat next to pilot on the plane but everybody on a trip will get window seats.
My 30' minute trip covered the whole of San Francisco Bay including all the famous sights such as Golden Gate Bridge, Alcatraz Island, down San Francisco etc. 
Ensure to take smartphone or other camera/video gear to capture the views.
Small, but excellent, range of gifts available from check-in office including t-shirts, caps etc.

Brilliant, value-for-money experience and well worth doing on a San Francisco trip.

This is expensive, but worth every penny. If you visit the Grand Canyon and can afford it, we recommend you do it. For us it was one, if not the, highlight on our extended US trip which brought us to places like New York, Yosemite, San Francisco etc. You get fantastic vistas of the Grand Canyon. For our kids the Heli ride was in itself an experience they will long remember.  Maverick stands out as a provider. Security: we get the expression of a well run undertaking with very experienced pilots. Contrary to the local competition, they completely shut down helicopters between flights so that the helicopters can be refueled and briefly checked and the pilots can take a short break from flying. We find this is a great plus for security. Entertainment: Our pilot was motivated and contributed a lot to the overall experience. In flight we could talk and ask questions over the inflight system. We even saw some Bisons on the ground over at the north rim during flight.

We had an amazing Denali Flyer Tour with the glacier landing. From our initial contact with Ernie we were impressed. Our pilot Stan was outstanding and highly informative. The following morning we had a little car trouble and Chad jumped right in to help us out. 

A flight tour around Denali is a must for any visitor to Alaska and K2 is the company to trust for an outstanding time.

My husband and I went on this tour during our honeymoon in Kauai and we weren't disappointed.  The pilot and other employees couldn't be friendlier and more accommodating.  There were only 3 passengers on our flight and Captain Josh was able to answer all of our questions while in the air.  My husband and I debated whether a helicopter tour or plane tour would be better and we believe the plane tour was a better value for the money.  The planes can't go into the valleys nor go as close to the mountains as the helicopters but the plane flew slower (great for photos) and was substantially cheaper.  I'd do this tour early so that you get a good overview of the island and with the money you save on a helicopter tour go on the Na Pali Experience boat tour!

review_title: great birds eye view of the island
review_text: The day was a bit more cloudy than we would have liked but the rainbows made up for it.  It was delightful to see the canyon lands from the air after we had driven up there the day before.

I am an instrument-rated pilot from Texas.  My first concern is safety.  The TAT planes and equipment and first class, maintain like new, and in excellent condition.  Our pilot, Michael, a skilled commercial-rated pilot, is equally skilled and safe.  He knows how to maneuver the plane for optimum comfort of the passengers, alerting us to what he is doing (turns, ascent, descent) before he executes.  He is an equally good tour guide in the air but his cockpit situation awareness never waivers.  We had a beautiful clear day and the air tour exceeded all expectations.  I don't weep easily but these views of Creation being awe and delight.   The staff on the phone and at check in have a wonderful service culture.   You immediately feel welcome and appreciated.  This service is definitely a choice for experience and safety.

I was able to sign up for this at the last minute AND go on a day when Denali was not shrouded in cloud cover.  I volunteered to sit in the front seat, which is the place to be on this flight.  We all loved landing on the glacier and taking in that surreal and sunny world. The ground and air service were efficient, friendly and very professional.  Our pilot narrated what we were seeing, which was helpful, since it’s not easy to know what in the world you’re looking at when things look so new to you.  We flew very close to the mountains but I was never scared.  I feel very fortunate to have had the occasion to do this. Family and friends love those videos the best of everything I did in Alaska.
Wow, what a good idea it was to fly up to Roche Harbor instead of driving and taking the ferry. Service was friendly, punctual, and fun!

The Hoover Dam, Lake Mead, Mojave desert and Grand Canyon by air was spectacular, and we can only assume far better than trying to see far less of the same sights from the ground by bus or car. It was also fun to fly in a Cessna.

We actually got this on a $50 off per person promo, so it cost just about the same as the 8 hour bus trip from Las Vegas. Staff were friendly and professional, and the Boulder City airport was clean and modern. Highly recommended!
Same day availability in October fantastic weather. Amazing pilot and staff. Great views we would highly recommend . Wonderful value !!!
smooth flight from a bada@@ woman pilot.  Info on the mountain and amazing views. The flight was safe and clean.  Easy check-in and on time tour

review_title: Our Flight Around Paradise Was Nothing Short of Amazing!
review_text: We scheduled our flight around paradise through our hotel concierge.  The process worked flawlessly.  Tour staff picked us up on time to begin the journey.  Once at the airport our small group was met by Air Ventures staff who were very courteous and then ushered us to the counter.  The check-in process was quick and efficient and in just minutes we were walking to board for an on time departure.  The equipment was clean and appeared well maintained.  Once on board the pilot went over safely procedures and other important info about the plane and after which we taxied to our runway.  The take off was smooth just as the flight.  What view's!  We covered the entire island taking in all the beautiful sights - gorge, Na Pali Coast, rain forest etc flying up close and personal over these natural wonders.  All the time being described in great detail by our pilot.  My wife and I loved it!  What a way to start the adventure in this magical island.  Thanks Air Ventures for making this possible!  To all those who read this post....don't hesitate for a minute to start your vacation week like ours and take the plunge into these sky's!
We had an awesome tour!! We loved our pilot Eric!! We spotted lots of whales. The pictures I took of the Napli coast are worth putting on our wall as at home.

Denali is awesome if all you get to do is see it from the road.  Having the chance to fly among the peaks and land on a glacier is a not-to-be-missed experience.  The weather was crystal clear the day we were there, but we were told that was rare and that only about 30% of visitors actually get to see the top of Denali.  It is usually shrouded in clouds.  It's an expensive venture but worth every cent.

If I could sum up this excursion in one word- BREATHTAKING!   From the moment we checked in to the moment we left, we had the best experience.  Everyone was so friendly.  Jacob was our pilot and was so knowledgeable about the island.  You have headsets so you can listen and talk to the pilot.   I can’t sat enough about this tour other than it’s a MUST do.  You must see Kauai from the air and I would highly recommend Wings over Kauai.  We decided on the Cessna which can fit up to 3 based on weight.  We only had 2 people so it’s a private tour.    The flight was smooth and so enjoyable.
So many pictures! They do not capture the entire experience. The music they played while going over the Grand Canyon added more excitement.

I took my son for he’s 12 birthday . He totally loved it , he was afraid at first but the people there were so nice that they make him feel so comfortable and relax . The view was one in the life time experience and I would highly recommend

I bought a private flight as a birthday gift for my husband and we had a fantastic time. We had a friend who came along for the flight as well. The pilot was awesome, friendly, easy going, and made the flight a fun and laid back experience. We will definitely book another trip with them for another beautiful look at Oregon from above. We got to see stunning views of many of the surrounding mountains and rivers, can’t wait to do it again!! Thanks for the amazing adventure!!

review_title: Epic Kauai flight & customer service experience
review_text: My wife and I had the pleasure to enjoy the highest level of flight and customer experience with Jill and Ray from AirVentures. When the weather wasn‘t great on our first flight, they offered us a second flight for free to ensure we would get a great experience seeing Kauai from high above. They both were not only highly professional, but they were also very customer focussed, helpful and great fun. You can see from all the little details that they really do care about creating the best possible experience for you. At the end we had an unforgettable flight with Ray, for sure a highlight of our Hawaii holiday. We can highly recommend booking a flight with AirVentures, you will not regret it. Nadine & Daniel

I would advise anyone who visits Talkeetna to take a trip if a life time with K2 Aviation. I don't like to fly that much but I couldn't believe how smooth the ride was. The scenery can never be matched in your lifetime! Our pilot, Chip was amazing. Make the most of you visit and take a ride you'll never forget!

Well.. I suppose we were really lucky ducks. ..
Booked month in advance from downunder..flew specially over from our holiday stay on Waikiki for this trip.
On arrival our booking was confirmed..and were welcomed by Mary that made us already feel so comfortable.
Had to wait anyway... but looked at the skies which might looks a tropical shower awaiting us... but a little  prayer to the local indigenous god Pele seemed to have averted the spoil ... 
We were comfortable seated on the right side of the (Aussie made) plane. .. and Bruce gave us those wings of excellence over Kauai to see the beautiful scenery while Pele opened up the blue skies...
Also it seems that we chose the right time to see the sun provided the nice lighting and shading...
All in all this trip is par excellence to us..

The minor problem is that something needs to be done with the audio system as it was hard to hear the conversation even that the volume was set to max.

Thanks Mary..Ellen and Bruce for the unforgettable wings you gave us..
Definitely worth an advisor...

Steph & Anton from poʍunupəɹ..

review_title: Harry was a great pilot and showed us a great time
review_text: Only negative in th whole trip was the back 2 seats. It was very cramped for me. But the views over whelmed the tight squeeze

review_title: Fly over Canyonlands and Arches National Parks
review_text: We had a thrilling adventure flying over the Canyonlands and Arches National Park.  Not being hikers, we got to see areas of the parks that we would not have had a chance to see from just driving on the scenic roads.  Most of the 80-minute flight was in Canyonlands and included the Maze.  Our pilot, Desi, was wonderful about pointing out many geologic features, such as several arches, and flying around them so that everyone got to see them.  The plane was very comfortable and equipped with head sets.  We easily booked our tour at the Moab Airport and were able to make a reservation for early the next day which fit perfectly into our schedule.  It was well worth the money spent and a great way to see more of these beautiful parks.

What a great experience the people were just wonderful Eric and Jill run a top notch program not to mention the Cessna 182 had all the bells and whistles very up to date I will be going again before the trip is over.

review_title: A great part of our trip to Kauai
review_text:
I would highly recommend this tour.  A very competent, accommodating family-run operation.

We waited till we got to the island and saw what the weather was like, then phoned Wings over Kauai directly.  They were very helpful and gave us a number of options for times over the next several days.

When we arrived at Lihue Airport, check-in was fast and friendly.  As they promised, all four of us got seats on the right-hand side of the plane, which gives everyone a nice view of the various coastlines, especially the Na Pali coast.  The pilot Bruce engaged everyone on the two-way conversation, and included very informative commentary without making it seem like he had given the same patter on each of the 5000 or more times he has flown the circuit.

Sure, you don't get as close to the scenery as you do in the helicopters, but it's still a great view.  Very comfortable plane, no weight restrictions like the helicopters have, and a guarantee of a view out the right side.   Good value for the money.
Fantastic views of the sunset and very unique views of the island. Loved seeing molakini from the air. Eric was very knowledgeable and a great tour guide and pilot.

review_title: Our BEST excursion of the entire Holiday
review_text: We have done just about every excursion possible, in several trips to beautiful Maui, but Eric and his flight takes the cake. Our family had such an amazing experience. Only regret - that there is not a 6th star to give this. We will be back again, for sure!

Our pilot was Dezi and she was awesome ! We got to see everything, and I mean everything and she was so knowledgeable about the island we couldn't have had a better time. They were all super nice and it was so easy to book and upon arrival it was quick and so welcoming. We loved or time!

review_title: Highlight of a magnificent trip to Alaska
review_text: I really wanted to see Denali. I didn't want to endure a long bus ride to do it. We opted to take a flight-see with a glacier landing on the Routh Glacier. We circled the mountain before landing --- 3 of the 4 mountain faces were visible. Our pilot explained several of the glacier formations and pointed out interesting sites on the way up to the mountain. We were flying in a DeHaviland Otter with the original engine --- it took awhile to gain altitude. Landing on the glacier was worth the additional cost --- it gave us the ability to really enjoy looking at the grandeur and scale that is Alaska. This was our favorite excursion of our trip.

A great tour and a great value. Eric our pilot was very professional, yet also funny and friendly. Very smooth ride; he always warned us if any slight turbulence was expected and checked on each of us periodically.

We arrived on Kauai two days ago and decided to take a flight around the island.  Our decision to take the "Air iVentures" Airvan fixed wing plane tour was a wise one.  The Pilot and staff at the airport were friendly and knowledgeable.  On the flight we were kept entertained with what we were seeing and were urged to ask questions and request movements of the plane to help us in our pictures. 

The plane was outstanding, looking brand new and very comfortable with air conditioning inside the cockpit.  It was quiet in operation and seemed very solid for a single engine aircraft. 

I reommend the busines hightly,

William Bluhm
Pentwater, Michigan

These guys know what they're doing. We booked our trip through Princess Cruises and were very well cared for. The flight was very smooth; I understand it's usually raining here but we had a rare dry day. Our pilot was great.  Takeoffs and landings were incredibly smooth. I have a pilot's license and have some seaplane training so I really appreciated our pilot's skill. 

The views are astounding. This is a "must-see" flight!
The whole experience was amazing! It was the best, breathtaking - have to see to believe it…and the pilot was great! Highly recommend!!

I was a bit hesitant on flying such a small plane but the owner-pilot made our experience truly amazing. He flew low enough so we could appreciate the beauty of the Miami Skyline and the reefs and ocean that make this such an amazing city.   I prefer to fly to Bimini than go by boat, especially when one wants to get in every minute of a weekend getaway.
Great views - perfect timing on the sunset! The flight was very smooth and Pilot Steve was great. Nice that it was a small plane so it was just us - not a big group.
This was one of the best things I have ever experienced. This tour looked over the beautiful islands of Hawaii.
The entire experience was amazing. My grandsons said it was the best day of their life!! The views we had of the Grand Canyon could not be seen from the ground. Great experience!

Our experience was perfect from checking in through landing. Our pilot, Bruce, was great telling us about everything we saw with his personal experiences mixed in, while expertly navigating the plane. The ride was smooth from take off to landing and the sights and view was indescribable. If you do one tour to truly see Kauai, book this one!!
This trip was more than I could ever dream of! The views were insanely beautiful and the experience was GREAT. It is a MUST!

review_title: Fantastic ride over Arches and Canyonlands
review_text: Great ride over the two parks. Smooth sailing all the way! We did this ride after hiking in both parks and seeing things from above really helped us understand the parks and the topography. Highly recommend!

review_title: Better late than never! I did this 5.5 years ago and LOVED IT!
review_text:
It's Alyssa Jacey, the singer/songwriter you hosted on the private helicopter tour! I have been MEANING to review this and my only excuse is that I went on tour! I've opened for Bruno Mars, PEPPER, Andy Grammer, Lisa Loeb, Tavana and about 20 others! Anyway, enough about me. THIS TRIP WAS OUTSTANDING! I loved every second. It was so gorgeous, I felt very safe, they had a clean, comfortable heli...it was all wonderful. Not to mention their staff! LOVED them. So sweet, genuine...there was a lovely girl there at the time that hand drew me a map of the island...just to have! Anyway, I'll be coming back my next time to the island! I'll be on my 3rd tour in a year next month (June 7-19) to HNL. Visit Alyssa Jacey dot com for show details, maybe you can come to one of the nine?? 

To all considering Wings Over Kauai...stop hesitating and do it! You'll love it!

Sincerely,
~Alyssa Jacey

review_title: Incredible views of Denali and mountain glaciers
review_text:
My wife and i loved our visit to Alaska. We happily chose to fly over Mount McKinley/Denali using Talkeetna Air Taxi.  A first class outfit, we flew in a Dehaviland Otter with Tyler,  a superb young pilot who inspired confidence and was helpful as a guide. We experienced once in a lifetime views of Denali and the Alaskan Mountain range and actually landed on a glacier!
I was very impressed by the integrity of the administrative staff, also. Service oriented, safety-conscious and attentive to our needs, we received an unexpected partial refund when cloud cover did not permit the airplane to circumnavigate the whole of Denali.
Took a tour down to the keys for lunch then back.  Captain Tony is the real deal!  We will be back and highly recommend this to anyone looking for a little adventure in their lives.

My wife and I got tomfly in the 2 seater with Bruce the owner as our pilot. His love for his island is evident and he is a wealth of information. His singing, maybe not so much :). We did a circle around the island in about an hour and could not have enjoyed it more or been happier. While granted you cannot get as close or as low as with a helicopter, the scenery around the island at 3000 feet is not to be missed.

This was one of the best things I have ever done!   Words cannot describe the beauty and magnificence of flying around the mountain in such an up close and personal way.    WOW.    Make sure you include this in your trip to Alaska!

Booking was easy and so was check in. Greeted when we walked in & boarded right away. Quick instructions & safety tips then we were off! Pilot pointed out all the sights & would fly over most places twice so each side of plane could see sights. Luckily we had nice weather.

This was the highlight of our trip to Alaska! We thoroughly enjoyed Tim as our pilot and gave us a smooth pleasurable flight. We landed at Base Camp on Mt McKinley, got to walk around & take lots of pictures! It was amazing and well worth the money! I recommend you do it😍 Ask for Tim he was Great!!

Great experience!!! Very nice pilot !! 
I enjoyed very much . Great views and unforgettable experience

Nice overview of the island. Very smooth 55 min. ride even with looming clouds and wind.
Good pilot, friendly, with a lots of comments. We were 6 people from the same family, it felt like a
private plane.

Having 37 years as an Airline Pilot, I've seen plenty, but landing on a glacier was one of the most memorable moments I've ever had.
Our pilot Jack was a true professional and I knew.my wife and I were in good hands. You could tell that Jack absolutely loved what he was doing and his narratives were first class and informative.  Add to that a fleet of beautifully maintained aircraft and K2 becomes hard to beat.  The views, experience and memories are worth every dollar.

We spent 14 days on 4 islands and did kayaking, snorkeling, whale watching and doors off helicopter tour over volcano.  This was by far our favorite and the most amazing experience.  We were met by the owner both before and after our ride.  Harry was our pilot and was great and gave alot of narration.  He did a few airplane tricks also that felt like we were on a rollercoaster.  After ride he wrote down a few other suggestions of sights to see on Kaua’i.  PAY the money and take this trip, it was worth every cent.
Awesome flight, really enjoyed flying with Eagles Air Tours, I did the Private Exotic Air Tour 45 Minutes, It was great no doubt.

review_title: Eric was a GREAT pilot and tour guide!
review_text: We had a wonderful tour of the island and will recommend you to everyone we know coming to Kauai! We did a helicopter tour years ago but found the fixed wing airplane so much smoother and more enjoyable!! 😄

A great flight that began with a great aircraft with  every passenger having a window view thru clear clean bubble windows. We were blessed with a perfectly clear day that the pilot said was one of the clearest he had seen recently and rewarded us with locations that normaly might have been cloudy such as the peak of the mountain which is the rainiest place on earth (can't remember it name). We over flew the Napali coast and famous spots from the movie Jurrasic park. The flight was smooth and comfortable with plenty of photo opportunities.

We took the 45 minute plane ride from Las Vegas - great pilot and smooth ride over to the Grand Canyon.  Then we took the 25 minute helicopter ride over the north rim - our pilot was BJ who was great, very funny and with great knowledge of the Canyon - my daughter and I were lucky enough to get the 2 front seats next to BJ so had fabulous, simply breathtaking views.  We would thoroughly recommend this fabulous tour - very well organised and worth the money.

review_title: One of the best moments of my life
review_text: Great customer service, very professional company. Spencer was our pilot and he was amazing! 10/10 would recommend over and over again. The views are amazing!

Awesome service. Our pilot, Bruce, made a point to keep track of all our names and interacted with each of us by name throughout the flight. A very nice touch. We actually flew through some rain (as might be expected as you approach the rainiest mountain on earth) and turbulence didn't get uncomfortable. They had assured us that if they had to cancel due to weather that we would not be charged for the tour at all. It is true that everyone gets a window seat but the nature of an airplane is that it doesn't turn on a dime. They essentially have to choose to go around the island clockwise or counterclockwise. They choose clockwise, so those on the right hand side of the airplane get the best views. If you fill the plane, there will be 2 guests on the right and 4 on the left. They do fly across the middle of the island, turning inland over Poipu going up Waimea Canyon and then out over the ocean for the trip down Na Pali. He does do a full circle over the most beautiful section of Na Pali so everyone on the plane gets a view. He then flies to the left of Ke'e beach and Tunnels then turns inland over Princeville for a nice view of the waterfalls coming off the mountains there. They don't fly as low as helicopters do, but I wonder if helicopters take you over the entire island. (I think they may have to focus on one area or another.) 

Overall a great trip for a fraction of the cost of a helicopter trip. 

We chose airplane over a boat trip because we feared Captain Andy's from Port Allen would be too choppy and the risk of getting seasick was too high. Also we heard the Port Allen route gives you too short of a visit to the Na Pali coast.

Thanks, Bruce!

review_title: This was wonderful. The trip was exactly as advertised.  We flew taround the Alaskan Range, Mt Mckinley  (Denali) and la
review_text: Awesome! The pilot made certain each side of the plane saw everything. Landing on a glacier was exciting. Beauty surrounded us. Cannot use enough superlatives to describe this trip.

This flightseeing trip was the pinnacle of 2 weeks of amazing experiences.  Words and pictures fail to convey what a flight around McKinley is like. I thought that upon landing my girlfriend and I would be babbling about the flight, but we were both so awestruck that we didn't actually say much at all, nor did we need to. It was like being in your own Discovery Channel documentary. I can tell you that it was very smooth and even though we were flying between, around or over mountains, we always felt extremely safe and comfortable. I was expecting the plane to be bouncing around while in the mountains but the flight was as smooth as glass. Later in the week we had talked to some people who described themselves as nervous fliers but on their flightseeing trip they had no nervousness or fear. The flights are not cheap but they are so incredible that a flight and glacier landing are an absolute must do. Save money by not doing all the silly touristy activities and have a genuine Alaskan experience.
The view was so beautiful and amazing, absolutely stunning and the waterfalls were gorgeous . We loved every moment of it

review_title: Great way to see the island
review_text: Eric was a great pilot and we had a great experience. Do this at the beginning of your stay so you can see all the fabulous places you want to visit. It was a really nice perspective of the entire island. Less expensive than a helicopter and you get a longer rider.

This was our favorite part of the trip. Seeing the island from the air is amazing. I was a little nervous but it turned out fine. Our pilot Doug was amazing and very knowledgeable about the island. If you get a chance definitely put this on your list of things to do.

this is a must when you are at this island we found this on this site.and were met of the ship by a very friendly young lady who drove us to the flight centre.(wok).we were very impressed with bruce our pilot he is a fountain of knowleadge a very informative,the flight was fantastic  and veiws out of this world,we have done helicopter flights but this exceeded them.we would like to thank everyone for giving us a wonderful experience.if you take a cruise to this island i suggest you book early to avoid dissappointment.a lot cheaper than the helicopter tour you get on the cruise ships.
We had a terrific flight with Eric!  Lots of beautiful views and information about all of the islands we saw. He was happy to answer all of our questions. Highly recommended!

We booked AirVentures when our reservation was canceled unexpectedly by another plane company. I'm so glad we booked with this company instead! Their customer service is friendly and professional. My husband, daughter and I were very comfortable and the ride was smooth. Two of us get motion sickness, so the helicopter rides were never an option. This experience allowed us to see the highlights of Kauai and focus our time on other activities. Highly recommend!!

Our pilot was very knowledgeable regarding the island and it was an exceptionally smooth
ride. We are recommending it to family and friends.

This was an amazing way to start our week long vacation. It allowed us to see all of the major sights in one excursion. Would definitely do this again! JT was very knowledgeable and he made the experience enjoyable.

review_title: Great way to see the entire island!
review_text: The pilot was excellent.  He cared about the comfort and experience of all of his passengers and was very informative.  We got some amazing pictures and had a really fun flight.  The "office" staff was very efficient

My husband and I had the GREATEST time on a seaplane piloted by Charles Perkins on June 17, 2018.  It was our first trip to Alaska and this was our first excursion from the ship.  It set up our total week by being GREAT.  Charles is over the top with his knowledge of the FJORDS and total area.  His seaplane was skillfully piloted and, again, we had a great time.  Highly recommended!

Worth every penny! 

My husband and I brought our 3 children aged 13, 16, and 20 on a flight which was supposed to take us sightseeing through Denali and land on a glacier.  The weather was sketchy, so the pilot decided to cut it a little.  We were able to go up and see the Denali peak and land on a glacier! 

It was a magical moment in life! Every one had a great time.

I recommend this company wholeheartedly, every member of the staff was professional and friendly.  Our pilot was fantastic and let my pilot husband sit as copilot for our return.

we flight with Wings Over Kauai because friends told us about it. It was simply great! Everybody was so friendly, even though we made first a mistake of the date. We felt very safe at the flight and we get a lot of informations. Everything was very personal, we felt like friends.

review_title: The son says it was DOPE
review_text: booked this in England so only went on trip advisors comments and was pleasantly surprised.  Nice welcome when we booked in,  just a warning, they weigh you! !, pilot calls out your name when its time to board.   The pilot gave a good safety talk and told us where to sit,  you may not be next to your family as weight is distributed.  Pilot, Alex, gave us some brilliant information about the area and was obviously knowledgeable about the canyon,  the ride was smooth.  A WOW from us all.
This flight was enjoyable and a highlighter of our Maui trip. Highly recommend because it's just amazing!

review_title: The Best way to see the island of Kauai!
review_text: As first time visitors to Kauai, my wife and I wanted to see as much of the island as we could. The staff and crew with Air Ventures made our experience so comfortable and relaxed, and at the same time so exciting. Our pilot effortlessly flew all of the sites from multiple approach directions to provide everyone on board the best views. The large windows in the plane allowed us to capture some fantastic pictures. I highly recommend this Air Tour and Air Ventures to anyone that visits Kauai.

From start to finish was the best part of the trip. All the people I dealt with at K2 were friendly and professional. Our pilot was very knowledgeable about our plane and the area we flew over. If there was a down side it was that we didn't land on a glacier. But that was no fault of K2, it was weather related. K2 happily refunded that portion of the price. There was no fighting or hassle - it was in my bank within 2days.

I highly recommend flying with K2

Check in was easy and our pilot Josh was professional and made us feel safe and secure. He provided a lot of information as we flew over Kauai/Napali Coat. We were thrilled when we flew over jurassic park waterfalls and the theme music played over our headphones - a childhood dream come true. It was also very affordable in comparison to the helicopters. The helicopters seemed to get lower/closer which we would love to do if we went back again. We just couldn't justify paying the price of the helicopter tours (especially since the Canadian dollar is not so hot right now). I would highly recommend this tour - great value for money and absolutely amazing views!!!!!!!!!!

review_title: BEST way to see the Grand Canyon!
review_text: The BEST way to truly see the Grand Canyon!  Short flight from Phoenix, fly over Sedona and all around canyon.  Lands at small airport near Grand Canyon and hits all the best spots to view the canyon.  A remarkable and unforgettable experience.  Customer service was impeccable!  Flight out was smooth but a little bumpy on the way back due to warmer climate.  Best part was that we were back at our hotel by 3pm rather than making a 3 hr drive up, spending the day there then driving 3 hrs back.  THANK YOU to all the staff at Westwind for making this such an incredible experience!

We took a family of 4 on the seaplane and neets Bay bear watching tour. Mike was our Pilot and he was great. 1st time we landed you didn’t even know you were on the water. The guide on the short walk was great as well and he makes sure you’re well informed. Overall the entire tour was great and a must do in Ketchikan.

Amazing experience in kauai! Was worth every ar i’ve spent on it! My boyfriend and I appreciated the whole tour! Amazing views, great team with a nice pilote! Thanks JT for your time! I recomment it for everyone- it’s an experience of a lifetime!

review_title: Best way to see Canyonlands NP
review_text:
We booked this trip with Moab Adventure Centre but when we got to the airport for our flight we found we were travelling with Redtail Aviation. Our pilot was Kim, he told us this was his retirement job, and he had been flying these trips for 4 years.

The plane was a 7 seater, 2 up front for the staff and 5 in the back, there was plenty of leg room and headphones so you could hear the pilot. Everyone had a window seat.

The flight was amazing, Kim was very knowledgeable about the area and pointed out all of the points of interest. At the end of the flight the landing was very smooth. I would definitely recommend this trip to anyone wanting to see Canyonlands National Park properly, you only see a fraction of it from the ground.
Amazing trip well worth it. Great guide and wonderful explanation. I would recommend this to anyone with kids. Specialized attention to details.

Had a great experience with the Talkeetna Air Taxi.  We were originally scheduled for Friday and the weather wasn't looking to great.  Showed up and asked if it would be possible to change the date.  The front staff were more than willing to allow us to change the date at make it at the end of our trip when the weather appeared to be clearing up.  During our stay we were never able to see Mt. Denali due to clouds and rain UNTIl we took flight with Andy.  This was a huge highlight to our trip!! I have two teenage boys (15,17) and my husband and I (45,43).  Expensive yes, but worth the experience.  We also paid for the glacier landing which is another must do.  The clouds were still around Denali but Andy flew us to a spot that he had heard they were able to catch a glimpse. We then landed on the glacier and spent 15" taking it all in.  If you are quiet you can actually here the water flowing from the glacier. Andy explains things into your headset all the way there and back of all the things you are seeing.  I would definitely recommend this experience.

Our pilot Jake was awesome! He not only flew the helicopter so smoothly so that our 1 family member who has a tendency together airsick, did nit!! Jake was a tremendous narrator/historian of the area.Landing on top of the mountain in the rainforest was truly a once a lifetime treat! Eldwin, the horticulturist was there to meet us and give us a  walking tour of the area. We learned so much about the trees, flowers and past history there....and we loved his great "vibe"! Being able to see the beautiful  coast , waterfalls and where they filmed scenes from jurassic park by helicopter was spectacular. Maverick  rates an A+
the pilot was friendly and professional and explained the route. I saw colors and whales and the experience was amazong

review_title: What a unique and beautiful way to see the waterfalls!
review_text: We had an unbelievable adventure! We weren't sure what to expect, especially with a 7-year-old who is a little afraid to try new things, but John (our pilot) was incredible! He made everyone feel at ease and did a wonderful job showing us all the waterfalls (and even sea lions) on our journey. Highly recommend if you want a non-traditional way to see a beautiful section of the PNW.

Best experience, last minute booking and very very fair price. We we're looling for a last minute birthday gift and we found sea plane through trip advisor. We booked and flew to Bimmini for the day and took also tje private tour through the island. Best experience ever !!! Thank you tripadvisor and big thank you to Toni !!!

Wow. Wow. Wow. Viewing Denali and other majestic peaks, with a glacier landing to the south…words are inadequate, you just have to experience it. Our pilot Chris gave us an unforgettable perspective and also really impressed us with his knowledge of glaciers and mountains and the forces that shape them.

Working with Redtail Aviation was fantastic. Period.  Their service is impeccable!  I was planning a trip for my boss (he needed to charter a flight from Salt Lake City to Moab) and Cindi at Redtail saved my life!  Everything was super easy, and they were very accommodating. I'd recommend to anyone.

review_title: Must do when near San Fran!
review_text: The guide as well as ride was amazing!  Truly worth your time and money!  A must do when near San Fran.  It was one of the best parts of our honeymoon stay!

review_title: Rafting trip pickup out of Hite
review_text: Excellent pilot. Had great tour over the Colorado River on our way back to Moab from a 5 day rafting trip. Joshua was a polite and informative pilot! Thanks for the amazing experience!

Flying over the Denali National Park and landing on the glacier close to highest mountain of North America is definitely a lifetime experience.

The trip is very expensive but worthful. We selected K2 because it is very friendly and flexible. We know sometime the weather could be bad and you could not flight out or see much over the cloud, and K2 gave us call about the weather and the choice for other flight. It is also very family friendly.

Although the flight is only 1 and half hour, you need prepare half day for the waiting and preparing. Please call them check the weather early.

review_title: Fantastic way to view the island of Kauai at a great price!
review_text: We are a family with 4 children ages 12 to 19 and spent a week on Kauai.  We really wanted to do an air tour with our kids but the cost of a helicopter flight would have been well over $1,000.00.  We saw a brief introduction to Air Ventures and it seemed interesting so we decided to look into it some more.  A few people discouraged us from doing the plane trip as opposed to the helicopter because the planes "do not get as close" to the features as the helicopters do.  Well, we decided to roll the dice and go with the plane tour which was less than half the cost!!!  For a family of 6, cost is a very important factor.  I was concerned we would spend the money and be disappointed.  Boy was I wrong.  This trip was phenomenal.  My wife and I had been on a helicopter tour in the past so we definitely know the difference.  What we found is actually the opposite of conventional wisdom.  By not going quite as close to the features we were able to get a much bigger picture of the landscape and actually enjoyed the tour more than the helicopter trip we had done a few years ago.  The plane got surprising close to the features and the landscape and it went slow enough we were able to get great photos and take in the views.  If we had it to do over again, we would definitely go this route.  It was a fantastic time for everyone and the cost made it much more bearable on my wallet.  Highly recommended.

It was amazing! Our flight took us through the mountains and we were lucky enough to see Mt McKinley and land on Ruth Glacier! It was breathtaking and a must do if you are visiting Talkeetna! Suzanne, thank you so much for this experience, it was one I will never forget! Many thanks to our pilot Patrick as well, who was a fabulous tour guide!
Beautiful weather gave us great views around the island of Kauai. Very professional company.  JT is an amazing pilot.

What an incredible day 
The Grand Tour by TAT was over the top beautiful stunning bucket list worthy
The people that work here are all awesome
Annie- what can I say but you are so terrific
Our pilot was great and took as to all sides of Denali
Landed us beautifully near their in Little Switzerland on a glacier
Gorgeous day fabulous 2 hour flight
Highly recommend this excellent company
Super fabulous trip. The pilot was very informative. I highly recommend this.  It was really beautiful.

review_title: The staff was amazing and Brian, the pilot was wonderful.
review_text: I highly recommend this service. The flight was great!!! The pilot, Brian was extremely nice and very knowledgeable of the island.

Perfect Bay Area sightseeing trip.  I’m a pilot, so a plane tour is right up my alley.  Took my fiancée, who is a bit nervous about flying, and she LOVED it too.  Excellent way to spend a offload a good chunk of money, ha.

What an adventure, a 2-hour flight trip from Talkeetna, about 185 miles around Mt. McKinley on August 6, with clear skies! It couldn't get any better! We had a very smooth ride in a 6-passenger plane, everyone with their own window. And the pilot made sure that both sides could see everything.

Just like the Grand Canyon, you have to get up close to experience it all fully! Taking the Denali Grand Tour all the way around Mt. McKinley with the Glacier Landing is definitely worth the extra cost! We took movies on our camera and glad we did!

This is a once-in-a-lifetime adventure we'll never forget!

This was by far the best part of our four-month trip around the Yukon and Alaska. If you get a chance to get on one of these planes, especially on a really clear day, your trip to Alaska will be a success!
Where do we even start ! Not only are the views beautiful but the team is the kindest group of people you will meet! It’s everything you could ask for ! Def a must do !

review_title: The only way to see the real Kauai!
review_text:
This was our second visit to Kauai, and had not planned on taking any special tours. However, after hearing about Air Ventures and seeing the brochure, we changed our minds, and had some friends join us.  It was incredible!  The pilot was super -- starting the trip by taking our photo in front of the plane (with our own cameras!).   He was very informative, yet didn't talk so much as to distract from the flight.   

Our only negative comment:  that we didn't do this earlier in our trip! If we had, then we'd have known about the 9-hole golf course that only costs $9/day to play! 

We took a helicopter tour the first time we came to Kauai, and can honestly say this was better -- and cheaper!   

Thanks for a memorable trip!!

A must
Must do if you are on the island. Loved Kevin the pilot. Very knowledgeable and informative. A while different way to experience the island! DO IT!!

Wonderful, awe inspiring. Do It! Will be back next year. Love the boat tour of misty fiords also. Don’t miss the bear tour with Alaskan rainforest adventures. Ask for Allie as you tour guide. Outstanding guide.

This company was so cooperative and friendly!  The pilot was very knowledgeable with pointing out the sights. Do not miss the glacier landing! It is a must! They went over and above to insure a wonderful experience.

I would really recommend this tour in Moab. I wasn't sure if 15min ride would be long enough so we booked the 30 min flight and that was just right. Seemed longer once your in the air. My son is getting his pilot license and really wanted to experience a tail-wheel plane. The pilot really showed us some sights and talked with my son about his flying experience and technical aspects of the flight. They provide good headsets to cut out the noise and being in the open cockpit is awesome. The pilot compared the engine to a harley the way it sounded when first started.

review_title: Amazing way to see the crater
review_text: Eric provided a fantastic experience on the custom tour. The views were amazing of the crater and would highly recommend the trip to anyone.

got to sit in copilots seat and got some great shots with my DSLR, landed on the glacier and didn't fall into a fissue and die, which apparently can happen. Nobody puked, no turbulence, Chris I think was our pilot, he was super nice. The mask stuff was pretty dumb though since the plane isn't pressurized, its like being outside.

review_title: As good as reviews said it would be
review_text: I was a little tentative to get on a small plane but Bruce made this an unbelievable experience for my husband and I. The flight was much smoother than I anticipated. This is a must do while on Kauai!
Eric loves his work and is a great pilot. Definitely one of the most exciting holiday experiences ever. Everything was easy and straightforward but spectacular!

This was the first thing my wife and I did when we got on island.  We referred to it as our "orientation flight" because we could physically see everything and decide what we wanted to visit and what we didn't.  Best money we spent in Kauai.  We were able to see all the hot spots including but not limited to the Na Pali coast and of course Waimea Canyon.  Friendly staff.  Overall great experience.  Military discounts are available.

Was lucky enough for perfect weather. Great customer service and pilots. Unbelievable beauty flying around Denali and landing on Ruth Glacier. As we were flying through the mountains, it almost seemed you could reach out and touch them. Landing on the glacier, getting out of the plane seemed like standing on top of the world.

Eric of Maui Plane Rides gave us the opportunity of a life time to see Maui from a bird's eye perspective and actually fly the plane. He had the second steering wheel of course, and he's an experienced flight instructor but still I could feel the wings and the balance and the movement. Being a copilot is a zen experience. I will never forget seeing a huge forty-foot humpback diving just beneath the water at 800 feet. We coasted by the Molokai sea-cliffs and landed on the remote peninsula of Kalaupapa where a single runway extends almost to the splashing waves and the entire airport is run by one hyper-energetic guy on a walkie talkie. On the way back we switched seats to give my wife and our friend a chance to fly the plane. Eric was a great guide with lots of Aloha and lots of pride in his craft. We flew back to Maui and felt we had been in another world for an hour. Highly recommend.

review_title: This was a once in a lifetime experience!
review_text: The view and experience were superb. The helicopter and boat ride add a dimension to the Grand Canyon that are beyond expectation.  Rob, our pilot was fantastic.  This day trip was Great!

I was on the island of Oahu, Hawaii when my plans to visit Pearl Harbor fell through.  I didn’t want to waste one day of our two week vacation and so I decided to research how I could visit Kauai for one day. You may think that is a ridiculous idea however, once I found Air Ventures Hawaii and spoke to a representative early Wednesday morning to secure the proper flight times for Thursday I decided to book a flight to Lihue via Southwest.  We arrived at noon and our Air Ventures flight was booked for 1:30pm.  The cost was $337.08 (two passengers) for one hour.  This flight was definitely longer, less expensive, and more beautiful than our helicopter tour that we took a few days prior to this adventure.  Trisha and her assistant greeted us with a warm Aloha and they were extremely professional and helpful.  I am happy that they informed us about paying $30.00 to capture the GoPro footage of our one hour flight.  The footage from the NaPali Coast was unbelievable yet stunning!   It is well worth the money.  
Prior to boarding we were weighed and seated in a nice open air waiting room.  I would suggest that a few hours prior to the flight that you take Dramamine to ensure you will not experience any motion sickness.  I always practiced this so I didn’t have any problems on the flight.  I believe only one passenger was somewhat ill.  I think this is important because the flight is absolutely breathtaking and you simply don’t want to be ill while enjoying such an unimaginable view.  Please be mindful that Air Ventures Hawaii has no control over Mother Nature and sometimes a few bumps might occur throughout the flight.  
Nate was our pilot.  I must admit that this guy was stellar!!!  First, he has the best personality.  He welcomed us aboard as guests, explained all safety precautions, told us exactly what would happen while in flight, and even explained what we would see while on the trip.  In addition, he was a skilled aviator that paid attention to the details of safety and also provided valuable information at the same time.  I am very happy that Air Ventures Hawaii takes passenger safety seriously.  
In addition to being a good aviator the pilot did an excellent job of explaining all the different sights that we saw during the flight.  I must admit that I love seeing the Grand Canyon of the Pacific and the waterfalls however, the NaPali Coast is a sight to behold.  Nate indicated that the NaPali Coast is considered one of the most beautiful coastlines in the world.  I agree with him unequivocally!! My eyes have not seen such natural uninhabited beauty like that since visiting Bora Bora in 2007.  The beauty of the NaPali Coast is the best reason to take this flight.  In addition, if you can only spend a day on the island it will take two hours to reach the NaPali Coast and I believe much of it cannot be reached by foot.  I believe seeing the coastline from the air is unexplainable in words and unimaginable even when you see it.  Bucket list for sure!!!!!
Our day trip to Kauai was stellar because my son and I had an opportunity to see all of the natural beauty of Kauai from the sky.  If you are in search of seeing unexplainable and breathtaking beauty I would suggest Air Ventures Hawaii.  Nate was an exceptional pilot and I feel I received everything that I paid for and more.  Thanks Nate for being a wonderful host and helping my son and I make beautiful memories.  We will forever remember the time we spent over the NaPali Coast because of you!  Mahalo for everything!!!! You represent Air Ventures Hawaii well!!! Keep up the great work!

Originally going to take the helicopter tour but changed our mind after seeing some of the review and glad we made the change. Airplane tour fly a lot high up for an overall stunning views and most important much more comfort seats. Recommend to go with early tour (we went for the first tour of the day) if possible that way it is less busy and guarantee a good view and lots of amazing pictures.

On November 26th we enjoyed the awesome experience of seeing the island of Kauai on Air Ventures Hawaii.  This is the only way to see the entire island.  The pilot did an excellent job keeping the plane smooth and narrating about all the sites we flew over.  We flew over mountain tops viewing several magnificent waterfalls, valleys, beaches, coffee fields, golf courses, and the cliffs.  There are 25 miles of coastline that is only accessible by boat or air.  At this time of year the ocean waves are quite high.  This is the only way to see the cliffs in their full spectrum, they were spectacular.  This is a must do activity on Kauai.

Over the years we have taken several aerial tours. The biplane tour has been the best by far. The pilot covered parts of the island we have never seen before and was very knowledgeable of the different areas.
It’s my wife’s birthday and we had an incredible time with Davi’s the pilot. Amazing and highly recommend it!
We had a wonderful experience. The weather was excellent, and our pal it was even better if we could give him a six star we would definitely worth the trip.

review_title: Neets Bay Bear Watch by Floatplane
review_text: This was an amazing tour! We were picked up from our cruise ship in a bus and taken to the floatplane dock. The floatplane pilot was very professional and pointed out all the interesting view points along the way. On arrival to Neets Bay our guide walked us along a short track to the bear hide, where we sat and waited for the bears to come. There were plenty of eagles flying around and the salmon were swimming upstream but not a bear in sight! Everyone was very patient and just as we were about to leave a black bear appeared! It was a fair distance away however I was very happy to say I saw a bear. The floatplane pilot took us back a different way so we were able to see more of the beautiful landscape.
Excellent experience seeing Kauai from the air.  Great service and nice narration by pilot Paul.  Nice combo with Kauai land tour.
Steve was fantastic! I'm afraid of heights and he made the experience smooth and enjoyable. 100% recommend!
We flue for half an hour, all over south beach and N.Miami and over a nice island. The pilot was great! Everything was great!!

We had a two day visit to Denali and after having limited peak viewing at the park, we decided to book the air tour with glacier landing.  It became the highlight of our trip. The views of Denali were amazing

review_title: Great value for money and very friendly
review_text: We flew on 8th April and have to say this was a real highlight of our trip. We chose the small plane instead of a helicopter tour as we wanted to fly with our 2 year old. Right from the off they were very helpful, provided ear defenders for our daughter and the service felt very personal without being intrusive. Extras like the free photo and lai were very much appreciated. We purchased the DVD and are now enjoying it all over again. Would definitely recommend.

Took a super trip to the canyon with Eric as our pilot. Full day with spectacular canyon views, helicopter drive to the bottom of the canyon and short boat trip. Best way to maximize activities and experiences on a short vacation. Thank you Meg and Eric.

review_title: Great way to see Moab’s terrain
review_text: Recommended by a friend and it did not disappoint! Amazing to see the beautiful landscape from the sky. Connor was an excellent pilot and the flight was smooth and enjoyable. Would highly recommend!

review_title: The Best Alaskan Experience Out There
review_text: Great professionalism and unsurpassed scenery.  Pay the extra fee for the glacier landing. I grew up in Alaska and have visited Denali Park at least 30 times. Nevertheless, I'd never seen it from the air.  The airplane was marvelously stable and smooth - takeoff and landing were more smooth than a commercial jet. The views make you feel so small as the pilots wends his way through glaciated valleys and snow bound peaks. A true adventure and worth every penny. Don't come all the way to Alaska and miss this!!!!

I'm a Moab resident and took a tour with my out-of-state family…it was INCREDIBLE.  I highly recommend the National Parks tour, especially over Canyonlands, as you’ll see geologic features from the plane that you might never see otherwise.  Our pilot, Chris, was exceptionally knowledgeable.  We had requested the front seat for one of our party and Redtail was only too happy to accommodate (first come or ask/first served).  Thank you, Redtail!

We don't usually spend this kind of money (about $550 for 2) on an hour and an half activity, but this was well worth it.  My husband and I were in a tiny plane with just the pilot to fly over the south face of Mt. McKinley.  We paid extra for the landing on the glacier, which was so cool, very soft landing and neat to walk around there.  It was the highlight of our trip.  Our pilot, Will, was great.

We had a WONDERFUL times on our tour. We went on the "airbus" tour with our pilot Marcus! He was so great!  The views were the most beautiful I've ever seen, Marcus was interesting and funny! They sent us a video of our tour which I will force all of my family to watch! Such a great experience. We highly recommend!

review_title: The only way to see the canyon!
review_text: We scheduled our day tour with Westwind up to the canyon. We had been to the canyon before by train and by private car. The air tour is the best way to see it because they fly directly over the canyon, both north and south rims. Everyone at Westwind was professional, extremely friendly...from the office staff to the pilots and tour guides. We had Carla for our guide and she was wonderful. This was a great tour overall with the flight up, the landing at the airport, the 3 hour stay at the canyon, including lunch...and more touring, then back to the airport for our return trip to Phoenix. I would highly recommend this tour! Absolutely the best way to see the canyon! Thank you Jim and Dave for safe flights to and from! Loved, loved, loved your service!
This tour not only helped me achieve one of my bucket list, but it helped me create a memory that shall last a lifetime!  Thanks Talkeetna Air Tour!!
We had a lovely time flying with Dorothy. Though our original route into Denali was cancelled, going over the Talkeetna mountains was amazing, and the ride was completely smooth.
The tour was awesome and worth every penny spent! Out guide Anthony was very friendly and offered great narrative throughout the trip! Highly recommended.

review_title: Best Family Oriented TOUR on the kauai.
review_text: We LOVED it! Capt. Bruce and "Aunt Ellen" were great. They took care of us so well. A lot of companies treat you bad when you get a "deal", because they say, "YOU GET WHAT YOU PAY FOR".  Well, they did not, they were still so caring, kind, and understanding. We had 3 kids under 11 yrs. old. (a 4 and 5 yrs. old ). Any one with young ones, know  how tough this be.  This family was great, before, during and after the tour.  BTW, the tour itself was phenomenal. It was truly a great way to see the island. Thank you so very much!! Highly recommended for families with young ones. If you want to be treated like family rather than just a number!! MAHALO, HOPE TO BE BACK AGAIN!!!

Awesome experience of flying with Talkeetna Air Taxi. All the representatives were very helpful, warm and welcoming. Pilot was very friendly, explained everything about the trip, Denali mountains etc., also, patiently answered all the questions that we had. They picked us from our hotel and also dropped us to the area of our choice, hence it was very convenient for us as we didn't have any car and quite a bit of luggage. Overall, we feel that we made the right choice to fly with Talkeetna Air Taxi, would love to visit again.

Took my grandkids 👩🏻‍🤝‍👨🏼👨🏽‍🤝‍👨🏾across country on a Nana trip from GA to CA & of course the Grand Canyon was on the list. I was not sure about the small craft flight, plane ✈️ they had all flown in a larger aircraft, but smaller planes are different but everybody did  well! Captain Jack gave us a beautiful & inspiring view of the Grand Canyon 🏔 departing from the southern rim up to the snow covered north rim. Everyone at home was asking me was it worth the $$ for the air tour and I say it definitely was! There is no way to grasp the grandeur & beauty of the canyon except from the air!!! I have visited before but this was the best!!! 🏆

my daughter and me took this flight in sept 2015 is was a great flight pilot was friendly shows us water falls the coast so when we came back to hawaii with my son in sept 2019 we did it again we so many water falls the second time  any got an hour it is worth the money
Wow what an amazing flight! Steve was an excellent pilot and knowledgeable about the 5 islands as well. My family could not have had a better experience!

This was an awesome tour! It was a cloudy afternoon when we went up. We got to see the top of Mt McKinley through the clouds.  We landed at a base camp because of the weather but it was still amazing.  The views were breathe taking!
this was fascinating to see the islands from the air and get an entirely new perspective. our pilot was excellent and so much fun

It's great to wrap up my 5 day Kauai trip with an airplane ride that let's me reminisce all the activities I've done on this island. 80% of the island is only viewable from the air. So you'll be able to find out what's in the middle of Kauai which you can't access by driving or sea.
Bruce our pilot was extremely pleasant to be with and steady with the plane throughout.

For half the price of the helicopter ride, I think airplane view of Kauai (1 hour) is a steal!

There are many helicopter and plane tours you can take on Kauai.   We stumbled upon this one and it was fantastic.   They picked us (6) up near the cruise ship and we took a 1 - 1.5 hour tour of the island.   The Waimea canyon and Napali coast were the highlights of our trip to Hawaii.   Our pilot was very skillful and knowledgeable about the island.   The plane is very comfortable, air conditioned and has rounded windows for great views.   At $125 each it was WELL worth it and I would recommend Air Ventures to anyone.

review_title: Great trip, lots of interesting info and views
review_text: Bruce was our pilot and guide. He put us at ease very quickly and was very informative. He made us feel like an old friend. He is also very knowledgeable about the island, it's attractions and it's crops. Thanks

After poor weather cancelled our flight the first day, we were pleasantly surprised to get to fly the following morning.  Weather on the mountain was stunning, especially compared to the rainy gloom in Talkeetna.  We landed at base camp to pick up climbers - absolutely the best part of an already amazing experience.  Without a doubt, the best adventure of our entire week in Alaska!

Took our return trip back to Moab from Lake Powell after 4 days of rafting on the Colorado through Cataract Canyon. George was our pilot and was very friendly, professional, and knowledgeable about the area! Awesome views from above after experiencing it from the River!!!

If i can include more stars I would, my friend surprised me with this flight tour and it was the best surprise EVERRR 😊!The staff was friendly and kind.we had an incredible experience.Thank you so much 🙏

Great flight, interesting info from our pilot. My wife had injured her knee a few days before and he was very patient and helpful when she got on and off the aircraft. I would highly recommend this tour.

We went on the summit trip. It was a perfectly clear day. Our pilot was very knowledgeable and friendly. He made sure both sides of the plane could see everything. Gave us plenty of time on the glacier. I would definitely do this again!

We really enjoyed our flight over the Grand Canyon!  We did the 45 minute tour and loved everything about it!  Never been in a helicopter before but we felt totally at ease!  Our guide Alex was great! Lots of information and plenty of great photos and videos! Highly recommended!!
BJ our pilot was terrific and the views of the Canyon were amazing. Very professional and a once in a lifetime experience. If you are making the trip to the Canyon this is a must with Maverick

SeaWinds was awesome and super personable! I went on my Misty flight with only two other guests so I got to sit co-pilot for some extra special views. 

The tour was great and sights were pointed out to us along the way, but our pilot also just let us take all the amazing scenery in. 

Bonus points for two adorable doggie mascots!
