review_title: Heavenly views of Maui, Molokai Sea Cliffs
review_text: A must do while on Maui! If you are a pilot wanna be, and want to see some of the most incredible natural coastline views, Maui Plane Rides is the one! Eric our pilot was friendly, helpful and a great pilot instructor. I would recommend them to anyone!

My wife and I flew with Eric our pilot over Kauai and had the most wonderful time, Eric is very knowledgable and has a great sense of humor. All the office girls are wonderful also: (Casey and Jill). I highly recommend going with Air Ventures on your flight over Kauai.

I cannot say enough about how great our flight was. Bruce and Caitlin were very friendly and were very genuine about making sure we had a great flight.  My family of 4 were the only ones on the tour. They had water and Sprite on the plane. The views of the coastline were just breathtaking. Our 7 and 9 year olds enjoyed it as well.  A cool addition was that they had go-pros on the wings so you can purchase an edited video of your tour. Would highly recommend this tour to anyone looking for an air tour of the island!

June 21 8:30am Grand Denali flight was amazing, awesome, beautiful.....! Brad was our pilot and did an outstanding job. It was a beautiful clear day so the summit was in full view. Amazing seeing the base camp and trails of the climbers. Glacier landing was pretty cool. Flight was very smooth. Highly recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi. It was the highlight of our entire trip.

The plane had seats for 6 people, each had their own large bubble window, so taking pictures was great.  The pilot was very informative, we had earphones so the noise was almost entirely eliminated!  Great flight.

Outstanding flight and experience for our entire family.  Even our 6 year old enjoyed the flight.  Harry, the pilot, did a great job showing us Kauai from the air in a relaxed and informative way.  We had been on the island for several days when we took the flight and had already seen some of the sights; however, seeing them from the air was a thrill.  We even saw some whales breaching and playing on the ocean surface.  This flight is cheaper than a helicopter ride and I recommend it to anyone.

My husband and I did a heli-hike this morning. The pilot, Will, flew us out and dropped us off in the Talkeetna Range. Will was very nice! On the way back, he helped us spot moose and caribou, as well as views of Denali.
Matt, our pilot, did a great job. Our flight was over Denali and the entire South facing range. The base operations were efficient and staff well trained.

Highly recommend this tour.  Captain Bruce did a great job.  I normally suffer from air sickness but this ride was so smooth, I felt nothing.  Unfortunately the weather changes quickly so we were unable to fly over the Napali Coast but Bruce still gave us a fantastic tour.

Air Ventures Hawaii is the best way to see all of Kauai.  Paul, our pilot, was very informative and friendly.  Plane was comfortable, it did get a little hot but it was abnormally hot on Kauai the week I was there.  This was part of our land, air and sea package.  Beautiful views and we got to see Pierce Bronson's house. LOL    A little rainbow followed us part of the way.  Too cool!   Would do it again!!  Thanks to all, Tina
We loved our flight and even though Eric encountered bad weather he kept it very entertaining and fun.

This was a trip taken with Steve's Best of Kauai....and Air Tours on Wednesday... September 26, 2012 ...one day before my birthday.... My husband and I enjoyed this  AirVenture ride! ....This was my first time in a small plane and I made it OK!  The scenery was simply beautiful. This will be a most unforgetable experience  on my first trip to Kauai, Hawaii.

Thank you for this one experience that was  on my bucket list,

Arlena Dean
PO Box 1904
Broken Arrow, OK 74012

Eric is the smoothest pilot !!! I’m afraid of heights but with Eric I felt safe and really enjoyed my ride 
I highly recommend this to anyone visiting Maui
We took the glacier landing flight and have to say it was the highlight of our trip!   Great pilot, very accommodating to get pictures, felt very safe.

we felt very safe on our flight and the company takes safety very seriously. Our pilot was nice and knowledgeable. Unfortunately it was too cloudy to see Mt McKinley on the day of our flight but the other sights were amazing.
Our Pilot was the most helpful, profesional and fun we had on the Island. We loved our 8 yr son had the best time in his life!!!

review_title: Beautiful view of the most beautiful state.
review_text: Our weather wasn't perfect for a glacier landing but our pilot made up for this with a tour of absolutely amazing views.  And what a pilot!  Such a smooth ride.  We would recommend this company for anyone considering a flight from Talkeetna.  Very professional.

Best decision ever and worth every penny! Great plane, outstanding pilot (Kevin), great weather and the breathtaking beauty of the Island of Kaua'i. What else could you be asking for? I had a great time and would recommend this trip to everybody! One hour of pure fun!

We thoroughly enjoyed our one hour flight over this beautiful island. Our pilot Kevin was great. Lots of commentary so we knew what we were looking at. He told us a little of the history of the island. The views are just spectacular. We took the 0830 slot and am glad we did as it was a beautiful clear day. I sat up front as co pilot! If you are taking a lot of photos I suggest you sit at the back as the light from the sun hitting the wings casts white blobs on your images. May not happen if you are later in the day but then you have clouds to contend with. Lots of waterfalls to see and the Na Pali coast is breathtaking. We saw two humpbacks frolicking  below.  We booked through Air Venture direct and saved $40! Highlight of our trip to Kauai. Many thanks Kevin for a great tour.

Taking a plane ride with air ventures in Kauai, hawaii was truly a memorable experience. Paul was our pilot and flew all over Kauai to show us the beauty of that island.Paul explained alot of "history" of the island and explained what we were seeing while flying.The Napali coastline and the canyon were unbelievable.I recommend this experience to everyone wanting to see an entire island while visiting for a short time.

Took friends from Texas to K2 for a Denali Flight on 28-August-2017.   It was an outstanding experience in all aspects.  

The weather mostly cooperated, but the top 25% of the moutain was fogged out, so we had to choose a different route than originally scheduled.  The pilot went out of his way to show great vistas and scenery.  

While Denali / McKinley was somewhat clouded in, the surrounding peaks and area were crystal clear and the scenery was stunning.
Everyone was FANTASTIC to deal with at Wings Over Kauai!  My wife and I loved it so much that our two kids and their friends also booked trips!  They also LOVED it!!!
Pilot was amazing and we had an amazing time. He explained all the islands very well and answered all of our questions. Would totally book again!
Absolutely fabulous!!  10 stars. Exceeded our expectations!  If you are unsure, just book it. I promise you will love it!

review_title: A unique adventure you'll never forget!
review_text:
We had an amazing time going up in the "Red Baron" biplane for a soaring journey over most of Kauai.

Our pilot, Kevin, was extremely friendly and full of great facts and information during our journey.  Needless to say, he was an excellent pilot, providing a smooth and comfortable ride.  

What a thrilling journey, with absolutely breath-taking views of the stunning Kauai!  It was a blast seeing so many sights we had already visited from an entirely new point of view.

Highly recommended!

Amazing experience, great views. 
Highly recommend. 
Leslie was very accommodating and let us change tours when there was not much chance to see bears. Super friendly team, would book with this company again. Family loved the tour, even a very hard to please son.

Great pilot!    Saw absolutely beautiful scenes!   Waterfalls were flowing and gorgeous!   Pilot was extremely friendly and helpful.    we also did a land tour of the gorge and this proved to be another way to view the area’s beauty!

We had a wonderful experience with Wings Over Kaui. From the first phone call everyone we dealt with was pleasant and helpful. I don't really like to fly so I was nervous about being on a small plane. I'm so glad I was being brave for my husband's sake. It was fabulous! We had a beautiful clear morning and it was magical. Kaui is so beautiful and you must see it from the air. The flight was very smooth and Josh gave great commentary. It is obvious that he loves Kaui and by the end of the flight you will too.
Make sure you get the DVD. It will be a great reminder of paradise when you go back to the real world.

For a little while, I felt luke a bird as i soared through the skies of Lauai. The world around me was new at this level - a truly delicious banquet for my eyes! Thank you Air Ventures for a his truly amazing experience!

review_title: Seeing the Island as never before!
review_text: We have been to Kauai before and love the island, This time we took the air tour with Air Ventures. What a great choice. Harry our pilot was great. The island holds so many magical and majestic beauties. A must for any visitor to the Island of Kauai..

We chose Wings over Kauai based on their reviews on Tripadvisor, great ratings and reasonably priced. It was a good decision.
We booked the first flight in the morning @ 9:30 as per their recommendation, Josh was our pilot.  He was an excellent pilot and had very good knowledge of the island.  We saw couple of whales during our tour. It was amazing to see the island from the air. Breathtaking!!! 
A must  do tour in Kauai.

We took the around Denali flight over an hour on a beautiful day. Perfect weather ,great pilot "Nick". When we got there there were some questions as to if we should take this more expensive option.  Take it if it is a clear day . Nine passenger piper chieftain and no one said a word we were so enthralled by the view. The turns into the passes between the peaks and glacier below said it all.

At the time of booking, we were debating about the drive and cost. But believe me it was worth every penny. Topping that was the friendly staff, awesome pilot from Florida Prof. Melissa. She was an excellent guide and kept the trip lively. Smooth landing, history tour. Overall a great experience.
Enjoy the nature while you can.

We loved our day of flight seeing. Our pilot Sam was informative, funny and a pleasure to fly with. The bears, whales and the views were extodinary. My wife and I would highly recommend this excursion!

Paul was our pilot and I was seated in the co-pilot's position. The flight was an excellent way to see the island's inaccessible areas and see the contrasting landscape. We were comfortable in the aircraft during a smooth flight. The pilot was always safety conscious about the passengers and other aircraft, while giving in-flight descriptions of our travels. Later, on the ground, I was amazed how much quieter this fixed wing is compared to the noisy helicopters. As a tourist, this is certainly the less intrusive way to explore the island.

What an incredible way to see all of the island, especially the waterfalls, the Napali Coast, and the North Shore. We were staying in Poipu and could pick out our condo from the air, as well as see all the way we had walked a couple days before from the Hyatt to Gillens Beach. Tunnels Beach and its reef as well as Waimea Canyon also stood out as aerial viewing treats.

All 4 passengers were on the right side of the plane, so everyone could see everything, and all had unobstructed viewing out the large windows. We had a lovely day, and Josh our pilot was first rate. We got a free DVD at the end, with our picture on it in front of the plane. Just one word of caution to those who get motion sickness. I don't, and thought the flight was pretty smooth, but my husband had taken 2 Bonine and even so was a little queasy by the end of the one hour flight.

My husband and I flew with Bruce of Wings Over Kauai during our honeymoon in Novemer 2011. It was all around an amazing experience! Ellen coordinated everything for us and made the whole process very easy. Bruce was an excellent pilot and made everyone feel very comfortable. He talked about the history of the island, the types of trees/plants we were looking at, all of the different areas we flew over, and even pointed out some "star's" homes. We had some clouds and a little rain that morning before the flight (as is to be expected in Kauai - that's why it's so green!), but it turned out to be beautiful! This is definitely the way to go if you want to see Kauai from the air! Thank you to Bruce and Ellen for a wonderful and memorable experience in Kauai!
Fun and awe inspiring experience...highly recommend. Another item checked off my bucket list  Great views of the canyon and surrounding rim.

The employees of Talkeetna Air Taxi are courteous, helpful, professional people.  Our flight was a great sight-seeing adventure.  Landing on the glacier was AMAZING!  To stand on a glacier and look up at Denali so close is truly amazing.  This is a great experience that should not be missed on any trip to Alaska.

We were scheduled for the Denali Flyer with glacier landing. Clouds socked in few passes, but our pilot found alternates and got us some good sightseeing, even though we could not see Denali or complete the glacier landing. They credited us back a portion of the fare.   So, instead of a busted trip we had excellent glacier and mountain viewing.

OUTSTANDING!  Great pilots and excellent customer service.  A trip of lifetime! Highly recommend!!!!  The pilot was super on answering questions about what we were looking at and great at trying to provide us the most spectacular tour.

This is my third flight with Friday Harbor Seaplanes and my favorite way to get back to the island. These flights never disappoint! I highly recommend this company if you have the opportunity to visit Friday Harbor or wherever they fly. The pilot, Jason, is the best! Everyone who works there is friendly and very efficient. They never disappoint. Treat yourself!

We did the Denali experience with a landing on the Eldridge Glacier and I can confidently say it was in the top 5 experiences of my life. I felt like a child again soaring past sheer granite cliff faces, and my little brain marvelled at the incomprehensible majesty of the landscape surrounding us. The landing was amazing, and I have loved re-living it with photos, videos, and the story of this amazing experience. The pilot was knowledgeable and made us feel very safe and I would highly recommend this trip.
Eric was very friendly and had a lot of knowledge to share about the islands. The views were spectacular.

review_title: One of the best things we did on our trip to Kaua!
review_text: The 5 of us totally enjoyed the flights and sights of the trip.  Desi was extremely knowledgeable as well as entertaining as she narrated the sights of Kauai.  I would recommend using Air Ventures without hesitation to anyone.
K2 was great. Terrific plane, pilot and trip. This flight with the glacier landing was the highlight of our 10 days in Alaska.
This was definitely a once in a lifetime experience for our anniversary. It was amazing. It's a must do. Eric our pilot was awesome and my husband even got to fly the plane. So awesome

review_title: Once the rain cleared, blue skies, sunshine and stunning views.
review_text: K2 Aviation was so accommodating and worked with us due to weather delays. Our flight with Chris was amazing and the majesty of the Alaska Range, breathtaking. Highly recommend flying with K2.
Wow wow wow!!!! What an amazing experience!!!!!   Once in a lifetime worth every dollar!!!!  Eric was outstanding

Wonderful adventure.  This was one of the highlights of our trip.  It is so well worth it.  TAT is so well run.  Everything went smoothly.  The trip was so exciting and the landing and take-off on the glacier was amazing.  Our pilot, Trent, was informative and friendly as well as a great pilot.  If you go to Alaska, this is a must-do adventure!
Great time. We were lucky the weather cleared up.  The pilot was awesome and knowledgeable. The Glacier landing was a once in a lifetime experience.

Very windy day we scheduled.  Pilot, Parker, said we could go, but we'd have a better time next day.  He checked NOAA site.  They could have lost money, but valued our experience.
Parker sick the next day, so owner, Bruce, took us up in Cessna 172, (two maybe 3 small people max).  Best tour flight I've ever been on.  Bruce knew everything about the island.  Circled back so we could see a whale.  Lots of stories.   Answered all our questions.  Can't say enough good things about the company and the experience.  Would do it again.  Super friendly and safe.

We we treated to a exciting , beautiful trip on a plane ride around Mt Mckinley and glacier landing. Pilot was extremely friendly and skillful. Company did everything in their power to help change reservations for us and make our adventure successful. Highly recommend this company for your vacation.
Had a great time! Cool vintage plane! Perfect amount of time and narration. Oren was a clever guide. Highly recommend. Our teenager loved it.

If you are planning a trip to Moab to see the National Parks, you absolutely HAVE TO take a flight tour with Redtail. Sure the beauty of the red rocks in person are breathtaking but seeing them from above gives it all a whole new perspective! Jenny, in sales got us booked on a 30 minute flight over Arches for my daughters birthday. We showed up and checked in, staff was amazing, and friendly, made check in super easy. They gave my daughter a cute birthday bag of delicious cookies! We didnt wait long, and the Pilot, Dan, came and introduced himself, gave us some history of the airplanes and a wonderful tour. He was very thorough, and made it so fun for all of us. We got some amazing pictures, and we definitely will be recommending this to everyone!
Wonderful! Great views and information. A great pilot that was super fun and energetic. The sunset was beautiful!

My friends, a married couple, came up from Florida to visit us. He's an Air Force pilot with a lot of flying time; we met in pilot training.  He came up with the idea of taking the tour and set it up.  We were going to fly around McKinley and land on the nearby glacier.

We saw the weather getting worse the day of our planned trip and were apprehensive.  When we got there, the desk person confirmed our fears.  We wouldn't be able to go on the entire planned route.  They were clear on what they expected to be able to do and gave us the option of cancelling all together.  We went for significantly cheaper than the entire amount we'd planned to spend.

Our pilot, Gregg, was awesome.  He got us closer to the mountain than I expected.  He had great airmanship, able to tell whether it was safe to go down a certain valley or not.  We got to see a lot more than I expected, but I never felt unsafe.  He was a great tour guide, relating the history of the area and pointing out landmarks very naturally.

I couldn't have enjoyed it more.  Their planes are well maintained.  The pilot we flew with was awesome.  Their location is great.  I couldn't recommend this more!

We had a wonderful time on our flight with Wings Over Kauai! I had looked at helicopter tours as well, but we chose a fixed-wing flight because it's far safer (check out Kauai Underground Guide's table of helicopter tour fatalities, also because it's an awesome guide), it's half the price, and I had read reviews that the view you get from the helicopter tours is a 'luck of the draw' situation. 

We booked a 4 person AirVan Private Charter, the flight takes a sort of clockwise tour of the island so we were all seated on the left to ensure we all had excellent views. And excellent views we had! Whales, canyons, Na Pali coast, waterfalls, extinct volcanoes, river valleys...you name it, we saw it, and it was stunning. The bubble windows allow you to see below and above the plane, in addition to out to the side.

Bruce, a retired agronomist and our guide to the skies, seemed almost as excited to be on our flight as we were. He proved to be an incredibly talented pilot and knowledgeable (and entertaining) guide to the Garden Isle. I love flying, but my boyfriend and sister were a bit nervous about being in a small plane--if you are, don't let this stop you from booking with Wings Over Kauai! That was probably the smoothest flight I've ever been on.

During our booking process Ellen was extremely accommodating and responsive to emails. Our original tour date wound up being incredibly stormy, and we were able to reschedule for a sunny day. Do bear in mind that Kauai is subject to changeable and sometimes stormy weather, if it is not safe to fly your tour will be cancelled. Ellen will do all she can to reschedule your tour in such an event, but if your stay is short this may be difficult. So make sure you stay for awhile, because Kauai is absolutely amazing and a Wings Over Kauai flight shouldn't be missed!!

Omg it was such an amazing priceless experience! We took off during the sunset and the pilot extended our tour a bit more so we had extra time in the air. The owner and the pilot were extremely welcoming and friendly. I’m so glad I booked with them and their prices are very affordable. Definitely the best experience ever, completely worth it!

We had a beautiful day for seeing the mountains & our pilot was so helpful in pointing out the highlights & answering our questions. We were able to take many pictures, as we each had our own window. What a great way to begin our trip!

review_title: Awesome way to see the island
review_text:
Our round island flight was one of the highlights of our trip.  It was the perfect way to see the island and find out more about what we wanted to do and where we wanted to go.  I'd recommend it as a great way to start your Kauai trip.  
The company were professional and safety orientated, but it was done with humour to stop it being a boring lecture or OTT.  Kevin was our pilot and he was a wealth of local info, but wasn't over the top or too touristy.  The view was amazing, with loads of photo ops.  
I'd thoroughly recommend them and we'll be back again......
Fantastic experience, breathtaking scenery. Jesse was our pilot, very knowledgeable and informative. Was the highlight of our trip!

review_title: Awesome Denali Flight with Glacier Landing
review_text: Loved the trip and we managed to do a Glacier Landing and walk around. It is only from the air do you get a true appreciation of the scale and beauty of the various Mountain Ranges.
Amazing experience! Informative, exciting, comfortable and fun! We would highly recommend and only wish we would have brought a better camera!

Talkeetna Air Taxi was the highlight of our trip to Alaska!  Our pilot was Dan and he took his time explaining the geography. We also had plenty of time on the glacier landing for photos and checking it out.  We went above the clouds to see the peaks and it was breathtaking!  We felt safe and the customer service on the ground was also top notch.  I highly recommend doing this...worth every penny!!

We had a great flight and i have to say the whole operation is top shelf.
I can not wait to take another flight with Bruce and wings over Kauai.
It was amazing topography throughout the flight.

review_title: Spectacular Denali flight-seeing. Don't miss the opportunity!
review_text:
Seeing Denali from the ground is awesone - seeing it from the air is inspiring, truly hard to find the right words.
K2 is a well oiled machine and works a process that leaves nothing out.  From the moment you make your reservation, to the time you get off the plane returning from your trip - everything is explained in detail, and handled expertly.  These guys are pros!
Seeing the "great one" up close with a panoramic view at 15,000 feet, looking down at the terrain and different glaciers provides a view of how this terrain was formed for eons, AND JUST MAKES YOU SIT IN AWE.
Kudos K2 - truly a highlight of our trip!

I took the flight that landed on a glacier. The trip was everything I had hoped it would be and more. Both the office staff and pilot were helpful, kind and fun. The views were absolutely amazing. I would do it again in a heartbeat!!

Ray, our pilot, clearly loves his work. He gave us extra time....about 90 mins. Very knowledgeable with a great sense of humor. Well worth the cost. Kuaui is gorgeous from the air. Very enjoyable trip with a real Veteran. Thank you for your service, Ray, and a really nice morning trip!

review_title: Amazing, once in a lifetime flightseeing trip!
review_text: This flightseeing tour with subsequent glacier landing was one of the coolest things I have ever done in my life, and one of the few activities where the views and experience is worth every single penny. Captain Andy was both professional and jovial, and had nothing but wonderful things to say about Talkeetna Air Taxi - you could definitely tell he loves his job! On this flight alone I took nearly 500 photos, so that alone should tell what a phenomenal trip we had. Cannot recommend this flightseeing tour highly enough; there was literally no negative element of the trip, from start to finish.

Three brothers and wives flew south Denali. It was a magnificent view! Our pilot shared this was the best weather in a month! The young pilot's expertise started with the safety talk and just never let up!
He was terrific as a geology narrator and a historian. He was polite and answered  our many questions.
We got such great photos. It was a wonderful highlight of a great ten day vacation in Alaska.

I have travelled to many parts of the world but this 2 hour flight with TAT is THEE BEST experience I can ever recall. They are seasoned professionals that will greatly exceed your expectations. Make sure you have a clear day when you visit "the great one,"  McKinley! There are no words that describe the experience of walking on the glaciers our pilot landed on or seeing/touching the awesome peaks of this range of mountains. The photo opportunity is unbelievable. 

It cannot be improved on!!!!!!!!!!!

Worth every penny. Alaska is fortunate to have these wonderful folks with such a great mission - to share the beauty of Mt McKinley!!

We highly recommend the very personable experience we had with Wings Over Kauai.
Bruce and Ellen were very accomodating to us - allowing us to change flight day and time.  
Captain Bruce is a wealth of knowledge as he flies you over the island.
Our family really enjoyed it because they add so many personal touches.

Thanks Bruce and Ellen!

Toronto, Ontario

From start to finish it waa an outstanding experience. We took the flight to the west rim including the skywalk.  The flight was smooth and the views were amazing.  Narration was available in a variety of languages via headphones. Skywalk was really wonderful, and it was funny to watch the people who were really nervous about stepping on the glass. The photographers were very good for those who are interested in pictures. The 2nd stop on the shuttle bus was breathtaking and there was opportunity to do a little hiking.  This definitely was an experience and was worth every penny. Highly recommend

Not only was this a breath taking ride around Denali, Martha was such a pleasure to work with. What a sweetie! She spent a lot of time making sure our trip to Talkeetna was incredible. She must know EVERYONE in Alaska, because she had contacts name for everything we needed for our visit from Anchorage to Fairbanks. Thanks to her, we took the Winter Train on Alaska Railroad. Do not miss the flight around Denali and be sure to get on the train to Fairbanks! Send another big hug to Martha and and warm wishes to the entire team at Talkeetna Air Taxi!! THANK YOU!!!

review_title: First time ride on a helicopter
review_text: Not scared at all due to the professional pilot. The views were indescribable, great experience. Monsoon rain and fog had us postponed our date, company was flexible, no problem in accommodating us on another date. Once-in-a-lifetime experience.

review_title: Trip Miami - Key West - Everglades - Miami
review_text: Once in a lifetime experience!! We've had an amazing time with our pilot and tour guide Antonio, it felt like a two week holiday on a single day!

Our seaplane adventure was amazing and had Spectacular and breath taking views! The pilot was amazing and had a lot of experience including military flight training; that’s a plus! Check in was so easy. Nice and friendly staff. It was my children's first flight and they loved it. I think they are inspired to be pilots, especially my 12 year old daughter. She wants to be a fighter pilot now! We are definitely going again!
Fantastic day!  Fantastic views!  Fantastic experience!  We would do it again!  Saw whales, waterfalls, lava flows, fun!

review_title: Wonderful flight seeing of Misty Fjords
review_text: Since we were in Ketchikan on a sunny day, we decided at the last minute to book this flight.  The scenery was great, and the pilot experienced and competent.  The flight include a landing and take off from an inland lake.

This was definitely the highlight of our trip. Pilot Alex was fantastic. We had a great experience landing on Ruth glacier and getting some fantastic inflight views of Denali. You'll get to see 360 views of Denali. I highly recommend the glacier landing as it's a truly unique experience

Fred, our pilot was just the nicest.  He make sure the temperature in the helicopter was comfortable.  The background music that played as we approached the rim of the canyon added to the excitement.  It was the best and shortest 45 minutes we have ever spent.  Mark one off the bucket list, it is a must do experience.

We flew across many waterfalls, jungle scenery and amazing beach views! This trip is part of the Best of Kauai tour, which also includes an island tour and river boat cruise. Well worth the price. It's a whole day of Hawaiian history stories and dances. You learn the hula and have a wonderful lunch. The flight is absolutely amazing. Scenes of mountain ranges that are used in many movies including Jurassic Park. I highly recommend it. We got on the tour from the orientation at the Bali Hi Wyndham Vacation Resort. We loved every bit of it.

review_title: Amazing way to see the Canyon
review_text:
We booked our airplane tour online prior to travelling to America.  We arrived at the airstrip, checked in and waited for our plane in comfortable surroundings - it couldn't have been easier. 
Our flight was stunning - the views were awe-inspiring and the audio commentary was very informative.
A not to be missed trip at affordable prices.

We had a fantastic time with seaplane adventures. Everything was perfect from being transferred from Pier 39 to a wonderful,flight over than Francisco and the bay. In the Morning a guided flight in a seaplane with breathtaking views of the bay. Very friendly staff at seaplane adventures. In the  afternoon the visit to  Alcatraz made it a perfect day. Worth every Cent. If you plan a trip to,San Francisco, then do the Kombi-Tour..

review_title: Best Way to see ALL of KAUAI
review_text: We met our pilot at the Lihue airport. He was very professional and really knew his Kauai facts. The flight was just the right amount of time (about an hour in the air). I really don't like flying but our pilot was great and made us feel so comfortable that I was able to just relax and enjoy the tour. (I'm sorry I don't remember is name. I think he is a retired Doctor).

review_title: Fantastic Tour of all the must see places in one half day
review_text: My wife and I booked this tour in advance since we only had one day in the Moab area.  We were excited to discover that it is possible to see all of the biggies from the air without waiting in line to enter the Parks and driving from one to the next.  The adventure was so worth every penny we paid.  We had our own Cessna aircraft with Derrick Peterson as our pilot and guide.  He was extremely knowledgable about everything we saw (and it was a lot).  He skillfully piloted the plane to maximize our viewing opportunities at every site.  Since returning to our hotel, we are still excited about our adventure and are happy to share our memories with everyone.  We highly recommend this tour to everyone.

We did the 1.5 hour flight with the glacier landing.  Words cannot explain the beauty and splendor of  Mount McKinley up close and personal like this.  It was truly amazing.  Our pilot Michael was excellent and very knowledgeable about the area. He answered every question and was very knowledgeable. The rest of the staff were also very helpful and were very friendly and happy to help with anything that was needed.  I would say this was definitely the highlight of our trip.

This was the most awesome experience of a lifetime actually seeing stuff from the top of the world the glacier landing and walking was outstanding I would do it again in a heartbeat.  If we would not have done this we never would’ve been able to see Denali as we’ve seen it. I highly recommend it

This was outstanding!  The beauty of Misty Fjords is amazing. It was truly a thrill to see this pristine area. A special shout out to our pilot Chuck.  He provided excellent commentary and, when he spotted mountain goats on a hillside, flew by, then made a U turn so that people on both sides of the plane could see them.

Absolutely the best way to experience Denali!   You can see all sides of the mountain and glaciers.  We were unable to land due to recent snowfall but they were great about creditong back a portion. Our pilot was professional and confident - exactly what you want in a small plane pilot.   I had never been on a smaller prop plane like this. It seats 11 and everyone gets a window seat.  Windows are bubble shaped so you can really see all around.   The ride was smoother than I expected.  Commuter flights bounce you more than this one did.  It's an unforgettable experience. Alaska is enormous and trying to drive everyone doesn't give you a chance to experience enough.  This flight was the perfect way to see Denali!

We were so fortunate to take a tour to the Grand Canyon on our recent trip out to Phoenix.  From the initial booking with Lindsey to our wonderful pilot Daniel and tour guide Jeffrey (a Navajo Native American who was able to share his culture with us), everything was perfectly planned and executed. Daniel was a great tour guide in the air, showing us the red rocks of Sedona, Flagstaff, and of course around the Grand Canyon.  Jeffrey took us to several great viewing points along the south rim and was very knowledgeable.  We would definitely recommend to friends and family.

We are so glad we decided to do this. The view of Kauai from the air is amazing, especially the Napali Coast. Our pilot, Nick, was born on the island, and he did a great job describing the sights. Highly recommended!

We want to express our appreciation to Chip Sonn, our K2 pilot for our fantastic late afternoon/evening flight excursion while recently visiting Talkeetna, Alaska.  As part of our planned Land/Cruise tour, we did not want to miss this opportunity – and glad that we took the extra effort to reschedule through the cruise planning offices to get all 5 of us to be able to attend as a family together on this flight.  We flew across a varied array of physiographic regions in and around Denali Park while Chip extolled about a combination of historical/geological/topographical/mountain climbing/gold mining aspects related to this diverse region of Alaska.  Climbing in altitude up through the sinuous glacial flows between spired peaks for repeated glimpses of the great mountain – Denali was truly awe inspiring.  How many pictures is enough?  However, in all honesty, landing on the glacier with our wonderful pilot was truly the greatest event to remember as a family from our land/cruise tour from all of Alaska.  Standing together as a family in the quiet Pika Glacier valley with great spires around us and peacefully reflecting on family and life was truly one of those “Picture Perfect Moments” that we will treasure forever.  We all agreed during our ride back to the hotel, that this adventure would likely become our best family activity together for the entire 12 days of land and sea excursions – and now having completed our trip and returned home, we can confirm that this flight and landing on the glacier was indeed our best activity as a family together in Alaska.  The K2 planes are safely maintained and their staff and pilots are the greatest.  We had great peace of mind and felt very secure flying with Chip and the K2 family.  Thanks again for Chip’s time and talent for the great evening of flight together – one we will not forget!

review_title: Take this trip early in your visit!
review_text: Don't hesitate to do this! To see the island from above gives you such a new appreciation for Kauai - there is no way to see its beauty from the road or sea. This team is down to earth, friendly, & professional. Josh the pilot & Val are great!
Great trip.  Thoroughly enjoyed sight seeing Denali.   Flying was excellent.   Pilot was very  knowledgeable.

review_title: Forget the helicopter ride, take a Maui Plane Ride.
review_text: This was the absolute highlight of our trip. We booked with Eric through our condo concierge. As soon as we arrived we knew we were in for an amazing experience. Eric, the owner/operator shared with us that this was his dream and it totally shows. We got our preflight safety instruction and we're off the ground in less than 10 minutes. My husband who was sitting next to Eric even got to help take off and fly!  You can't say that with a helicopter tour. Eric was super knowledgeable about everything we were seeing, from the valley's to the breathtaking sea cliffs and even the last active leper colony! He checked with us frequently to make sure we were comfortable throughout the flight. This truly an unforgettable experience and something we will be telling everyone about. Thank you Eric for memories that will truly last a lifetime and thank you for sharing your passion and dream with us.

review_title: Magnificent Denali Flight-seeing Trip with Glacier Landing
review_text:
My wife and I with two friends to a Talkeetna Air Taxi plane ride around the mountains and glaciers near Denali.  The weather wasn't the best, but the pilot gave us all a wonderful scenic flight with great commentary and a glacier landing on Pika Glacier.  What an experience!!

Definitely well worth a stop when in Talkeetna.  We would absolutely do this trip again.

Professional, friendly, down-to-earth staff. Knowledgeable, competent pilot. Even though there were clouds around, breathtaking scenery and numerous photo ops. Felt very safe and comfortable the entire time.
We had a  great experience and enjoyed seeing the whales from the air. Our guide was helpful pointing out all the sites.

It was the best decision to take up this tour with them . Very experienced crew and very thorough planning for the flight keeping weather in mind and everyone’s safety . The pilot made sure we get the best views and pictures .
Amazing experience!  Eric was nothing short of amazing, he personalized the experience and made us feel more than welcome.  The views were spectacular!

This was a wonderful flight over the park and a sunny, clear view of the mountain! We were so lucky since our first flight six years ago was fogged out and no view at all! The pilot was knowledgeable and able to point out the interesting areas, including people who were climbing to the summit. We would do this flight again!

Due to weight restrictions, our flight was delayed until a smaller pilot could arrive. That was a blessing in disguise as both the weather improved, and we got Piper for our pilot. Piper was great! If you can have a choice of pilots, I'd choose her. Very knowledgeable. Very informative. Very fun. 
We saw the whole island and got great airel photos. 
The only complaint was an equipment issue with the headphones behind the pilots seat. It had a short, that made the narration cut in and out. 
Overall, I highly recommend this tour, and I can't say enough good things about our pilot, Piper.
The company is highly responsible and safe. Clean and neat flights. I loved the experience to be my first seaplane and sky tour of Seattle and the ocean towards Friday Harbor.

Our pilot was great. Too bad I forgot
His name as we have been to so many attractions. Views were so beautiful and it is definitely worth it

We had a very limited amount of time in Alaska and wanted to maximize it. I've never done a flight tour but thought it was our only chance to see Denali. We drove to talkeetna getting there late afternoon and stopped in and they were able to get us on the last flight of the day. The weather wasn't great and I know seeing Denali can be hit or miss.  The staff was super friendly and our pilot Stan was informative and funny. I'll be honest the first bit of the flight I found myself thinking "this is nice but we shouldn't have spent the money". I've flown over lots of mountains all over the world. THEN the Great  One  appeared over the clouds with sun beating down giving the snow a golden hue. OMG 💜😳 freaking amazing!!!!!!! Just unreal. Then landing on the glacier was like something off a documentary. Beyond words. There's nothing to give the mountains and glaciers perspective so it becomes incomprehensible to appreciate the size and scope. This was by far our favorite part of the trip. Don't miss this opportunity!

Truly fantastic! Best birthday gift I ever got for my husband! What a way to tour the city. We're from the bay area and yet learned things we never knew. The pilot was very informative. Can't wait to ride the seaplane again!

We have been to wings over kauai up recently, the flight was quite fun, scenery amazing and the Bruce was very helpfull with explaining anything of what was arround, also he circled quite a few times when we wanted to take extra pictures of the spot.
We did it as a trio and had much fun.

Would recommend them for anyone!
Thanks Wings over Kauai for an amazing adventure!

the most amazing experience I ever had , the pilot very knowledgeable making the trip very enjoyable, an experience of a life time I will do it again ,and again.
 thank you for such an amazing time.

We had a great time once we got off the ground and got used to flying in a small airplane. Justin our pilot did an amazing job of narrarating all the sites we flew over. Some were a bit hard take photos of as we had to be at a higher altitude to stay out of the turbulance. But Justin got everyone on board the best view possible of everything. We probably won't ever visit Kauai again, which is why we took the tour. From beginning to end the entire staff is very friendly and professional in every way.
Eric was FANTASTIC!  Views of 5 islands, historical perspective, friendly and gracious!  Nice Archer II, nice flying Piper, and the picture/vent window!
This wonderful team gave us such a memorable experience. My Dad sat right up front and got the co-pilot treatment. Very cool, very exciting and the photos are breathtaking!

After seeing the bi-plane fly over last year, I knew when I returned this year that had to go.  I am a paraplegic and so there was some concern if I could get in the plane, even though I have a strong upper body.  Our pilot Kevin was more than willing to give it a shot and it turned out great!  Don't let a wheelchair stop you from exploring.  Thanks for the memories that will last a lifetime.
A must do.  Amazing experience.  Everyone is so nice and the pilot gives you a lot of history and  fun facts about San Francisco. We had a spectacular time!!! Highly recommended.

review_title: The highlight of our Alaska vacation
review_text: Joe our pilot made us feel very safe and comfortable. He took us on the ride of a lifetime to see the spectacular scenery with our glacier landing. Thank you for the wonderful trip.

review_title: Great tour to see the River
review_text: Flew with John. I highly recommend this tour. I had limited time but wanted to see the Columbia River gorge and didn’t have a half day to spend hiking. This was perfect!

review_title: We had  a fantastic flight with Stephen!
review_text:
First, Maui Plane Rides was easy to communicate with. They provided clear directions and contacted us the day before and the morning of our trip to address any of our questions. Stephen greeted us at the entrance to the facility.
The flight was amazing! My husband got to sit in the pilot's seat and took the controls for take-off! (With Stephen's expert guidance, of course.) And of course the scenery was gorgeous. The views of the islands, especially the sea cliffs, was spectacular. Stephen's knowledge of the area makes him an excellent guide.

As long time Kauai visitors (12th trip?), its still a thrill to see it from the air. We booked a package that included a NaPali coast supper cruise plus the hour-long trip in the air. 
Received driving directions at least a day ahead of time and easily found our way to the Air Ventures counter at the Bradley Aviation building near the Kauai airport. There were six in our party and, after a picture and a short briefing we were on our way. 
The pilot was friendly, informative, and seemed genuinely concerned about our comfort and safety. He narrated the tour and provided information about the various coasts, the canyons, waterfalls, and topography of the island. 
I've taken a helicopter ride on Kauai before, and wasn't sure what to expect with a small airplane. I was surprised how smooth the ride was. The plane travels at a relatively slow speed and its easy to focus on the scenery and take pictures. The only downside, if there is one, is that a plane can't hover in front of waterfalls or cliffs like a helicopter. That said, the pilot will turn the plane around to ensure everyone gets good views of various scenes. He even made an extra loop above the ocean when he spotted a pod of whales.  
Kauai is an absolutely gorgeous island and the combination of the ocean's waters, the NaPali cliffs, the beaches, and the inland canyons and waterfalls, make this trip quite memorable.

review_title: Worth the trip! Excellent experience to see the amazing Kuaui island
review_text: Excellent tour. Beautiful and amazing scenery. Nicely organized. Great pilot who explained areas we flew over. He was very engaging and knowledgeable. Checked on how everyone was doing on regular basis. Highly recommended!

I choose to fly with Sea-Wind on my Alaska trip last year, they are a wonderful family run operation, Steve and Leslie are the best. As a former pilot myself, Steve is an excellent skilled pilot, I would fly with him anytime.the tour of the Fords  and landing on a mountain lake was exciting.smooth , Steve and Leslie do everything to accommodate you.Can't wait to go back next Year!

review_title: Very Professional and an Amazing Experience!
review_text: Loved this! I highly recommend! Paul, Annie and crew were amazing! Flown with these guys several times and each time they have done an amazing job! Keep it up guys!

The folks at K-2 were awesome.  Garret was super and Adam the pilot was extremely knowledgeable.  Flightseeing may seem pricey, but it is worth ever penny!!  We wanted to see Denali, but the weather on the mountain was bad.  K-2 came up with a great alternative.

My husband and I were desperate to take a flight over Kauai but were concerned we wouldn't be able to because of our children being so young (3yrs and 1yr). We stumbled across Wings Over Kauai Air Tours on the net and were excited to see they would take young children up too. 
On arrival at the airport we were greeted very warmly by Bruce (the pilot) and his wife plus another colleague. Myself and another female passenger were given kukui beads as a gift and the children were given flowers. We were weighed and then we had our picture taken in front of the plane before setting off. Bruce warned us that our kids would probably fall asleep during the flight and he was right! Our kids nodded off pretty soon after being in the air which was great - it meant my husband and I could relax and enjoy the view in peace! Bruce was very knowledgable and went to great lengths to engage with each of us throughout the flight. The scenery was breathtaking and our photos don't do it justice. You just have to take the flight! Wings Over Kauai are about half the price of the helicopter tours on offer. At the end of our tour, we were given a DVD of the flight we took (complete with our picture on the cover). Very sweet.  A great little business. I would highly recommend these guys.

review_title: Unforgettable experience the private tour in air!
review_text:
Eric, the pilot, is a amazing guy doing a great job! He said we are sharing his dream, actually he was making my dream come true by letting my little girl driving a little bit! Sounds crazy but it was peaceful and joyful! Totally unforgettable experience in our life! Thank you Eric!! 

Merry Christmas and happy new year, Eric!

Salina
What an amazing experience! Highly recommend this tour! Seeing the city from the air is so beautiful. The pilot was also very good and shared a lot of knowledge of the area.
It was a very nice experience. A must try aerial view of the city. It took 45 mins including the take off and the pilot was very friendly.
We went with our 6 year old twin boys. We all loved it. The staff was so nice and knowledgeable and you really can't beat the views. It was such a cool experience landing on a glacier
Great flight. Sergio was a nice pilot. Must fly with this company. Very helpful and great deals as well.

review_title: Best way to see Misty Fjords!
review_text: My husband and son booked this flight after getting off the ship.  From the booking through the flying experience everything was top notch!  There was an excellent view from the plane, the pilot knew the area very well and constantly pointed out sights and animals during the flight.  This is a highly recommended attraction is Ketchikan.

The only thing in our planning that didn't go well was this plane ride but it was our mistake. We checked the time to reach there from our Hotel was 30 mins that morning but our tour was at 5pm (sunset time) the time shown was 1 hour. So we were caught up in traffic due to some accident and they called us and said that they have to charge additional $45 for the delay. So I think one should be early for this tour (multiply the usual time taken to reach there by 2). 
The Tour was great with champagne and all the information and view we saw but at night it wasn't that amazing. Rather go at day time.
Laura is our pilot and she’s so amazing and professional, that we really enjoyed our time with her. Had wonderful time in the plane, and Laura provided explanation along the ride. Thank you so much!
They worked us in just a few hours after I called today. Had a great time, memories that will last a lifetime. Aloha........

review_title: Best dollars ever spent on our vacations!
review_text: Was the highlight of our trip.  Been to Kauai many times but first time seeing it by air.  A must do!  Have seen the Napali Coast by boat but seeing it by air was even more incredible.  Plane was comfortable, great visibility and gave us opportunity to take some great shots!  The host and pilot were the best!  Would do it again!
This was a bucket list excursion for us, and it didn't disappoint.  The only way to truly capture the magnificence of Denali!  The glacier landing was definitely a highlight for all.
This tour was amazing! Josh was a fabulous pilot and took us on a great tour of Kauai. It was definitely the highlight of our vacation.

review_title: Top of our Bucket List achieved!
review_text: Maverick are a responsible, professional group with safety as their top priority.  We had an awesome pilot/guide taking us through the spectacular Grand Canyon in September'18.  Will recommend Maverick to all our friends.

WOW, WOW, WOW, WOW... the phrase I kept repeating as one beautiful view after another unfolded!  Our Wings Over Kauai Air tour was just amazing!  Dori and John were soo friendly and helpful.  We have visited the island three times and this is by far the best tour we have experienced!  I can't wait to do it again on our next visit!

Awesome ride. We toured Canyonlands, Monument Valley. It was great. We rode in the 4 seater Cessna 172 with Veteran Pilot Tim, He pointed out so many things we would have never seen, arches, roads, trails, etc. We feel so lucky to have had this experience. Keep up the good work RedTail!

Seeing Grand Canyon from a helicopter was without a doubt one of the most amazing things I did during my month in America! Come to think of it, it's probably one of the coolest things I've done in my entire life. The staff at Mavericks were very professional, especially our fantastic pilot BJ that gave us a very pleasant trip. This was my first time in a helicopter and Mavericks made it into a very pleasurable experience. I was on the 50 min tour and it was worth every cent!
Everything was amazing!! Stunning views!! Great memories with my daughter best hands down!! Definitely recommended

review_title: Great Flight w/ an Awesome Pilot
review_text: Our trip was a blast! The Pilot was knowledgeable about the area and made the whole experience fun! The flight was smooth and the scenes were beautiful! The office gals were friendly and the building was clean and very inviting! Looking forward to another flight with them in the future!
We flew with our pilot, Chris and what an adventure! Spectacular views of the mountains and Denali! The landing on the glacier was flawless and beyond words of description.

review_title: Amazing thing to do on maui
review_text:
Ive been wanting to take a flight lesson forever... my wife got me a lesson with eric for my birthday and im so glad she did! 
Aside from the ecstatic experience of flying above the islands of maui and molokai, Eric was amazing. Very knowledgeable and patient. I can honestly say that this is a must do adventure on maui, even if you don’t plan on becoming a pilot :)

7 of us went flight seeing with this company. We explained that our Florida grandchildren had never seen snow. We landed on a glacier and had a snowball fight! The pilot said the weather was beginning to look ominous and he cut the trip short. No one could tell. They refunded $700. If you want to flight see pick this company. No second choice

Thank you Yelp and Tripadvisor.com reviewers for recommending SeaWind Aviation!! What made this trip memorable:
1. Amazing views!!!
2. Very friendly, professional staff and reasonable prices.
3. Their planes offer EXCELLENT views from no matter where you sit. Their windows are clean and not scratched up, so pictures come out clear. 
4. The noise-canceling headsets allowed an informative interaction with our pilot. 
5. The driver who picked us up from our cruise ship offered to drive us to our hiking trail after the flight tour - that saved us 3 miles of walking! He deserved that little extra tip! :)
6. We were fortunate enough to have SUNNY weather that day, but overcast days still provide excellent views!
Don't bring backpacks as there may not be enough room on the plane. If you do, you can store them at their office during your flight. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND THIS TOUR!!!

My husband and I took our 15 year old son to Sedona and booked this full day Grand Canyon experience. It was an awesome experience to see the terrain from above! Our pilot Max was a part of what made it so fun! From the flight to the west rim, the skywalk and lunch (yummy options), the two stops to see some breathtaking views and have some picture opportunities, and last but not least the helicopter ride down into the canyon where we got to spend 20 min or so on the Colorado River. The perspective looking up had us all in awe. A full day so spring water and a couple of snacks. You won’t be disappointed!

My girlfriend and I wanted to do something unique and memorable on our Maui vacation. This was it. We really wanted to see the Molokai sea cliffs and the unfortunate landslide on the hiking trail made the mule ride a no go and the flight into Kaluapapa sounded nice but this sounded better and we were right. Eric was amazing, genuine and friendly. Of all the air tours I’ve done on the islands this was by far the best. It was just us so it was our trip the way we wanted to do it which can’t be understated. I’m an avid photographer so having a place to take clean pictures without having to deal with window glare was also awesome. If you are going to do an air tour...do this one!

Words cannot express how awesome our flight over Kauai with Bruce was. It definitely was the highlight of our vacation in Kauai. At half the price of the helicopter tours, our Wings Over Kauai flight was first class from start to finish. Bruce and Ellen are a special couple running a family business with all the right touches from the fragrant gardenia flower, the beaded lei, their friendliness, their genuine concern for your comfort, to Bruce's professionalism in his flying and expertise in telling us all about the island. The authentic Hawaiian music and great sound system on his plane made the tour exceptional. Top of the line, Bose noise-reducing headphones were awesome. We could hear Bruce's wonderful narration of the island tour without the noise of the airplane and, we could converse with him as well. Ellen is so nice and friendly, too. She really gives  a welcomed, homey feeling to the tour. Taking a photo of us and then e-mailing it to us is an extra nice touch. I highly recommend this tour to anyone who wants the experience of a lifetime. Thanks again Bruce and Ellen!

review_title: Fantastic views of Kauai and great staff
review_text:
The pleasantness of the staff and the pilot made the experience even more memorable. And of course no questions about the aerial views. 

Tip: eat nothing/ very lightly before the flight to avoid nausea.

review_title: Clearly a highlight of the trip!
review_text: Do not miss landing on a glacier if you visit Alaska.  This was absolutely amazing.  K2 did an excellent job.
We took the path of the waterfalls and it was breathtaking! Phenomenal experience! I would highly recommend taking a ride!

Wonderful combination of both the seaplane and trip to Alcatraz. Professional company with friendly,  knowledgeable and experienced staff. Regular email contact following booking, clear instructions where to meet. Warm and knowledgeable welcome by Michael the shuttle  driver and excellent commentary by Jerome the pilot. This trip is not cheap but is a must do if you're in San Francisco, The aerial view of the Golden gate bridge, Alcatraz and San Francisco city was amazing. Had a clear sunny day with great views. Fabulous experience!

This was a fabulous experience. Josh and Dori were welcoming and friendly and were focused on  meeting our needs. In the air, Josh was an informative and entertaining pilot. We learned a lot about the island while viewing the amazing scenery. We would highly recommend Wings Over Kauai.

review_title: Grand Canyon experience to the Max!
review_text: Our pilot Mike was so kind and made the entire experience totally enjoyable. We also included a helicopter ride down into the canyon with a boat ride on the Colorado River. This combo package was the highlight of our trip! We really feel like we did the Grand Canyon experience to the Max!!

We appreciated the professional and thorough booking process; everything went smoothly for check-in too- very welcoming. The ride was great- worth doing the glacier landing. Our guide Daniel put us at ease and was informative. Thanks K2!

review_title: Stunning Views of the Garden Isle
review_text: Beautiful views from a perspective we hadn’t seen before. Pilot was great, especially with the weird winds that day. Staff helpful and friendly.

What an amazing experience! From correspondence with Envi before booking (super helpful!) through to the welcome on arrival and fantastic pilot skills of Davis we had an incredible time. Highly recommended to anyone with an interest in flying, volcanology, local history and sights. 
Davis made us feel so welcome and comfortable and gave us the smoothest ride, best local info, and very best of views of Mount St Helens which was simply AWESOME. 
Stop hesitating and just book it!
Another amazing time flying with you thank you so much for the professional service and attention to every detail.
Great trip. Expensive but worth it! The staff were professional and accommodating and we saw lots of bears.

I took a 70 minute flight instructional Kauai Air Tour with Wings Over Kauai, with my wife in the rear seat as the photographer. I do hold a Private Pilot's License and was able to fly the Cessna 172 for the entire tour over almost the entire island of Kauai. Bruce is an excellent flight instructor, and gave me several pointers on improving my flying skills. The small plane tour will not get you into the canyons or valleys like a helicopter tour will, but if you are looking for a tour in a small plane, this is the operator to choose.

We made our second trip to the beautiful island of Kauai this spring.  And, one of the highlights of our trip was our tour of the island on Wings Over Kauai Tours.  The first time we were on the island, we took a helicoptor ride over the island.   And, it is both of our opinion the next time we visit the island we will choose Wings Over Kauai again.  You almost feel like you are floating in the air, and you really get the opportunity to view the terrain instead of just zipping by it in the helicoptor.  And, an added benefit was the information that the pilot and "tour guide" was able to give.  Bruce had excellent knowledge of the vegetation of the island which made it all the more interesting.  So, we would hightly recommend this to everyone. . .it would be our first choice regardless of the price. . .but with the price compared with the actual flight time . .this is the way to go
Sisters from Omaha, NE .

SeaWinds came to our rescue when I booked the wrong flight off POW island!  They responded very quickly, sent a 185 floatplane to pick us in time to meet our commercial flight in Ketchikan!  Mike was an excellent pilot and very engaging in conversation.  We will definitely use SeaWinds again and highly recommend them!

Our party of four booked the Southside Explorer (one hour flight plus glacier landing). When we arrived that morning we received a weather briefing and learned the glacier landing would not be possible if we departed at the scheduled time.  We were presented with options i.e. flight only (glacier landing component of booking to be refunded), wait 45 minutes to see if weather would permit a landing, get a complete refund, or rebook for later in the day.  We decided to wait after which time we learned the glacier landing would be highly unlikely but the low cloud would not impact views of the mountains.  We decided to go ahead and were fitted with the glacier landing gear just in case.

The flight was smooth and the views of the mountains were fantastic.  It felt like we were extremely close to the mountains but the pilot assured us we would never be less than 1/4 mile from the face of the mountains.  Our pilot was excellent ensuring each side of the plane enjoyed the views.  We flew to the glacier landing area and could see it wasn't possible to land.  Honestly, the flight was so good we were happy not to land (and receive a refund for that portion).

We highly recommend Talkeetna for their professionalism and for ensuring we had the best possible experience.

We took the long tour down to Lake Powell. It was expensive but worth it, with a very experienced pilot showing us every interesting place on this 2 hours flight over the canyons. Aircraft in very good condition. A great experience.

Westwind was the easiest to work with. They are very accommodating in answer your questions if you have any. Westwind also keep you updated on any changes that might be needed. Our pilot. Brandon was amazing. The takeoffs and landings are the smoothest ever. On the return flight there were some storms in the area and he did a fantastic job, avoiding all, IFor us, this was a once in a lifetime experience. We highly recommend this company.

Prior to being in the area we had looked into a flight seeing trip.  We decided not to book it because you never know what the weather will be. On our way back from Denali National Park and Preserve we had a picture perfect day. We stopped at the office in town, Talkeetna,  and found they still had available flights for the day. We decided to do the Grand Denali trip with a landing.
We were floored by the experience, better than we could have imagined. The pilot,  LeeAnn was great. We landed at Base Camp 1 which was WOW.
So glad we did the trip it was one of the best parts of our Alaska trips.
Additionally all the staff we dealt with were very professional.

review_title: AMAZING DAY! Incredible and memorable for a 60th birthday!
review_text: We went to celebrate my husbands 60th and I was really scared and afraid to join him and our 13 year old daughter (fear of heights). Well, the champagne before the flight helped calm my nerves (highly recommend) and it was a totally smooth and comfortable ride. Our pilot was awesome! I loved his commentary and all the great stories he shared. It was a truly incredible once in a lifetime experience!!! The helicopter tour looked cool too :)
Amazing views!  This tour helped deepen my understanding of the island with firsthand views of the topography.  Pilot Eric was very welcoming and friendly.  Wonderful experience!
This was an amazing activity.  I highly recommend it.  Very memorable. Just do it.  You won’t regret it.

We really enjoyed our flight and glacier landing. We lucked out and had beautiful weather so we had awesome views of Denali. Our pilot was excellent. He explained highlights during the flight but didn’t talk so much as to be intrusive. I would highly recommend during this tour, it was a wonderful experience.

Just, ermuhgawd WOW. Our pilot flew us right up to McKinley. The pictures and memories I have are for a lifetime. GO! Pretty drive from Anchorage to Talkeetna, too. Seriously, there are no words. You just need to go.
Fantastic experience!! The pilot was amazing getting us up close and personal with the mountains.  The glacier landing topped it off wonderfully.. Such amazing views it doesn't even seem real.
Booked the day before. Pilot was super cool and knew a lot about the area we were flying over. 10/10 would recommend!
Excellent way to see the Grand Canyon...much better than by car. The vast size left me speechless. I would do it over again.

review_title: The best way to see the vastness of Alaska!
review_text: The flight was great, our pilot Kris was awesome - very knowledgeable and did a great job showing us the Alaska range. The views are just unbelievable! What an unforgettable trip, thanks for the wonderful experience!
We did the Nor Cal tour and it was terrific.Our pilot was knowledgeable and very personable. It was money well spent. I highly encourage this trip.

We booked a Denali flight, and when we arrived in Talkeetna by Alaska Rail from Anchorage, the weather was so bad that they canceled it.  They were very professional and apologetic, but safety first.  Disappointed, we wandered Talkeetna, when we got a call from the Air Taxi and said that the weather was breaking and they were going up to take their chances if we wanted to go.  Of course we did.  Barely glimpsed Denali through the clouds, but had a fabulous flight anyway, followed the Ruth glacier, and saw some amazing views.  Sit towards the rear of the plane for best views.  Under the wing you don't get the majesty of the height of the mountains.  Our pilot was very informative, but we had some stretches where Iwish our pilot had talked more about what we were seeing.  Or given us more Alaskan lore.  Overall great trip.

We had booked the 11 am tour online even before we reached Kauai. We called ahead and the person who answered told us we could come by 10:45 am or so. We reached round about then only to be told by Val that we were late & that the flight briefing etc. takes time. however, sensing our dismay and the fact that we had been misinformed, Val & Bruce agreed to conduct the tour for us.

Val weighed us and gave us a few tips while Bruce decided to brief us while we taxied. Soon we were in the tiny Cessna with seatbelts fastened and headphones on. My husband was on the copilot seat and Bruce almost made him believe that he was steering the flight :) As we took off after about five minutes of taxiing, I realised this was one of my once-in-a-lifetime experiences.

Bruce was exceptionally knowledgeable, friendly and funny. He soon put everybody at ease, even our friends who were a little afraid. He is clearly a master at flying. Not for a moment the small aircraft caused discomfort to us. He showed us many spots which he puts on his must-visit list. To make it even better, the sky was as clear and sunny as it could be. The tour lasted a little more than an hour. The best hour of our lives perhaps.

My husband rued that perhaps we should have taken the helicopter tour which takes closer to the waterfalls but after flying with Bruce, I am glad we took Wings Over Kauai. Great hospitality, great views, great infotainment. A gorgeous way to see a gorgeous island!

We booked a Misty fjord seaplane excursion through Princess. It was raining and I was a bit apprehensive about going up. But, the flight was phenomenal. Our Pilot Chuck Perkins was a fantastic pilot and host and we were thrilled with our experience. Great pilot/guide, great music and breathtaking scenery! I HIGHLY recommend it.
The glacier landing was well worth the money. Our pilot was top notch! It felt like we were in another world when got out of the plane on the glacier. Amazing!

review_title: Great way to see the island
review_text: We were fortunate as the weather cooperated and we saw great views of the island of Kauai.  We saw spectacular  rainbows and stunning views of the Na Poli cliffs-  which can only be seen  by air or sea.  Our young pilot was very experienced, and super friendly and informative. It was an amazing tour.

We had a wonderful ride across Denali Mountains. The weather was getting bad and the office team has put us on safest route available and the pilot was very experienced to drive very safely covering all possible glacier.

This is a great way to see Kauai that is more economical than the helicopter tours, about half the price.  Book online to save, you'll get DVD free, although not of your actual place ride, but done professionally on very good weather days over the same route.  The plane is comfortable and flight was relatively smooth for the day we went.  Of course the weather changes quickly, was sunny leaving Lihue but interior and Na Pali coast was overcast and raining some of the time.  Just shows you how diverse Kauai really is.  As everyone points out, flying gives you a great perspective that you simply can not appreciate from the ground, plus seeing areas you're not going to be able to drive to.  To be fair, we have not done a helicopter ride, so we can not truly compare with a fixed wing flight.  Probably the apples and oranges argument. But from our perspective, we were happy with the experience. Not noisy at all.  You all have the headsets that cancel most of the noise plus can communicate with each other and the pilot. We are a little older and felt that the helicopter a bit much, plus it boiled down to our what our travel budget can handle.  In our opinion, the argument that if you'd made it to Hawaii, then you should be able to afford a helicopter ride is really false, we all have price points.  Air Ventures provides you basically the same flight itinerary and for a lot less money.  For those environmentally conscience, the fuel used by Air Ventures is a fraction of what a helicopter uses.  Just check the fuel surcharges.  Book online with Air Ventures to lock in your savings.  We'd do it again!

From start to finish this was an awesome experience. Booking was simple with Val, day of with Gayle and Lindsay was great so professional and informative. Mark, our pilot was professional and informative! The tour of the Canyon is a must on an airplane best way to see it in its totality. Thanks for a great trip experience!

Best way to see Miami. Captain Tony was excellent. Having grown up in South Florida, and a pilot myself, I was impressed with Tony's knowledge and skill.  You can't beat the value, and the photos you will have will be magnificent. In addition, I was a walk-up, and Tony accommodated me without hesitation.  Don't miss this!  Brad Middlebrook. Atlanta, GA

Spencer, our pilot was very down to earth and made us feel at home, He was very knowledgeable about the local customs , history and landmarks, which made the trip a lot of fun.
What I really appreciated was that he wanted us to have fun but safety was always first.
The scenery was amazing and if you've driven the Columbia Gorge even a handful of times, this will add a whole perspective to the drive.

We had flown around the Island on a previous trip by Helicoptor, but flying this time in the Bi-Plane was the ultimate experience.
I cannot priase Val at the front desk, or Kevin the pilot enough for their attention to all the details, information, and making sure that we had a good time.
The Yellow Bi-Plane was like ( and was) new, Kevin gave us a complete rundown on the planes history, its workings, how to get in and out and how to take photos. We chuckled to ourselves with our helments on, and thought of Biggles the pilot or Snoopy LOL.
The take off was smooth, the flight was smooth and the landing even smoother!
Kevins information was  limitless, and kept us entertained thru out the flight. The sights were breath taking, you get a good look at the island from a totally different perspective. Taking photos was a little challengeing, but they have all come out great.!!
Was the high light of our Kauai holiday!
A Special Thank you Val for gifting us a Blue Planet A very special treasure :-)
Mahalo  Val & Kevin

booked this trip mainly to get an alcatraz tour because all other tour companies were booked. I have to say it was the HIGHLIGHT of our ENTIRE vacation in SFO. The staff is AWESOME. definitely worth it.

My husband and I went on a flight 3 days ago, and it was amazing! I took a Dramamine prior, since I get motion sickness, and had no problem! I got to be the 'co-pilot', which didn't involve more than enjoying the scenery. Bruce pointed out two humpback whales; we even saw the baby breaching! So beautiful! 

Bruce provides an entertaining and informative narrative during the flight. Each passenger receives Bose noise-canceling headphones which enable each person to hear and communicate with the rest of the passengers. I had such an amazing time on this flight that I immediately purchased this as a wedding gift for my friends that are honeymooning in Kauai in August! A Must-See, and what an amazing price!

This was our 1st time on the island and it was a great way to get an overview. Our pilot, Harry, was very informative and knowledgeable of the island. I especially enjoyed seeing the Na Pali coast. It was an amazingly beautiful tour of the island.

review_title: Hightlight of my trip to Alaska!
review_text:
I highly recommend taking this flightseeing tour with glacier landing and I can't imagine getting better service than from Talkeetna Air Taxi.  Although I had to wait for 3 days because of the weather, it was well worth it and the highlight of many highlights of my first trip to Alaska.  

I ended up taking the Grand Denali with Glacier landing and it was some of the most beautiful sights my eyes have ever seen.  I've taken an open-door helicopter over the volcanoes in Hawaii and landed in the Grand Canyon - I'd have to say this is right up there with all of that (if not on top!).  I felt very comfortable with our pilot and his experience - very smooth flight, he was very informative, professional, and made sure we were comfortable.  Landing on the glacier was incredibly smooth, I'd really have to say it was smoother than any landing I've had at an airport (this was my first flight on a private plane btw).  

Overall, one of the most amazing experiences of my life.  I cannot recommend this flightseeing tour and Talkeetna Air Taxi enough - they are top notch!

Very nice flight around the wilderness, see 10 bears 3 mooses and caribous
flying out of the heavy crowded of talkeetna is very charming! no stress, very nice approach
over a small lake!
I highly recommend Westwind Air for a great time and great service ! They accommodated us last minute and were wonderful to deal with !

Ellen, Bruce and Joshua are a great team and make their customers feel welcome and relaxed.  I had come to Kauai specifically to see the Na Pali coast by air (since i could no longer hike it).  The fixed wing plane was good value and Bruce was a fount of information.  The fixed winged plane does not go into the canyons but looking at helicopters that did, I was glad that the plane did not do that -  a sudden gust of wind could be extremely dangerous.
Kauai is beautiful from the air and with so many contrasts it is a delight to see.  We had seen the Waimea Canyon from the road the previous day and the plane view gave a wonderfully different perspective.  Flying over Princeville and the northern coast was also lovely and gave us an idea of whether we wanted to visit there or not.  If you are a golfer then there are some very interesting and beautiful golf courses.
Be ready with your camera and dont lean it against the window - it damages the windows.  The opportunities for photographs are quick so you really need to be prepared.  Video of the trip would be great.  Bruce's son has produced a CD with photographs taken of customers before the trip and highlights of what is seen on a typical trip.  A great souvenir.  They also present the women passengers with a Kuki nut lei.  
Bruce was an agronomist and is able to tell you all about the crops and flora of the island.  The forest of abiza trees from Africa are beautiful - hopefully they are not an invasive pest.
We were lucky enough to see some waterfalls as there had been a lot of rain recently.  The extinct volcano in the middle of the island has the highest record of rainfall in comparison with other parts of Kauai so there were quite a few waterfalls on he northern side.
Ellen provides air sickness ginger candy for those with queezy stomachs and cold drinks in the form of cola and water.  Bruce goes through all the safety checks before take off including the use of life jackets.
The plane we flew had been made in Gippsland (Australia) and took six passengers as well as the pilot.  It was comfortable.  Note that the seating of passengers take place according to weight so you may not get the seat you had hoped for.
