However all seats have good views and Bruce will point out places and things of interest if you advise him before hand of your particular interests.
The fixed plane cost is roughly half the cost of a helicopter flight.  It is good value indeed.
The waiting area looks over the helicopter landing area and you can sit in the open air and watch the helicopters taking off.
This was an event to remember and we will certainly be talking about for a long time to come.

Our family had a wonderful time flying on a Grand Canyon tour.  The people were very friendly and professional.  The sights were amazing and the tour gave you a great feeling of just how majestic and awesome the Grand Canyon truly is as a whole.

This was one of the best experiences of my life. It was so amazing to fly over the Grand Canyon. The pilot was so awesome and informative. 
Would definitely recommend!
Did this tour with my mother for Mother's Day and we both had a blast! Harry is an awesome pilot and I'd definitely recommend this adventure to anyone who doesn't suffer from severe motion sickness.
Super friendly and informative staff. Our favorite excursion. Great ride and beautiful scenic views. Was really impressed with, Doug, our pilot. Informative and experienced!

What a wonderful morning we had  on Thursday. Everything turned out to perfection.
Bruce and Ellen and Josh and dori are, without a doubt,  the most amazing people
To deal with. Bruce was our pilot and  gave us the most amazing tour of this beautiful 
Paradise that only God could have created. Bruce gave a very descriptive rendering of
The many gorgeous sights that  are distinctly  Kauai.
Expensive but has to be done. Flying over the edge and seeing the canyon disappear in front of you is awesome. Brilliant experience.

We recommend to fly with this company.
We are very enjoyed by this large tour. It's was an amazing tour, wonderful views and very good comments of Jeroen. 
Congratulations for this exceptional experience to Jeroen our pilot (he speaks french), very friendly and enthusiastic person, sharing his experience and his historical comments.
Also a thank you to Michael for his very good and warm welcome at our arrival.
We hope to have a new opportunity for flying with you next time !

review_title: Wow, what a great landing on Ruth Glacier
review_text: This company is first class in every way. We loved or flight with Barry on the Otter, and landing at the top of the glacier was a unique experience. We had an extraordinary day with blue sky and smooth air. Checkin was quick and everything moved along on time. We even met a great young sales girl who found the t-shirts we wanted in the back room. I highly recommend this experience.

We had been dealing with some cloudy days with some rain but on the day of our flight it was clear and sunny.  Great flight with beautiful views and knowledgeable pilot.  Flight included glacier landing which was really cool.  Recommend this business.  We’ll be back to do again.

Overall just a great time in every sense.  It was a windy day on ours which made turbulence more prominent.  Our pilot seemed to have everything handled with confidence and we just enjoyed looking around.  I would go again and I’m glad I did it!

My wife is not a good flyer, even on a 767, let alone a little Cessna or the like. There was no way I could get her on a helicopter tour, so the doors off experience wasn't going to happen. So I read to her very carefully, the reviews on the stability of WOK's Australian built plane, the safety etc, but she still wasn't having a bar of it. So I did what any good husband would, I booked it anyway.
So, one or two days prior, she began to go quiet and on the day of the flight, she couldn't even talk to our pilot, who was doing his best to appease her, but clearly failing. The only thing left was to just get her in the plane and do it. 
Well, the flight was faultless, hardly a bump, even when warned of certain areas that may cause a bit of turbulence. The scenery is spectacular, the commentary informative, with an open mic if you want to ask anything at all. 
I recommend you do this straight up, and then spend the rest of the time relaxing. We drove around a bit, hiked, but the view is unrivalled from the air. Don't miss this, as only 15 or 20% of Kauai is accessible by road. It is The best way to see the NaPali coastline. We hiked up the Kalalau trail from Ke'e Beach on a very calm day and watched as the Catamarans and Rafts bounced and bounced all the way down the coast. We were so glad we cancelled our plans to "sail" down the coastline. It looked liked a bumper car ride. And I really don't know how you could get the same perspective as from the air. A lot of bouncing to zip through a couple of sea caves I think. 
Plus, at the end, you can order a copy of your flight, recorded in 1080HD, complete with all your audio too, for $30. Great value. It costs about that for two digital photos off a Disneyland Ride doesn't it. And don't worry about the clouds. We went on a very cloudy day, which it always seems to be, but saw everything, but the top of the peak of course. Great value. Book it now.

We booked the Canyon Spirit, Grand Canyon helicopter tour. It was truly amazing. The view from the helicopter is magnificent and really shows you how vast the canyon is. The helicopter tours do not fly over any of the public lookout areas, but covers all the canyon that is virtually not accessible to the public. The Maverick helicopters are very nice. They seat 5 passengers (excluding the pilot). The ride is very smooth and the seats are very comfortable. Every seat has an amazing view. I highly recommend the Maverick Helicopter Tour of the Grand Canyon.

This was our favorite excusrion on our vacation.  Shadaen was an amazing flight guide.  We loved this tour.  It was so cool to see the entire island from the air.  It was a gorgeous flight and informative.

review_title: One of the best experiences we've ever had!!
review_text:
Our pilot was so informative and very friendly.she made sure that we had the best experience up in the air
My husband and I will recommend this locatin and wi come back and bring our kids next time!loved it thank you for an amazing experience 👏🏻👏🏻

Hawaii is a long flight that I've taken on other airlines... never again, when I go back it will be Hawaiian for sure.  Plenty of leg room, free TV,  cell phone charger on every seat, free carry on, complementary meal and blankets.   They make sitting on a plane for 8 hrs as comfortable as humanly possible as you can!

Eric was the absolute best.  He spotted 3 whales for us.  The ride couldn't have been better.  We saw so many beautiful sights and it's something I'll never forget.  For our first trip to Kauai, it was magical.

review_title: Wings Over Kauai Air Van Tour
review_text:
It is wonderful trip to view beautiful island. 
Thank you for the pilot and staff. I think it is better than helicopter ride.

Eric was awesome, easy going and fun, full of interesting information about Maui.  Fun flight with beautiful views from the air.  Would recommend Maui plane rides to everyone for a personal experience away from the crowds and large group activities.

We communicated via email with Ellen concerning our reservations. She provided detailed information promptly to our queries. Our 60-minute trip was set to depart on a Thursday afternoon, but was moved back on our request due to the weather several times. Josh was our wonderful pilot. All 4 of us had window seats with a large bubble window that hardly had any reflections. Large headphones with 2-way communication with the pilot and others in the plane. Views were fantastic, of course.  Overall, a great flight!

K2 gave us the most incredible tour of Denali! The weather cooperated the evening of our tour to the summit. Our capable pilot took us to Mt. Forager, Mt. Hunter and Mt. Denali. We got very close to the summit of Denali. We were the last flight of the day which gave us a little advantage in that we flew several minutes longer than we normally would have. Very memorable, great photos, not to be missed!

Our flight with Cptn Harry was the greatest flight ever.  Harry know just which parts of the island of Kauai are of interest to his passengers, and his piloting skills are exceptional.  Way to go Harry!
This was an awesome, spur of the moment adventure!  Excellent views and narration of the sights! Great!

We had a wonderful trip with our knowledgeable pilot Harry.  We were upgraded to a private plane for our trip around and over the island.  Sites were breathtaking!  There is no other way to see Kauai!  The staff and owners were personable, accomodating.

We had a great experience flying with K2.  The pilot was very knowledgeable providing informations information during the flight.  The customer service was great.  When I had a couple of issues, everything was quickly addressed and resolved.  If you are flying with children 2 and younger, I would recommend K2 as they provide seats for them at no additional charge, which was a big savings and allowed us to enjoy the flight a little more.  We weren't able to see much of McKinley, but thats just a roll of the dice based on the weather.  Everyone was very professional and it was our favorite tour over a 2 week trip in Alaska.

My wife and I loved our first bi plane experience, so different from sitting in an enclosed helicopter, feeling the wind on our arms, and faces when we looked out of the cockpit was fantastic. The thrill of the engine starting up and take off and landing is not to be missed, awesome job of our pilot to circle around many of the waterfalls and sights so we both had great views. Wish it was longer, we loved it.

Seeing the Grand Canyon from the rim is awesome enough, but flying over it adds another dimension. 25 minutes for $245, but worth it to see the folds and colours of the rocks in the morning light. Our pilot was very pleasant, putting a nervous passenger at ease, and informative but never intrusive. A 'once in a lifetime' experience indeed. Do it if you can.

I am a very anxious flyer and was having a hard time deciding if I would go on the flight trip.  The pilot, Patrick, came out to meet me, took me to the plane to show me everything, and really put me at ease.  He checked on me throughout the flight.  It was an amazing experience, and I am so glad that I decided to go through with it. One of the highlights of our vacation.

review_title: FANTASTIC Full-Island Kauai Air Tour w/ GREAT Informative Pilot
review_text:
I had the pleasure of a late afternoon "The Big Kahuna" air tour this week with Air Ventures Hawaii that was a FANTASTIC full tour of Kauai.

The views from the plane were amazing and the pilot Brian was outstanding.  With headsets on he provided me and the 3 others on the plance an amazing historical, geographic, geological and current events explanation that highlighted everything we saw and importantly he did so with great delivery and with good doses of humor too.

On Kauai everyone has multiple options to tour from above by airplane or helicopter and since I grew up in a family where my father flew small private planes as a hobby his whole life and it's how we traveled on vacations on the mainland, I really wanted to experience Kauai from above in a plane and I can tell you that this fixed-wing air tour did NOT disappoint. In fact, I was blown away by how much I saw in Air Venture's roomy GA-8 Airvan with large windows, comfortable seating and air-conditioning I believe.  It was comfortable!

After take-off the plane headed South and this is only some of the things we saw -- the incredible Kipu Kai shoreline, Poipu, Olokele Canyon (I actually saw the famed Robinson family's house!), many different angles & views of the Waimea Canyon which is a MUST for any Kauai visitor and then an outstanding tour or the 
Nā Pali coast.  Brian, our pilot was flawless with his detail and was really entertaining about all these sites and more.  The view of the "cathedrals" along the Nā Pali coast was very amazing!

We then wrapped around the North Shore at Ke'e Beach which is the end of the road on North Shore & start of the 12-mille ea. way Kalalau Trail along the Nā Pali coast. Extending the North Shore we then had amazing views of Tunnels Beach, Ha'ena, Lumaha'i Beach, Hanalei & all Hanalei Bay...and then Princeville.

Brian then flew us inland up the Hanalei River valley & as close as we could get to Mount Waiʻaleʻale at over 5,000 feet, almost always shrouded in clouds as it was for us, on the summit as this is one of the wettest spots in the world with over 600 inches of rain per year.

Just think GREEN & BLUE because this is what you will see.

GREEN because that is what you see on this airplane tour of the many remote places on the land of Kauai and BLUE for all the beautiful water you see and then including beaches, reefs, Hanalei valley & taro fields, the Wailua River and TONS of waterfalls.

After the interior tours both on the West side and the North Shore, we then came into the back side of Kapaa over mountains with even more waterfall views & then beautiful views of East side beaches before landing in Lihue.

Air Ventures and pilot Brian are to be commended for running an outstanding tour, at least the one that I experienced.  I would recommend this to anyone of any age from anywhere.  It was just a fantastic experience.

Mahalo Air Ventures Hawaii... :)

To echo all of the other very positive reviews, we had a great experience flying with Wings Over Kauai.  The friendliness and helpfulness of all of the staff (family) at Wings was truly notable, from online booking to check in, to the flight itself. 

Bruce, our pilot, is so very knowledgeable about Kauai; the information he shared with us regarding the island was fantastic.  We had been to Kauai a few times and decided to try a flight to see the whole of the island.  We are so glad that we did!  

We cannot say enough about our flight--we so thoroughly enjoyed it. It was a highlight of our trip to Kauai.  Highly recommended!!

but bad booking help.
I had call to do a present to some friends, left a deposit and my credit card to pay for the flight. The person who left all the information was very nice, but the other person who dealt with my friends, did not. She accepted the credit card of my friend who finally paid the all trip for 4 people.

I always wanted to take a seaplane flight and I finally, at age 70, got my wish, even getting to sit in the co-pilot's seat. It was a beautiful day and the pilot, Charles, did a great job explaining what to expect and what we were seeing. Take-off and landing were smooth. The trip took about 50 minutes, but the land and sea ferry trip would have taken about 4 hours. Well worth the money!

review_title: A Must for your Bucket List
review_text: Fly, walk a glacier, go onto the largest mountain in the Northern Hemisphere, this is the experience of a lifetime.  Don't forget to take a trip with Talkeetna Air Taxi if you're in the area.

If you do nothing else while visiting Alaska, make sure you do this. We did the 2.5 hour Grand Denali with Glacier Landing. It is absolutely worth every penny. We have been visiting Alaska for a month and this was the best thing we have done. Make sure you do this out of Talkeetna because if you fly out of Anchorage you will not see as much. A good part of your flying time is just getting there. We had a perfectly beautiful day and the time spent on the glacier taking pictures and playing in the snow was priceless. The plane is small (10 passengers),but it is not cramped and everyone has a window. We will remember this forever. Tnank you Talkeetna Air Taxi.

I was on holiday with my two sons who are 21 and 24.
This was a combined SeaPlane/Alcatraz trip. The access to Seaplane location is easy with plenty of parking or pick up at the Piers in San Fran.
The plane itself is a De Havilland work horse.This is a beautiful and nimble bit of kit. I know nothing about planes but it felt both exciting and safe at the same time.
The actual flight is phenomanal. It flys over the Golden Gate Bridge, over the bay, over San Fran and Alcatraz. Much better flight than I could imagine beforehand.
The pilot we had was Jerome -I hope I have that right. He is fantastic not just as a pilot but he knows the area well so we had first class commentary on the trip and he is also great fun and very witty. I couldn't recommend him and this trip enough.

review_title: Tallest sea cliffs in the world!!
review_text: Steve was an amazing guide, the sights were incredible and being able to pilot the plane was really special. I highly recommend this tour! I can't wait to get home and go through all the photos we took. Steve also took photos of us before and during the flight!
This one-hour tour was amazing! Everyone at K2 was really nice. I would absolutely recommend this tour to anyone coming to Talkeetna!
This was the most amazing things we have ever done!  The flight and landing were spectacular!  This is something that everyone should do.

This trip was taken during a Princess cruise to Alaska. 
Excellent trip, well organised. Flight was great. Saw some bears and bald eagles. Superb guide.
Great photos taken by Taquan Air downloaded from email link.
We were very happy with the flight, the information, and the scenery!  What a great experience.  I would definitely recommend it and we would do it again!

review_title: superb flight even if the mountain was in the clouds
review_text: We were scheduled to fly to mount McKinley but the weather was rainy and the mountain top invisible.  We decided to go anyway giving up landing on a glacier.  Despite the weather our pilot made sure we got our money's worth and we certainly did.  The glaciers we flew over and had a chance to see close-up were just awesome.  The huge dimension of it all was just awesome.  The pilot was informative and discussed all aspects of life in the area.  Great trip! Highly recommended

Amazing experience.  It was our first trip to Alaska and the flight was the highlight of our week.  We were able to land on the south base camp glacier.  We had plenty of time there to take in the surroundings.

review_title: Nice guys and a great tour
review_text: Everyone was so welcoming and patient. Our pilot was upbeat and knowledgeable. We were so satisfied we left a generous tip. It wasn't cheap but it was worth the price.

review_title: One of the best thing to do in Miami
review_text:
For the views on Miami downtown and beach.
For the take off in Miami's bay.
For the kindness and professionalism of pilots.

An absolute must do in Miami!
This wad excellent flight with our pilot who was excellent. We had a lot if fun. We saw the Crater and some whales and we circled as needed. Really comfortable.

Everything about Talkeetna Air Taxi oozes experience and professionalism.  From the initial decision process on which flight to take, to the actual flight itself, I could not have had a better experience.  Employees were knowledgeable, friendly, and helpful.  The pilot of our plane, Kris, provided a safe but incredible experience flying around Denali, and of course had a ton of interesting tidbits to add for everything we were seeing.  Upon asking out of my own curiosity, I also found out the plane was basically brand new.  If you have ever had any reservations with flying on a small plane, this outfit will inspire confidence.

My wife and I were in San Francisco visiting family over the Christmas holidays and were given a seaplane tour by our kids for our 35th wedding anniversary. Seaplane Adventures helped our kids pull this surprise off. It was am amazing experience. Their shuttle driver was prompt and courteous. The tour was expertly organized. And the flight over SF was a once in a life time experience. The weather cooperated that day, so we have some memorable pictures. 

We would highly recommend Seaplane Adventures for a magnificently organized, professional and uniquely memorable experience.

review_title: A Float-plane is great way to see Alaska.  Great experience
review_text:
The flight was high point of the entire cruise.  Absolutely stunning to be flying among a maze of 1000 foot cliffs.  Great landing on a mountain lake where the water was so clear you could see fish 15 feet down. 

The staff was friendly and the pilot very competent.  If you want to really see Alaska, a seaplane is one of the best ways to get a feel for the majesty of the land, and I highly recommend SeaWind

We had a fabulous full moon flight over Maui! Eric was an exceptional guide who gave us a once in a lifetime ride around the island. We had such a wonderful flight and have great memories to cherish forever. Thank you so much!

What an awesome opportunity this company offers to experience spectacular sceneries and the beauty of the Kauai Island.  The ride was very smooth, Paul (the pilot) make us all feel very comfortable and did an excellent job at explaining and pointing out all the sites of interests.   Would highly recommend this company...by the way, thanks for the group picture...

My husband and I flew with Andy in a single engine Cessna. It was tiny but what a ride.  We did the South Face McKinley trip but McKinley, whilst pretty impressive, was not the main attraction for us.  We were blessed with great weather and the mountains and scenery was gob smackingly gorgeous.  Andy gave a narrative along the way and made sure we experienced the majesty of this mountain range.  We saw the glacier tour on the glacier and they were ant size which gave us a good perspective of how big these mountains are.  We flew within 25 yards down the side of a gully where you felt you could reach out and touch the snow.  If we had more time I would have loved to have gone again.  Well worth the time and money to do.  Thanks Andy, we had a great time.

First of all, Captain Jack was a great ambassador for flying and the airline. Talked at length with him before and after the flight.  A comfortable, quiet, scenic flight that went by way too fast. 40 minutes, worth every penny. Every seat, at least on the Caravan, is a window seat. No bad views.

We are 'local' (Anchorage) and had scheduled a trip on Saturday. Friday's trip to Talkeetna was beautiful....Denali visible from our home all the way to Talkeetna. Sarah worked with us to change our reservation from Saturday to Friday. Chris was our pilot and it was an overall awesome experience. Their goal is to have you enjoy the trip...not take your money. What a refreshing change and what an amazing experience!!  Very "Covid Aware"! Most grateful! -Rick & Natalie

This was the highlight to our visit in Kauai!  Imagine finding another Hokie (Virginia Tech alumni) as the pilot of our plane:)  Bruce was very professional, and patiently explained everything that was going on in the aircraft prior to taking off.  I felt like I had mini flying lesson.  His knowledge of the island is thorough, and he welcomed all questions.  Thanks for a great time - the picture of us in front of the airplane was excellent.

There are not many experiences like flight seeing around Denali.  Everyone gets an amazing view no matter your seat on the plane.  Our pilot gave us a good mix of narration on the mountain, it's geology and some climbing history.  This is a must do!!!!

review_title: Breathtaking views and a fantastic guide made this experience truly memorable. I would definitely recommend!
review_text: The views were breathtaking and our guide was very knowledgeable and made this a great experience! I would definitely recommend!

We did the package for air and sea for $189 and it was Amazing!!!  I don't think there is a better deal out there.  The tour guides on both of the tours were very informative.  I felt that the hour up in the air was more than enough time to see just about all of Kauai and you can snap some wonderful pictures.  They advise you to not wear bright clothes.  Take heed to their advise.  Your pictures won't come out the way you want them to if you do.  I would definately recommend  these tours to friends and family.  As a matter of fact, I already have.  Thanks again Air Ventures!!!!!!
Eric the pilot was great. He really knew exactly where to fly to give us the best views. He was personable and engaged with everyone on the plane.
Even though I am scared of heights, the flight was very smooth! Pilot was awesome!! Friendly and accommodating. Amazing night city views ✨

review_title: Breathtaking Views, wish I didn’t get motion sickness
review_text:
There are 2 companies side by side that offer this, we went with Air Adventures do to availability (the other co I found first but they were booked .. this co was rated exactly the same ).  The check in was easy and the people were very nice and personable .  Our pilot Eric was very nice, funny, and knowledgeable . He gave a history of certain areas of the island we flew over and kept asking if everyone was ok (especially me) . We hit a bit of turbulence soon after take-off but that stopped after a minute or so and then it was fairly smoothe going .  We were thinking of doing the helicopter tour originally but I read that you would feel more movement and that costs close to $600 for 2 people  While they may get closer to some areas the small plane we took a smoother ride and you got to see everything and it was $270 fir bothering of us plus every person gets a window seat . In the helicopter .. if you sit in the middle .. you can’t see. 
Now the bad.... nothing to do with Air Adventures... about 10 minutes into the flight I had severe motion  sickness . I took a Dramamine before the flight but it didn’t help . I don’t get sick on regular planes , I guess this one was different.  The lady next to me was a nurse and she kept putting cold towels (which they provide) on my neck and legs.  The views were stunning and I managed to take a lot  of pictures regardless. My husband sat on the co-
Pilot seat up front , I sat behind the pilot .  Finally when we landed the person at the front desk gave me ginger ale to drink. I will say it took a few days to get feeling back
To
Normal . I highly recommend this tour and company , but if you get motion sickness, take precaution.

Had a flight seeing tour with K2. We couldn't do the glacier landing due to weather conditions but nevermind, we still very much enjoyed that our. We saw dramatic landscape, glaciers, waterfalls, campers/hikers on a glacier. We saw Denali but not quite the summit because the clouds were sittings top if it. The landscape was just mesmerizing. A shout out to our pilot Brian. Nice, friendly, informative. Altogether very rewarding experience.

A great time, the view of Miami is magnificent
A little attention for the photo and video in front of the plane which is a pleasure before taking off

This was an experience and way more than imagined!  Such an easy day because Westwind Tours took care of everything. Easy flights thanks to Caden and Carla and an amazing experience with the Hummer Tour with Buckwild Tours and Tre Soule.  The right amount of time and expert commentary as we went to amazing overviews of the canyon with guidance of where we were in comparison to other areas of the canyon. The flyover of the canyon was simply spectacular.  We highly recommend this tour and Westwind alongside Buckwild Hummer Tours!!
We had a lovely experience. The views were really beautiful. Awesome volcano view.  Best landing ever!!!!

review_title: Best Way to View the Entire Island
review_text:
We did this on our third day and really were glad that we did. We did the 1-hour tour and got the free DVD for booking online. (By the way, the DVD is worth it if you book online and get it for free, but not for the $20 or whatever you had to pay for it, it's only like 20 min. long and doesn't have that great of quality, but was a nice gift for us since it was free!) This was something my husband was adamant about doing and since I get really motion sick, I wasn't originally too keen on it. In fact, he originally started wanting to do a doors-off helicopter ride and I was excited to find Air Ventures had such great reviews so that I could suggest this as an alternative to the helicopter, which went over well and I think he's very happy that we did it this way. 

You really get to see the entire island from above and get some of the history from your guide. Our guide/pilot wasn't as talkative as we would have liked, but really no one on the plane was asking questions or talking to him either, so I think it's understandable that it turned out that way. And most of the sights speak for themselves. You get to see the coffee fields, all of the fabulous/famous beaches of the island, waterfalls, Waimea Canyon, where Jurassic Park/Raiders of the Lost Ark was filmed, etc etc etc --- it is really all encompassing and I would recommend it. 

The people that run it and were the pilots were SUPER nice as well, which really makes for an awesome trip, especially because I was a little nervous about flying in such a small plane. 

As for the motion sickness, I did ok for a half hour and then was feeling really ill for the second half, but I never actually got sick and imagine it's MUCH better than a helicopter ride would have been. And they were very sweet about it as well, offering watering and where I could sit to cool off, so that was much appreciated. 

I think this is a must do for those on Kauai, it's so cool to see all of the places from above and then spend the rest of the week exploring from the ground or water, very cool!
This was a really great experience! The views were phenomenal and our pilot was very knowledgeable and took us places we would have never seen if we weren’t flying over!

Of all the things we looked forward to on our Alaska trip, the floatplane tour was in the top 3, actually #1 on my husband's list.  Larry, our pilot, did not disappoint.  What a great personality. He engaged each passenger with easy banter and his narration was perfect.   Loved the music and of course, the magnificant scenery you can only see this way.  My husband has a few mobility issues and Larry went out of his way to help him in and out of the plane. Great pilot, great tour.  Everyone should do this!

review_title: Just do it ! you wont be disappointed !
review_text:
So many people recommended the Maverick helicopter tour to me and they were 100 % right.This is a must do regardless of whatever cost.Our pilot Barclay ,was knowledgeable,friendly and explained so much history about the Canyon.
There are not enough words to describe the stunning view...Don't procrastinate.just do it,it is so worthwhile.
Chad our pilot was awesome.  This was the highlight of our trip to Alaska, the views of the mountains, landing on the glacier and then taking off again were stunning.
Very professional. Informative information through the flight. Absolutely amazing experience to see this natural beauty from the air. Visited on my wife’s birthday with our 14 & 12 year olds.

review_title: There is no better way to see Mount Denali!!
review_text:
K2 Aviation and our K2 pilot provided us with an excellent and unforgettable experience on our flightseeing tour of Mount Denali.   We saw it all as the pilot expertly wove his way around the mountains.  His knowledge of the area was excellent and he communicated it well.   The plane was superbly maintained and comfortable to ride it.   

Money well spent!!
We had a wonderful night to go up and see Mt. Denali, super clear!!  Sunny and warm.  Our pilot , Will was great with all the history and information about the plane and the mountain.

There is no way to experience Canyonlands National Park that is more comprehensive, picturesque, or outright thrilling than a scenic flight. From take off to landing, I was completely absorbed in the experience, like watching an incredible movie, the rest of the world melted away as we flew over the 3 districts of Canyonlands. It was fun spotting familier landmarks like Corona Arch and various points of interests through Island in the Sky as well as flying over (personally) uncharted territory. It was a great way to see the Maze, which is the least visited and most difficult section of Canyonlands to explore. Our pilot, Nick, was everything you could ask for in a guide. He was personable yet professional, humorous yet informative, easy-going yet experienced, and most of all, fun. We had a great flight!

Wings Over Kauai was wonderful! I highly recommend it. I got an immediate response when I emailed them our reservation, check in was enjoyable and the trip was amazing. The scenery was incredible! Bruce was very knowledgable. We felt like part of the family. Well worth every penny.... and more!

We toured the island of Kauai, Hawaii in a small plane which held six passengers. We covered the island as the pilot pointed out magnificent areas of beachfront, the island's own version of the Grand Canyon called Weimea Canyon, the Wailua River, and the various flora the island grows such as taro, which is what poi is made from. We saw the locations of the films Jurassic Park and World, South Pacific, and Pirates of the Caribbean. Also, the area where Mark Zuckerberg, George Clooney, and Ben Stiller own large homes was pointed out. The time "flew" by. This was a delightful trip, and our pilot was knowledgeable and charming!

review_title: Grand Canyon Air Tour then South Rim
review_text: This was a really great trip that I would strongly recommend. Air tour was really cool. I drove up to the South Rim village afterwards to walk around on foot. Think that was $36 per vehicle to enter.

Our scenic air tour experience was perfect! Ed who welcome us and Fred our pilot was very kind. It's a very beautiful experience in a very safe plane. Everything was Perfect and we really recommend this company for this tour!! Thanks a lot

review_title: BEST excursion of our 13-day Alaska trip!
review_text: This was our best excursion during our recent vacation.  The pilot was personable and professional and the equipment (plane and headsets) worked fine.  I would HIGHLY recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi to future travelers.

My Boyfriend and I used the seaplane to get to and from the San Juan Islands. The service and knowledge were impeccable! We were able to sit up front and learn about the plane as well as be provided with state knowledge from the pilot. We were even able to schedule a ride back to the airport through them.  It was a remarkable experience that I recommend to everyone!
We loved our tour around the south side of Denali.  The views were breath taking and the glacier landing was a wonderful experience.

We were visiting our son in Moab, and he gave us a Redtail tour as a gift. Chris was our pilot, and he was amazing. He was extremely knowledgeable. He knew so much about the geological formations, topography, and cultural history and shared so much information that made the adventure so much more than just a tour. Chris was an excellent pilot, and was professional while being personable. The ride was absolutely breathtaking--it was nothing short of one of the most incredible adventures we have ever been on. Impossible to describe the beauty from a bird's-eye view. We were given the Bryce Canyon/Capitol Reef and didn't want the ride to end. We will go back sometime to see more and will definitely book Redtail and Chris. Outstanding, humbling, and truly a once in a lifetime experience. Highly recommend Redtail and Chris--you won't be disappointed!

Taquan Air transported us to The George Inlet Crab feast.  This shore excursion thru Holland America was truly fabulous.  Our pilot was Dave, who gave us a mini tour of what we were seeing from the air as we traveled.  This was probably the best trip I have ever taken.

I met my husband in Miami at the end of his business trip and he surprised me with this excursion! The meet up for the Sea Plane is at the end of a gravel road near a marina, since the plane was late I had no idea even though there’s a large sign. What a surprise when the plane arrived! Adriel, our pilot could not have been a more phenomenal person or tour guide/pilot! Personal stories interspersed with the history of the area made the tour fascinating. The trip back from the Everglades was a special treat as my husband was able to sit in the co-pilot seat! We flew in between two thunderstorms and had a bird eye’s view of the Miami coastline and the Everglades! So spectacular. The Miccosukee Tribe of Indians Everglades tour was wonderful as well. Guided by Fabian, he took us to points of interest and personally called out several alligators who swam up to the boat. A small island topped off the tour where he shared his tribes’ history and way of life. It was a Magnificent trip!!

What an amazing experience, getting to see the breathtaking beauty of Kauai from the comfort of a private Cessna, with a wonderful and personable pilot who gave us an awesome narrated tour! Thank you Desi! And thank you to all the staff who give their true aloha!

A really professional and friendly organisation from checking in to saying goodbye! All the staff involved were polite, helpful and knowledgeable. Our pilot Liam was smooth, professional and very informative. Unhesitatingly recommend the trip.
We have beautiful weather , blue sky very experienced pilot...what else to ask for😀It is not cheap trip BUT worth it every penny

review_title: Great flight on a beautiful morning
review_text: The pilot was very nice and friendly, held great conversation and maintained perfect control of the plane while answering questions. Very fun and definitely makes me want to get a pilots license in the future!

My husband and I had never been to Alaska.  We had an amazing trip. We drove up to Talkeetna, and flew to Denali with K2 aviation.  It was a fantastic experience. The pilot was very skilled and knowledgeable. We throughly enjoyed the flight around the south face.  We were suppose to land on a glacier but due to the weather we couldn't.  That was okay   It was amazing seeing all mountains and glaciers.  Everyone we met was friendly.

All we can say is WOW!!!! We were a family of 6 that did the Mountain Voyager tour on August 22. The company did tell us that our pilot was running about 10-15 minutes late but they still gave us the full time advertised. We were on a small plane that carries 10 people. Everyone gets a window seat. We all put on headphones so we can hear all the info that our pilot, Dan, wanted to relay to us. The flight was smooth, simple, and we felt very safe throughout. What we saw just blew our minds! To see the completely snow covered mountains and the glaciers from where they form and down till they end was just other worldly! And although we didn't actually get to see much of Denali itself, seeing everything else was just a sight we will never, ever forget!
Fantastic experience, highly recommend. Pilot was friendly, knowledgeable and fun. I wish I had done it sooner. I will definitely book again next time I'm in Sobe.

We emailed back and forth to Ellen before our trip to Kauai, and she was always prompt to answer any of our questions. We decided to wait till  we arrived in Kauai before booking our flight to see what the weather was. That was no problem getting a flight for the following day at 1pm. We ended up flying in their smaller plane with just my wife and I and Bruce the pilot. A private flight tour was great. We wanted to do the flight early in our trip to Kauai, so we had an idea what the island looked like and places we wanted to visit while there.
Their daughter checked us in, Extremely friendly. She gave my wife a nut Lei and a flower for her hair and lots of helpful information about the flight and sightseeing ideas on the island
Bruce was great- very friendly and informative in showing us points of interest while flying over Kauai. It was a A-plus experience and the highlight of our Kauai vacation.
We had perfect weather with hardly a cloud in the sky.
My wife sometimes has issues with motion sickness. She had none on this flight-very smooth.
She sat in front seat next to Bruce and even helped with pre-flight checklist.
We saw many beautiful things during our flight. The flight lasted almost 90 minutes.
We picked the airplane over Helicopter and were completely satisfied with our decision.
We highly recommend taking a flight with Wings over Kauai. It is a great family run business.
They also include a CD of flying over Kauai with their flights. We took lots of great photos.

This flight-seeing tour enabled us to see and photograph all the land feature highlights from above. The pilots were top notch skilled professionals and the flight was flawless. An interesting feature is the narration coordinated with the views from the windows that brought the experience home. 

The twin Otter plane is comfortable, the flight was smooth, and the ride was priceless.

Loved the flight and glacier landing with Pilot Chris. The staff at TAT are very friendly and accommodating.  We had and awesome time. Great commentary as we were flying there and back. This is a must do.

We took the Grand Denali Flight Seeing Tour with Glacier Landing. The tour provides awe-inspiring looks of the Denali mountain range and the glaciers. Thoroughly enjoyed the tour and took some great pics.

Highly recommend It.

If you are visiting the Grand Canyon, the only way to take in it's full majesty is to do it by Helicopter. Maverick Helicopter were fantastic. You must take a flight with them, well worth the cost.
Booked from the UK whichI think is the cheaper option.
Totally agree with all the glowing comments on previous reviews.

review_title: You have to book a tour! So much fun!
review_text: This was so special. At first, we thought the price was too good to be true, and we were beyond wrong. From the moment we arrived, our pilot made us feel comfortable and safe. We took the Figure 8 flight tour in the Columbia Gorge and Portland and loved every minute of it. The views were amazing and it was so much fun. We’ve gone on a helicopter tour in downtown Portland last time we visited, and that was fun but really expensive. We felt that we got way more out of this tour than that one. Highly recommend Envi to everyone. Fantastic.

review_title: The Only Way to See Arches and Canyonlands
review_text: If you're at all nervous about flying in small aircraft, my advice would be to just get over it, or you're going to miss an an unbelievable experience. We took the Arches and Canyonlands combination flight a little over a week ago, and I'm still coming to grips with the views. PIctures just don't do it justice. Our pilot, Kim, was great, and the descriptions and overview flight were a great way to plan out what you might want to spend more time seeing from the ground. This was  a great thing to do at the start of visit to the Moab area. Redtail was full of nice people, and made the whole experience memorable from start to finish.

We did this on our first full day, and found it to be a good way to get a sense of the island.  Captain Bruce, with our OK, changed up the itinerary a little because of expected winds and we appreciated that.  Had a great time in the larger plane.
It was a fascinating flight over Marin County and parts of the East Bay Area.  It was a big hit for my wife's birthday.  She still talks highly of this trip.

The weather was cloudy at best for the week that we visited Kauai.  After a couple of cancelled flights due to poor weather our pilot Kevin was able to read the weather for an appropriate take off time.  I have done a number of scenic flights but can easily say that doing it in an open cockpit of a biplane complete with cloth helmets and headset was easily the most enjoyable.  Kevin has lived in Kauai for years so not only was his commentary excellent but also restaurant tips!!  Thanks Kevin!

My boyfriend & I took a flight over Arches National Park & Canyonlands.  The view was spectacular! Our pilot, Derek, was great and tried to point out the most notable sites (Thelma & Louise Point). It was a small craft that carried 3 passengers & pilot. We used the earphones to talk back & forth to the pilot. If you do anything in Utah, take the air tour!

review_title: Wow!  A wonderful way to see the beautiful island of Kauai
review_text: I had a wonderful flight over Kauai with Wings over Kauai.  It was wonderful to be able to see so many things while only paying $125.00 rather than $300+ for a helicopter.  Josh, our pilot, was very friendly and ensured that everyone got a good view.  However, I will say that I think that you are better off if you can be the co-pilot or be in the right hand side of the 'plane as there is more to see on that side.  We saw some wonderful waterfalls and the Napali Coast looked stunning.  Considering that later in the day when our cruise ship sailed past the Napali Coast, the clouds had come in, it was so nice to know that I had seen the Coast in all its' glory from the air.  I was then so surprised to receive a DVD of my adventure at the end of the flight.  What a wonderful memento of this wonderful experience.  I highly recommend Wings over Kauai flightseeing over Kauai for all visitors to Kauai.

review_title: Denali is an incredible sight and K2’s crew were excellent.
review_text: We had beautiful weather and a smooth flight. Chris, the pilot, was clear and informative. And the mountain is incredible.

review_title: Best way to see Kauai quickly
review_text:
We visited Kauai while cruising on the Pride of America, which provided a limited amount of time to see the island.  Fortunately for us, we researched flights and decided on Wings Over Kauai due to it being a family-owned business with excellent reviews.  Our decision was rewarded greatly, they are wonderful folks to work with and everything was as smooth as could be.

I was very surprised to have Bruce himself pick us up at the ABC store, he is a very nice man and shared a lot about how he started WOK as a "hobby" after retiring.  Check-in with Val was a breeze and soon Josh had us flying high above island, seeing all of the key sights during our one hour flight.  We saw more than could have ever been done with a bus tour, and the insights that Josh provided really made the trip special.  My wife was a bit apprehensive as she is not a fan of small planes, but she loved it and said she was more comfortable than on a larger plan.  

This flight was one of the highlights of our 11 day trip and should not be missed.

review_title: The best thing to do in San Francisco
review_text: I have been to San Francisco over a dozen times and I'm mad at myself for not doing this before. Everything else has mostly been said by previous reviewers but I regret only doing the 30 minute trip, which was still absolutely memorable and brilliant. The time just went so quickly, it was amazing. I would recommend and will be doing myself next time, the 40 or 45 minute one. I don't think that I would see anything else on the 60 minute one where I could justify the cost to myself, but with the 30 minute one, I definitely regret not paying a little bit more for the 40 or 45 minute trip.  I normally don't like guide commentaries but the pilot, which we had, didn't stop talking much for the entire flight and it was really interesting. Shamefully I can’t remember his name but thanks whoever you are. I was expecting a rough landing (I actually like that kind of thing which was one of the reasons for doing it) but I couldn't even tell when the plane had landed, what a pilot. As well as a camera, of course, I would recommend a pair of binoculars to zoom in on things which interest you. After over a dozen visits to San Francisco, this was also the first time that I had visited Sausalito which is nearby. It’s a really nice town and there are many excellent places to eat.
From the shuttle driver the book..In procedure to the professionalism of the pilot and the beautiful scenery and the exhilaration of landing on the glacier this is a must do tour

Flying over Kawai is a BEAUTIFUL experience. Most of the island is impossible to see in any other way. You get a general view of the canion, the craters, the different beaches and interesting facts and stores told by Bruce (the pilot). 2 or 3 passengers in a 4 people plane.... AMAZING!

Se lo recomendaria a todo el mundo!

My husband and I have been to Kauai twice and on our last trip we decided to try out the bi-plane tour and we are so happy that we did! It was so fantastic. What a great way to see the beautiful island of Kauai. The service was superb and our pilot was amazing. I would highly recommend this tour to anyone.

Wow just wow , look no further this is the company you e been looking for ! absolutely amazing and so glad we took the opportunity to do it and especially with Maverick, exceptional service with a call the previous day to adjust our flight time due to booking numbers but we arrived early and some people came along bespoke so still managed our original time flight, with no fuss or delay. 

We took the 45 min trip and was simply breathtaking , informative smooth flight, considering I'm afraid of heights I'd never let that get in the way of such an experience. We researched other options which meant the west rim but we wanted to view the canyon at the best spot the south rim so well worth the road trip. 

Thankyou so much Maverick and to all those looking , book now and enjoy the flight 
Matthew & Joanne UK

SeaWind was awesome.  From the super convenient pick-up at the cruise ship, to the friendly staff at the office to the actual flight.  I witnessed the staff being super helpful and patient with customers that had mobility issues.  The flight was amazing and included actually getting out at the fjord on a dock to allow for photos.  The pilot was super friendly and knowledgeable.  We had the ability to actually talk via headsets while in flight to the pilot and the other passengers.  The value for the price was exceptional.  It was the highlight of our entire trip to Alaska and Canada.  The folks at SeaWind were genuine, warm and down to earth....not a corporate or cold experience.  Loved it!!!

review_title: A perfect overview of the immense beauty of Kauai
review_text: Our flight over Kauai was a spectacular finish to our week on the Island. I only wished we had taken the flight at the beginning so that we would have a better idea of all the possibilities. Remote beaches, little known trails, secret waterfalls.... Kauai is a beautiful place, but flying over the island gives you a completely different perspective.  A gorgeous rain forest clinging to the face of soaring mountains covered with waterfalls. Our pilot was excellent and the flight was flawless. Crossing over the mountains and then descending down along the Napali Coast was amazing.

Absolutely fantastic! My wife had never flown in a small plane and loved it. Stan is a great pilot and narrator. We were supposed to have the Grand Tour with glacier landing, but weather conditions made it dicey, so they changed it to the next level down - and it was still one of the best things we did. I would recommend and early flight. The light was fantastic.

review_title: It was a wonderful experience, especially to be able to see so many whales.
review_text: We enjoyed the trip around Kauai flying in the GA-8 Airvan (fixed wing airplane).  It all started with the viewing of several whales. We were lucky enough to have excellent weather and got to fly over parts of Waimea Canyon. The scenery is beautiful so bring your camera. The only negative remark is that the Airvan cannot get as close to things as a helicopter. However, the view is still spectacular. For those on a budget, the price is difficult to beat. The flight lasts about 70 minutes, as advertised.
Eric was an absolutely wonderful! Such a lovely guy & even let us switch dates, no problem, when we were sick on the original dates. The views were unreal and worth it all. Manolo!
Excellent trip, would highly recommend! Very coordinated from airline tickets to bus. Loved hearing the local stories

This was the best part of our trip.  The views from the air were Amazing.  We had considered the helicopter but opted for the AirVentures instead due to seating and price.  We were so glad we did.  This is one thing you can not miss while on Kauai.   Our Pilot was so fun and knowledgeable and pointed out many things we would have missed on our own.   Besides the many things you will only see  by air.   I love re-living it by watching our DVD they gave us at the end.   I would highly recommend this adveture to all.

The greater bay area Seaplane tour enables its passengers to get a spectacular view from the air, to see the scale and beauty of San Francisco. My family members and I thoroughly enjoyed it! well worth the price in my humble opinion. I would highly recommend.

My husband and I did this June 21, 2021. Chris was our pilot. He did an awesome job pointing out landmarks and telling us about the area. It was cloudy in Talkeetna but bright and sunny on the mountain. We did a glacier landing...its hard to put into words really, but if you are on the fence about spending the money, just do it! Totally worth every penny!

Can't express how amazing this flightseeing was!! We did Mt. McKinley base camp with glacier landing. During the flight, I was just screaming (nobody could hear me as everyone wore headsets), the view was stunning and we were able to see Mt. McKinley so clearly! The glacier landing was also awesome and we had so much fun. The customer service was very informative and kind as well. One the best experience ever. This is definitely the best way to see Mt. McKinley!

review_title: Wonderful service from front desk to pilot
review_text:
This was a phenomenal experience. Of course the scenery was breathtaking. This activity is WELL worth the money. It is an expensive outing, but such a wonderful experience.

There are several companies in the area offering similar service, but TAT was fantastic. We were scheduled for one day but had bad weather. They were very flexible to reschedule us for another day (and so friendly about it). When we arrive for our flight, they still were not sure if we could land on the glacier so they did not take our payment before we left. All the front desk staff was friendly and helpful. The pilot did a great job of flying and narrating the trip. Don't be scared of the small planes - the ride was very smooth. Turbulence isn't a huge problem in Alaska because there isn't enough heat to make the air unstable. My husband and I took motion sickness meds just in case. The glacier landing was well worth the additional money. It was such a unique experience.

Bottom line - spend the money for this experience and go with TAT! They are great!
Great experience seeing Denali from the air and then landing on a glacier. Highlight of our Alaska trip. Highly recommend!

review_title: A great way to see the island!
review_text: We were looking for a fun birds-eye tour of Kauai and we found it with this tour! Since we wanted a more intimate experience, Ellen recommended the two of us take the Cessna plane instead, which was a great choice! Bruce was an excellent and knowledgeable pilot, and we would certainly suggest this tour to people looking for a different Kauai experience.

This was a treat!  I've taken a helicopter tour, which was cool, but sometimes a little unnerving.  If you want a little more metal around your seat area, do this flight.  The ride was totally smooth, and personally narrated by the pilot...sitting right next to me.  To make the flight extra special, I got to help with the pre-flight check list!  I felt more involved in this flight than in a helicopter.  I was right there with the pilot, helping and seeing all flight prep right in front of me.  I am one of those window watchers in any flight I take, and this was the ultimate view.  My husband and I got the personal touch, not some canned audio presentation, showing us just the sights the flight company wants us to see.  My own personal pilot answered all my questions, and even shared some family hiking stories of his own.  We saw plenty of waterfalls, and traveled over miles of gorgeous coastline before heading through the middle of Kauai, and back to the airport.  I was greeted with a real Kukui nut lei, and a pre-flight photo of my husband and I was waiting in my email box the next day.  I'm only sorry I haven't written this review until now.  Dr. Bruce and his staff were very welcoming, and made sure we had a special experience we will always remember.

review_title: Talkeetna Air Taxi and K2 Aviation
review_text:
Both K2 and Talkeetna Air Taxi (TAT) get my highest recommendation. Follow along with the bouncing ball, kids, as our tale unfolds:

Pre-booked directly with TAT about a month before leaving for Alaska. Our tour train arrived in Talkeetna about noon and we were scheduled to fly with them at 3pm. Walked over to their shop in town at about 1pm and spoke with Chris, who explained  that the weather on the mountain was less than optimum for flightseeing so far that day, and showed us a current computer graphic of the weather system to illustrate the point. We explained that we had only that afternoon available since we were scheduled to leave Talkeetna 11am the following morning. Chris suggested that we kill a few hours in town, cross our fingers, and pray that the weather gods cleared things up enough by early evening to give it a shot. Touched base with him on the hour until 6pm, but the mountain remained fogged in. Sensing our desperation to go up anyway, Chris explained that he'd be happy to fly us around the lower part of the Ruth Glacier on a less extensive tour, but strongly urged us to call it a day since we were likely to be unhappy with the view. Look. When a pilot tells you to cancel...you cancel. We told Chris we'd try him again early the next morning if the weather cleared, and TAT refunded our deposit no questions asked. I have to commend Chris and TAT for their helpfulness and honesty.  

Fast forward to the following morning. We take a look out the back deck of the Talkeetna Alaskan Lodge at 7:45am. The sky is clear and the mountains are in plain view. I call TAT back, but their entire morning schedule is committed to taking up climbers that they were unable to get up the day before, and they can't possibly get us up and back before we have to leave. TAT made their bones depositing climbers on Denali, and understandably they're priority #1. We're out of luck and about out of time.

It's a horrible sight to see a grown man cry. It really is. In a last dicth effort at salvaging the most anticipated part of our trip, I run over to the concierge desk at the lodge and BEG the woman to put us on something...anything...a hot air baloon if necessary... some Wright Brothers pedal-powered contraption...that can get us up to Denali and back by 11am. 

Angels exist. Trust me. I found one. Within 10 minutes, the concierge (who is now a viable candidate for sainthood if she performs just TWO more miracles) called us and set to get ready...she got seats for 4 of us with K2 Aviation at 8:30, and we'd be back in time to make our bus. Take note, my countrymen. I  do solemnly swear that I shall willingly fall upon my sword for this woman should the need ever arise.

Mike at K2 took us up in a 5-seat Cessna for the ride of our lives on their Denali Grand Tour. Nothing compares with the sight of seeing the biggest rock on the North American continent up close and personal. Loss for words. Fill in your favorite superlatives. There's a dreamlike quality to the entire landscape, as if it were some massive painted backdrop for a Cecil B. DeMille film. Mike gave us the 4-1-1 on the geologic environs as we flew around Denali, Foraker, Hunter, the Ruth Glacier and the Talkeetna Mountain range. Absolutely the highlight of our trip to Alaska. It'll be yours, too. 

The flyguys of Talkeetna are a cooperative and close-knit band of brothers who are constantly in radio contact with each other about flying conditions in the area.  You won't find a friendlier, more informative bunch of "Right Stuff"-ers anywhere this side of NASA. Hats off, and sincere thanks to the crews at both K2 AND TAT. 

And, of course, to my guardan angel at the Talkeetna Alaskan concierge desk. Who loves ya, baby?

Strongly suggest that you make arrangements well before you leave for Alaska if you're planning on going on a Denali flight. Space fills up quick (and we got damn lucky). And be prepared on any given day for the mountain to do what the mountain is wont to do. Anything big enough to create its own weather system ain't arranging its day around YOUR schedule. Denali is like a box of chocolates, Forrest...

.

From our phone call with Ellen to check in with Jeannie and Bruce everything was too easy. Try some other activities and you know what I'm talking about.  Personable,friendly,
courteous, professional....you get the picture. 
 
 Then the tour.....oh boy!  This was my first time to Kauai so I thought a flight around the
island would be a great way to get started. We were blessed with a cloudless morning
and Bruce worked his magic for longer than I could have imagined or hoped for. I can't 
say enough about a tour with someone with the knowledge and joy of what they do.

 We were laughing on the short walk to our car about taking the next tour. We did a number of other things including a boat tour of the Na Pali Coast, all great on their own
but Wings Over Kauai was the most memorable of our visit. Will see them again for sure.

                  Aloha,
                            Joe and Luana
                             Haiku,Maui

review_title: Amazing Experience complete with a Glacier Landing!
review_text: This was a wonderful experience. Our private guide called ahead and we were told that the planes were doing the tour but landing on the glacier was not guaranteed for our particular day based on weather. Upon arrival to checkin we were greeted warmly, given our card, and send outside to wait. We were given glacier boots to cover our hiking shoes, in case we were able to disembark and walk on the glacier. Our pilot Tim, was EXCELLENT. He gave us our safety briefing and then did our flying tour, explaining everything, including flying us so close to the peaks, it was incredible. The pictures I took were amazing, it was great. He even played some great music while we flew. We were able to land on the glacier and that was also a great experience. We were traveling with my mom who uses a walker and she was able to climb in and out of the plane. I highly recommend this tour company, there is nothing I can share as constructive criticism, it was amazing.

Cool to ride in a float plane. Not something you get to do often. Our pilot, Tracy, did a great job! We had very beautiful weather, and we got to see the gorgeous views. Would recommend to anyone while in Ketchikan.

Unbelievable experience from Talkeetna flying to Denali summit and landing on glacier.  Our 9 passenger plane piloted by Phil was on the glacier alone for about 20 minutes experiencing the silence and  magnitude of this once in a lifetime experience.

We flew roundtrip with Friday Harbor Seaplanes between Renton and Seattle and used the Sea-Tac shuttle service to get to the Renton airport.  Awesome experience and by far the easiest way to get to San Juan islands if flying in from out of town.   Both flights were on time with professional pilots.  

The plane fit 6 passengers plus the pilot although both of our flights only had 5 people.  There are window seats for 5 passengers.

Everyone that does the open door helicopter tour will tell you to DO IT. I am telling you try something different and do the BIPLANE. It was fantastic. The tour lasted longer than the helicopter at 1 hour 15 min. He narrates the entire time and provides plenty of time for questions. I NEVER felt unsafe. You are securely in but have the ability to feel the air and elements since it is an open cockpit. We went around the ENTIRE island and thru the canyon . Amazing pictures. PLUS once you do it people will be jealous and say, "wow, I wish I would have known about that!"

We couldn’t have asked for better weather or a better pilot! He was professional as well as friendly! We were able to land on Ruth Glacier, walk around the glacier, take photos and phone videos during the entire excursion! I got to sit in the co-pilot seat and had a first hand view of everything from take off to two landings( on and off the glacier)   The pilot pointed out different climbers base camps, climbing route, facts about the mountain and so much more! This was by far the most memorable part of my 12 day trip

Dan was an incredible pilot who made me feel so secure when I was terrified.  It was not scary AT ALL in the end and the views were BREATHTAKING.  This is a MUST do for anyone who wants to see the Grand Canyon.  Incomparable and amazing.

review_title: Flight around Denali and landing on a glacier.
review_text:
This was the highlight of our trip to Alaska.  The scenery is breathtaking and the glacier landing is really fun too.  Our pilot (Alex) had tons of experience (thousands of hours flying these types of flights) and made us feel safe.  He also shared lots of interesting facts about Denali and the glacier.  While this is a bit expensive, it is definitely worth the cost.

BTW, the funky little town of Talkeetna is a lot of fun too.  Sort of like a ski town from the 1950s.

If you drove up to Talkeetna from Anchorage, take the Hatcher Pass on the way back.  It will add about 45 minutes to the trip, but it is totally worth it.   Don't worry when you get to the part that is unpaved, it is very smooth, safe and well travelled.

One of the best things I have ever done in my life. So amazing and so gorgeous of views. It makes the world seem so small. No matter the cost you must take this trip especially if it is the only time you will be there. Once in a lifetime. The people there were great. We booked thru a cruiseline and they were right to use them. Professional and organized. The pilot was nice and knowledgeable. I went by myself as others in my group were scared to take the flight. When I got back and told them the amazing sights and they all wished they went with me instead. MUST DO!!
The airplane ride was my favorite part of the trip, and the chance to fly it, even for a moment, was the highlight of my fiances trip. Highly recommend!

review_title: Fun flightseeing in a tiny airplane
review_text: We took off in the smallest plane in the fleet, which turned out to be perfect, as the day was cloudy and we were able to dart among the clouds until we were above them, with gorgeous views of Denali and the surrounding mountain range.  Our pilot was knowledgable and friendly.  He did everything possible to make our experience special, which it certainly was.  This is not a cheap activity, but if your budge can handle it, it's worth every cent.  Do it!

Coordinating a weekend getaway was so simple with Nicolle and team. Nicolle responding quickly with every question and found the best possible place for us to stay. Our pilot was prompt picking us up and gave us first class treatment in Bimini. An incredible high touch personal experience with this team. I would 100% recommend anyone to plan a trip with Miami Seaplanes :) You will love it!
First time on a helicopter and it was great. The pilot was knowledgeable and exuded confidence. The trip over Grand Canyon was amazing

review_title: Delighted with our choice of plane over helicopter
review_text:
We debated helicopter vs plane  and eventually decided on the plane because we would see more and have more time in the air for less money.  I was also motivated by the fact that planes are safer than helicopters and use less gas. 

We were delighted with our choice. We were made feel so welcome by Bruce and his daughter - charming people. Our pilot was Marcus. I was nervous because he is young but he has great credentials and inspires confidence.  He did a great job telling us about Kauai. 

 The weather wasn't good so I was nervous about a bumpy ride but Marcus knew exactly where the smooth spots were while still showing us everything.  We each had a big window and could talk to each other over the headsets. My husband loved being in the co-pilot seat. We had a great time and highly recommend.
Must be the best tour I ever have taken. Unbelivable views and amazing experience. Great pilot with good sense of humor
Superb guide Eric provided with a Thrilling, exciting  experience with spectacular views which u won’t get otherwise.

review_title: Beautiful way to see the Grand Canyon
review_text: We booked a 9am discovery flight which began a little late but the pilot and stuff were very friendly with a good sense of humour! Lots of photo opportunities and chances to be amazed.

review_title: I'd give it a 15 on a scale of 1 to 10
review_text:
The scenery was amazing!  There is so much natural beauty in Kauai and this is a great and special way to see it.  Some of the interior parts of Kauai are only visible by air, as they are so inaccessible.  All the staff were great and made the experience very pleasant.  Bruce was a very good tour guide and pilot.  His narration added a lot to the experience.  He has a very soothing voice and seems like a very down-to-earth guy.  

Do this -- you won't regret it at al!
A super experience, so beautiful to see!  You can't get a better view of the Grand Canyon.  Pilot explains everything well, really a super flight.  Thanks

We flew from Talkeetna to Anchorage with a fabulous detour over Denali and the Alaska Range. Our pilot took us through some amazing scenic passes over glaciers and around mountain tops with "the Great One" always in view. We were fortunate to have had a day of sun and high clouds creating spectacular views.
Our pilot was very informative and eagerly answered our questions and requests.

Ed Galenkamp

review_title: exciting and interesting way to see the island
review_text: This was a very exciting way to see the island - I was lucky to be able to sit in the co-pilot spot which seems to have the best view (but all seats were great I was told by family). You get to see some remarkable things and don't worry about it going too fast - it doesn't. You have plenty of time to study the terrain. Makana was our pilot and was incredibly good at his job, friendly, and fun. I highly recommend this if you need something in the 60-90 minute range.

This was one of our highlights of our trip! My girlfriend suffers from motion sickness, so helicopter rides are not an option. Thankfully we found Air Ventures and she and I both had an awesome time - plus she didn't need to use their little white bags. :)

Our pilot was Paul and he was a very nice guy. He seemed quite knowledgeable about the island and certainly experienced as a pilot. The plane was comfortable and looked very new inside. The windows were large and gave us a great view as we flew over Waimea and the Na Poli coast (among other places).

Small tip: try to sit on the right-side of the plane. They do turnarounds to show off the views to both sides of the plane, but it seemed like overall the right-side got a slightly better view.

I strongly recommend this tour for anyone wanting an aerial view of the Garden Island.
Lost for words, thank you for an amazing trip Fred & Co! It was truly life changing to go with you guys!

review_title: Best Flightseeing Tour and Company I’ve Ever Seen
review_text: Absolutely amazing experience all around. I was hesitant at first because it was my first time on a small plane, but the pilot was so personable and really perfected the experience. Stunning views that you can’t get anywhere else in Alaska and I also learned so much about the area. Definitely a must for anyone traveling that wants an experience of a lifetime.

What an incredible flight. Lucked out with blue skies and a few small clouds to help the pictures. Pilot was very informative and made sure everyone had a good view no matter which side of the plane you were on.Highly recommend the glacier landing to have the complete experience.

A fantastic day all round.  Very well organised from pick up to drop off and a very professional organisation. Bears in abundance, including cubs feasting on salmon in their natural environment. Incredible. Bald eagles, humpback whales and orcas. An excellent adventure which did not disappoint.

My husband and I took a Wings over Kauai tour in early March 2012.  Bruce and his crew went above and beyond to provide us with an excellent tour- from welcoming us at the door on a first name basis, providing us with reading materials while we waited for the pilot to ready the plane, to opening the door for us as we landed asking us how our flight was.  The plane was able to hold 8 passengers, we only had 3 passengers, my husband and myself and one other.  While many other companies might consider rescheduling or canceling with so few passengers in order to maximize their profit, it appeared Wings over Kauai was interested in providing an exceptional tour and customer experience- big or small profit.  I would recommend this tour to anyone who is considering an air tour in Kauai!

Excellent trip, We were able to see most of KAUAI from above. Everyone made sure that we were having a good safe time. Well worth the cost. Eric called us by name and the headsets worked perfectly. Cool towels were available in case you started to feel a little out of sorts. Also bottle water.

Thank you Eric for such a great and unforgettable experience you provided!
This experience is really the one you will never forget!

On our recent trip to Kauai I really wanted to take an aerial tour of the island, but was discouraged by the helicopter companies policy of gouging big people for a ride. I'm 6'6" and just shy of 300 lbs, and the helicopter operators charge you for an extra seat. 
I discovered AirVentures online, and for just a little over a hundred dollars had a GREAT air tour. 
The staff was super friendly....very Aloha!! I got the seat in back right by the door, with no seat in front of it, and was able to stretch my legs fully out on the ride, and was able to easily see out of both sides of the plane. Our pilot was really cool, and talked with us a lot during the trip.
The ride itself was awesome!! The headphones made the noise minimal, and communications were easy. The takeoff was smooth as can be, and the flight very comfortable. There were a few bumpy parts here and there, but really nothing major. We saw all of the sights from Poipu, up Waimea Canyon, all along Napali, the North Shore beaches, Hanalei Valley, and inland to Waileilei, then over the East Shore before landing back in Lihue. 
While we didn't dive into the canyons like the helicopters do (although watching the helicopters below us, I thought they got a bit too close for comfort) we flew low enough to see everything in great detail. And there was no "wasted" time flying over the water as somebody had previously posted. 
AirVentures Kauai is an excellent value....if you dont want to pay the exorbinant charges the helicopter companies charge, book this flight....you WILL NOT be disappointed!!
One last thing, if it is the only splurge you take on your trip....do not miss flying over Kauai. It is honestly the most beautiful sight I have ever seen.
Flight around Denali. fantastic views and pilot, fantastic views and pilot, fantastic views and pilot

It's best option to look around whole island within an hour. The staffs were very kind and everything went well. I have a motion sickness so boat tour is littlebit hard for me because it takes more than 4 hrs. Times fly~I highly recommend this tour to all of you.

My wife and i did the 30 minute plane ride and this was way too short.  We should have done the hour or two hour as time went by so quickly.  You really do appreciate things when you see them from a different perspective.  Ariel (Tony's son) was a great pilot/guide, really showing us how much he enjoys flying and the area.  Our trip was delayed a bit due to the weather, but we still have great views regardless of the overcast skies.  This was the highlight of our trip.

Tips: Dock wasn't the easiest to find; GPS didn't direct us right and we had to call for instructions.  Also, make sure to wear sandals or flip/flops since you need to walk into 5 or 6 inches of water of get to the plane and there's jagged rocks below water.

review_title: Helicopter ride over the Canyon was AWESOME!
review_text:
We booked the helicopter ride with Maverick because it got the best reviews here, and we were not disappointed. After being warned I might get motion sick, I was a little apprehensive. Our pilot, Matt, was so smooth and gave us the best ride! The moment when you leave the forest area and first go out over the canyon just can't be described - it really just takes your breath away. 

He spent time hovering in several spots, and explained what all the different peaks were called and where the names originated. He also rotated the helicopter so that every person got a clear view of everything. He was so nice, as were all the other people we interacted with at Maverick. The helicopter was brand new, and very comfortable. 

I would definitely recommend this activity - even for those who are afraid of heights or might be afraid of motion sickness - it was the best!!!

We’ve never seen Hawaii until we saw it from the air.  The pilot was amazing.  The staff friendly and accommodating.  The ride was so smooth, I didn’t have any motion sickness that I normally experience.

I encouraged my husband to take the biplane flight/tour. I had no intention of going. My husband and the pilot Mark encouraged me to go along. The front seat holds two. I decided to share the experience and I'm so glad I did. Mark was such a great pilot and enthusiastic guide. He showed us such beautiful views of the canyons, rock spires and formations, explained special sights or industrial locations like potash ponds. He is such a good pilot I felt completely at ease after feeling this was not for me. Mark was as big a part of the special adventure as the cool plane and views were. The ground staff were really friendly and seemed as pleased about our happiness when we landed as we were. Thank you, Mark and Redtail Air Adventures.

I went up with Bruce in the 172 and had a marvelous time. I am an instrument rated private pilot and had some fun flying the plane as well as seeing the gorgeous island from above. Bruce is an excellent flight instructor, and I appreciated picking up some new tips. He was also great as a tour guide and taking control while I snapped pictures. The staff was welcoming and efficient. I will definitely visit them again.

We flew to a glacier and landed on our first day in Alaska.  The company was very safety oriented .  Our pilot was Michael and he was excellent.  Told us all about the area and made it look so simple.  Landing on the glacier was crazy exciting.
We had to wait for the skies to clear, but we had a great flight all around Denali and a super landing on a huge glacier, a highlight of our trip.

From the reservation process through the flight, this was a professional and well run excursion. 

Everyone is so nice and they continually worked with us while we worried about rain and changing us from a private flight to a group tour so we could get the photographs we wanted.
