The fight itself was flawless. Marcus is an amazing pilot. His commentary was informative and his landing was impeccable! We didn’t even know we’d touched down. 

I would highly recommend Wings over Kaua’i!!

You’ll get your picture taken before you take off and receive a gift upon landing. 
I have motion sickness issues, but was perfectly fine until the very end of the flight. 

Mahalo to everyone involved, we had a great flight!!

review_title: Flying over the island of Kauai
review_text: This is a perfect way to see the island - from Waimea Canyon to the Napili Coast.  The 6 seater plane offered each of the passengers a window seat with full viewing, and the pilot (J.T.) turned the plane so both sides had equal sharing time of the impressive sites.  Read many reviews on helicopter rides and I believe this little plane gives them a run for their money (but doesn't charge as much).  Well worth the trip !!!! Viewing was amazing ! J.T. was awesome for our pilot (very knowledgeable and sings his pilot lingo a little), but the whole crew was fabulous !!!
Stopped in and took a flight around Denali and talked to the pilots a while before and after as I'm a pilot and they were very friendly!

We (4 adults) took a cruise to Alaska, and although a couple of the individuals have some fear of small planes, we decided to do the misty fjords excursion (we booked this directly, not through the ship). From beginning to end the experience was wonderful.  We were picked up on time and taken to their office, where 10-12 bald eagles were perched nearby.  After checking the radar and webcams (we were allowed to also view) we boarded the plane and took off.  Takeoff, landing and the flight it self was very peaceful and we were advised of all the different scenery (with nice music when people weren't talking). Communication is easy, and the scenery is beautiful.   We did not see any wildlife, but the experience and views made it all more than worthwhile!  This is a definite must do!

I have never flown in a 6 seater plane, was very nervous but knew if the weather was clear that I must do it. The sun was out, our pilot Leeann is a 3rd generation woman pilot and was the perfect guide for us. She had previously lead climbers up Denali so her experience and knowledge of the area and terrain was invaluable. It was a very humbling, moving experience to be in a tiny plane at 12,000 ft and look up at the 20,000+ ft stunning Denali right in front of us, to fly over the glacier and granite landscapes. We saw things I will never see again from the air. Flying over the base camp for the climbers was also very moving, to visualize the feat of their efforts. It made it very real for me. We landed on Ruth Glacier, 4000 ft thick at the 5000 ft elevation level. We got out and spent 30 minutes there. Blue skies, sun on "the mountain", walking in the snow. What a once in a life time experience!! Leeann always made sure we were informed, safety was her 1st priority. The entire staff from pilot to all staff made sure we were comfortable in every way. I am so glad I pushed myself to do this. They give you glacier boots to keep your shoes dry. All seats are window seats and the headsets were perfect for the narration and noise. AMAZING!!  Do it!!

review_title: flight over glacier with glacier landing on 6/24/17
review_text:
Amazing!
The highlight of our trip!  We would highly recommend this special adventure!
Excellent service by the ground crew & a great pilot!
Smooth ride & majestic sights!

I did my research. I looked at the pictures. I read the reviews. When it was time to make the reservation, my expectations were high. We were lucky that we had a beautiful day ahead of us. Nothing compares to when that plane is flying towards Denali. But when it came time to land....... words can't express it. It is one of the most beautiful sights I've ever seen. The entire crew, from the aviation center to the pilot (Chris) were true professionals. Highly recommend it. Highly enjoyed it. Highly met all my expectations. Thank you.

It was great plane ride!
We were going for a helicopter ride and decided last minute to switch up to a plane ride and wow 
Good thing we did!
It was the greatest experience we could have done in Maui!
Everytbing was so great I will be doing it again in the future!

review_title: Amazing Father’s Day with my son.
review_text: For the price, this might be one of the best experiences of my life. My 11 year old son and I had a great time. Our pilot made the whole thing so much fun and he made my son feel so cool by letting him sit up front and talking to him the whole time. I wouldn’t think twice to schedule another flight with them.
Great side by side couple hours in Denali mountains!! Bumpy but lot of fun! Scenery amazing and guides knowledge were super!!!
Amazing views and most efficient way to see the entire island. Highly recommend it to anyone wanting to see all the highlights of Maui in one tour!

You have to take this tour if you go to alaska!
Please don't miss it. 
When we went glacier landing was not possible but just the flight tour was breath taking.
Once in a lifetime experience! Beautiful views and very pleasant flight! Its worth it and will definatelly do it again!

review_title: Amazing Views and a Smooth Ride
review_text: What a wonderful way to see the island! The whole experience was amazing. It was fascinating to see the cliffs and waterfalls on the way to Hana as well as some of the houses tucked away in the greenery. I had never been in a small plane before and was a little nervous. Eric and Blake made it easy. I just parked my car, received a warm welcome and then walked right to the airplane.  Once there, they explained the safety procedures, made sure we were comfortable and we were off into the clouds.  It was literally smooth sailing in the sky - much better than riding on the roads.  I highly recommend it!!
Spectacular, breathtaking, once in a lifetime experience. (Unless you decide to do it again cause it’s so good). Pilot was amazing and made the whole experience very comfortable.
An amazing experience. Eric did a great job and talked us through the whole flight. Great service as well.

review_title: Such an amazing view of downtown Portland.
review_text: Our pilot Corey to be honest. He was super polite and delivered an outstanding tour and brief history of Portland

review_title: Amazing Value & Great Tour Guide - Justin
review_text:
Booked Air Ventures Hawaii on Kauai for a same week excursion. We found them on Tinggly and saw their reviews on that site before booking. It was an amazing decision! I have been on a Kauai helicopter ride as well so I was able to experience both.

Air Ventures is definitely a value for the experience! Our pilot Justin was considerate and caring. He answered all my questions about the island and really made an effort to show the best of the island including pointing out a humpback whale off the Nepali coast!

A few notes on the services itself:
- $149 per person is a deal!
- The right side of the plane sees more of the best of the island including waterfalls and the Napali coast, but Justin did an amazing job making sure the left side got to see everything too with some awesome turns.
- The plane is not like a doors off helicopter. It's a smoother ride, and the views are less dramatic. For those who are prone to air sickness, I highly recommend over the helicopter.
- Parking and check-in is a breeze, it's right by the FedEx and has a designated parking lot
- Very organized operations and the staff are super friendly

I would highly recommend Air Ventures Hawaii in Kauai!
TAT was very helpful getting me on a flight last minute. The knowledge and the views are amazing. Would definitely do again thanks TAT!

Chris was an excellent pilot and tour guide.  We were fortunate to see Denali.  The glacier landing was a once in a lifetime experience.  My granddaughter loved playing in the snow. Definitely a highlight of our trip!

My wife Cindy and I traveled to Kauai in early March.  Since the Napali coastline is only accessible by air or sea, we planned to take a flight over the Island.
The first day we scheduled a flight turned out to be cloudy with very low visibiltiy; so, Bruce and Ellen were able to reschedule our trip.
The morning of the trip turned out bright and sunny.  Bruce prepared us for the trip with all the pre-flight info.  We took the 70 minute flight to be able to view everything.  Bruce did an excellent job of pointing out the numerous highlights.  The waterfalls are simply spectacular!!!  We saw the Waimea Canyon from the ground; however, the flight over the Canyon was awesome!
Then, we flew along and over the Napali Coastline which is simply magnificent.  All the while, Bruce is continuing to point out places and areas of interest.  Great Job Bruce!!
I highly recommend the flight and consider it an absolute must for any visitor to Kauai!
Again, thanks for the wonderful trip and experience!
Roger & Cindy Thompson
Council Bluffs, IA

We took the 2 hour flight over Miami and the Everglades. Our pilot was very friendly and showed us some beautiful houses and wonderful beaches. But the best part of the tour was the flight out to the Everglades. Way up high you could see the enormity of this National Park. We also flew up close and saw alligators in the water. Time flew by while we were up there.

This is a great excursion if you want a birds eye view of Denali.  There were some concerns about whether we would be able to land on a glacier due to weather but they made it happen!  They work with your schedule as much as possible which was really nice.  

On a separate note, if you are prone to air sickness or ear popping, be prepared to feel a little off- at least I did.  I don't know that I could do this tour again just because of my own issues but I'm glad I did it once!  The views and being up in the mountains among the glaciers was really surreal and so peaceful.  Kids enjoyed and husband got to sit in the cockpit with pilot.
The whole tour package was wonderful, and the entire staff was marvelous!  Highly recommended.  May take another tour with Westwind.
Really Recommended, The view was just Awesome my wife and I really enjoyed thank you Eagles Air Tours we will be back soon.

We just completed our first Grand Canyon visit and the Scenic River Canyon Tour was the absolute best part of the trip. The entire tour could not have ran smoother. We arrived at the airport at 5:45 am, about 15 minutes from the El Tovar Lodge at Grand Canyon Village. Easy check in. We were provided a light breakfast with muffins, fruit, juice and coffee. We gathered in a comfortable lounge while waiting for the departure. We boarded about 6:20 with departure at 6:30. There were 6 passengers on our plane, every seat a window seat. Our pilot was delightful and informative. Although the plane was small, the flight was super smooth and thrilling. No matter how long you look, you can not see the depth and detail of the canyon from the rim like you can from the air. It is something I will never forget. After about a 50 minute flight, we landed in Page. We were soon met at the airport by a Navajo guide that would take us via 4-wheel vehicle to Antelope Canyon, a 20 min drive. The truck was open-air, so a little cool, but not too bad. At the canyon, the guide took us through, stopping and explaining exactly what we were seeing and the science and history around it. She gave us all tips on how to photograph the canyon and made this part of the tour a highlight. I promise you it will be the most beautiful place that you never heard of. After completing this part of the tour, we boarded a bus for a 10-12 min ride, and were provided a boxed lunch. The next stop was the canyon river portion of the tour. There we boarded a raft with our river guide 'Jenny'. You can sit in the provided cushion seating or the large pontoons. I recommend sitting in the seats just forward of Jenny's console. Those seats have back rests. Most folks ate their lunch as we headed down the river. Iced water and lemonade was provided. The 3 hour ride was incredible! It was slow and smooth, just fast enough to create a gentle, and appreciated breeze. You find yourself looking in all directions. The vistas in front and behind you. And the massive walls of rock on each side. In many places the 46 degree water was crystal clear and fish are easily seen. Jenny was a compete joy. She was funny, informative, courteous and helpful. She constantly informed us as to what we were seeing, and added great stories along the way. We made a stop along the way on a small sandy beach. Bath rooms are provided. You're also able to check out some  petroglyphs on the  canyon walls. After about a 30 min break, we re-boarded and continued down the river. More incredible views were along the way to Lees Ferry, where our motor coach back to the airport was waiting. There are bathrooms here as well. The bus was very comfortable and most folks napped on the way back. We stopped at Cameron Trading Post for about 30 min to stretch our legs and purchase souvenirs if you're inclined. The bus driver also was courteous and informative as we drove past more vistas along Desert View Drive. We returned to where we started,12 hours earlier. I can't think of any better way to experience the canyon. From the air, the Colorado River at the base and the rim during the drive back. I highly recommend the tour. It's a little pricey but you won't regret it.

Air Ventures Hawaii is absolutely the best way to see all of the best parts of the island, from the Na Pali coast, the Waimea valley, and multiple waterfalls. Our pilot was great and setting up the tour was low-stress and hassle free. The price for an hour's trip was very reasonable. I recommend going after you've spent a few days on the island, as you can pick out places you've already been but from a totally different perspective.

This was an absolutely fantastic experience and I would highly recommend it! The pilot was so nice, accommodating and did anything and everything possible to ensure we were comfortable and had a great experience. Thank you Maui Plane Rides for making our anniversary so special and memorable!
Excellent experience. Unbelievable scenery. This was our first time flying on a small plane and it was fantastic. This was the highlight of our vacation.

Wow! What an experience. From the minute we arrived at Tusayan GCNP airport, to the moment we touched down after an exhilerating 45 minute flight over the GC - every second was INREDIBLE.

It was great to see the GC from above, and even more so as the North Ridge was still covered in snow - what a site! 

Absolutely worth every cent!

My husband and I had a great time on our flightseeing trip with Wings Over Kauai. The captain, Bruce, makes you feel completely comfortable and it helps tremendously that he is so friendly and at ease himself. 

There were three main reasons that we chose to do an airplane tour instead of the helicopter: 1. The price, Wings OVer Kauai was less than half the price of helicopter tours. 2. The plane tours were recommended to us by people we spoke to while in Kauai. 3. My husband gets motion sickness which helicopters aggravate badly. Ellen gave my husband some ginger candies to help his nausea before we left and Bruce was extremely good about checking to make sure he was still doing good. 

Our tour with Wings Over Kauai was definately one of the highlights of our trip!

from the moment i started email talk about my flight i knew these were a good company,You can just tell cant you
They were there at the exact time on pick up and the driver was brilliant and talked to us all and got us more excited!
once we arrived at the base we met the staff who were equally friendly then we went to the plane,the pilot was great and had a very witty sense of humour so we got on great.
the flight was truly amazing,The pilot was as well.
the views on offer were jaw droppingly good.it was a 30min flight but it felt much longer,the pilot also had a lot of info on the city.
It was just amazing and i cant recomend this company highly enough,YOU MUST get in touch with this place to create a memory of a lifetime.
Just to add....i asked the driver on the way back to drop me off at the golden gate bridge,Because we were all talking he missed the stop,No problem he just turned round and drove back over it to drop me off!! perfect customer relations.
Go book it.

review_title: Amazing a must do while in Kauai
review_text: Extremely memorable!!! Took this tour our first day on the island it was unbelievable!!! Absolutely magnificent. Our whole family did it which included our 4 and 9 year old children it was thoroughly enjoyed by the whole family. Bruce was amazing as well as all the office staff. Very personable and knowledgable about the island. They make you feel safe, comfortable, and welcome. I would recommend this tour without any reservation for all ages. Thank you wings over Kauai!!!

The flight in a bi plane was something I wanted to do since I was young. When I saw this opportunity while planning the trip to Hawaii, this became #1 on my bucket list. All of the folks at Air Ventures were extremely courteous and friendly. The plane is nearly new and the pilot very qualified and friendly. and helpful. It was cold, rainy and absolutely beautiful flying around the island. This flight by far was more than expected. Totally fun. Would do it in a heart beat again.
We had a excellent flight over Canyonlands and arces national park. Everything was great. We planed the trip a view months ago and the organization was great.

review_title: A Highlight of of Our Alaska Vacation
review_text:
We were traveling with our two young teenage granddaughters and took a K2 Aviation flight through the glacier fields and then on to the airport in Anchorage.  The weather was not conducive to flying around Denali and so we had an up close view of the mountains and glaciers to the  southwest of Talkeetna.

Our plane was their Piper Apache six passenger 300 horsepower that made for a great flight for the four of us and our wonderful pilot Rosemary.  With their headphone set up for everyone, we got a description of what we were seeing and the chance to ask questions.  The girls had never flown in a small general aviation plane and loved the experience.  They had lots of questions for Rosemary about how she became a pilot.  We got a wonderful sightseeing experience and an empowering learning about the learning to be a pilot.

This flight was without a doubt the highlight of our Alaska trip.  The girls rated this better than the Husky puppies at Martin Buser’s and that is saying something.

Definitely the best way to see the Grand Canyon. No other view will ever compare to flying over the Grand Canyon. We are not rich or well off by any means but it was 100% well worth the money spent. Our pilot, Vern, was awesome and pointed out a lot of cool sights, like rafters on the river who were so tiny they looked like Legos. We will never forgot our helicopter tour over the Grand Canyon. Simply breathtaking!

DISCLAIMER: I’m a tour professional living and working here in Alaska and not compensated in any way for this review. I do it because these operators are my FELLOW ALASKANS. 

There are a handful of memory-making travel experiences around the world that are worth the extra expense after just “getting there”. When you come to South Central Alaska (the greater Anchorage area), a flight up into the Alaska Range is a must. Sure, it’s spendy. (But many worthwhile things in life aren’t easy or cheap.) Get a mountain-sized dose of amazement and humility flying among the mountains above glacier-covered gorges. The beauty is mesmerizing. Feeling so tiny against these giant peaks gives one the opportunity to take a breath and view life's hassles with a little humility and perspective.

I’ve been bringing guests to K2 Aviation for almost two decades because of their outstanding commitment to safety and hospitality. From nearly immaculate aircraft to the thoughtful considerations like a basket of “loaner” sunglasses, K2 has this thing figured out! With K2, everything from the patience of the folks on the phones explaining prices and weather, to the shuttle drivers and pilots who clearly LOVE what they do, these people care that guests have a genuinely amazing time. But it’s not just tour groups that get great service. I’ve seen independent travelers in rental cars walk away after a flight with the same joyful glow that my guests get after a great flight.

REAL TALK: The Alaska Range is tricky. The weather up here is tricky. Book the first available time slot that you can. Try to be in Talkeetna more than one night to increase your chances of a “try again” flight in case weather isn’t cooperative during your visit. What K2 tells you about weather and visibility comes from a deep tradition of transparency with their guests. They really desire that everyone has a great flight. They have been forthright with me in communication. I trust them when they advise me about weather and I know from years of successful flights and hundreds of happy clients that they want all fliers to come away with a mind-blowing, life-changing flight in the Alaska Range!

TIPS: Be on time. Wear a mask. Tip your pilot. If you’re in a group, one person takes a time-lapse video and others take photos to share later. Put down the cameras every few minutes and soak in the experience with your eyes and your imagination. Enjoy the moment and make some truly amazing memories!

review_title: Awesome flight through and around Denali
review_text: Landing on the Ruth Glacier was one of the most amazing experiences. Surrounded by all the peaks in the middle of Denali is almost mystical!

review_title: Airplanes fly when copters get cancelled
review_text: We did a plane tour over the canyon with Grand Canyon Airlines out of the nearby airport right outside the park entrance. We had scheduled a helicopter tour with Papillion but it was cancelled due to high winds without any notice even though i heard later they had been canceling all week.. The plane was cheaper and a very smooth ride.. I was also disappointed to learn copters and planes can't fly below the level of the canyon inside the park so I wouldn't have been able to land at the bottom of the canyon anyway unless I had taken a copter tour from Vegas or at the skywalk that fly over and Inside landing in the canyon. GC Airlines was very professional and I was impressed with them. They also had a nice gift shop. The tour was narrated in various languages over headsets. The only downfall was thelackofpersonalinteraction with the pilot..
The fight was thrilling , the weather beautiful.  Our pilot Kim was engaging and very informative.  A must, to really see the Aches, Canyonlands and Monument Valley. A once in a life time experience.

We did a lot of research before we went and ended up booking with Maverick due to the trip advisor reviews. So glad we did. It was amazing and whilst the Grand Canyon would be amazing with any of the tour companies, Maverick were faultless. Great pilot and very knowledgable, took off on time, super helicopter and all round great customer service.
My wife and I had a great time and beautiful views - even though we did not see the top of Denali. It was still worth the trip! Our pilot and staff were great!

review_title: Private Pilot - Do your own flight around the island
review_text:
As private pilot, I was able to rent a Cessna with one of the CFI instructors from the company, and do my own tour around the island, taking my family for the nice personal flight tour. 

Wings over Kauai office is located at the airport and you will depart and land at the same airport used by all airplanes that land on the island. The flight around the island, including flying over all local attractions will take up to 1 hour to complete. Because of the water (ASL to 3,500 feet AGL), you will experience clouds below, above and around you. The flight includes mountain flying as well as flying over the water, so get ready to polish your private pilot flying skills.
The view is beyond description. Highly recommended experience. Eric explained everything in details. Made our day.
Bruce the pilot was great with our 2 nervous flyers.  He gave a great talk while we were flying and patiently answered any/all questions.  All of us were raving about the tour long after it ended.

excellent staff,pilot and equipment. They took care to explain that the winds would not allow the trip to the back of the mountain and quickly credited our total $$. Nice location/shop and orderly departure -- felt safe and informed throughout -- would definitely recommend K2! THANK YOU ALL

Highly recommended experience to see the island. Wonderful views, friendly adventure. Great photo opportunity. Warm greeting and comfortable smooth expierence with a history lesson of the island. You won't be disappointed.

review_title: Must do. You can never get such a view without taking a flight
review_text: This is a must do when you visit Alaska and this is the only way you can see the Denali peak. The view from the flight is one of it kind. It gives you an idea of how large the mountains and peaks are. But the most important thing in that you have good clear weather. We got lucky. Our captain was really good and gave us information during the flight. He also took photos for us after we landed on the glacier. The only downside was that we was there on the glacier only for few minutes. A little more time on the glacier would be good. I would recommend this to all tourists.

The staff was very friendly.  The pilot was knowledgeable and very amusing.  We toured the whole island and one thing that struck me was that he would fly over an area and let the right side see then double back and let the left side get the close up look.  My wife and I had a blast, and would recommend this to anyone that enjoys seeing different perspectives of places.

This flight/tour was just as good as advertised.  The plane held ten passengers including the pilot.  Everyone had a window seat and the pilot did his best to make sure that everyone saw everything and he would teach about the all of the sights that we came across.  This is a great way to experience the awesome magnificence of Mount Denali and its glaciers.

The entire team at AirVentures was amazing. Jill and her husband make you feel like family. And JT was a great pilot tour guide. That’s a pretty amazing task to do at once. The whole team truly wanted you to have a great time and was willing to serve you however possible. We felt safe and had a fantastic time together!

On June 15, 2016, my wife and I were driving back home to Fairbanks from Anchorage on a beautiful sunny summer day and Mt. Denali was just standing out against the blue sky. We decided to drive into Talkeetna to see if we could get on a flight seeing trip and land on the Ruth Glacier. We lucked out and were able to book a ride. We only had to wait around for about 1.5 hours. The experience flying up to the glacier is breath taking. It was really neat to land on the Ruth Glacier in the Sheldon Amphitheater. The whole trip with the time spent on the glacier was about 1.75 hours. You get relatively close to the mountain and the landing spot is at 5400 ft altitude. 

If you are in this area and the sky is clear and they are flying up to Denali, this trip is highly recommended. Do not pass it up. I am 69 years old, I was born and raised in Fairbanks, AK and after decades of flying by Mt. Denali on my way to or from Anchorage, I finally made the decision to experience this wonderful trip.

We had a wonderful experience from the time we arrived, in the air and back. Our pilot was very friendly and professional. The highlight being the Birthday Boy flew the plane to his big surprise and amazement. The scenery along the coast and over Golden Gate Bridge was amazing. Time and money well spent.

It was a wonderful airplane tour over the beautiful island of Kauai. The guide/pilot was a good host. The flight was fairly smooth overall. It provides an interesting perspective of the island and of whales in the ocean as well. Definitely worth doing for the price of admission being so much cheaper than the helicopter tours.

My family and I thoroughly enjoyed a wonderful flight experience. The pilot, plane, staff and service were all exceptional. Hats off to K2!

PS: regarding the question below, our visit was family (dad and three 20+ year olds)

The booking process was extremely easy and made the check in day of even easier. Our pilot was very knowledgeable and provided tons of fun facts throughout the flight. Even though Denali was in the clouds, it was still insane views!

review_title: Fabulous Adventure of Bay Area Sightseeing
review_text:
From the start, the ease and friendliness of making a reservation is as good or better than I’ve experienced in a life of traveling.
The planes and equipment are top notch.
Quality aircraft, taken extremely good care of.
The pilot was very knowledgeable and wanted to know what we wanted, not give us an off the shelf trip.
Hi end knowledge of the Bay Area and it’s history made our trip really a great one.
We felt like we had new friends that we will come back to and take another trip with because it was so fun!

This was part of another tour that had eight people on it, including our two traveling companions.  We were separated from our companions and put on two different planes. We were introduced to our pilots. I don't remember either's name. But I have included a picture of our pilot. The other pilot was a young woman with long curly hair. Both were excellent. We were asked our seating preferences. And all got the seat that each wanted. Each person had a window. I was in the back seat and had one on each side. We circled sites so that both sides could see them. A bonus was seeing so many whales. A fantastic tour.

Wonderful, fantastic, exhilarating views of the islands. Saw sights you just don’t see from land or boat. Eric is a great pilot and knowledgeable tour guide. I can’t wait to go up again and see more of Maui with him.

Everything we did was well planned. The only waiting we had to do was beofre going to Glen Canyon Dan and the rafts was waiting for a supervisor before we could go through the security check beford getting on the bus. Weather was perfect....

This was truly an exciting memorable experience. I, and my family, totally enjoyed the experience of flying over a glacier and being so close to the peaks it seemed as if one could touch them. The pilot was competent and pleasant. To become immersed (even for a short time) in the beauty and majesty of nature is something to be experienced.
Everything went great, everybody was professional, but super friendly! Our pilot was personable but obviously experienced and capable. It was an awesome time I'll remember forever!

review_title: Flight of a Life time - Misty Fjords by Seawind aviation!
review_text: We really enjoyed this excursion.  The entire was accommodating and friendly.  Our pilot Ed was exceptional.  Let me sit up front with him, and explained everything as we flew.  He shared a lot of history with us, his family has grown up there for  several generations.  He picked a beautiful spot to land the plane of a lake.  Great pictures with those gorgeous views.

review_title: Landing on a glacier is awesome!
review_text: We had a fantastic experience! Chris is an excellent pilot and guide. He shared personal experiences with us and is a wealth of knowledge.  We got a beautiful view of the area. Landing on a glacier is incredible! We laid on it and even threw a couple of ice balls at each other.  We highly recommend

review_title: flight around Mt Denali with glacier landing
review_text: We had a crystal clear day, with 2 feet of fresh snowfall on the peaks, and the trip was spectacular. Our pilot was a great source of information and details.  I loved every minute of the trip.
The entire experience was fantastic. Out pilot was a great guide and this was definitely worth the money.

JT was our pilot on our 60 minute tour of Kauai. It greatly exceeded my already high expectations. Highly recommend to anyone visiting the island. Gives a great overall and history of the island without spending hours and days in your car.

Fabulous trip! I did the Denali Grand flight and our pilot, Joe, was great. He is also a photographer so was able to put us in position to get some great shots. He was very knowledgeable about the area and pointed out so many things to us. This was the best part of my trip to Talkeetna. Many thumbs up! 
👍👍👍
Ray is a great pilot that showed us lots of waterfalls and good commentary. It was a good ride. We thoroughly enjoyed the sites he flew over.

After living in the islands and visiting all the major ones, this was our most exciting time!  My wife Susan and myself were treated like family by Bruce and Ellen.  They are gracious and caring people who make your trip unforgettable.  Bruce is a wealth of knowledge regarding Kauai.  The flight was interactive and flew over the most amazing country I have ever seen.  It was the smoothest most satisfying flight we have ever experienced. We are coming back next year and I will look up Bruce and Ellen again.  Do not pass up the opportunity to fly with them.  It was incredible !!!
We had an amazing flight with Eric! Beautiful views of Maui and Moloki. Truly a once in a lifetime experience. Book your flight and you’ll be glad you did.

We were greeted with a very friendly staff the moment we walked in until the moment we walked out.   The helicopter was well maintained, comfortable and very clean.  We felt safe at all times.  
The views of the Grand Canyon was simply breathtaking
It’s wonderful adventure! Would recommend to anyone? Awesome. Wonderful & experienced pilot, Eric. Love it!

We took our grandchildren on the 45 minute helicopter tour of the Grand Canyon.  This is the second time my husband and I have used Maverick and have been very pleased with them.  They do a wonderful job!  The kiddos were absolutely thrilled with the experience!  It gave them a great overall perspective of the size and grandeur of the Grand Canyon before embarking on hiking.  Maverick was professional, informative and did a wonderful job in all aspects or our ride; we could not have been more pleased!!!  They thought of everything we could need or want; it was a wonderful experience!!!

Very helpful, safe, and most importantly super romantic.
I booked it for my wife’s birthday, we got everything we wanted, even tho we were a little bit late because of Uber driver drove us somewhere else. Steve was super responsible and reliable person. I definitely recommend booking this service! Especially for a special occasion.
It was amazing  I will definitely recommended to anyone that wants do something different we their friends or partner

The day started out cloudy, so my first original flight was delayed until conditions cleared up. Which they did because they want you to have the best experience, and I was happy they did this for me! The experience was amazing and something I’ve never done before! It was a wicked blast that I booked another flight with a glacier landing for late May!

review_title: The best hour we spent in Kauai
review_text:
WoK was super nice and professional, and the tour itself is our best memory in Kauai.

I was concerned that my 28 week pregnant wife might have motion sick for the flight, WoK was happy to rescheduled for me a morning flight with a bigger plane. It turns out to be only my family was there so we actually get a private tour.  Our pilot speaks Chinese which is a big plus as my wife & kids doesn't speaks much English, and the pilot introduced so many attractions in the flight. They gave my wife and daughter beautiful flowers which is the first surprise. 

The weather was very good for flight and we were lucky to see the Mount Waialeale, the wall of tears. Needless to say we go to the Na Pali coast, the waimea canyon, we even saw some dorphins. 

I would definitely do this again in next visit.

My wife and I took the Denali Flyer tour as part of our 25th Anniversary trip to Alaska.  It was amazing!  We had perfect weather and the views of Denali were spectacular...officially part of the 30% club.  Our pilot, whose name I unfortunately don't remember, gave us a perfect flight and provided information on everything from the peaks and glaciers we flew past to the history of Denali...he made the experience even more enjoyable.  If we ever return to Alaska, we will definitely be taking another flight with K2 and I highly recommend them to anyone looking for a wonderful experience.

Wow! Definitely the pinnacle of our trip! When deciding what we liked best about our honeymoon, my wife and I both agreed we had to throw out the flightseeing tour because it was far and away the best part. Although it was pricey it was worth every penny! We took the green route and paid extra for the glacier landing. Again yes it was expensive but WOW the views of Alaska from the plane were breathe taking! Our pilot, Chris if I remember correctly, was very knowledgeable about the glaciers, the mountain, and the area.

review_title: By far better than a helicopter!!!!
review_text:
Everyone gets a window seat....how cool! This is much quieter, smoother and all around a better option. Our pictures were perfect. I do suggest doing this at the start of your stay. Do not hesitate to use Air Adventures!!  Thanks to Reese and Harry for a perfect outing. 
Excellent!!!!!
Amazing ride! Saw some amazing views! Crater was amazing and say the resorts. Pilot was amazing and talked the whole time and guided us around!
This is an amazing way to see all of Kauai, whales, Waimea Canyon, waterfalls, Napali Coast.  Our pilot did not disappoint!

Hubby and I debated spending money on this, esp including glacier landing. SOOO GLAD we did!!!  we only had 2 nights in Talkeetna so scheduled 11 am 1st day to give us a 2nd day possible reschedule buffer if weather not good.  on our drive up to talkeetna they called to tell us 11 am was cancelled, but wondered if we would be open to a 6 pm as they thought weather might open up ... and it did!!!  they normally do not stay open that late but they sent out 3 planes at that time.  Our pilot was amazing & I was lucky to sit in cockpit on the way out and watch him brilliantly fly it.  Ride was smooth and views unforgettable (glaciers, hikers at basecamp and on the mountain, and, of course, Denali and all of it's beauty).  Got to see another plane land after us on the glacier, and witnessed small avalance while we were out on the glacier.  We have travelled many places and done many adventurous things, but personally this ranked at, if not the top, of things we have done.  If you are blessed with the weather to allow this, just do it.
The highlight of our Alaska vacation.  Lucky to have a beautiful sunny afternoon to enjoy the views.  The pilot and the rest of the staff were great.  Do this if you can.

This was a bucket-list flight for my husband and me and the centerpiece of our trip/cruise to Alaska. We were fortunate to have Patrick as our pilot. He was experienced and very knowledgeable about the area. The weather had been iffy, but cleared enough for him to take us above the clouds to see top of Mt. Denali. Our flight through the Alaska Range was truly spectacular, culminating in our glacier landing. Patrick explained the weather situation and landing procedure to us in advance, and we felt completely at ease. It was breathtaking, a once-in-a-lifetime experience! We knew we were in very good hands. As a result, we would highly recommend K-2 flights to anyone considering a flight-seeing tour of this area!

I’ve never been on a helicopter tour and I was debating if this would be worth it - especially given the price. It is absolutely worth every penny! Our guide Jesse was fantastic and everyone was very friendly. Great tour. Highly recommend.

Our experience was awesome. The ride was a lot smoother than we expected and it was an absolutely beautiful day. Our pilot was so friendly and knowledgeable of the island since he was born there.  It was very obvious that he loved his job. I highly recommend this adventure.

review_title: Flying High with Air Ventures Hawaii
review_text: This was the first activity we did in Kauai.  It was the best decision we could have made.  Flying over the entire island gave us a birds eye view of everything and helped us understand the layout of the island. The views were spectacular.  The pilot was awesome.  He gave just enough information without spoiling the trip with constant banter.  It was incredible to fly over and into the canyon.  We viewed waterfalls galore that can be seen no other way.  Flying the Ne Pali Coast is a must - even if you plan to see it by boat.  (We did both and liked the view from the air better!).  We saw whales from the air too!  Flying with Air Ventures Hawaii is a must do when you visit Kauai!!!

review_title: The best, the very, very best experience with a glacier landing also!
review_text:
Mike who was our pilot, was a quiet guy, very knowledgeable and obviously a real professional. He shared all the important stuff along the way, pointed out all the must sees and a few more. He manoeuvres the plane to ensure that every gets the chance to see the same thing and in doing so it makes the trip a bit of fun with some of the turns! He made us feel really welcome and when we landed on the glacier it was such an awesome time for these two Aussies.

Thanks Mike and K2 for giving my wife an absolutely beautiful lifetime experience as this mountain and the flight with the glacier landing, was the reason behind our decision to go to Alaska, stay at Talkeetna and then someone ensured that Denali was totally cloud free on our trip. We could've reached out and touched the mountain it was so clear!

K2 booking online from Australia was easy and the staff we're fantastic when we arrived to check in for the flight.

My wife is now the proud owner of a K2 Denali zip jacket and when she wears it she relives her time of our flight around Denali!

3 weeks prior to our Alaskan cruise, realized we hadn't booked a flight seeing excursion. I called Seawind Aviation and booked Misty Fjords excursion. This was the highlight of our cruise. Steve & Lesly Kamm were very accomodating to arrange this flight on short notice and around their family Holiday plans. Steve, a 4th generation bush pilot, with 20,000 hrs. plus flight time; gave us an incredible flight to take in the scenery and wildlife (did see a bear and numerous mountain goats!)
Seawind is a definite must if considering float plane excursion in Ketchikan!

Did the Canyon Dream and Land Tour . We were picked up on time from our Hotel, check in at the airport was smooth, the 2 two pilots who took us out to the grand canyon in a very small plane were great fun. We did not have to wait long at the Canyon before being taken by Helicopter over South Rim, it was an informative and lovely trip, we were then bused to another location for another view from land and given a packed lunch , the only complaint was the bus we had or rather a trolley type vehicle to this location was not the most comfortable ride but it wasn't for long. Overall well run, professional, informative and a great day out

Took this trip Sept 3, 2016.  Chuck Perkins was the pilot, who had a very smooth touch operating the turbine powered otter among mountains and high lakes.  He pointed out mountain goats, and took time to go around so everyone could get good look.  The beauty of the area,  his knowledgeable narration, and his personally chosen music made this one of the most exhilarating experiences we have ever had.
Eric was a fantastic pilot and guide. He gave us beautiful views of the islands and made sure we felt at ease.

review_title: Definitely a great way to get from the San Juans back to the real world ...
review_text: Loved the flight ... the plane came in to Friday Harbor a bit late (about 10 minutes), and for those of us used to constant updates on delayed flights on the regularly scheduled major airlines - and in this case, no news at all - was slightly anxiety-raising ... but the pilot was delightful, friendly and knowledgable, got us under way with no fuss - and the flight itself was spectacular: the views were great, and the flight itself extremely smooth (our flight from SeaTac to Chicago, on a 737, was a study in contrast, with harried passengers, stressed flight attendants, and a bumpy ride).  And the coordination on the Reston end was perfect: the van was waiting for us to take us to SeaTac, the driver was helpful, and the trip to SeaTac blissfully short.  Highly recommended!
UNREAL! 10/10 would recommend. Steve was great, super accommodating. Loved the flight, great weather!
We were looking forward to the flight & it exceeded our expectations.  Everyone should feel so free.  I will do it again if we are in the island.
Could not recommend this company enough! Our family of four had a fantastic time!!! The whole experience was top notch!!

This was awesome!!  We scheduled the 50 minute tour.  The views from the air are breathtaking.  I had never flown in anything before (plane, helicopter...).  Our pilot Adam was wonderful.  He made sure we all had a great time.  He pointed out all the points of interest, answered any questions we had, and encouraged us to all talk to each other and have a good time.    Very inspirational.  In my opinion everyone needs to add this to their Grand Canyon Trip!!!  Loved every minute of it!!!

I did the glacier landing tour and it was absolutely one of the most amazing experiences in my life. You get to fly through, see the mountains up close, and then land on a glacier. It is really bright on the glacier so sunglasses are highly recommended, and wear layers (including gloves).

review_title: the most amazing ride of my life
review_text: My husband and I went with another couple to Kauai and experienced all the island had to offer. We went sight seeing by boat-train-rental car and now flying. We did not miss a single second of any attraction, however this was my favorite. The pilot was professional and funny-the plane was roomy for the 5 of us and the sights were amazing. The ocean with sting rays-sharks were thrilling. The mountains were majstic, you went away with an awed feeling of the whole experience- thank you

review_title: Wings Over Kauai, Up Close and Personal
review_text:
What a trip! What a welcome from Ellen and Bruce. There was just Paul and I on board as passengers that 9am on 2nd January 2010. (Julia Roberts was boarding the private jet next door.) The weather was perfect and we saw EVERYTHING you could hope for. We flew over the south side of the island spotting 2 whales surfacing and glinting in the sun. Then up the west side to the grand canyon of the Pacific and then on to the Na Pali coast. Then along the northern beaches with the celebrity homes and then inland to the waterfalls. 
Bruce was knowledgable about the flora, fauna and topography. The operation was slick and half the price of the helicopter tours. It was just us, no sharing with others, so we felt it was very personal. What a great trip.

Wow what a ride! Not only do we get to see the beautiful waterfalls and waterfalls and pools of water among the mountains and the snow, we landed on a tiny Little Rock formation where the pilot let us get out and take pictures. The views were amazing and  the tour was so fun! Talk about photo opportunities!

review_title: Awesome views of the Napali Coast and Waimea Canyon
review_text: The flight around the entire island of Kauai was awesome.  I've taken a helicopter tour of Hawaii before, and this tour gives you more of a birdseye view.  You can see the helicopters flying below you.  The views of the Napali Coast and Waimea Canyon were spectacular.  Keith, our pilot, made sure to fly the plane in both directions so both sides got a good view.  I highly recommend this tour.

Our Wings Over Kauai trip was all it was hyped up to be. The views were incredible and geographic highlights added an extra layer of interesting to our tour. Our son enjoyed his first small airplane ride immensely. Incredible addition to our Kauai trip! Don't miss it!

Great experience, the pilot was personable and very knowledgeable about the area.  He pointed out many areas of interest, and knew a lot of the history of the various areas.  Highly recommend this tour!.  Don't arrive too early though - there waiting area is unattended and minimal.  Wear shoes/clothes that can get wet, and if you have mobility issues let them know before booking the tour. The boarding facilities are minimal also, and it is a seaplane!
This was an incredible trip! The route was beautiful and both of my sons flew the plane. The pilot gave instructions and opportunities while giving us history of the island. Highly recommend!

I've been in Alaska a long time and never done this before, and I don't know why - it was amazing!  I plan on having all my visitors do this from now on.  The pilot was fantastic and knowledgeable, and while McKinley and the weather didn't cooperate fully, we were able to land on the glacier and seem some amazing things.  K2 was great and actually refunded us partially because the flight wasn't the full time.
It was Awesome from the moment we walked through the door. The staff was friendly and helpful and the pilot was professional from start to finish.

Once in a life time experience! The pilot is experienced and super nice. He landed us on the upper base camp of Denali and the views over there is simply stunning. I now begin to understand why there are so many people risking their lives to attempt those summits.
We had a great experience.  A little nervous about a little plane, but our pilot put us at ease.  The scenery was fantastic.  It was a great way to see the Grand Canyon.

Words can't describe the experience of a flight seeing trip and glacier landing with K2 Aviation!  The views are something that can only be experienced from the air.  The time spent walking around on the glacier was awe-inspiring.  When you get off the plane, you can't help but be struck by the absolute quiet.  We were lucky enough to hear an avalanche happening somewhere in the mountains while we were on the glacier.  Our pilot, Chris, was great and the entire experience from start to finish was unforgettable.  Terminal is very convenient to everything in Talkeetna.  We wondered if the trip would be worth the money....the answer is a resounding ABSOLUTELY!!

review_title: So much fun, we never wanted it to end!
review_text: Full disclosure we found a deal on travelzoo for this flight and I was a bit skeptical at first, and even after we first saw the plane roll up. However, our pilot whose name I cannot remember (maybe David or something with a D) was so relaxed and friendly that we didn’t hesitate to jump in and go for our flight. Although it only lasted 20 minutes it was AMAZING! Such gorgeous scenery and we could see out all the windows, almost a 360 degree view! My cousin got a tad bit queasy for a second but it really only lasted a little bit. The rest of us were fine, a very smooth take off, flight, and landing! We absolutely LOVED IT! Our only regret was not extending it to include the waterfalls when he offered. It would have been at a considerable discount and doubled our flight time. Totally worth it! 👍

review_title: 2 GUEST CESSNA TOUR - DO NOT MISS
review_text: Had an amazing flight on the Cessna with Bruce last month, words cannot describe the experience and I have to say that I couldn't recommend the company enough. they were very communicative from booking until the very end of the service, made us feel so comfortable and at ease throughout the whole journey and literally gave us one of the best experiences anyone could have - an private tour of Kauai from the sky. Bruce was so interesting to listen to and we had good fun while up in the air. If you are in Kauai and thinking of doing this - go ahead; you won't be disappointed.
Wonderful scenery, great instruction and the kids loved every minute. I highly encourage anyone to take a flight with Eric while visiting Maui!!!

Professional, flexible, high-value, and talented. Redtail's entire team was wonderful and easy to work with from start to finish. Would highly recommend, and cannot wait to fly with them again. They're pilots are skilled, knowledgeable about the area, and very professional. They're shuttle and two are options are diverse and they are happy to be flexible to meet your travel needs. There is no better way to see Utah than from a redtail plane!
Had a great time on my flight, enjoy the views of Maui, Molokai, with sea cliffs, waters falls, and coral reef. Recommend to anyone who would like to do an aerial view of the islands.

Our flight over Denali with a landing on Ruth Glacier was nothing short of SPECTACULAR!  We waited out some weather but the wait was absolutely worth a “bucket-list” excursion.  
Many thanks to Talkeetna Air Taxi . . . you’re the “BEST”!
the views were amazing and we got to see the island from a whole new perspective. My favorite part was being able to fly the plane over the water! such a unique experience.

Our trip was one of the highlights of our fourth trip to Kauai. We liked it better than the helicopter trip we took several years ago! The pilot was knowledgeable and friendly, and we had a superb view of the Na Pali coast.  Two thumbs up, mahalo for a fun morning!

We went to the west rim and even though we got hit by unexpected storms it was great fun. The buses at the rim allow you to makes your own way between the different points and lunch stop. The Skywalk was closed but they organised a refund for this part of the trip with no hassle. Overall the staff were friendly, the flights good, we got to see everything and it was good value. Do it!

Expensive?  I guess it depends on your income and perspective.  I've paid more (much more) than this for a single night in a hotel.  This was my first ride in a helicopter, which made it especially interesting.  The weather was perfect the day we went out.  Pretty smooth ride; no one got sick.  Our uniformed pilot was very professional and attentive to everyone's needs.  They equip you with headphones and microphones that allow you to communicate with others.  They also play some theme music over the headphones that helps to set the mood.  We started out flying low over some flat wooded areas, and they played that Wagner composition from Apocalypse Now.  It was kind of like heading out for an attack mission in 'Nam!  Then suddenly the bottom drops and you are over the Grand Canyon.  Then they play music from Star Wars and 2001.  You don't just hover high above, they also take you in close to many rock formations so they are right next to you or right below you.  The length was just right.  I certainly did not feel like it was over too soon.  I went the day after Thanksgiving when it was really busy at the park, but still didn't see many other aircraft in the area.  Then we returned with some Indiana Jones music. 

Life-altering?  I wouldn't go that far.  But for me, it definitely fit into the category of "show me something I haven't seen before".  One more thing to cross off my bucket list.
Jason, the pilot, was fabulous.  Super smooth flight, & the glacier views were unbelievable.  The guided hike was wonderful.  We spotted a black bear.  Lunch was delicious!

Our sunset air tour with Barb from Redtail Air Adventures was definitely a vacation highlight!  Barb is an excellent pilot and the entire flight was smooth, from takeoff to landing.  Barb was an excellent tour guide and pointed out different landmarks during out flight and gave us the history and backstory of each as well.  It was a great way to start our time in Moab and gave us a great overview of the area for the rest of the week.  I would highly recommend Redtail Air Adventures!

review_title: 45 minute Helicopter flight over Grand Canyon
review_text: The most amazing experience of my life.  I would suggest anyone that has $150-$200 skip a fancy dinner or two and do this.  You won't regret it. Everyone at the facility was great and our pilot, Jessie, gave a great narrative as we flew through.  Thank you Jessie and everyone at Maverick.
We had the most amazing experience on the summer solstice!! The colors were spectacular and Eric was very informative!

review_title: A Must For Your Kauai Visit!
review_text: I was originally looking into helicopter tours but was worried about my wife getting motion sickness and the costs are pretty expensive.  When I found Wings Over Kauai on a TripAdvisor search and saw the other positive reviews it seemed like the perfect solution for our visit.  I booked the private 2-person Cessna tour and it was half of what a helicopter tour that wasn't even private was going to cost.  Our experience with booking, confirmation, directions and everything leading up to the flight was flawless.  On the day of our flight we met with Bruce who owns the company and was also our pilot and went through a thorough pre-flight briefing and were on our way.  Bruce shared his vast knowledge of the island as we flew by all the spectacular sights which added a nice touch to the tour.  We started out at 3:30 in hopes that the weather would be a little clearer (always a gamble on any day) and the sun would be better for some pictures along the Waimea Canyon and Na Pali Coast.  We lucked out and the scenery was amazing.  While you aren't right up on things like you might be in a helicopter I found that the views were still excellent and met my expectations.  Although the configuration of an airplane isn't the optimum for taking professional photos (and really only a doors off helicopter is optimal), my wife and I managed to get many great shots.  Wings Over Kauai also provides the option to purchase a high def go-pro video of your flight which is a nice touch as well that you could also grab still images from.  Overall our experience was excellent and I would highly recommend Bruce and Wings Over Kauai as an alternative to high priced and crowded heli-tours.

You really need to see Kauai by air to truly appreciate what a gem it is.  Wings Over Kauai makes this possible without breaking the bank.   We enjoyed our flight in the G8 Airvan in early November. There were three of us plus Josh the pilot so we all had a prime window seat on the right of the plane with space to spare.  Check in was easy, you have headsets to listen to pilot chatter plus you can talk between pilot and others in the cabin.  There is nice music playing in the background to give you that aloha feeling.

If you do have motion sickness definitely take something or use a PSI Band. Poor hubby gets seasick but never had problem in air before but I guess a small plane is similar to a boat...  Unfortunately we had not thought about it beforehand but he made it though a little worse for wear.  

We were surprised by the Kukui nut lei and DVD with images/music after the flight.  Really a nice touch.  This is a small family run business and you can tell they are passionate about what they do.
This trip was awesome, we got great pictures. Denali was breathtaking. We loved walking around on the glacier. Our pilot did a great job
Had to wait out a storm passing by but it was completely worth it. The vista view flight was breathtaking. Thank you thank you thank you!!!

review_title: Great for families, better than helicopter
review_text:
We flew with owner and pilot Bruce of "Wings over Kauai", after he was recommended to us by our B&B the day before. It was fantastic, to say the least! Highly recommendable, especially for families of 3-6 who can have the plane to themselves (we went with my in-laws and our baby girl).
Guaranteed window seats also. I won't go into describing the views, they were truly amazing and hard to described with words.

Bruce and his wife Ellen have lived on the island for long and know it really well, they both have PhDs in agriculture and so we got to hear  a lot of interesting stuff on the vegetation and history about Kauai. They are friendly and relaxed and run the small family show as a 'retirement' hobby, so its far from the expensive, highly commercialized and high-throughput tourist ripoffs you are likely to get with the helicopter operators. 

We got a proper safety briefing before the flight, and could not have felt more comfortable before and during the flight. Free soda's and ginger chews were available against flight sickness, but we didn't need them. 
Excellent in-flight communication system with Bose noise cancellation headsets, our 9-moth old daughter got soft baby earplugs and earmuffs on top, and slept straight through the 65 minute flight. 
   
Discounts available or Hawaii residents or if you bring in a coupon.

review_title: Six seater plane ride to site see at Kauai
review_text: This was the first time I rode a small plane and expected to be a choppy ride. It was smooth and slow so I can enjoy the scenery of Kauai. I am glad I did this instead of a helicopter.

The overall process was very efficient. The pilot was professional and knowledgeable. The views were spectacular. Took many videos. Sitting in front seat was awesome. Highly recommend Maverick Helicopters for your tour.

review_title: Great fun and best way to see the island!
review_text: Kevin was terrific and made the ride a lot of fun!  He is very knowledgeable about the island which was great.  We highly recommend this tour over a helicopter tour - you are out in the open which is a better visibility all around.  He also acted as our concierge - made some really good recommendations.

It was fantastic we had a beautiful clear day.  The pilot was amazing, I was some what freaked out flying in a small plane but he flew with grace!   Landing on the glacier was the most amazing experience I have had.

We loved our air tour above the beautiful environs of Mt McKinley/Denali & the glacier landing at the base camp where explorers begin their expeditions to the top of The Great One. This is definitely a FANTASTIC way to enjoy the nature this beautiful state has to offer!

It was a gorgeous day out so there was little to no chop in the sky. The stop in the rainforest was pleasant & refreshing.
Our pilot was extremely knowledgeable. Would recommend 10/10.

Customer Service Outstanding! Experience was superb! Thank you Leslie, Naomi, Eric and Ilse. 

Joan & Duke
My first time flying in a small plane. Was pretty nervous at first, but the skill of the pilot, and the scenery below calmed me down.  Love it, only way to see the whole island.

I cannot say enough how this is one thing a person should put on their bucket list! Amy in the office was so nice and knowledgeable, she truly enjoys her job. They provided us with boot covers and off we went, Mike the pilot was amazing. He answered questions when we landed and narrated through the entire flight. This company can give you a truly memorable experience!

review_title: Wonderful Flight and Service to Denali Mountains!
review_text: We just came from Alaska Trip for 4th of July Holiday.   Talkeetna Air Taxi trip was the most wonderful trip out of our entire Alaska Trip.  They were so well prepared and entire flight was incredible.   Landing on glacier was such a wonderful experience to us like from LA and so smooth.   The scenery was magnificent and especially weather was incredible.  Talkeetna Air is the Best and you don't want to miss this wonderful trip to Beautiful Denali Mountains when you visit Alaska.  This is a MUST trip.   Thank you, Talkeetna Air.
It was a great experience. Tiny little plane but it was fun. Very intimate. Twenty five characters left.
This tour of Kauai was excellent!  Pilot was great and narrated all the key points over our headphones.   Six seater airplane, seats are tight overall.  I got lucky and had the most legroom.

review_title: Best way to see the Canyon
review_text:
There is no better way to view the Grand Canyon than by helicopter. This company has a tremendous safety rating and well trained guides. We enjoyed our tour thoroughly. 

If you take the train to the Grand Canyon then you will have to arrange for a taxi to get you to the airport for this tour. We had no trouble accomplishing this, and it seemed to be a common occurrence. Just be aware that the helicopters are off-site and that there is no public transportation available.

My family had a great time and our pilot, Makoa, did a great job of showing us the island sites with plenty of humor thrown in.  As a 30 year full time professional pilot myself I highly recommend Air Ventures.

The staff and pilot were so kind and attentive to us. We had the most amazing flight that words cannot express, simply stunning views. I had been working with one particular staff member who kept me updated with adjusted schedules due to COVID. We made this trip with friends and family and I was planning on a second flight with another son arriving the following day, working with the staff to make this trip as wonderful for him. Heavy rain prevented us from doing the trip but we will do it again. Thank you Talkeetna Air staff...you made a memory for our family and friends we will never forget.  Nor the kindness you extended to us!
What a fantastic experience! Once in a lifetime views of the 5 islands. Eric was professional and made us feel comfortable with every step. Highly recommend!!!

A very fun experience!  We had a very good weather day and our pilot commented on what we were seeing which was very clear.  Might be scary on a very windy day.  We had a bathroom emergency and the pilot landed in Willow so the gentleman could take care of his problem.  Very good service!!

Our pilot Jonathan was so nice and informative.  We took an 1 1/2 flight tour with a 1/2 hour glacier landing on Ruth's Glacier.  Weather was great and we even got to see McKinley.  I even made a snow angel, did a cartwheel and made a snowball on the glacier.  Words cannot express what an amazing experience it was.  Definitely worth the money and will have to come back to do it again.  This was the best adventure my husband I did during our Alaskan vacation.

My husband and I choose to fly with Wings over Kauai on January 3rd. It was an anniversary surprise for my husband and Ellen helped me execute it perfectly.  The flight experience was exceptional right from the start. Pat and Bruce gave us a warm welcome.  It was an hour-long flight and we flew over some of the most beautiful and untouched parts of Kauai. The ride was smooth and Captain Bruce regaled us with his knowledge of the island and stories from his past experience. I usually have motion sickness but I followed his advice and did not feel a thing throughout the ride. At the end of the flight we were so surprised to receive a complimentary dvd with our picture on the cover.  Amazing experience from start to finish!  I highly recommend flying with Wings over Kauai - You will definitely not be disappointed!

First thing we did on our first day in Kauia was to ride this small seater plane. Pilot was excellent, felt very safe and secure with him. Extremely smooth ride (only encounter turbulence once and he handled it like a pro). Best way to view this magnificent island is by air. You get a larger glimpse of the beauty. Helicopters get closer but not necessarily capture the whole perspective (not to mention the risk of dizziness with their swinging movements.) Plane trip felt relaxed and mesmerizing. The Napali coast line and the numerous waterfalls to observe on this trip were spectacular. The cost was very economical considering the once in a lifetime views and the memories that you will forever keep with you. Front desk staff friendly and the flight left on time. We had the plane all to ourselves so we got special attention. Go ahead and book this tour now... you will be you did.. if you don't.. you will regret this once in a lifetime opportunity
Wonderful experience!!!Will do it again!!!Pilot was superb!!He knew how to operate the plane very smoothly so we can enjoy the ride!!!Very exciting trip!!!
Great friendly staff! Wonderful scenery! Well worth the memories of a lifetime! Mr. JT gave us a smooth flight from beginning to end! Ray, Jill, and Kevin were superb!!!

Eric our pilot was great.  He was knowledgeable, enthusiatic and made the experience
a whole lot of fun.  The plane was comfortable and the views were great.  With everything explained we really got a good overview of Kauai.  It was a much cheaper that a heliocopter and I think we saw more of the island.  The office staff was very nice to pick up and drop us back by our cruise ship. This is definitely the tour to take.

review_title: The best experience - a must do
review_text: We booked this as part of a Viator package to see Alcatraz and it completely blew us away.  We were a party of 4 - two adults, a ten year old and a 4 year old.  Despite a total fear of small aircraft, we couldn't have felt safer.  Jerome, our pilot, was hilarious and kept us entertained.  He was also very knowledgeable.  I would book this experience again in a heartbeat.  Thanks for a truly brilliant time!
Excellent experience. We will never forget this! Breath taking views. Great customer service. Do the glacier landing flight!

This is how you make an astonishing place even better: Do an air tour run by people that are as happy as you are to be there. The views, experience, and value are unparalleled. Being able to log time as a visiting pilot was an added bonus. Bruce is a great CFI and I came away with more than a logbook entry.

Flew with the owner, a PhD agronomist, and saw all of Kauai as can only be done from the air and benefited from his knowledge of the environment. Flew our adult family of four in the van airplane and enjoyed a comfortable ride and panoramic views. Highly recommend!

review_title: Grand Denali air tour with Ruth Glacier landing.
review_text: We took the grand Denali air tour with a landing on Ruth Glacier. Incredible views of Denali and the surrounding mountains and glaciers. The landing on Ruth Glacier was unbelievable. Our pilot was wonderful. Incredible flying skill and detailed descriptions of what we were seeing. He was very good at making sure both sides of the plane could get the same views. This is a once in a lifetime trip - take it if you are in the Talkeetna area!
Wow. What an amazing experience. My girl and I were alone and floating in the sky. TOTALLY AMAZING MUST DO EXPERIENCE. PRICED GREAT FOR PRIVATE TOUR.

review_title: One of the highlights of my Hawaiian vacation!
review_text:
This was the first time I've seen Kauai from the air, and it was amazing! I would highly recommend this company for anyone looking to see the aerial view of the island. Professional and personable check in staff, the pilot really knew what he was doing and he was funny and informational during the trip. 

Be prepared to take about 200 pictures of the island, and see Kauai is ways most people won't see!

We took the flight tour of the Misty Fjords Wilderness when our cruise ship was in Ketchikan.  Lesley and her husband who own the business are wonderful to deal with.  They are both so personable and accommodating.  Our flight was on a particularly clear and beautiful day so the scenery was incredible.  My most favorite moment of our entire Alaskan cruise experience was landing in a remote lake in Misty Fjords and being able to stand on the shore in such a wild and unspoiled place.  While we were there, a loon swam by and hummingbirds circled us.  Just incredible!  I had never been in a float plane before and truly enjoyed it.  Lesley carried us back to the ship and helped us choose a lunch spot and wound up dropping us off right in front of the restaurant.   All in all a terrific experience!

review_title: Air Ventures tour of Kauai was breathtakingly awesome
review_text: Amazing Aircraft, wonderful and knowledgeable pilot and of course seeing kauai from the air was fabulous.  i would recommend seeing Kauai from the air to get an overall view of the island.  Our trip was absolutely amazing.  The new aircraft allowed us to fly at slower speeds and really take in the sites.  We flew right into one of the volcanic craters and back out (or course).  The Na Pali coast was WOW!!!.  There are parts of the island tht you can only see by air or from the water.  Again, I recommend the air tour.

My family of four recently took a tour of Kauai with Wings Over Kauai. We all thoroughly enjoyed it! Josh, the pilot, pointed out the many sights and shared good info about the island. The background music was a little 'hokie' but fun. We did a helicopter tour on the Big Island a few years ago. This tour was better in that you could see more of the island at a time and still get up close to special sights. The Na Pali coast was so beautiful from the plane.

Josh the pilot was very friendly and explained a great deal about the island. The tour is a good way to scope out potential driving spots and hiking spots. Jurassic falls, and several other movie locations are covered. We went in a four person plane and everyone had a window seat.
Such an amazing experience, we had booked it two days for our anniversary, the guys are very welcoming and the drink was delicious, thank you guys.

review_title: Do it! Do it! Do it!
review_text:
We went on the 4th of July with K2 to do a "fly and hike."  The lady who was the owner drove us to the lake where we caught the water airplane.  She was really nie and personable.  We didn't know she was the owner till later.  Our pilot was Jeff Babcock.  He was really nice.  The flight was just my wife and I.  We went on a plance that they don't make anymore.  I think it was called a Haviland.  It sat 6 people.  I felt really safe.  The water take off and landing was smoother than a commercial jet.  Jeff took us around the mountains and we played peekaboo with Denali, the 20,000 foot mountain.  It would occasionally show itself from the clouds that surrounded it.  The flight around the mountains felt like some sort of National Geographic experience.  It seemed so beautiful and surreal to me.  Am I in the Himmalayas or in America?

We landed in this mountain lake and these two young hikers showed us around.  We felt safe and they were very knowledgable of all the flora and fauna.  We saw many plants and the Alaska state bird.  The birdt did not fly away when I took a picture of it.  We hiked uphill to a mountain stream.

At the end of our hike, they gave us wine, cheese, crackers, AND smoked salmon.  My wife thought they were kidding when the female hiking guide asked what kind of wine we wanted.  My wife had the Reisling and I had the Malbec.  This gourmet snack was included in the price of the fly and hike tour.

Had a smooth flight and great pilot to take us to the West Rim.  Then an AMAZING helicopter ride down to the bottom of the canyon and boat ride which gave a wonderful perspective of its beauty.  'Captain Kip' stayed with us all day and kept us entertained, informed and satisfied.  This was a trip that was well worth the money.  I can't imaging spending basically 8 hours on the road in a day trip from Scottsdale to the canyon.  Our memories and pictures will be endless!

Our pilot, Alex, did a great job flying and answering questions and telling us all about the areas we were flying over. The ride was smooth and we felt very safe the whole time. This was a really fun experience we would definitely do again.

If you can only do one thing in all Hawaii islands, then it is taking the flight tour over Kauai. The tour was our best experience in Kauai, and Ellen and Bruce are the most friendly and warm person we met in this island. It was a very personal and thoughtful service. Bruce gave me a fragrant flower and a nice Lei and explained everything about the flight very clearly. Ellen cleaned the windows specially for us so we could take clear pictures. The view was more than spectacular, beyond imagination. The flight was very safe and Bruce did an excellent landing, very very smooth. What's more, the price is half of the helicoptor tour!

review_title: Amazing Flight over Islands and the Sea!
review_text: Eric loves to fly- and to share this amazing experience with the rest of us! We had the experience of a lifetime flying low over cliffs, coral, small towns, and big open spaces. Make this a Definite on your list! Call Eric.
Amazing views from above pictures came out great. Was able to enjoy some time in the skies with my family. West coast (yellow) was a 10/10

These Folk are very professional and adept at their tasks. The trip includes pick up and return from your LV accomodation and a bus trip out to Boulder City Airport. This trip in itself (approx 1 hour) was most interesting, climbing out of LV on a very busy motorway. The plane (a twin engined high wing Otter) was basic with each passenger (12) having individual windows, the Pilots were immediately in front of us and We could watch their every move. Beautiful sunny and hot day, the views and commentary were perfect and most memorable.
Well done GCA, a top flight organisation.
Very capable team and smooth ride.  very special views of the mountains, glaciers, and glacier highways
Our pilot was great! And the day was so clear everyone got to see the summit.  Hardly any clouds at all.
Took a flight seeing tour. We were able to see the peak of Denali and landed on Ruth Glacier! An experience we will never forget. Would highly recommend!

review_title: Amazing flight into the Alaskan Range.
review_text: The flight at K2 was an exceptional way to see the Alaskan Rnage. The weather conditions were not optimal, but this doesn't take away from the one of a kind sights to see there. Furthermore it was a very smooth flight to and from the mountains. In my opinion it's the best tour you can take from Talkeetna.

review_title: Great bird's eye view of the beautiful island of Kauai
review_text: My wife and I thoroughly enjoyed our flight with Marcus and Wings Over Kauai.  The flight was so enjoyable on a clear day and the narration by Marcus was very informative.  It is the perfect way to see the beautiful island of Kauai.  I would highly recommend this trip to anyone who would like to see otherwise inaccessible parts of this beautiful place.
Took a flightsee tour last September, incredible views. Here is Mt Denali

review_title: One of our favorite memories from our trip to Kauai
review_text: Seeing the Garden Island from a plane with a pilot as cool and knowledgeable as Bruce is one of those experiences that will always be a fond memory. We highly recommend seeing Kauai from the sky with Wings Over Kauai.

review_title: Words Can’t Explain How Amazing It was
review_text: This was the best activity we did while in Alaska for 3 weeks. The staff was very helpful. Our pilot was great. The flight was very smooth and enjoyable. The views were beyond amazing. Words cannot explain the beauty of the Denali and other mountains and glaciers. We highly recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi Denali Flightseeing with Glacier Landing. You won’t regret it.

review_title: Wow!! Great Service and Amazing Views!!
review_text: We took a flight on March 15th and it was incredible!! Dress for cold weather and bring a camera! We had a fantastic time walking on the glacier and seeing the mountains up close!! Highly Recommended!
