review_title: Awesome views on Air Venture Tours
review_text: We had a great time on Air Venture Tours during our recent family vacation with our young adult children. Everyone had a blast learning the history of the island as well as seeing movie sights. Such awesome views from the aircraft. Definitely a must do.

Clean windows, a good view from every seat, smooth and comfortable flight, accommodating pilot ... the flight was everything we hoped for.  The windows of the Otter were clean and flat so photographs came out great.  The pilot tipped the wing when asked to enable shots of the Denali summit.  He circled in a pattern that allowed everyone onboard a good view.  Takeoff and landing were smoother than a commercial jet.
AWESOME flight seeing trip around Denali! Our pilot was so knowledgeable and gave us us a smooth flight with fantastic views of the mountains and glaciers.

The rule of thumb is that there is a 1 in 3 chance of seeing Denali (Mt. McKinley) without cloud cover. However, on those days that Denali is in the open a flight is a must if your budget can manage it.

One morning following a rainy day we saw that Denali was in view and immediately booked a flight with K2 Aviation, which has a menu of several flight options including landing and walking on a glacier, flying over the lower reaches of the mountain, or flying over and around the  entire mountain. We chose the least expensive flight, over the lower reaches of the mountain, because it was the least expensive, my wife is nervous about flying in small planes, and I saw that lenticular clouds were starting to form near the mountain, a sign of high winds and turbulence.

The booking over the phone went fairly quickly; the drive to K2 took about an hour. There was a bit of a wait for processing, and so many people had booked flights that  there was little room indoors to sit until departing on our six-passenger Piper Cherokee, which was small but comfortable in terms of seating space and cabin temperature. 

We had a capable and well-informed pilot who provided an ongoing narrative that covered the key points of the area and Denali; he also kept a sharp eye out for moose (we spotted several) and bear (no luck). It turned out that high winds cut short the trips of the planes slated to fly above and around the entire mountain, so we were glad we had not opted for that.

We could hear our pilot talking to the control tower from time to time throughout the flight, reporting our location at various key points along the way and keeping track of the numerous other planes in our vicinity (when Denali is visible, all the flight tour services in the area are heavily booked). It is clear that K2's safety protocol is rigorous and well-execute.

Bottom line:  A wonderful experience, would do it again, many thanks to K2.

review_title: One of my best experience ever
review_text:
My only regret is that my English is not good enough to match my feelings towards those wonderful people on the ground and in the air. Thank you Ellen and Josh.
For a great day over Kauai. 
dvora and Naftali Sahar

review_title: My best experience of my Kaua'i vacation (And I did it ALL)
review_text: What a great experience. Out pilot, Shaydin (sp) was great.  Lots of information about the island, and some good stories and lore.  Besides being a excellent pilot and providing not only a smooth flight but also great vantage points for seeing things from both sides of the aircraft. I would highly recommend this.  Even better than the boat charter around Napali.  Best tour I went on.
Definitely a highlight of our trip! Our 6 year old became a pilot just like daddy, my wife and I enjoyed so much that we are recommending this to all our friends!!!

review_title: Views like a James Bond movie
review_text: This is a very well run and professional company.  Our pilot provided a good explanation of what we were seeing and turned the plane around so passengers on both sides could get a good view of all of the sights.  The magnificent views were like flying through a James Bond movie.

Aside from the opportunity to soak in some gorgeous and dramatic views of the island, the whole-island tour was an especially enjoyable trip for a pilot. I had originally wanted to fly in their C182, a private 4-seat Cessna, with an instructor, because it is the only way to fly around the island, at the controls, unless you take a checkout flight so you can rent further, solo (more of an option for residents). My wife and I decided this time to take the tour in the AirVan, with J.T. as our pilot and tour guide, along with a few other passengers. 

Even though we pilots are always itching to be at the controls, this was still a fine choice. The airspace is relatively busy with other air tours and traffic, there are several local VFR reference points you don’t know, and the terrain has unique properties which require attention, as well. I was simply able to sit back and enjoy the beauty of Kauai—without getting too antsy to fly, myself! 

Incidentally, with the varying terrain and ocean comes what’s called “uneven heating” which is one of the factors which creates turbulence. There’s only two things one can do to mitigate that: 1) fly early in the morning, or 2) get a pilot who knows how to soften the ride (there are a few ways). J.T. is just such a pilot. 

Highly recommend! (20 year, instrument pilot)

review_title: No better way to experience the Grand Canyon!
review_text: We decided to do this vs standing on the edge of the Grand Canyon like Clark Griswold. The cost was $159 per person vs. +$200 for a shorter helicopter flight that wasn't as extensive. This tour covers most of the GC, is safe and there is a narrated voice over to listen to along the journey. Requested both of us have window seats which will cost you an additional $10 per person, but they were nice enough and waived the fee. The seating is 1 x 2 configuration with the exception of row 7, which is 1 x 1 with no 'B' seat, this is where we sat. Only downside was the tour was supposed to be 40 - 50 minutes, we were back at the terminal around 33 minutes.

Got the chance to fly with Brian at Air Ventures.  Took the family out for about a 70 minute flight.  We got to see the entire Island from an amazing point of view.  Very comfortable and super informative. Brian was professional and so knowledgeable about the entire island, geography and history.  So many waterfalls that you would never see or know were there.  Definitely a highlight of our trip.  Thanks Brian!

review_title: Great view of the bay and beaches
review_text: Tony's love of aviation an his knowledge of the area make for a great south Florida adventure. Will spend more time with Tony on our next visit!

review_title: Great vacation gift for my wife.
review_text: This was a gift for my wife. She had never ridden in a helicopter before. She loved the flight. Jake was our pilot and he took off and landed very gently. The rain forest tour was great. Jake was very knowledgeable and answered all our questions. Jake also made sure we all got a view of all the great places we flew over. Maverick helicopters is a great company and they take care of you.

Took a noon flight to Friday harbor. Great flight great views!!  Smooth ride.  Friday harbor was lovely.  Quaint shops and restaurants. Took an afternoon flight back.  Also great flight great views and friendly pilots. 
The weather was cloudy and the flight times were changed but we were notified several times.  Terrific customer service.  Really wonderful way to spend a day and see the islands.
We flew over the Grand Canyon on our way to Page.  One of the most awesome days of my life!  Highly recommend it.

We recently took the Grand Denali flight and glacier landing with Talkeetna Air Taxi and couldn’t have been more pleased. From the check in to check out, the entire staff was great. We especially enjoyed our pilot, Melissa. She was very conscious of our safety, describing the sites, making sure passengers on both sides of the plane got to see the beautiful views and finally taking great photos/videos of our group during our glacier landing. I highly recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi if you’re in the area.

WOW!!! What a fun experience. We got to see the whole island. Our pilot, Nate, was a great tour guide. Nice smooth ride. We got to see up close the Jurassic Falls. Nate took the time to turn around at one point so we could watch a whale breaching and wagging tail. I would definitely recommend this tour. Hubby and I have done both helicopter tour and this one. If you want a relaxed tour of this beautiful island BOOK YOUR TOUR HERE!!!

We flew with K2 in 2013 and enjoyed the lower glacial flight but had hoped to be able to fly around the summit of Denali.  On our return trip July 2015, the weather finally cooperated and we were able to check one more thing off our bucket list.  Truly a wonderful experience with extremely capable pilot, Patrick.

I have previously flown with Talkeetna Air Taxi when climbing Denali in 2010, and they did a great job supporting our expedition. This past summer (July 2016) my wife and I traveled to Alaska for a vacation. We flew with Talkeetna Air on the Grand Denali tour.  My wife commented that it was the "flight of her life".  Our pilot Andy did a fantastic job of highlighting various aspects of Denali and the surrounding peaks.  I highly recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi.  Steve Van Meter

review_title: Best Way to see the Grand Canyon
review_text: We had one day to visit the Grand Canyon with our young children (ages 4, 6, and 8).  The Adventure tour was well worth the money and was better than expected.  The plane ride, helicopter ride, boat ride, lunch and SkyBridge were all perfect.  Things moved quickly enough that the children never got bored, but slow enough that everyone could keep up and not be completely worn out.  We were back to Deer Valley Airport by 3pm, which gave us plenty of time to take our tired kids back to the hotel, get them fed and in bed at a decent hour.  My husband and I are both professional pilots and can say the aviation portions were very safe and well done.  Good job Westwind!  The employees of Westwind were very informative, kind, and helpful.  Great customer service all around.

My wife & I really enjoyed the smooth ride with Air Ventures. The pilot was very knowledgeable about the island history & gave us great views of the best sights Kauai has to offer. A great value, would absolutely do it again.

This company is very well organized and its employees are professional and customer-focused. We took the 9:00 Arches-Canyonlands air tour, 50 minutes, in a beautiful Kodiak turbo-prop seating 8-9, all window seats for great viewing. Our pilot Dave was exceptional in both his flying skills and as a guide describing features, geology, and human history of the area. Our flight was the high point of our visit to the area and we highly recommend seeing these parks by air with Redtail.  With high visitor volumes at Arches and Canyonlands, and resulting traffic congestion challenges, we found seeing the parks by air a serene, stress-free and beautiful experience.
The experience was incredible. My parents had a wonderful time. An experience to cherish. They enjoyed every part of the excursion.

review_title: something else  that makes the Bay area Unique!
review_text:
Wonderful time, easy to get to from SF or Marin. Family owned, responsible pilot AND a great time when you take the tour.
For people who LIVE in Marin, it gives you a whole new perspective on the county we

Approximately one hour.  Can choose either Cessna (seats 2 passengers) or AirVan (total of 4 passengers on our tour).  We toured all around the island including the Napali Coast, and by air is probably the best view of that area.  Breathtakingly beautiful.  The pilot was friendly and well-informed, answering many of our questions.  Noise canceling headphones were helpful.  

Some mild turbulence during our floor but the operators did their breast to plan ahead:  there was a cooler full of ice and cold water.  If you're prone to motion sickness it's a good idea to take Dramamine in advance to be safe. But many photo opportunities and highly recommended.

review_title: If you only do one thing in Alaska, make it this
review_text: We had an absolutely fabulous time with K2.  Incredible views that left our jaws hanging open.  We saw things we wouldn't have seen any way other than by air.  We were bummed the weather didn't cooperate to see the North side of Denali but they happily accommodated us and lowered the price.  The glacier landing was awesome and made for a stunning photo opp. Stan our pilot was cool.  This is something we'll be talking about much in to the future.  Sleep in your car if you have to to make room in your budget, hands down the best thing we've done in any of our travels ever.

review_title: Private Cessna is the only way to fly!
review_text:
We decided to splurge during our visit to Kauai and booked a private flight on Wings Over Kauai's Cessna 172.  It was a bit more expensive than the group flight on the Caravan, but so worth it.  Imagine having your own private chauffeured hour to fly around the island!
 
We were warmly welcomed to the flightline by Val.  She took our information and gave us a quick rundown of what to expect during our flight.  She also discreetly weighed us 
to ensure the weight and balance is set up properly for the flight.

We met Captain Bruce and after introductions were made all around, we all walked out to the plane.  So much nicer than boarding a commercial flight.  Yeah, the plane was smaller but no one was fighting you for overhead bin space! As an #AvGeek (read "plane nerd!") I called shotgun and my wife was nice enough to indulge me.  Bruce also teaches flying, so he took the time to explain flight dynamics and how the airplane respond to different inputs.  We both worked the pre-flight takeoff list and after waiting for a Hawaiian Airlines 717 to land and vacate the runway, we were off.

It was a beautiful day for flying.  Puffy white clouds dotted the sky and visibility was forever.  Mt. Waiʻaleʻale was almost totally visible, which is vary rare!  Bruce kept up a running commentary was we overflew Poipu Beach, the Waimea Canyon, the Napali Coast, then across Hanalei Bay and back down towards Lihue.  When we were halfway through our flight, my wife commenced the drink service with bottles and cans from the cooler under the back seat!

We were thrilled with our choice of Wings Over Kauai.  We highly recommend the private Cessna flight for a group of 2 or 3 people.  Even if you take the group flight on the Caravan, seeing the island from the air is a fantastic trip and should be considered a "Must Do!" during your visit to the Kauai.
They were very courteous and professional in making the experience as comfortable and fun as possible.
Simply great, on time as promised and exceptional pleasure for the family. Thanks to BJ a great pilot and Shawn who organized!

review_title: Best part of our trip --- Highly Recommended.
review_text:
This was a great experience from start to finish.    Unlike other helicopter and airplane tours there were no hidden fees, no gimmicks, no up-sells, just first class service.  Booking our group of four was painless and easy with Ellen.     We arrived, got weighed in, and were on our way in the air in 15 minutes.  Ellen even took our pictures with her professional camera by the plane and emailed us the photos for free!    Bruce was an experienced pilot with a cornucopia of knowledge of not just aviation, but of the history of the island and agriculture/farming --- I mean, it's not every day you get a personal tour of the island from a local who also has his PhD!

I cannot stress how wonderful and educational this experience was for our group; and the views of the island were obviously amazing.   Out of all our memories of our trip, we will remember this the most.  Just book this trip, you will not be disappointed.

Thanks Bruce and Ellen,

Satisfied Customers:  Nathan, Amelia, Jeff and Amy

review_title: Private flight for two in a Cessna 172.
review_text: Absolutely perfect.  Our pilot Bruce was an absolute expert (I know since I'm also a commercial pilot) and fun to be with.  Top notch operation without the attitude of others...  Don't hesitate to book now.

If you're thinking of taking a flightseeing tour stop thinking and start doing! Best part of our trip so far. You'll be absolutely amazed by what you see. Literally took my breath away a few times! Definitely worth the money!

review_title: DO IT DO IT DO IT!!
review_text: This was the highlight of our honeymoon. The tour was absolutely amazing and we got some pictures worthy of postcard covers. It was a bit pricey but worth every penny and I would definitely do it again if I were in the same place.

Excellent flight and right on time, easy check in being no TSA out of Signature Aviation in SLC. The views were amazing along the way and the pilot was super nice and knowledgeable of the area. Definitely recommend this service and would hands down fly it again. Go give Redtail Air a try from SLC to Vernal or Moab
What an amazing experience! Highly recommend to anyone visiting Maui - Eric is extremely nice and made the trip worthwhile ! Would definitely do it again.

We took the 45-minute canyon flight in the morning. It was a great experience all around. Our pilot, BJ, was easy-going and extremely capable and the flight was super smooth, no jerks or drops, it was like sitting on the couch at home, enjoying the fantastic panorama that unfolded once we cleared the canyon rim. We were a true 45+ minutes in the air. This flight was a birthday gift for an 85th birthday, and the recipient could not have been happier.
Seeing the beauty of the islands from the air was fantastic!  Great Trip! So much fun!  Such a beautiful place!

review_title: If you do just one activity make it this!
review_text:
You just must see Kauai from the air. It is an experience you will never forget. To see the green, green valleys where Jurrassic Park was filmed, to the beaches of the North Shore, it is just an awesome adventure.
I don't need to tell you how sweet the owners are and how professional the pilot is because we have all read that. I just want to add that you have other choices for air tours on Kauai, but you will not be disappointed with WOK.

Flying open air, low and slow is absolutely the best way to see Kauai. My wife and I drove the entire island and would have missed most of its beauty.as much of it is inaccessible. My wife is a bit of a nervous flier in small planes and the team at Air Ventures put her at ease all along the way - from the pre-flight briefing to a super smooth landing and the entire comfortable flight in-between. Most of the flight was flown at approx. 1,800-2,500 feet and between 80-90 kts. It was amazing how much we could see, how good the view was for both of us sitting side-by-side with our pilot in the cockpit behind us and with the high-end headsets we were provided our pilot gave us great information on what we were seeing, history and etc. We've been on helicopter tours and given they seat 4-6 people always get stuck in the middle and miss the best sight seeing... The 60 minute flight was certainly the highlight of our Kauai vacation and was definitely worth the money.

I took a HAL cruise in June 2010 and booked this excursion through the ship.  The bus was there to pick us up right on time but there was a bit of a traffic jam of buses, so we got to Taquan Air a few minutes late.  There they put us through a quick safety briefing and got us out to the floatplanes.   The experience of getting into a plane that was sitting in the water and then taking off and landing on water was really difference and interesting.  I'm glad I got to try it at least once.

My plane had the pilot and three passengers. I thought that was good, it looked like the plane could hold more.  We all got a window seat, however the same person sat in the front both there and back; I think that could have been rotated since we got out at Misty Fjords.

The beginning of the flight was kind of average but once we got into Misty Fjords it was just break taking!  This does not happen to me, but I literally teared up a bit as we flew through the area, past the solid walls of granite plunging to the water.  It was just so beautiful and pure, it was really amazing.  It's just about impossible to describe.  I don't want to oversell it, but for me, I've done a lot of traveling, and few natural wonders have hit me as hard as this one.

The pilot few around a bit and pointed out a brown bear on the ground.  That happened so fast I didn't get a picture. We landed in one of the lakes and got out and stood on the pontoons of the plane.  The pilot came around and took a picture of each of us standing outside of the plane.  We had a shorter stop since our bus had been late.  Then we got back in and flew back to Taquan Air.  My only issue was that I missed some stuff that was on the same side of the plane both times, with me on the wrong side. I thought possibly we could have switched or the pilot could have gone wide so both sides could see. 

Overall, I don't know how much of a difference it makes what company you fly with.  Taquan Air was fine and I have nothing to compare them to, my five star rating has more to do with the beauty of the Misty Fjords.  They did have a gift shop and I got a nice purple fleece with the Taquan Air logo.  At the end, we got back on the bus and were dropped back by the cruise dock.

Unforgettable flight and tour we recently went on with K2. We booked the guided hike tour that K2 flies in a float plane up to a glacial lake in Denali National Park. Upon landing we were greeted by a guide who took us on a few miles of guided hike in the mountains around the glacial lake. The K2 staff was first class and very professional. Safety for the flight and guided hike were their number one priority. The float plane ride with our pilot Chip was incredible. His knowledge and experience of the aircraft, the alaskan wilderness, mountains, glaciers, etc was impressive. It was truly a guided flight as we learned so much on the flights to and from the lake. We even spotted some moose on the return flight and he circled around so we could get a better view of them. All in all, we highly recommend K2 for whatever adventure you are thinking of going on in Talkeetna.

Amazing Tour and perfect way to see the entire Island. Marcus was a wonderful pilot and we felt safe the entire time. Seeing Kauai from the sky is breathtaking. And Wings over Kauai did not disappoint. The six passenger plane has a window seat for everyone on board. Highly recommend.

review_title: Misty Fjord Flight is a must!
review_text: They picked me up at the cruise ship, did a quick safety briefing, and after a short taxi to the waterway, we were off!  Mike is a great pilot.  He told us about the fjord and landscape, and he played a fitting musical shuffle in the background during the trip.  The ride was smooth and relaxing as we meandered through the valleys, circled wildlife we spotted, and landed on a lake about half way through the trip.  It was personal; there was no script, and Mike had no problems maneuvering back for us to get another glimpse or photo of the spectacular landscape.  I still have a smile on my face - it was worth every penny!

We were in Kauai the last week of September.  It just took me a while to do this review.  The day after we arrived we were on the Wings Over Kauai tour.  It was great.  Never having been here, it was nice to get an aerial view of the island.  From this, we were able to plan what we wanted to see for the week that we were here.  Josh was our pilot and guide.  He had loads of information about the island and he was a lot of fun.  We had done the helicopter tour on the Big Island 3 years ago so we knew we wanted to try something different on Kauai.  It was the best hour tour we had.  There was only one other couple on the plane so it really felt like we had the plane to ourselves.  I highly recommend this tour.

review_title: Outstanding and inspiring views of entire Kauai island.
review_text: We enjoyed this experience beyond any expectations. Views were breathtaking. Pilot was so competent and so relaxed. We will never forget this unique view of Kauai. Much better than a helicopter.  Thanks to everyone at Air Ventures for giving us lifetime memories of this beautiful island.

Air ventures Hawaii was such a great experience, they were flexible in fitting us in around our other planned activities. The tour was absolutely incredible, seeing Kauai from the sky is definitely something you won’t want to miss. Ray was also a great pilot and he kept the tour interesting, Thank you so much for the friendly service and tour of a lifetime!

review_title: Spectacular views, once in a lifetime experience
review_text: We were lucky enough to be in Talkeetna on a bluebird day and went flightseeing.  It was unreal how huge the mountain is and seeing it close up gives you a whole new appreciation of the scale and majesty of the place.  Of course the glaciers and cliffs were beautiful, but the pilots knowledge of the different places really made it a great tour.  I've flown in lots of bush planes and helicopters in Alaska but this was my favorite trip.  Highly recommended if you even have a little curiosity about Denali.
The beautiful landscape that we saw.  Loved the glacier landing.  Pilot was very helpful and informative.

This was a fabulous way to see all the beauty of Kauai! It was a beautiful, mostly clear day. There were waterfalls, beaches, and lots of rainbows. All you need to bring is your camera! 

Everyone at AirVentures was knowledgeable and nice. We felt safe the entire time--from the ride to the airport, during our flight, and the trip back toward the cruise ship where we originated.

They took a picture of the 6 passengers along with the pilot standing next to the plane prior to our flight and then emailed the picture to us. They also had a DVD for purchase (not our specific flight, but with all the sights included) for about $10.

We plan to return to Hawaii in the future and will definitely go through AirVentures for some new experiences!

review_title: A once  in a life time experience
review_text: All the staff was frrienly and helpful  Felt safe at all times. Pilot was helpful. knowlegabe, apprroachable.  Answered questions in detail.  The highlight of our trip to alaska.

A highlight of our trip to Alaska was flightseeing with Steve of SeaWind Aviation.  We chose SeaWind instead of the cruiseship's tour and were delighted with our decision.  Our family of 7 including 5 kids (ages 10-18) were given a flight of a lifetime and benefited greatly from Steve's years of experience and familiarity with the majestic Misty Fjords area.  We had close up views of a bear in the grass, numerous mountain goats in the snow, lakes, waterfalls and fauna.  Steve was an excellent pilot and guide and provided us with many interesting details or the geography and history of the area.  The landing on a pristine lake and view of a family of six furry friends playing in the water nearby will remain in our memories for years to come. Steve's wonderful wife Leslie who was so friendly and helpful on the phone led us to book with Seawind in the first place. She was an excellent ambassador not only for Seawind but also for Ketchikan and was incredibly kind and helpful to us for our other activities there.  We cannot say enough good things about Seawind.  The trip was worth every penny.

What an experience! We were scheduled to fly on the 8/8 but due to the storm, TAT rescheduled our flight. Thanks to an amazing pilot, everybody in our party of ten were mesmerized by the views and the glacial landing. Thank you!

review_title: If Trip Advisor would let me give them 10 stars, I would!!
review_text: It’s Memorial Day weekend.  The line to get in the main gate at the Grand Canyon visitor center was over a mile long.  So on a lark we decided to investigate the helicopter tours.  Am I glad we did!!  Maverick was super friendly, has a great facility, and the 45 minute tour was well (way more than) worth the price.  Pilot Joe was great, and provided some great narration the whole way, answering questions as we went.  The scenery was, well, it’s the Grand Canyon!  You get views you can’t get any other way, period.  Jaw dropping from start to finish.  Ten thumbs way up!

Pua did a great of getting our flights booked.  Paul did a great job of not only piloting our plane, but he was very knowledgeable when pointing out the native history of the island and areas of interest while narrating the flight.

review_title: Don’t miss it…way worth the price.
review_text:
Staff is very customer service oriented. Everyone wants you to have the best experience and they were successful!
Equipment well maintained and clean.

My brother and I wanted to do something amazing for mom's bday. We originally looked at helicopter tours, but they are over priced and shorter- after discovering wings over kauaii, which by the way is also more eco-friendly then the helicopter option, we were all set. 
We had our mom blindfolded till she got to the plane and Ellen helped us put up a banner that said happy birthday. Needless to say mom absolutely adored it, as we all did!
Also, all seats have a window except for one- a great plus!!
Pilot was sweet and knowledgeable- we loved it!

The flight was wonderful. The pilot was very nice and very knowledgeable. He explained many of the sights we flew over. The staff was very courteous and helpful. Overall there was nothing negative and I would recommend the flight to anyone.

We had the best time ever with Air Ventures. Our pilot Eric was amazing and full of local knowledge. The views are breathtaking and this magnificent island really is best appreciated from the air! We found everybody associated with Air Venture were great to deal with and fully recommend flying with these guys!

We had the most amazing time with Eric today. Not only did we get to fly over the islands of Maui and Hawaii but we saw the craters from an amazing perspective in the air. We could see all the lava flow fields and I got absolutely incredible videos and photos due to the camera porthole in the window. At one point the weather didn’t seem like it would cooperate for us to see the most recent lava explosion but Eric managed to find a safe way for us to fly over it. Eric even let both us of take over the controls and steer the plane a bit which was so fun!  Once we landed in Hilo we went for lunch at a great diner and then back up in the air to fly past the beautiful cliffs and waterfalls en route to Hilo. Such a great value compared to helicopter flights. I felt so safe the entire flight and it was such a comfortable experience! Thank you Eric for the amazing candid photos and best day of our vacation!

This experience was one of the best I've ever had! Me and my partner loved it. Eric the pilot and guide was awesome and made us feel comfortable the whole time. I highly recommend this to anyone who wants to see Maui from above. The sunset, clouds, rainbow and landscape from above is something out of this world!

I stayed in Talkeetna specifically to use K2 for my flight & glacier landing.  I am so glad I chose this company as they were professional, kind, courteous & knowledgeable from jump.  The pilot didn't "over" talk either, which was nice so we could enjoy looking at all of the lovely sights around.  Make sure to add the glacier landing...it's an experience you will never forget or regret!

We flew with Mike on the Denali Flyer with glacier landing, and had an absolutely fantastic time!  What a great pilot and guy.  All of the staff at K2 were very helpful and pleasant, providing us with a once in a lifetime experience. Thanks so much!

review_title: Great experience all around and very convenient
review_text: Great experience all around, can't beat it for doing a half-day tour! Airport was very convenient, pilot was awesome, and really fantastic views from the plane and at the canyon.
Probably one of the best experiences of my life even our pilot said we were in the 5% perfect weather perfect conditions landed on 2 feet of snow. It was absolutely beautiful.

review_title: Review of Talkeetna Grand Denali tour
review_text: A magnificent tour of the Denali peaks! The staff was informative, friendly, and accommodating. I loved the flyovers around the peaks and glaciers and the glacier landing was spectacular!! A very memorable experience!

We booked this just before leaving the UK for our cruise around the Hawaiian Islands. We had not decided what we were going to do on this island and left it late to make the decision. The day was almost fully booked but we found an early flight with seats available. I would suggest booking early rather than later. This flight was taken on 12th March on my wife's birthday as a day to remember. Josh our pilot did an incredible job, the views were perfect and commentary excellent. I got to sit in the co-pilots seat with my wife directly behind. We all had good views through the windows as we each had our own and we returned with some great pictures as well. The weather was also perfect with sun and blue skies with some cloud over the higher mountains, which produced the rainbows. We decided a plane trip was the best way to see as much of Kauai island as possible as we were only there for a day and half. We purchased the video as a download and have watched this already as soon as we returned home and will look forward to sharing this with our family and friends.
We had a really good time, all the islands are amazing, our pilot, Eric was very professional and kind, all the procedures are very thorough and informative.
Couldn't have asked for a better birthday flight around Miami Beach. Tony was wonderful and really made it a great experience. Highly recommended.

review_title: Airplane tour of the Grand Canyon
review_text:
With a family of four the helicopter tour was a bit too pricey so the airplane trip, while still the wrong side of reasonably priced, was a better alternative.

I have to say: this is the only way to see the Grand Canyon! There is simply no better way to fully grasp the entirety of it; the forces involved in its creation.
Stunningly beautiful. Humbling.

The flight through the Grand Canyon was incredible!
The Hummer tour was awesome.  Our guide, Alice was very knowledgeable, attentive and fun.  Thank you for an unforgettable trip

The folks at Talkeetna Air Taxi made our entire experience very enjoyable.  The weather had been overcast for days prior to our flight and the staff was very patient and understanding about my hesitancy to spend a nice chunk of change on our flight when we might not be able to see the peaks of Mt. McKinley or do a glacier landing.  I appreciated the fact that they do not penalize you in any way for weather related cancellations made at the customer's discretion.  They explained the probabilities of seeing McKinley (60% due to clouds) and doing a glacier landing (50% that day due to new snow) to us and left it our decision whether to go or not.  In the end, we decided to risk it and I am so glad we did.  We saw everything and the glacier landing was an overwhelmingly beautiful experience.  The beauty of this area cannot be fully appreciated in pictures or even flying above it.  Our pilot, Jonathan, was an awesome bush pilot and was extremely knowledgeable about the geography, geology and history of Denali. This will be one of the more expensive things you may do (minute for minute) but it is totally worth it!!!

review_title: This is a MUST DO if you are headed to the Grand Canyon
review_text: I have been to the Canyon several times over the past 30 years.  This tour made the experience of the area come alive.  Fabulous guides, well organized and I can honestly say it was 10X better than I had envisioned.  Linda

review_title: Great experience with Wings Over Kauai - highly recommended
review_text: We took a flight around Kauai with Bruce (the owner/pilot) in the smaller Cessna 172 and had a great time.  I'm a student pilot and sought out WOK because Bruce is a certified flight instructor and they the Cessna is the same plane I'm training in.  We got two great experiences for the price of one - my daughter and a friend got a great aerial tour of the island and I got a flying lesson all in one package.  We visited in January so we had to wrestle with uneven weather.  We ended up rescheduling our flight twice (the right safety decision) with courteous ongoing communications with the staff.  I've taken the Blue Hawaiian helicopter tour in the past and thought it would be unlikely that we could cover the terrain in a light plane as well.  Bruce proved me wrong.

My husband and I took a flight with K2 Avation from Talkeetna into, around and through the Alaska Mtn Range that will forever be in our memories and our photo album and our screensavers and FB feed!  It was AWESOME!  We were blessed with very clear and smooth skies on 6/29/16, had amazing views like we have never seen anywhere before,and got so many photos.  K2 runs a great operation---nice plane, clean windows so we didn't miss a thing, and especially a great pilot who showed us and told us about the area, topography and history.  We would highly recommend a flight with K2 and from Talkeetna!

This was by far my favorite thing we did during our visit to Kauai.  Our trip was piloted by Eric and he was an amazing pilot and a great tour guide.  At no point did any of us feel unsafe.  
As far as cost goes, it is definitely competitive with the other air services on the island.  I highly recommend this company.
Great experience.  Went with my wife and two daughters.  It is a great way to see the canyon and surrounding area.  Maverick staff very professional.

Our 45 minute view of the Grand Canyon by helicopter was stunning!  Our pilot, Daniel, was knowledgeable and friendly.  It was a very smooth ride with lots of interesting things pointed out along the way.  Daniel also gave us tips on the where to see the best things along the rim trail when we hiked.  Pima Point is the place to actually hear the Colorado River from a mile above.  Our flight was a bucket list item, and we are so glad we did it!

review_title: Take this tour if you can!
review_text: Took the tour during the last week of May with my two adult sons.  Excellent operation from reservations to landing. Felt very safe and enjoyed spectacular views. Fantastic memory for the rest of my life.

Air Ventures Hawaii gave us a wonderful experience.  Our pilot JT was very professional...and fun at the same time.  He was very knowledgeable about all of the sights we were seeing.  He also did a great job keeping the plane stable even though it was a bit windy out.  One person in our group was generally a little fearful about flying.  JT made sure that all of us had a great, memorable experience.  Our next visit will include a flight with their bi-plane!!

Last year we had the amazing experience of flying with Eric in the airplane...wonderful!
This year we flew with Kevin in the Waco...truly a fun time!  It was more difficult getting good camera shots from the biplane, but we decided beforehand to have a GoPro attached...good choice!  Kevin gave us a thorough fly-over of Kauai...made even more spectacular by the hundreds of waterfalls from the previous night's rain!  AirVentures is a first-rate company with impressive staff!
Pilot was outstanding and did an excellent job of narrating.  It was such an awesome view and tour of Kauai.  It was far better than the helicopter tour.

Amazing views of spectacular scenery. Best way to see the Maze District and the confluence of the Colorado and Green Rivers in Canyonlands National Park. Very friendly and knowledgeable pilots and staff. And experience our kids will never forget.

review_title: Amazingly wonderful glacier landing plane ride
review_text: Worth EVERY dollar!  This is a most incredible experience. The views are unforgettable. The feelings you get are phenomenal! These guys are the best!! If you do nothing else in Alaska and only this ride, you will have had the experience of a lifetime. Go early and pay the extra for landing on a glacier. Book this ahead of time, it fills up fast.

This was an amazing tour and worth every bit of the cost.  The only way to see this beautiful island!  Our pilot, Bruce was knowledgeable, friendly and professional.
Best part of our vacation so far!  This is a “must do”!

We arrived in good time and after  paying and being weighed for the correct distribution within the helicopter, we sat and waited for the 3 other passengers. The area you sit and wait has a variety of tshirts, baseball caps and other souvenirs, the seating is comfortable and the whole area clean and spacious. The staff were all very friendly and accommodating. I explained that as I can suffer with claustrophobia, if possible could they place me near the side not in the middle. The other three passengers only just made it in time. As we were on the 4pm flight and they have to clear the canyon by 5pm, the staff told us if they hadn't been on time, they would have taken off without them. We were relieved as it is expensive and we wouldn't have wanted to have our experience, which we had looked forward to for so long, cut short. Our pilot was Brad, a lovely person who we felt completely comfortable and confident with. We were given the safety briefing and got on board. I was thrilled to find that I was seated at the front next to the door, fabulous views. Not sure if this was after my request or just luck :-) We took off and flew over the pine forest. As I have never been in a helicopter before I wasn't sure what to expect. It was a lot smoother than I thought it would be, I felt comfortable and safe. We approached the canyon with Brad saying that if we had a camera, turn it on now. I took a video with my phone. As we approached and then flew out over the canyon everyone just said ....WWWOOOOAHHHHH. It was like the bottom just dropped out of your world, incredible. no amount of words can describe it really, no amount of looking at photos, you just have to see it for yourself. Brad was excellent, giving commentary on points of interest and answering our questions, which he encouraged us to do. As I just couldn't get perspective on the immensity of it all, I pointed out a particular elevation and asked Brad how tall it was. He answered, 3 Empire State buildings. That gave us all perspective and helped us understand the size of the canyon, just amazing. The whole flight was just fantastic. My only minus point was that as we had opted for the 4pm flight, the sun was low (we wanted a later flight to get the shades and colours) and at times washed out the colours on the way back, but by no means diluted the experience. Brad flew a couple of times into shade to give us the best possible experience. We landed and photos were taken with the copter. All in all an unforgettable experience and what a way to spend my 50th birthday. I would heartily recommend this company to anyone wanting this flight over the Canyon. Just wonderful!

Awesome once in a lifetime experience ! We upgraded to the glacier landing and it was totally worth it! Breath taking views of the mountains! Pilot was great and flight was smooth. This is a must do in Talkeetna M

review_title: A must for your visit to Miami
review_text: Great company, great pilot, and amazing experience.  You simply cannot go wrong!  Did the Stiltsville tour.

What an incredible experience! My husband and I were lucky enough to go on the 'Summit Tour with Glacier Landing,' and it was an experience we won't soon forget. The folks in the office were very knowledgeable in answering our questions. We were concerned about the weather, but they said it changes so frequently and to be patient. Sure enough, about 10 minutes before our check-in the skies opened up, and we were cleared to get up to the summit. Do understand that they can't control the weather but really try to work with you to get you the best option to see Denali. Our pilot (I forget his name) was great as well. Peppered in enough fasts so we knew what was going on but didn't chatter the whole time. He really let us soak in the moment. He also provided one of the smoothest rides!

review_title: Wonderful way to see the island!
review_text: We had a group of 12 and another tour company wouldn't take us all together because of their weight limits.  Air Ventures had no problems with taking our group. We also saved money by booking the luau package deal with them. Jill told us to book early in our trip so we would be able to reschedule if weather was bad.  That turned out to be great advice.  We re-booked twice and were finally able to go out on our last morning for a beautiful tour with perfect weather on our last morning on Kauai and easily made our departing flights.  Ray was the perfect tour guide/pilot. Jill and Ray were wonderful! It was the perfect finale for a great week in Kauai.

review_title: A wow trip to the glaciers.
review_text: We booked this flight as soon as we arrived in Talkeetna as our excursions on the ship were cancelled.  What a wonderful surprise.  Riley was our pilot and we landed on the glacier and took photos for at least 20 minutes.  The flight and landing were amazing and surreal ! If you get a chance to go you should do it!
Our group had an awesome time at Seaplane Adventures. It was a magnificent day and the view was amazing. Cannot say enough wonderful things about it! Worth every penny! We'll do this again.

Great views at a fraction of the cost of the helicopter. Our pilot was easy going and informative very conversational. the girl who works in the office is the hardest working girl we've ever seen. always smiling, running from task to task, making sure each and every person feel special. you can't go wrong with this tour.

review_title: The only way to see the island of Kauai
review_text: I had heard so many great things about the island of Kauai, I wanted to see the whole island and not just a part of it. Researched the helicopter companies and all of them had basically a fixed route and you would be essentially a "passenger". As a pilot, I wanted to have more freedom and flexibility to see more of the island. The answer was Wings Over Kauai. Had the opportunity to fly with Bruce, the owner of Wings Over Kauai, in their Cessna 172 and it was an outstanding experience. For just a little more money than the cost of a "canned" helicopter flight, I was able to fly completely around the island and take the time to see more of the great sights. For the same rental price of the C172, you can bring a second person along as well. It was like having your own personal tour of the island by a local. The operation was safe and professional. I would fly with Bruce and Wings Over Kauai again in a heart beat. In fact, I am already planning another trip to Kauai!

I had gotten a recommendation to take a Talkeetna Air Taxi flight on my trip to Alaska just before I headed on my trip, and I'm so glad I did!  What a wonderful experience!  From the friendly staff to the competent & engaging pilot, and the INCREDIBLE views!   Thoroughly enjoyed every bit of the flight- Stunning mountain views and our pilot, Andy, was a wealth of information on the areas we were flying in.
Came to Alaska on a cruise.  Did the seaplane tour for our excursion. Our wonderful tour guy Ken did a great job.

review_title: Fantastic views of Kauai from the air by a brilliant company!
review_text: Had a great time on our aerial tour of Kauai on Wings over Kauai.  We were booked on a Sunday but as it had been pouring rain the night before and strong winds on that morning we called to check whether the flight would proceed.  We were told that all flights were grounded and they could fit us in on Tuesday or we could cancel our booking with no penalty.  We went ahead with the tour on Tuesday which we thoroughly enjoyed.  To top it off we were given a free DVD with our photo on the front.  The service by Wings over Kauai was 100% and would gladly recommend this company to anybody interested in an aerial tour of Kauai. We believe that this tour is much better than a helicopter tour and we were happy that we made the choice to go with Wings over Kauai.  Thanks agains.

review_title: Spectacular aerial tour of the Garden Island
review_text: We wanted to see the Na Pali Coast and it was a toss up between air and sea.  We also wanted to tour the island by bus.  Best of Kaua'i  Tours offered a combination tour with Air Ventures that seemed to fit our wishes.  While the bus tour was pleasant, relaxing, informative and enjoyable, Air Ventures was the highlight of the day.  Our pilot flew us over some of the most spectacular views that we've ever seen on earth, the Na Pali coast and more, and they will be permanently etched in our memories.  Thank you everyone at Air Ventures and Best of Kaua'i Tours.

Booked our glacier landing on a whim as we walked through town. If you do the first flight (8:00am) or the last one out (6:00pm) they give you the landing for the price of the fly over. Dud the last flight at 6pm and  I think we paid $199 each to land in the glacier and capture the most gorgeous photos on film and in our memories! Pilot was outstanding.  Very knowledgeable, patient and professional.  They also give you a last minute chance to change your mind before you go up if the clouds are obstructing the summit and fully refund your money. No tricks or gimmicks, they want you to enjoy your flight and get your money's worth.

review_title: Scenic Canyon River Adventure vs Imperial Ecostar Helicopter Tour in Grand Canyon South Rim
review_text:
Both the tours left from Grand Canyon National Airport. Both I booked through Papillon, but Helicopter left from Papillon section of the airport whereas Scenic Canyon River Adventure left from the Grand Canyon Airlines section of the airport. 
Helicopter tour - lasts 45min, $294 (I would give two stars)
Grand Canyon River Adventure - lasts 15-16hours, $394 (I would give five stars)

Imperial Ecostar (Two stars out of five)- The first day I took a helicopter ride and booked "Imperial Star Helicopter Ride" by Papillon. The helicopter is well maintained and a smooth ride. It was advertised as 40-50minutes, but my tour lasted 35minutes and we spend approximately 10-13minutes seeing the Grand Canyon. My pilot was not friendly as she preferred not to talk much and didn't seem to know answers to simple questions about the Grand Canyon. I am not sure whether the pilot was interested to be there. I was disappointed that I wasted nearly $289 with limited time over the Canyons, so decided to do a different one the next day and I got it right the second time - the Scenic Canyon River Adventure.

Scenic Canyon River Adventure (Five out of five stars) - I booked it through Papillon website, but the tour left from Grand Canyon Airlines from Grand Canyon National Airport. I couldn't get enough of this tour as I enjoyed throughly every minute of it. It costed $394 for the whole day, breakfast and lunch included, it lasted 15 hours, we left at 6am. When we arrived at 6am in GC airport, our breakfast box was waiting.  We boarded on a small plane to fly over the Grand Canyon to Page Airport for an hour, our plane was an eight seater plane with brilliant views for everyone as all seats were window seats. We flew over Grand Canyon, saw Glen Canyon Dam and had beautiful views. In fact I enjoyed my views from this plane than the helicopter tour I did the previous day. We had a short break in Page airport where we could use toilets and was given a brief briefing on what the next tour would be - Antelope Canyon visit. We sat on back of trucks which were converted to be tour trucks with two rows of seats backing each other thereby all of us got good views of the town on the way to the Upper Antelope Canyon. It was an interesting unique rocky fun experience in this truck to the Antelope Canyon, I wouldn't want to trade it any other way. We spent some time visiting the Upper Antelope Canyon where our tour guide showed all the interesting views of Upper Antelope Canyon. I wish this tour had included the Lower Antelope Canyon also. We were then taken to Colorado River Discovery Office where we had 45 minutes to relax in the cafe and take a toilet break. We could fill up our water bottles in the cafe. Big buses came to pick us up to the Glen Canyon Dam site. We were given packed lunches when we boarded the bus.The long tunnel ride by bus was one of the most unique drives I have encountered - I would suggest to sit on the front seats as it has better view in the tunnel than the rear ones if you are interested in watching the dark tunnel drive. The tunnel was a two mile long dark tunnel dug through the canyon walls with small window of light dug out for ventilation. On the end of the tunnel was the base of Glen Canyon Dam and our motorized raft with our tour guide. Our guide Brian was knowledgable, interesting, interactive, fun and made our 4 1/2 hours ride as perfect as it could be! We had two toilet breaks, two brief swimming breaks, stopped at petroglyps, took several pictures, it was serene and beautiful in the Colorado river.  Interestingly, I couldn't picture the feel of Horseshoe bend while in the river as well as we could see it, since our view was limited by the Canyon walls. (So went the following day driving to see it from top of the Canyon). We had plenty of drinking water on board also. Our motorized raft ended in Historic Lees Ferry Port where buses were waiting to pick us up to drive back to Grand Canyon National Airport, it was a long drive for 3 1/2 hrs. We stopped at Cameron Trading Post where there were interesting Navajo Indian Reservation handicrafts, gifts, cafe, toilets and hotel. Our bus driver pointed out to the interesting tourist spots on the way back and stopped to drop some people off at the South Rim before getting back to Grand Canyon National Airport.
Loved the glacier flight and our pilot Billy!  A must-do when in Alaska! So much to see and Denali, wow! The landing on the glacier was perfect and my photos turned out great!

The flightseeing tour we took of Mount McKinley was absolutely amazing.  While it was cold (March 2012) the views were well worth the minor discomfort.  My wife is normally nervous when it comes to small planes but our flight was absolutely smooth.  Our pilot Richard was excellent.  The most amazing part was landing on a glacier.  It appears as if you are flying directly into the mountain before you touch down.  WOW!
I was initially concerned about the cost but I was glad we took the trip within minutes of reaching Denali.  It was definitely one of the high points of our Alaskan vacation.
The most memorable experience of my life. And I’ve saw a lot! The perspective you get from the air is remarkable. We saw Sharks, Dolphins, Sea Turtles… incredible.

I believe our guide’s name was Nate and he was excellent.  He was knowledgeable and made a point to circle in areas of interest so both sides of the plane got a good view.  Excellent experience!  Thank you!

Our family of 5 took the 1 hour island tour today with Doug and had a great experience.  The ride was smooth, Doug was an excellent pilot (take off and landing was not bumpy at all) and he had interesting facts and stories to share. I was hesitant to book a helicopter as I had felt sick after the last time, so we booked a flight instead. Despite my slight fear of flying in small planes and motion sickness tendencies, this trip exceeded expectations. I highly recommend this trip- you can’t see the whole island any other way.
Our young great pilot showed us the fantastic island from above, which we discovered by car before.  Gorgeous impressions! To me no difference to a helicopter flight but much cheaper!
This adventure was definitely worth the money. The service was awesome, and everyone was very nice and helpful! The sights were truly amazing. Would definitely recommend this to anyone.

review_title: Wonderful way to see the bay
review_text: Really well organised right from being collected at Pier 39 to being dropped off again. Very professional and friendly staff. Had a fantastic time.

review_title: A great way to see Kauai
review_text: My wife and I really liked this tour.  In fact, it was the highlight of our recent trip to Hawaii.  It gave us a great view of Hawaii's most beautiful island at a reasonable cost.  I also liked the personal touch offered by Bruce and Ellen and we felt that we were treated as friends and not as tourists. The strength of this tour is that it is a family run business and not ome big corporate touring company with their "canned" presentations.  The business is small, intimate yet filled with tremendous beauty as we flew over the island.  If you come to Kauai, don't miss this tour

review_title: Can't hike the trails? You gotta do this!
review_text: This is the way to see the waterfalls on the Road to Hana and experience an easily accessible rainforest. Rick, our pilot, is a great host, providing intermittent commentary and allowing us time to soak in the gorgeous views. When we landed in the rainforest, we celebrated with bubbly and snacked on some of the fruits available there. He shared interesting information about the rainforest, was knowledgeable and attentive to the needs of all passengers. The ground crew was well organized, friendly and clearly communicated everything we needed to know.

We went on a flight with Leighan including a glacier landing. The views are spectacular and it was so much fun throwing snowballs in the middle of summer on the glacier. Leighan is a fabulous pilot with lots of knowledge and she was great with our children.

review_title: Beautiful Denali flight and Glacier landing
review_text: Such a beautiful and breath taking experience!  The flight was incredible and the Glacier landing on Ruth Glacier was such a thrilling event!

That was the best and beautiful thing I’ve ever seen in my life. So many different landscapes 😍😍. Our pilot Marcus was also a real air guide, he knows a lot of things and he tried his best to made this tour unforgettable.
The air tour was great.  The staff was very friendly and helpful.  The pilot was informative and provided a very safe and enjoyable tour of Denali with a glacier landing.

review_title: Best views of Na Pali Coast!
review_text: This trip was absolutely breathtaking. Marcus did a great job and was very informative. My pictures all look like postcards and they even give you a free gift at the end. I would do this again in a heartbeat.

review_title: Pretty amazing views of the island in a biplane - Simply Spectacular
review_text: We flew with Capt Kevin who was a great guide and offered lots of great local information!  Capt Kevin made sure that both us in the cockpit were able to see all attractions and provided a great overview of the island.  The biplane ride was amazing and allowed us to see the island more up close and personal (we could touch a cloud).  Different that a helicopter ride in that you are in the open with goggles for viewing the sites - which range from the Na Pali coast, to the beaches on the North and South side, the lush interior and waterfalls, and Waimea Canyon to name a few.  Highly recommend as an alternative to the helicopter options

I have sent clients to Seawind ever since I've known them and they are fantastic to work with.  Leslie, who works in the office on booking, is incredibly organized and treats our guests like the special people that they are.  She also communicates well and returns calls promptly.  Steve is one heck of a pilot who is good at engaging the guests in conversation.  He knows the Misty Fiords and works his tale off trying to find wildlife and anything that will create a memorable experience for his passengers.  I have personally flown with him twice and both flights were awesome!!   I highly recommend this well run business with owners that "take care of business" with a positive attitude........and a sense of humor!   Philip Walker, John Hall's Alaska Tours
Energetic and fun pilot.amazing views of the island once in a lifetime experience. Felt safe and cared for during entire duration of flight. Fantastic all around!

review_title: Great host and even greater experience
review_text: Flying over the Columbia Gorge is a must-do in itself which Spencer, our host and pilot, made even more enjoyable. A truly memorable experience!

I HAD SO MUCH FUN! I wanted to do something especial with my boyfriend,I loved this experience.they’re super professional and friendly.it was wonderful tour to see those views,without a doubt i will repeat it .

This flight was my first time in a small plane and I loved it! I would say if you are considering flying with Envi Adventures, just do it! You will not regret it! 
We choose the Vista View and will definitely be back for a longer tour, probably the waterfall one.

I do not have enough words to describe all the beauty and nature we saw on this flight. We were greeted with a friendly, Aloha and given the ground rules for the flight. Bruce our pilot was amazing! He is very knowledgeable about the island and a very skilled pilot. If you are wondering do we do the helicopter or plane? Choose the plane Boss! My husband was so excited to be seated be next to the Bruce the pilot. I got some amazing pictures of all the stunning landscapes ! Mahalo! Wings over Kaui! 
Thank you Gina and Bruce for your amazing hospitality!
The Hopes!
Until we meet again!

The service provided by the Wings Over Kauai tours was very well done.  Ellen was very hospitable while waiting for our scheduled flight.  Capt. Josh has a very clear passion for aviation and an extensive local knowledge of the things we were seeing.  Flight was very smooth and comfortable.  I would highly recommend this service to others.

I had the chance of a lifetime to go on this amazing adventure with my brother on 6/30/17. My brother had been trying to talk me into going on a float plane trip through the Misty Fjords but I wasn't convinced I'd be able to go or enjoy it. One reason, because I'm scared of heights and have an over active imagination of things that could go wrong and second, I tend to get motion sickness. However I agreed to go even though I was scared out of my mind. Let me just say how amazing this trip was and I'm forever grateful that my brother talked me into this! Our pilot Sam was awesome, very knowledgeable on the area and you could tell he was all about giving his passengers an experience they would remember forever. The weather was great and the sights were breathtaking. I would definitely recommend this tour and guide! Thank you Sam for the tour!

I have always been afraid of small planes, but, after reading so many raving reviews, I decided this was worth it.  And, i never felt any fear during the flight.  The scenery is beyond anything I can describe -- total awesomeness of G-d.  Unfortunately, our glacier landing was cancelled due to weather, but the flight still exceeded my expectations.

My wife and I did a flight with K2 kind of on a whim.  We had planned to do lots of hiking in Denali, and along the Kesugi ridge in Denali State Park.  But 2 weeks before our visit I broke my leg -- so the hiking option was gone.  The morning we arrived in Talkeetna, the weather was nice, so we decided to try a sightseeing flight.  We did the short "McKinley Experience" flight, because I was concerned about the cost (and I am a pilot, so I've seen lots of mountains from the air).  The only option available for us on short notice that day was one with the glacier landing.  That turned out to be the BEST part of the entire flightseeing experience -- even though I probably would not otherwise had paid the extra cost.  In hindsight, we are really glad we did the glacier landing because it turned what would have been a nice tour into a great experience.  Even though I have a couple thousand hours of flight time as a pilot, the glacier landing and takeoff were a unique experience and well worth the expense.  So my personal advice would be that if you are trying to decide between a longer, more expensive flight -- or a shorter flight with a glacier landing, definitely choose the glacier landing!

My wife and I wanted to do something special on our trip to Alaska, and this was perfect.  The flight around Denali with glacier landing was thrilling yet comfortable, adventurous yet safe, filled with gorgeous, jaw dropping sights, and worth every dollar.  Staff were very friendly, too.  Highly recommended!

My husband took me for an airplane tour of the canyon lands for my birthday and it was amazing! Our pilot, Conner was very nice and informative. He pointed out all the things to see in time for us to look and made sure we saw it all. We’re from East Tennessee and this was one of my favorite things we done the whole trip out. Next time we will bring our 7 year old! Very calm and smooth ride. Turbulence wasn’t bad at all! Definitely a great unforgettable experience!

My girlfriend and I had our Hawaii vacation planned for almost six months.  The #1 activity we wanted to do was a flight over the island.  Months of research, countless hours of reading reviews, and we both agreed on Wings Over Kauai.

We just completed our tour yesterday, February 18, 2014, and the experience was amazing.  My girlfriend described it as the single-most amazing experience she has ever had, so the bar is set very high now.  I have to agree with her too. 

Before I get into the actual flight experience, I need to mention to staff.  The staff was extremely kind, friendly, and helpful.  They answered all of our questions in a friendly manner each time we called.  Also, even after our flight, they told us to call for any questions we may have on anything we may have such where to eat, other activities, if we get lost etc.  Really? Who offers that anymore?  But they offered and you could see they genuinely cared.

Now for the flight...WOW.  That pretty much sums it up.  Every second something else just stood out as beautiful.  I cannot state if every flight is the same comfort level, but our flight was extremely smooth and very little bumbs.  Bruce was our pilot on the private two-person Cessna.  He was extremely informative and extremely courteous to our needs.  Besides seeing waterfalls everywhere, we happened to come across a whale.  I saw the whale and mentioned it, he then took a few moments to guide the plane closer to it so we could get a better picture.  As he did that, the whale breached, which apparently does not happen to often to see from the plane.  It looked just like a Pacific Life commercial, but it was all while flying.

So my recommendation is to go ahead and book this; you will be happy you did.  The cost of the trip is extremely reasonable and the memories are a lifetime.

I LOVED Miami Seaplanes! They took us down from miami all the way to key west, with a bit of snorkeling thrown in. They were super professional, sweet, fun, and it was gorgeous! It's the only reasonable way to get down to the keys; I wouldn't travel any other way! From the sky you could see sharks, dolphins, rays and more, and it was an experience I'll never forget!

review_title: SPECTACULAR VIEWS from above the Arches and Canyons.
review_text:
This was a spectacular experience. We have seen the area from  every angle and every level.  We have Kayaked and canoed down the Green River, we have driven the 4 WD White Rim Road, We have spent time hiking the Island in the Sky. Now we have seen it all from the air. We flew over Canyonlands, Natl. Park, and Arches Natl. park. The views cant be described... but it certainly puts everything into perspective.
We went on a windy day so thought it might be bumpy, it wasn’t.  Our pilot was professional and knew his plane. He knew the area, and pointed out many landmarks using the plane wingtips. We had a pretty smooth ride, and a very smooth landing for such a windy day. Highly rated experience.

Maverick Helicopers is amazing! I wasn't sure if I should invest in this experience. It was my first trip to the Grand Canyon. All I can say is you should definitely do this! This was the most awe-inspiring, breathtaking view of the Grand Canyon. Every minute was exhilerating! 

The staff were outstanding. Dennis was so helpful with my reservationand with answering my questions. He was so nice and welcoming, that he is the reason I came back for a second helicopter ride two days later. He even gave me advice on which trails to hike later that day. Aaron, the pilot, was outgoing, fun, and extremely knowledgable about the Grand Canyon, geology, and history. 

I felt safe and the helicopter seemed brand new! I can't say enough good things. If you're not sure abotu this, just book it. You'll thank me later!!
This was an  awesome way to see the falls and the Columbia River. Our pilot was very knowledgeable and personable. The view from 1000 feet was exceptional.

I have been living in San Francisco for over 7 years now but this was the first time I have done the Seaplane ride. I can't believe I have never done it before! It's the best experience and truly a dream flying over the Golden Gate Bridge!!

review_title: Amazing way to end the day
review_text: Our pilot was great and made the tour that much better, very knowledgeable and very friendly. We will be back to fly with them again

A wonderful personalized flight experience that introduces the island of Kaua'i from a different perspective. We got the small 4-seater Cessna which is nice having the plane only for ourselves and the pilot Bruce (great entertainer).
Mahalo

Westwind gave me everything I had hoped for...An overall informative/view of the Grand Canyon. We could never have visited the Canyon in one day like Westwind provided for us both on the ground and in the air. Excellent customer service too. Hope we can bring the rest of the family in the future.
The flight was great. I would have liked to have been a little closer to the ground for better visabilaty.

review_title: Watching the bears was the highlight of our holiday!
review_text: Fantastic excursion to see the bears. It was the first trip of the year they'd run (the salmon have just arrived) but regardless we had an amazing time watching the bears fishing. Great views from the open platform and the guide was superb! A small group meant a great viewing experience. This was the highlight of an already fantastic 2-week trip.
Our pilot Barry was fantastic. Views were unbelievable. Don't miss out on this adventure of a lifetime.

review_title: An excellent way to see the Grand Canyon
review_text: We took the full day trip from Phoenix to the Grand Canyon on Jan 5, 2013.  We were very pleased with Westwind Air Service.  It was very easy to make reservations, the plane left on time, the pilot was very friendly and professional, and we had a nice ground tour of the South Rim.  We also thought that the cost was very reasonable and they even paid for our lunch.  With our time restraints, if it had not been for Westwind, we would have had a difficult time seeing the Grand Canyon.  I would give this company an A.

We had a chance to book a tour with Bruce and as a pilot they offered to let me fly with Bruce in the right seat as a CFI.  If you are a pilot this is a great way to see the island and get it in your log book.   My wife really enjoyed the flight and took a number of photos as Bruce pointed out island sights

review_title: Great experience with 30 min private flight over Miami.
review_text: Excellent experience! I recommend taking a 30 min flight over Miami. We took it on our first day of visiting the city and it was amazing.

We enjoyed a very comfortable sightseeing flight over Kauai's many wonderful sights.
The pilot was very friendly and informative, and kept the flight very smooth despite the rainy conditions. The extra time spent over the Na Pali coast was particularly welcome. The slow pace of the flight, and large clear windows gave ample opportunity for good viewing and photography. Compared to a helicopter the fixed wing aircraft felt very spacious. Rainy conditions gave us views of many more waterfalls than normal.
Our group of 8 booked a glacier landing on Denali. Awesome experience with a knowledgeable pilot. If you want to truly experience Denali, you have to do this flight!

We took this biplane tour of Kauai with our family on our recent visit, It was perfect weather, beautiful views Our guide Paul was very knowlegable and funny Our daughter felt a little airsick but still enjoyed the experience Would highly recommend it!

I was initially terrified, but had always wanted to fly over the Grand Canyon.  Thanks to the amazing pilot, I had the time of my life.  He reassured me, made me feel comfortable, and was incredibly knowledgeable. I would highly recommend
Josh was super friendly. Kept the flight as smooth  as possible in a small plane. Knew his was around the island and knew where the interesting sights were.

First rate pilot, landing on the glacier was amazing. Alaska is a land so awesomely grand, you just have to see it to believe it, there is no explaining it! Thank you for sharing it with us with such an incredible view! I would and will do this again, hopefully with my children someday.
Awesome views.  Everyone must see the island from an air view.  The staff at Air Ventures were awesome, very friendly. Would definetly use them again.

review_title: Wings Over Kauai Grand Deluxe Flight Rocks!
review_text: Our flight with Wings Over Kauai on April 23rd was an unforgettable experience!  We couldn't decide whether to do a helicopter or plane tour.  I'm glad we chose the plane, because it was a very comfortable ride, we had unbelievable views of the island, and Captain Bruce was very knowledgable and safety minded. After seeing Kauai by air, it made us really appreciate the beauty of this garden isle.  Bruce, Dori, and Josh make an awesome team! This was by far the highlight of our vacation.

Westwind is great to deal with and made everything so easy.  After we showed up, we never had to do anything but enjoy ourselves and the excursion was exactly as described... Except better!  A full day of adventure at the Grand Canyon and back in time for dinner.  Note that the west rim isn't the part with the national park, it is about 100 miles to the west on an Indian reservation.  Because it is on tribal land, not all the same safety rules apply, but use common sense and hang on to your family members, and you will be fine.  Highly recommend, you will walk away thinking you should have paid them more, and at least with me that never happens!

I thank Chris the Pilot for providing the most spectacular views and most entertaining history of formation of Denali National Park. From the description of size of some of the biggest glaciers we have seen in the park to how much the Mountains have moved, Chris was on point with the details. I now know and appreciate that the photos I took are one of a kind for every year this national park grows and moves around guaranteeing a unique sight and experience every time.  Bragging to all, spreading the word. Will  absiolutely choose to fly again with K2 Aviation.
The flight was awesome and our guide was the most enthusiastic and knowledgeable person making it an around great experience!

The personnel at Air Ventures cordial, helpful and polite.  I would recommend their services to anyone wanting to get a great aerial view of the Island of Kawaii.

Our pilot, rob, was most professional and handled the aircraft with tender care.  Smooth take-off and very smooth landing!  His explanation of the different areas of Kawaii were most enlightening.  Thanks, Rob!

We would definitely use their services again if the occasion would ever arise and recommend it to anyone interested in such and adventure.

Sincerely, Bill, Ann and Jordan

review_title: Amazing, the best flight on the Island
review_text:
This was the best flight around the island hands down! They are the most friendly, professional crew around from booking with Ellen and working with Marren we couldn’t have had a better experience. I was nervous about getting motion sick (like I did on a helicopter tour) and Marren stocked the plane with lots of things to cure motion sickness. Our five year old also had an amazing time she loved talking into the microphone and the pilot was awesome! 
I would highly recommend this to anyone who wants to see the island by air!
The best part was getting off the plane and Marren had already printed a photo, email us and had a dvd for us. Best customer service experience.

Thank you all!

We had booked a 45 min plane trip and the views were stunning. Best views on left of plane (if they always go that way round). Went over the canyon to the North rim and back round. I missed how to change my headphones to English commentary so had the first ten minutes in Spanish! The day before had been really windy and flights had been cancelled, so we were lucky as I wouldn't have wanted to miss it. But it was still windy and the flight was quite bumpy and quite scary. A couple of women on the plane (there were 8 of us) spent the whole flight consoling their two young children who were terrified. So be warned!
Wonderful flight! Mark was great and gave us lots of fun information about the area. We went almost all the way around the island and even saw some whales!! Worth every penny!!!

review_title: Neets Bay Bear Watching by Float Plane
review_text: We took this excursion to see bears in the wild.  We were not disappointed.  The bear watching at Neet's Bay was great.  However, the flight to and from Ketchikan was amazing.  We had a clear day and the scenery was spectacular.  Our pilot, Adam, took us to the bay by one route and then back to Ketchikan by a more scenic route - spectacular views.  Highly recommend this excursion.

One of our top activities we have ever done!
Eric was the best and the views were unprecedented!
Great!
Great trip and saw so many amazing things.  Eric was a great pilot and pointed out many objects to observe.  Eric made us feel very safe in the plane and made it a smooth ride.  Worth doing.
Ray was our pilot and did an outstanding job showing us the island, whales, key landmarks. I feel I saw everything there was to see on the island which made for a complete island vacation.
The world's tallest cliffs are AMAZING!!!  Eric is very knowledgeable and very friendly. Amazing views of the whales!

This was our favorite thing we did while in Alaska.  Getting to ride in a plane up to Denali Mountain was spectacular.  Views were gorgeous.  HIghlight was getting to land on the glacier and getting out of the plane and walking around.  It wasnt too cold either.  Our pilot was fantastic.  Very knowledgeable and very friendly.  This is a must do when in Alaska.

Harry the hairless pilot did a great job pointing out the best local attractions. We did our tour in the open cockpit biplane early in our visit and it was a great help deciding what else we wanted to visit during our stay. In my opinion, there is not a heliride on the island that would compare to this open cockpit experience.
