Everyone was great to work with as we planned it. Such a magical day!  Worth every penny! Hard to say what my favorite part was between plane, helicopter or boat on the Colorado.

Though TAT doesn't *need* more praise, my experience with them was simply so phenomenal that I have to give them yet another Excellent review. This is a top-notch company with some of the best pilots in Alaska flying the best aircraft for this kind of excursion. They are safe, prepared, and professional. I am a pilot myself and had the opportunity to sit in the right seat during the flight up - our pilot, Chris, was kind enough to talk me through his checklist as he fired up the turbine Otter for our flight. Plus, Alaska's weather cooperated and we had an absolutely STUNNING, gorgeous day for mountain flying. This experience was worth every penny.

Eric, our pilot was wonderful. We had a great trip really lot of a lifetime. Also gave us a lot of education about Maria mountain count Maui county and the five islands that controls are truly a great experience and I will pay all my wife said over and over. Wow.

Everything about this glacier tour and landing was absolutely perfect. We were thrilled to ride in the de Haviland Otter with pilot Sean. What a day!  One of the pilots was overheard saying they wait all year for a day like that.  Clear, no wind and the Alaska Range showing off in all its glory - chief among them  Denali. Great service and flight.

review_title: Kaui from the third dimension, simply beautiful!
review_text: Had a wonderful trip with the company owner in the Cessna 182. Of course the ride was a bit bumpy at times, but guess what...its even worse in a helicopter ...and muchmore expensive. Being pilots ourselves we could see the airplane was in good condition and thorougly enjoyed the views from above. Definitely wotth every cent!

Brentwood was our pilot of this 6 seater Dehavilland float plane.  All passangers had headphones to listen to Brentwood's interesting narrative and intervening music.

Flying for 75 minutes through fjords and mountains was the most exciting thing my wife has done in her life!  It probably helped that she got to sit in the co-pilot's seat after landing in Misty Fjord.  After a smooth lake landing, we exited the plane and stood on the pontoons to view and listen to the wilds.  Sheer granite cliffs, plunging waterfalls from an earlier rainstorm and pristine rivers and wilderness were breathtaking. This is a "don't miss" adventure.

After spending 2 weeks on a land tour/ cruise combination in Alaska, I can say that the best excursion we chose was the Talkeetna Air Taxi trip around Denali with glacier landing. We did not plan to do it originally, but decided at the last minute. The experience was way beyond expectations. Our pilot was in constant contact with the office and other pilots to help find the smoothest airspace. The landing was flawless. The views from the plane were spectacular and walking the glacier was magical. We were picked up at our restaurant to take the flight and driven to the bus depot after the trip. It may be a bit pricier than other things you can choose to do, but this one is totally worth it.

review_title: Amazing experience, great service, highly recommended
review_text:
The tour was an amazing and thrilling experience. The touring company, their service and the pilot were all very professional and respectful.

The place was easy to find in Talkeetna. Talkeetna itself is on the way from Anchorage to Denali and is very picturesque just like everything else here.

Highly recommended. A++

review_title: One of the highlights of my holiday
review_text:
We had booked this 45 minutes flight from the south rim before we left the UK. I am so glad that we did as the National Park was shut when we arrived there due to the Government shutdown.
The airport is easy to find, being on the main highway, and there is plenty of parking on arrival. The reception area is nice and large with a gift shop and plenty of seating area. We found the staff very friendly and helpful. What was a nice touch is that the pilot comes and calls you when he is ready to start loading the helicopter. This provides an opportunity for a chat and breaks the ice a bit. Following a brief safety chat you are taken outside to the helicopter where you have your photograph taken. These can be purchased at the end of the flight but there is no pressure to do so. The helicopters are very modern with good views from wherever you sit. Take note that seating is organised by weight to ensure the helicopter is balanced correctly. Once you get clearance you are ready to go!
The flight itself....well it was one of the most amazing trips I have ever taken. As we headed out over the National Park, the pilot pointed out all sorts of information along the way. He was witty and his commentary made the trip all the more enjoyable. Nothing any body says can prepare you for the sight of the Grand Canyon from the sky!
If you are worried about flying in a helicopter don't be, it is smoother than an aeroplane. A wonderful experience made all the more enjoyable by the effort made by Mavericks.

review_title: Awesome Airplane tour for two May 12,2010
review_text: I never took an airplane tour of any island in HI, but I am so glad I flew with the Wings over Kauai.  Owner Bruce Coulombe was a great guide, knowlegeable of the different vegetation in  Kauai , flew over the the canyons, Napali coastline, a lots of waer falls and  went out of his way to fly over the Resort we were staying to see the ocean front to see if we could snorkle. How can you beat this personal narrated tour...Love Kauai
In just one hour you view the entire island and some inaccesibles areas, freindly pilot and very comfortable airplane, good price.  I recommend this good experience. Randolfo Vignali,  Tijuana BC.
This was the excursion highlight of our 3 week Alaskan Vac. Seeing Mt. Denali and landing on Ruth Glacier... words do not describe.

First of all, in prearranging this trip I was so happy with the friendliness of the staff. The day of our scheduled tour, May 30, 2012,  the weather turned a bit cloudy as it got close to our flight time and the visibility was a concern.  We tried to communicate early with the staff about our concerns of possibly not being able to do our glacier landing or seeing Mt. McKinley because of clouds.  They understood completely and were willing to do whatever was in their realm of control to try to make our experience a good one.  They don't sugar coat things only to have you disappointed.  We got the report from them as to what they expected our flight to be like and they allowed us to make whatever decision we were comfortable with.  We talked with them and they arranged for a later flight time with the idea of reevaluating at that time.  They told us that the weather can dramatically change either way in a short time.  We left but returned shortly thinking we better just cancel because we didn't want to risk not getting out of the experience the things that were important to us.  They pleasantly refunded our money without hesitation. We hung around town just a bit and noticed the weather seemed different so we went back to the office and inquired what they thought and yes, it was just like they said..dramatic change.  So up we went and it was AMAZING!!!!  Visibility was great and we did the glacier landing which is a MUST if you go!!!  What a spectacular view that allows you to experience the immensity of the mountains all around you.  It's a trip that you just have to experience to appreciate it and you will be so glad you did it.  They equip you with boots that fit over your shoes for the glacier landing so don't worry about that.  Just wear a good coat, hat, gloves and sunglasses for optimum comfort.  Take your camer and make a short video if you can so you can relive the moment and share with others.  Our pilot was very nice and shared information as we flew and took questions.  I get motion sickness easily so I took Bonine and also had a patch behind my ear but I will say that I felt the flight was smooth except when you get close to landing and there is some bumping around.  I wasn't sick and never afraid but if you have motion sickness just prepare yourself as I did and you won't have an issue.  This is a super nice company with a great customer satisfaction and I reallly like how they operate.  I highly recommend them.  My only sad point is that we didn't have an extra day in Talkeetna just to hang around and enjoy the cool feeling in that town.  By the way, my husband and I had the privilege of making this trip with our 3 grown children and what a joy to experience this beauty as a family experience we will never forget!!! Thank you Talkeetna Air Taxi!!!

Flight seeing Denali along with the Kenai Fjords tours were the highlight of my Alaskan adventure.  We chose the Talkeetna Air Taxi out of Talkeetna because they had a variety of flights and provided options.  The trip was sensational and worth every cent.  The photos taken from the air are pricelss and stunning.  The pilot was very gracious and informative.  Suggestions:  try and keep a couple of dates for flight seeing because the weather pattern around Denali is unpredictable and cancelled flights seem to be common due to bad weather.  If you are going to take pictures, check the internet for do's and don'ts so you can get the best shot possible.

There is a reason every review is 5 stars. I have done quite a bit of exciting and amazing things and this was easily a top 5 all time. The views and experience are unreal. You MUST do the optional glacier landing. You will learn a great deal and see Alaska from a different perspective.

We did a glacier air tour and glacier landing with Talkeetna air taxi! It was amazing ! Our pilot was very nice and explained what we were seeing while flying. The views are breathtaking and totally worth the price ! 

The glacier landing is AMAZING! We only got to spend 15 mins on the glacier, wish that could have been a bit longer. But if you have to choose one activity to do while at Alaska I would definitely recommend doing this glacier landing tour!
Excellent and very accommodating Pilot! He was very knowledgeable about all of the areas we flew by!
This was great! Views were great, ride was overall very smooth. Super beautiful ride, would recommend to anyone!

We decided at the last minute to add a flightseeing trip around Mt McKinley and surrounding peaks. We were not disappointed. Had a fantastic weather day. There is no way to explain the immense beauty we saw on our flight. Talkeetna Air staff are great and, especially our pilot. He made sure everyone on the plane got an opportunity to see all the amazing sites and take photos. His narration throughout the flight was spot-on. Definitely the highlight of our Alaska trip. Take the glacier landing tour, if you can. It is a one-in-a-lifetime experience.

I really enjoyed this helicopter ride over the Grand Canyon, although if you are placed in the middle of the back row, you will not have a good view. You do not know what seat, nor do you get to seat yourself, since the seating is calculated depending on the weight of all riders to even the load. I sat luckily in the front so I had outstanding views.

Matt was the best guide ever!!! We highly recommend this flight over Kauai. We went the second day that we arrived on Kauai to get a feel for the lay of the land. It was so worth it. We chose to do the plane ride instead of the helicopter because we could see so much more instead of close up views of everything.

Great experience! 
Highly recommended this to anyone that wants a great view of the islands.

Had a fun time!

Amazing trip over the Canyon on a flight from Tusayan. It was a really smooth flight from our pilots Jeff and Jacob.  There was narration through headphones and the views were just stunning. The ground staff were lovely and helpful too. We’d definitely recommend this trip and was well worth the money.
This is an awesome experience. Flight, land and walk around. If your on you’re honeymoon I strongly suggest taking her on this flight.

We did the Grand Denali tour with the glacier landing and to say it was once of the most amazing experiences of our lives is an understatement.  The weather was with us for the most part, so the views were incredible.  Our pilot, Paul, was very knowledgeable about the area and put his nervous passengers immediately at ease.  Everyone we interacted with was genuinely excited about their work and the opportunity to share what they love with us.  I had been tempted to skip the glacier landing, but I am so glad we didn't.  Don't miss this!!!

This was a true highlight of my trip to Alaska, pay extra for the glacier landing, and bring your wide angle lens. My photos and video from my iPhone were excellent 
Enjoy!
I have claustrophobia and the pilot was very accommodating. He was also very informative during the flight.

We took the two-person plane ride that takes you on an hour tour of Kauai.   Brian was our pilot.  The plane is 60 years old and looks a little rough, but he assured us the engine gets replaced every 2,000 flying hours and it ran just fine.  Brian did a wonderful job of narrating the tour of Kauai, pointing out interesting spots, vegetation, and historical facts.  We really did see the entire island and got a sense of the amazing geographical areas that make up the different parts of the island.  While it is true that an airplane doesn't go as low and up close as a helicopter, we paid about half of what a helicopter ride would cost, stayed in the air almost twice as long, and definitely saw all the same points of interests.  I have no regrets that we chose Air Ventures over a helicopter.  We'd do it again in a heartbeat!

We flew over Knik Glacier as we were unable to fly the Denali trip due to weather.  Our pilot was superb.  He shared his knowledge of the area and was friendly.  He made sure both sides of the plane got to see the sheep and moose we flew over.  The trip was amazing.
It was an epic flight with Tom. The island is very nice but if you are in the clouds the sight is even more fantastic. Thanks for Air Venture for this cool flight!!!
Excellent experience! The pilot was knowledgeable and friendly and provided an excellent narration during our flight. This trip is well worth the time!

review_title: Unique perspective of a unique area
review_text:
Between all the hiking and driving we were doing in the area, plus the fact I've happened to fly (very high) over this area in a commercial airliner, I wasn't sure how necessary a cost this was.  But I fully recommend it.

We did the Canyonlands + Arches trip.  The Canyonlands portion was the main course, with great views over all three areas of the park.  The plane is low & slow enough to give lots of time to take it all in.  Being in a four-seat Cessna (including the pilot) was a new experience.  The Arches portion was not nearly as spectacular, but it doesn't add very much cost or time if you're doing Canyonlands.
It was a great experience. We took a trip to elephant island, and western maui and other islands. Beautiful coral reefs. Torquioise blue. Excellent virws.
Great trip!!!! Super nice family that owns and fly's the planes, Must see country that you can only see from the air!!!!

review_title: Great view but don't expect action
review_text: The views are great but I expected to get more action for the cash. Ask if the helicopter is fully booked, if you get a seat in the back in the middle you probably won't enjoy it very much. Heavy people have to sit at the windows. Try to be the heaviest in the group and you will be lucky ;-)

Larry flew us- outstanding service , piloting and memorable trip- thank you for safety , knowledge, the music ,education but mostly a fantastic life experience in one of nature’s awesome gift to all of us.

We were very lucky to have great weather allowing for amazing views of Denali.  I am not a fan of small planes and we did not land on a glacier and I am glad as I was scared.  But the flight and views were truly amazing and worth the view.  The bush pilots were in constant communication with each other sharing info and such (you could here it) and you knew these folks were experienced and safe.  Use a coupon from teh Alaska Tour book (we bought at the supermarket) and saved 100$

This excursion was one of the highlights of our trip to Hawaii.  We were a group of 8 and Jill, Ray and JT were so accommodating.  They went above and beyond to make sure we were comfortable. Their professionalism was outstanding.  We would highly recommend this company. :)

review_title: Grand Denali Flight Tour with Glacier Landing
review_text:
10/10 recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi! Seriously if you’re looking for a flight tour, this is the company to go through. We had an amazing time with breath taking views that made this trip absolutely magical. The mountains and landscapes were astonishing. So many glaciers, mountain peaks, ridgelines and of course Denali. Everyone at TAT was so friendly, professional, accommodating, knowledgeable and patient! Everyone in the office was great. Amanda was the one who got me and my group of 10 people booked and ready for our trip! I didn’t have a for sure amount of 10 people when I first called to schedule, but Amanda was patient and flexible with me until I could confirm my whole group. Her and another lady (I’m sorry I forgot your name) were so helpful with answering my multitude of questions and helping us to feel assured and ready for our trip. 
Our pilot Clay was excellent! He was cool, calm, fun and knowledgeable providing us with great information all throughout the trip. And most importantly he kept us safe! He checked on us throughout the flight making sure we were comfortable, updated us on when their might be some turbulence and was patient with our photo taking on the glacier and with our little kiddos we had with us. 
The office was clean, warming and had a true Alaskan feel to it. The plane ride was comfortable and even though I get nervous with turbulence (we had very little of it on our flight) I still felt very safe. I have 4 other friends that have used this company and they all have had the same positive, exhilarating and time of their life experience with this company. I will certainly be referring my friends and family here and if I get the second chance, I will be flying with them again. 

Thank you TAT crew!! 😎🙌🏼
It was great flying thru the mountains and landing on the glacier.  I got some fantistic pictures sitting in the front seat.
Absolutely beautiful views it was raining when we took off but by the time we got over the mountains it was sunny.  our pilot Chad was excellent. Worth every penny

review_title: A "Must Take" Aerial Tour when in Kauai !!
review_text:
This aerial tour was a top highlight of our trip to Hawaii.  As several other reviewers have stated, we were treated more like family than customers.  Our plot, Bruce Coulombe, combined his agricultural background with his extensive flying experience to give us a wonderful and informative tour of the island.  He made sure to check on the well-being of all his passengers (we were a party of 4) prior to, during, and following the flight.  His pre-flight briefing was comprehensive, and he has a quiet and comforting style in explaining all the flight procedures, and asking (frequently) if we had any concerns or questions.  His knowledge of the geography and natural history of the island is considerable, as well as his updating on movie locations and stars who have visited the island.  We had an excellent flight, with good weather, and even saw some Humpback Whales in addition to the regular island sights! 

As a pilot myself, I was impressed both with Bruce's airmanship throughout the flight, his great rapport with his passengers, and with one of the smoothest landings I have ever experienced !!

I have no hesitation to give this experience "two thumbs up" and recommend it as a "must do activity" on Kauai.

Geoff Gartshore
Ontario Canada
We truly enjoyed the experience. Flying over the national park and finding yourself all of a sudden out the canyon is breathtaking. The experience is worth the price, from the moment you check in.

We had the open cockpit biplane flight beginning of February after booking online from the UK.  Jill kindly offered to collect/shuttle us from the ABC Store at Anchor Cove Shopping Mall which is very close to the Cruise terminal.  She gave us a scenic ride to the airport via some scenic gardens which was unexpected.  The small office was very friendly and efficient with space for bulky belongings.
  There we met Kevin, our pilot who immediately put Jane's mind at ease as she was very apprehensive of small aircraft and open cockpit.  He assured her that the flight would have no 'aerobatics', just relax & enjoy it. An extra cushion was provided so as to help look out.
  After putting on a vintage style cloth helmet with noise cancelling earphones we were ready for take off.  It was warm in the cockpit, just a tee shirt is enough even in February as you have the radial engine just forward of your feet.  We flew a circle over the cruise ship and all the way down the westerly coast including the spectacular Na-Pali coastline overflying white surf and coral reefs.  Turning inland the Waimea Canyon was laid out beneath us on our return to the airport.  Kevin gave a superb commentary.  A big advantage of the open cockpit was that you don't get window reflections in your photographs - or having to look through scratched or milky plexiglass.
    80% of Kauai is inaccessible so the only way to appreciate its majesty is from the air on this 65 minute flight.  We hired a car for the rest of the day and drove to the end of the Canyon road as well - not much to see from the tree lined road so you would need to walk the trails so glad we had the flight.
On our return we were also shuttled to the Avis car depot.
  At first sight the trip sounded expensive at 500USD (£390) for us both but for the experience of a vintage style aircraft in such an exotic place it most definitely was not.  Putting it in perspective, the previous day we paid 300USD for us to have a minibus sightseeing excursion on Big Island.  No contest!!
  To those hesitant of the aircraft - don't be.  Open cockpit is exhilarating and all that fresh air and immersion in the experience blows away any concerns of nausia.  Jane was Cock-a Hoot afterwards with absolutely no regrets.
We are very well travelled seniors and this flight is surely one of our highlights.

Very close up view of the mountains...great pilots...something you won't soon forget! I was impressed with the knowledge that the pilot had about the mountain and the surrounding areas. The plane ride was extremely smooth, definitely not like other small plane rides I had been on.

This was the highlight of my cruise to Alaska on Oceania Cruises!.Great flight, lots of bears feeding at the hatchery and the best flight back to the dock. Our pilot, CHUCK, was the best!!!  Thanks for making our trip to Alaska.
Friday Harbor Sea Planes are always the highlight of my trip whether coming or going from the San Juan Islands! Love this company! The shuttle to SeaTac is so convenient as well.

Took the trip around the island in Bruce's air-van on June 1, 2015.  It was really a great treat.  He's very good at pointing out the details of what's beneath you as you fly.  We had fantastic views of Kauai's highlights.  I've already recommended Wings Over Kauai to a friend who is visiting shortly. I'd do the same for anyone.  

Thanks for a great trip, Bruce.  We will remember it forever.

review_title: An amazing Seaplane Adventure...over the top!!
review_text:
This was so much better than I had expected.  From booking the flight to the actual experience.  Everyone was so friendly and helpful!  Mary Lee welcomed us as if we were family.  I took my dad for his 80th birthday.   He forgot his coat (if you go, you should bring a jacket), so Mary Lee immediately helped us get a sweatshirt with no delays.  
There were six of us total and what a great day!  My 79 year old mom almost didn't go because she was nervous about climbing into the plane but Aaron the pilot along with Renato (Ren) made her feel safe and secure as she boarded and de-boarded.  They were awesome!
Up in the air, the views were incredible, Aaron shared the history of the Bay with us over the headsets that we were available for us on the flight.  I've lived in the area for over 40 years and I was surprised at the tidbits that I didn't know.  
If you've ever thought about riding in a SeaPlane, don't delay!  It was seriously a blast and a lifelong memory!  
Thank you Mary Lee, Aaron and Renato - we had an amazing tour and thank you to Ann (for all the helpful email correspondence)!
This by far was the coolest experience of my life. I did the Denail Grand Tour with a glacier landing and would highly recommend for anyone visiting the Talkeetna area.
Absolutely loved this trip, it was the best excursion of my vacation, you get so close to Denali and the landing on the glacier is a once in a lifetime opportunity. Just do it!

Line service guys were right there when we taxied in. Van came down from the FBO and took the passengers into Tusyan to catch a ground tour. FBO staff made my wait comfortable. Even the tower folks were extraordinary friendly and accommating. Was a great visit.
The flight was great. The pilot Mike is a hoot. My wife rode in the copilot seat...every part of the experience was top notch.

The flightseeing experience is great and was the highlight of our 2 week trip to Alaska. The pilot was experienced and knowledgeable and gave us lots of information as we were flying. Arranging the trip was a challenge, however. Our summit flight was cancelled due to last minute routine maintenance to our plane. Then it was rescheduled due to a last minute change to the maintenance date. Then it was downgraded to the Flyer Tour due to weather conditions. Overall, though, we had a good flight.

review_title: If only the mountain had complied
review_text: Scheduled a glacier landing on a warm and sunny day but when we arrived at the landing site the pilot was leery of the local conditions. We are not faulting the experience or the pilot just bad luck. Pilot did treat us to lengthy flight around the mountain

review_title: Amazing Seaplane ride and breathtaking views of Misty Fjords
review_text: My wife and I  booked our tour to Misty Fjords through Princess Cruise. I had mixed feeling about the tour because we could only get space on the first flight out of the day and I was not sure if we would be able to see much in Misty Fjords. There is a reason it is called MISTY Fjords. Ketchikan is surrounded by rain forest and it rains there all the time. We were told that if there are clouds our flight might not happen. When our cruise ship reached Ketchikan it was party cloudy. The forecast had slight chance of showers. Well by the time we boarded the small 6 seater seaplane sun had come out. It was our first time in a  seaplane. Taking off from  water was an interesting experience. Our pilot was experienced and knowledgeable about the area and shared interesting information through the whole flight. However, there were no microphones in our headset. so we could only hear our pilot but could not ask him questions. The headset were old also and at times there were lot of noise. The experience would have been much better if we had better (newer) headphones with microphones.  By the time we reached the fjords, the clouds and mist had cleared and the views were breathtaking. Our pilot flew the plane low enough through the fjords to really enjoy the spectacular scenery. We landed at a remote spot in the fjords and stepped out of the seaplane for about 5 to 10 mins. On the way back, our flight path was different than the one we took flying in to the Misty Fjords. We saw many bald eagles. Overall an enjoyable experience in a seaplane.

review_title: great experience. They even offered whale watching.
review_text: In general, this is a great deal. It is cheaper than the helicopters, but has a comparable view. The right side has better view than the left. The captain will watch for whales and point them out for you. Their big window offers great view, but the wings are sometimes an obstacle for taking pictures.

review_title: A must do if you can!
review_text: This was an add to our AK trip about a week ahead of time.  We are happy with our decision!  The staff, from check-in, to the lady on the deck getting our boots, to our pilot were all so nice and welcoming.   It was truly an experience and an amazing view. Landing on the glacier provided a great experience on our AK trip!
We very much enjoyed our flight.  The weather cleared just in time for us to get a great view.  It was a very windy day, but our pilot did a great job of keeping our flight smooth.

review_title: Cruise Excursion - Taquan Air - Misty Fjords - Spectacular views from a Seaplane!
review_text: We had a wonderful time on our cruise excursion flying to the Misty Fjords on Taquan Air.  The views from our seaplane were spectacular and we loved landing on a lake in the fjord.  It was so peaceful and the scenery was breathtaking...walking onto the pontoons to take photos was a lot of fun.  The only drawback was our pilot.  He was very competent but did not provide a lot of commentary on what we were seeing or where we were flying.  This is a highly recommended cruise excursion....if you can afford it!

review_title: Great way to see the island!
review_text: We loved our flight over Kauai!  We took our flight early in the week.  We saw a lot of the island that we wouldn't have been able to see any other way, and it gave us a different perspective when we visited some of those sites by car later in the week.  The flight itself was fairly smooth, and we all had a window seat in the 6-passenger plane.  It took off on time and lasted about an hour.  The pilot pointed out all of the features.  The views were fantastic!  We highly recommend it.

review_title: Get on the left side of the helicopter or the front row.
review_text:
I loved this so much but I missed so much sitting on the right side of the helicopter in the second row. I didn’t get to see the canyon as much nor did I get to see the two rivers merge into one.

I’m sure there’s a required flight path and all but I so wish the tour went clockwise and counterclockwise so that each side got to see the canyon in its full glory. I saw a lot of trees. I paid to see the canyon.
SeaPlane Adventures provided a unique experience to see major attractions in the Bay Area by planes. The pilot was very knowledgeable and professional.

review_title: amazing views. highlight of our trip. our pilot was not  very interactive but we still enjoyed it a lot
review_text:
all 3 air taxi companies in the area are located close by and they make a similar trip with a landing on ruth glacier or other glacier. this flightseeing trip was absolutely worth signing up for. the views are phenomenal. the vista on the glacier is amazing. 
I strongly recommend a glacier landing even if it costs  100$ more (whichever company you go with). 
we went with talkeetna as they seemed the most popular but the reviews of all 3 companies looked good. prices are similar. the route they fly is also similar
the signing up process/check in /equipment they offer etc was excellent. no concerns there. the only mild downer was that the pilot who was with us seemed most uninterested in being where he was. said hello. pointed at a couple of things while speaking in a hurry. got in,took off, sat in the plane checking his phone while at cruising altitude (we were not worried about safety), landed, called us back in when done with landing and got us off the plane at the airport again. 
did not show any interest in pointing anything out. once again. I am sure there are other pilots who are more interactive. it does not diminish the trip as the views are incredible.

This was supposed to be the "cherry on top" for our family Alaska trip, since our daughter is a mountain girl and pilot. Due to weather, we weren't able to fly as high as planned, and fresh snow prevented landing/walking on glacier. (Sad!) 
Regardless, it was INCREDIBLE!!!! THE FOOTHILLS ALONE WERE MAGNIFICENT!! 
Pilot let our pilot girl be "co-pilot" (no controls, of course!) 
Great experience! Courteous, helpful staff. Half refund since couldn't do what booked. Great communication from 6 months out til trip.

review_title: Highly recommended...  better than a sunset cruise
review_text:
So the BF and I were debating whether to view the Na Pali Coast by water or air.  I made the executive decision to do both.  We did the cheaper sunset cruise with Captain Andy's the night prior.  This by far, was a much better, unique experience.  

I know most people do the helicopter tours but those were much more expensive and I was wary about riding in a helicopter hovering over places like that and the loud noise.   Besides that, this place came highly rated on Trip Advisor so this was the choice for us.

The family that runs this company are very professional and courteous to a T.  Upon booking, I think I spoke with Bruce who was super friendly and helpful over the phone.  I hung up with a good feeling about them.

We were running slightly late because we took a wrong turn at the airport and had to circle around so they called us just as we were parking the car.   Dori was still very nice about it.  They called me to the back office and introduced themselves to me, each of the 3 people, shaking my hand.  I work in customer service so I make a note to commend them on that.

They gave me a kukui nut lei and a small white flower (I think it was a tuberose) to put in your hair.  It smelled wonderful but you can't really wear it on your ear since you have to wear the headphones on the plane so I ended up sticking it in my purse.  My boyfriend oddly enough, did not get any gift so I thought that was strange.  Another couple was there and the man was wearing the same kukui nut lei I had and the woman had on a different kind.  I suspected that they gave it to her but she may have already been wearing one.  Anyway, that was the only thing that bothered me about their service.  They should equally be accommodating to the males.

I agree with a prior review I read about doing this towards the end of your trip so you can see the places you have been to previously by land.  It gives you a better frame of reference and a greater appreciation of this beautiful island.  There are no bad seats on the air van.  Each seat has its own window.  They seat you by weight.  My boyfriend sat next to the pilot and I sat directly behind my boyfriend but I was fine with that.  They also provide drinks, at least mini water bottles and ginger candies in case you are prone to motion sickness.

The flight itself was outstanding.  Our pilot/guide, Josh, was super knowledgeable about everything and even answered all the curious questions we had about various things we saw.  The views were spectacularly awesome and they even had a soundtrack during the trip, sometimes corresponding to the view (i.e. - the Jurassic park music).  That was a GREAT, very much appreciated touch.  

They take photos of you in front of the airplane before you take off and email it to you for free.  Make sure the other passengers are not in the back photo-bombing your picture with their legs on the other side of the plane like ours had.  They have a video of your specific flight for sale if you want it but they gave us generic one for free!  :)

Loved it!  A must do!

review_title: Great way to see the Grand Canyon
review_text: We had a great flight. Check in and loading was easy. Our pilot was friendly and gave us a great tour with lots of information. The views were amazing! Unfortunately everyone doesn't get a window seat. The back row has four seats so seeing is limited.

It was a good way to see the entire Island.  But w e were a little disappointed with the narration.
Couldn't see much from our side of the plane

review_title: Affordable, Wide View of Kauai Scenery
review_text: My sister and I opted for the Air Ventures tour over a helicopter tour. We were pleased with the value for the money. We were lucky to have a clear day, and enjoyed beautiful views of the island. Pilot JT was friendly. Bottled water & cold cloths were supplied in the plane. The plane was comfortable. We were pleased with our experience with Air Ventures Hawaii. While the airplanes are not able to get a close-up view to the scenery like helicopters do, we were able to enjoy a wide view and took terrific photos.

The staff are cordial and warm. They called us in advance to warn us about inclement weather and cancellation of the tour on the day in question. The day of the tour , we arrived to the assigned place with the help of Lisa's directions through the airport. The pilot was a chilled out guy and he took our pics before the journey started and indulged us in many a trivia about the island and the wonders it has to offer. There were 4 of us in the ride meant for 6.Its was comfortable enough and once we rose to the sky , no looking back. We got to see the most breath taking views of the falls, canyon and the beaches. Got a little nauseous along the way but the views made up for the suffering. I am glad this was planned to be done by us in the beginning of the trip. The pilot told us about all the tourist and local attractions. After getting the view from the top, we later decided to get a close peek from the ground level! Helped us plan our trip better as we got to know which places are in proximity and can be visited in close succession. In kuaui, air tour is a must do.
We had a wonderful day, departure from Scottsdale area was so convenient, and the pink jeep tour of the rim was filled with stories and anecdotes of the guides experiences in the Grand Canyon.

review_title: Trip was pretty good considering the weather
review_text:
We were there three weeks ago, and unfortunately the skies weren't clear.  Most  people we were with rescheduled for the next day, but we didn't have that option since we were leaving the next morning.  So after waiting a couple of hours we got the go-ahead.  In hindsight, we wish we hadn't gone that day since we didn't get to see much of the mountains and couldn't do a glacier landing.   Brad was OK.  I guess we were expecting more commentary during the flight.  
So…. if the weather is really clear, go for it.  If it's not, pass on the trip and save your money.

My husband and I, and our 6 year old daughter took a wonderful plane ride with Bruce, our very knowledgable and hospitable pilot. We flew in the Cessna which seats the pilot, co-pilot, and two passengers (my husband was the co-pilot).The island was gorgeous from the air, so I would highly recommend a tour by air. If you can afford the helicopter tour I would recommend that, but for those on a budget (like us) I would highly recommend Wings Over Kauai. I received a beautiful necklace at check-in, a free DVD at the end of the flight, and had wonderful photos of my family emailed to us within an hour of our flight. Excellent customer service, fun trip, and great free gifts to remember the trip.

We were scheduled to do the Misty Fjords tour, but weather prevented that. The pilot made alternate plans  for our trip.   The space inside the plane is tight. My husband (6 ft tall) was very uncomfortable. We made a brief water landing.  We could stand on the floats  to take photos.

This was a fun experience. I would have rated it 5 had we not been 30 minutes behind schedule. No explanation given so we were just hanging out there wondering how late we’re gonna be up in the air. Pilot was very nice as well but there was a lot of silence during the air tour. Wish there were more info shared.

review_title: Never took the taxi but still would go here
review_text: We never took the air taxi because of bad weather but this company tried their best to accommodate us. Very polite, friendly, and full refund was given.

My friends and I used Air Ventures while on our Kauai,Hawaii
trip. Each person had a window seat. And the sites were 
beautiful. Our pilot Joel was so informative and had such
a warm, fun personality. The prices were much less than
the helicopter trips and accomplished the same goal.
The amount of time in the air was just right. One hour is plenty to see the entire island. Pilot was experienced with his knowledge but didn't have much personality. His name was Harry.

We were scheduled to fly over Denali, but weather did not cooperate and pilots had to regrettably cancel flights.  The folks at K2 were very apologetic and understood our disappointment.  Since we were in Talkeetna only one day, we had to move on.  The wonderful staff at Talkeetna made a suggestion, that ultimately took business away from them.  They recommended that we call a company in Denali to try and book from there, since that is where we were headed.  They didn't HAVE to make that suggestion.  K2 people are genuine and really care about folks like us who have a lifelong dream of seeing Denali.

If/when we revisit AK, we will definitely try K2 again!

BTW, we DID see The Great One 2 days later ...it is the most magnificent trip I've ever taken.  Highly recommend it.  Absolutely worth every penny! I still get chills when I tell about it.

review_title: You need to see the island from the air
review_text:
Much of Kauai is very difficult to reach and you see much more from the air.  We went with the airplane instead of the helicopter because it also included a number of land adventures that we were wanting include for about the same price.  This was the first air tour we had been on and really didn't know what to expect.  We were a little disappointed that we didn't get closer to the Napoli coast or deeper into the canyon (like I have seen pictures of) but my understanding is that we since we came in the winter the winds were much greater.  My disappointment was that we couldn't take pictures; we bought the DVD instead, but wasn't the same.  They were very nice and did a group picture in front of the plane before lift off and emailed to us.

Note:  We weren't told this until after we booked the tour (booked before we went to Hawaii) that the air tour depends on the weather (duh) but often the mists cover up a lot of the topography.  This wasn't the case for us and we didn't even have rain, but be forewarned. We booked early in the trip in case we had to reschedule.

review_title: A Misty Day at the Fjords
review_text:
We recently took a flight seeing trip to Misty Fjords with Taquan Air.  We chose this company because of the B1G1 free coupon offered in the Toursaver coupon book.  I really didn't know what to expect but the company was very professional and well run.  We were picked up at the ship and driven to the office.  It was a really nice and professional looking office.  It looked like a pretty big scale operation (I think I was expecting a mom and pop type of office).  We watched a video and soon were on our way.  They had several planes running that day and we were with another couple on our plane (so just 4 of us).  We took off and headed past the town of Ketchikan (and our ship) to Misty Fjords.  It lived up to it's name.  It was misty but it was also beautiful.  There was turquoise water, steep granite cliffs, waterfalls and even a rainbow.  We landed on the water in the middle of one of the fjords and got out on the float for a few minutes. The pilot did a wonderful job on the take offs and landings.
The negatives for me were several.  Most were not a big deal but I want you to know what to expect.  
I was in the back of the plane and it was FREEZING, and I don't say that lightly.  The seals around the door were non-existant and it made for a very uncomfortable ride.  On the way back I rode in the front and it was warm up there.
My stomach was also revolting the entire way.....especially on the way back.  I would definitely take some dramamine.  It is better to be safe than sorry.  I was eyeing that sea sickness bag and praying I wouldn't have to reach for it.  I kept staring at the horizon and breathing really deep.  Kind of took a little away from the trip for me.
Lastly, (but also initially)...when we excited our cruise ship and went to meet them where the map indicated, we also called them and let them know we were there.  We waited and waited.  Finally, someone from the port came up and asked if we needed help.  We told him who we were waiting on and he indicated that they were in a different spot today.  We went over there and the driver told us it was a good thing we showed up because he was about to leave us.  When I shared with him that we were waiting in the correct spot and that we had even contacted the main office and let them know where we were he said that he didn't answer his cell phone so he couldn't have known this.  This irritated me and I would have been extremely upset if we had been left behind...but we weren't so bigones and all that.  Just be aware. (0therwise the company was really professional and I blame the driver, not the company)
I thought the fjords were very pretty.  They didn't blow me away like some of the reports I read.  I don't know if it is because we are from Colorado or if it is because we have seen some amazing places like this before (or because I was green to the gills :)) but it wasn't my favorite thing in Alaska we did.  Once again, not a reflection on the company (that I am reviewing) at all.  Except for the "mix up" (see how kind I can be) at the beginning, they were great.
Hope this helps!
Couldn't have seen so much of Grand Canyon any other way.  Beautiful colors and amazing details as we flew over the canyon.

5STARS ALL THE WAY: once in a lifetime moment! OK but so this is really a response to another  4 star review that honestly I had a problem with reading because everyone is such a critic these days and so easy to just put your low blood sugar moment on the internet forever and end up not realizing it: My Son and I had the time of our lives, he’s 5 and flew until he got bored, our flight was exactly as expected and even more! We appreciated being asked to leave our feedback to this small business who makes real effort to provide the experience of a lifetime!    We were given our photos BEFORE paying, not after, and the pilot only stood over us to give us shade from the hot sun!  He was trying to guide us, nothing more!  He helped us through the review process which to be honest isn’t as simple as you might think and we’re happy to support such passionate and kind people!  They were so kind and helpful throughout and the only reason they would suggest what to say is obviously when told “ummm, I don’t know what to say”.  So here’s the thing, clearly we had the time of our lives, a thousand people did, and one person clearly just goes on vacation looking for nitpicking things to Yelp about, well, we wanted our 4 Star 5 Star review to put some balance into things for this passionate operator. We Enjoyed every minute! Professional Fun and so so Classy!  More than memorable! The best!  This is my honest review based on my own tour experience and wanted to support this truly exceptional small business. Thanks so much!

It was a cloudy, iffy weather day. We arrived earlier than our slot and they offered to take us immediately as the weather was supposed to get worse. They could not do the bigger tour and so offered the next level at the lower price. They were very honest about that and even offered the lower price that existed when we originally booked the tour months back. It turned out to be a great day, after all as the weather turned to better!

We came for a flight seeing tour of Denali but due to weather weren’t able to fly that day. I wish I had known to check my email on the morning of the trip, it would have saved me a long drive as they had sent a message telling us of the less than desirable weather. It was overcast and so we wouldn’t have been able to see Denali. We were rescheduled for the next day but the same occurred and they offered a flight seeing excursion around the Talkeetna valley area (sheep mountain). Although it was a bummer that we didn’t get the full Denali viewing tour (not their fault) the Talkeetna valley tour was fun. The pilot was friendly and knowledgeable about the area. He took his time explaining the safety features and helped quell some other people’s fears of flying. We felt safe and comfortable the whole time. It’s a little awkward getting into the planes but there were was an older lady on our trip with a bad knee that the pilots and rampers were only too willing to help out. I would fly with this company again.

Unfortunately the cloud ceiling in the Gorge prevented us from doing most of the trip. However, the pilot, David, made a big fuss showing my 5 year old grandson the plane, let him touch the instruments and talking with hm on takeoff and landing.  He dubbed himhis copilot and helped fill out a pilot log that thrilled my grandson.  So the rating reflects all of David’s great work and the crappy weather conditions.

This was our first time visiting Hawaii while our friends had been there several times.  To see the Na Pali coastline was a must.   We were there at the time of the hurricane scare and thus our zodiac tour was cancelled early in the morning.  Being our last day we needed to see the beauty of the Na Pali coastline and quickly got a plane spot for the 4 of us with Air Ventures Hawaii and at a great price than others offered.  They were very accommodating with scheduling us in early in the afternoon.  It was a beautiful sunny day and the views were fantastic! Our pilot, Bryan, gave us a lot of facts of the areas as  we flew over them and so it was quite informative.  The other couple did not feel any motion sickness, but my husband and I did.  I took a pill to help me with the motion sickness but probably not in time.  But the whole time, Bryan, gave me instructions on how to be comfortable.  They also have COLD bottles of water on the plane which helped me out a lot by minimizing the motion sickness.  Despite all of my sensitivity, the views were beautiful and glad I did it.  But it will be my last plane ride for a while!  Great experience to try atleast once!  and the company was great!

Wow! The view and experience was wonderful! Our pilot was courteous and polite. He rotated the seating on the return trip so that everyone had the opportunity to have a front seat if they desired. He handled the safety instructions in a professional manner that ensured everyone knew what was expected of them.

Unfortunately, despite following the instructions provided by our bus tour guide we were 7 minute lates for our time slot. This was partially also a result of a delayed shuttle bus. Maverick was rightfully upset that their scheduling was thrown off by the delay. Having the group of us stand in the lobby while they contacted the bus tour operator to correct the instructions provided to guests, however was not at all professional.

I lived here in Anchorage, Alaska and have never had a chance to fly up to Mt. McKinley and land on a glacier. What great service from the entire staff and the sales team.The sales team were great to deal with at the office in Anchorage and suggest the right type of trip for my family from West Virginia. The pilot on the plane took his time out to take pictures of the family and explain in detail of the fantastic views we were looking at. What a fantastic bunch of people to have a life time of memories.

review_title: Prepare to change plans and is AMAZING
review_text: It was the most expensive experience in Alaska and we had left half a day for the selected tour. After Memorial day they called the day of not enough people gathered for our tour so all our so they could only offer the Grand Tour. It only takes 4 people and the pilot to fill the small plane, choice of seats was arbitrary and of course the one next to the pilot is the best. I am writing this to warn you of this practice of switching times and tours without any prior notice and also the weather, the 30% rule. If there are clouds they admitted is good but not the same. If you can leave as many days open as possible, the mornings seemed clearer and supposedly more snow early season and sometimes less clouds, It was breathtaking and worth the expense. Did not do glacier landing. Just prepare to change plans if needed. The grand tour is the typical one for a reason.

Originally I was scheduled for the 9:00am Grand Denali tour but mother nature had other plans. Denali was still rained and fogged in but K2 was able to offer me the chance to instead fly over Knik Glacier. It was a beautiful flight and the views were gorgeous.  Our pilot was willing to answer any questions we had and it was a once in a lifetime experience I greatly enjoyed.

We booked the Denali Experience (1 hour flight, no glacier landing), but it was pretty cloudy on the day of our flight. Other passengers were rescheduling because K2 wasn’t doing any glacier landings that day, and K2 was offering refunds to some customers.  The staff showed us that our flight would be lower than usual, but there was still stuff to see, so we decided to go ahead with it. Our flight was a full one, 9 passengers in an Otter, because some of the customers who had originally booked a glacier landing decided to take the shorter flight instead.

Well overall, it was a great experience. My main goal for the flight was to get a good view of a glacier, and we spent a lot of time flying low over Ruth Glacier, which was awesome. Our pilot was a great tour guide and made us feel very safe. He made sure we all had a good view of the glacier, plus pointed out some bears and moose that we passed over. Every passenger had a window seat, and it was a smooth flight in spite of the clouds. I would definitely recommend flying with K2, but keep in mind that when you check in for your flight, you may need to make some immediate decisions based on the current weather.

Just got back from Kauai - went on a 1 hour airplane tour over Kauai - very nice experience over the island of Kauai - pilot tells you the sites that you are going over; at the end of the tour, the owners hand you a cd of your experience - nice touch.  Only thing we did not like was that we had an appointment for 9:30 but did not board until a half hour later as they needed to prep the plane.  As we were with a tour guide, our time was precious so we were not happy with this delay.  My advice to Wings is to have your planes prepped before you book the times for your clients - have a more accurate boarding time.  Otherwise, nice experience if never been on an airplane ride.

review_title: Glacier landing is a must do!
review_text: We enjoyed our flight around Denali.  Even though it was a warm and sunny day in Talkeetna, you could not see the mountain due to haze.  We were able to see the summit on the Grand tour, but not until we were 5 miles away.  Views are best from the left side of the plane - pilot's side.  Co-pilot seat is poor - dash is too high.  The best part was the glacier landing.  It's a rather thrilling landing and take-off.   We all enjoyed the snowball fight on the glacier and got some fun pictures.  Worth doing once!

review_title: Good trip but not clear details
review_text: The actual tour while on the water was stunning! We saw wildlife and our guide, Tia, was amazing! She was friendly and very informative. I have to take one star due to your saying full day. We were picked up at our hotel, had a 3 1/2 bus ride to Page, AZ, then another bus ride to the boats. Then on the water just under 3 1/2 hours for another return bus ride. Had I been informed that the tour originated in Page, we would have stayed there and eliminated the bus ride, but it never gave me the information during the reservation process. When I did call prior to it, I admit I should have asked if staying in Grand Canyon Village was a good idea. But, the tour itself it great, just make sure you stay in Page for it to start. Oh, and you should know the picnic lunch isn’t out on the water, but given to you on the bus. Then you must go through Homeland Security before you can board the transfer to the boat.

review_title: The best way to see Canyonlands
review_text: Our pilot Kim was the best. I was apprehensive about taking the flight but my husband convinced me. He was certainly right about this one. We took the one hour flight. Kim made us feel at ease. My husband got so many great pictures from the air. I had a smile on my face for the entire hour. Don't miss this opportunity. If you go, I hope your pilot is Kim. He is the best!

I so nervous booking this trip as I am terrified of heights so booked and paid months before!  On the day I felt ill with nerves but I really wanted to do it, you only live once! As soon as we were up in the air I felt slightly better as it wasn't as scary as I thought it would be.  The trip itself was amazing with breath taking views although I was a bit disappointed when we landed as that area didn't show the Canyon's best bits!  For the time we had (less than a day) it was a great way to see it but if you have time I would say to do the drive if you can and it will be worth it (did it when I was 15 with parents) and the memory is still with me 20 years later!

review_title: Airplane around Kauai shows the best parts of the island in just 60 minutes
review_text: Very good overview of the beautiful island with reasonable price (particularly compared with helicopters). Sensitive to low cloud coverage as it needs to fly higher than helicopters. We had a bit bad luck in a way that our flight took place in the most cloudy day of our visit… Good view out of the windows and helpful pilot trying to ensure there was a lot to see created a great experience nonetheless.

The tour pick up from the port getting us to the port where we took the seaplane out to misty fyords. Had a great pilot that gave us history of the areas that we flew over. Seeing the mountain range from a seaplane is breathtaking. Getting to see lakes on top of mountains was also unique. Unique experience with fantastic scenes

We had a wonderful tour with Bruce! Everyone with the company was incredibly friendly and for the price this experience could not be beat!!!
However if you are looking to explore all the nocks and crannies of the island I would probably recommend a helicopter. The airplane tours can't get into the canyon like helicopters can.
Wings over Kauai Tours was very nice and helpful.  They were not expensive and the tour and piolt was excellent.

review_title: Discover this garden island’s hidden treasures
review_text: Wonderful aerial tour of this beautiful island. Our pilot was great. My only issue was a faulty headset so I missed a lot of the in-flight narrative.

review_title: Wings Over Kaua'i Simply the best
review_text: Couldn't praise them highly enough.Quieter than the helicopter and cheaper.Put you at ease. Water and snacks if you can tear yourself away from the views - We couldn't.Communication with the pilot and ther passengers (Only 4 in total on our trip) for any questions.When we landed we wanted to go back again.

review_title: A must have experience in Alaska!!
review_text:
First things first. Book your trip way in advance, these trips get sold out too soon.
Landing on a glacier is a surreal experience, please opt for that.

One nit, would've loved if our trip started at the scheduled time. We got delayed for our later commitments.

review_title: Great experience apart from last minute changes!
review_text: The overall experience was amazing. However, we had booked the 8am flight and were meant to be picked up from our ship at 7:30... at 7:15 I got a phone call saying they would pick us up at 8:45. We had another excursion booked for later that morning so this was a problem. We were able to do both but we no longer had time to explore the town and had to really rush lunch which was a shame.

review_title: Scenic Tour of Grand Canyon, Antelope Canyon and Colorado River all in one day!!
review_text: Our family of 4 booked this trip due to limited time during our vacation to see the Grand Canyon.  I thought it would the perfect solution and sounded like fun.  I have two girls, 20 and 14. We all enjoyed the short plane ride over the Grand Canyon once we made it to the airport.  We received our box breakfast, which consisted of an apple, yogurt, muffin and a small orange juice.  Not too bad.  Got to Page AZ where they escorted us into the airport office to await our "jeep" ride to Antelope Canyon.  Well they loaded us in the back of a trailer attached to a pick up truck.  It was Memorial Day, and not quite warm enough for a 15 minute trip in an open trailer on the back of a truck but we made it.  Our tour guide was Rosie.  Very nice and knowledgeable about the Canyon.  It was amazing and a pleasant surprise for our tour.  Pictures we got were phenomenal.  Spent about 1-2 hours here.  It was hot once we got to Antelope Canyon but the temp inside was cool.  When this part of the tour was done, they loaded us again in the trailer and took us to the drop for the raft portion of the trip. It was around 12 noon now.  They gave us our box lunches that were decent; ham sandwich, chips, granola bar, apple and a cookie.  We got to the boat part and they once again loaded us on school bus and we road to a loading area near a dam.  I believe it was called Glen Canyon Dam.  It looks very similar to Hoover Dam and to see it close up was kinda cool.  They split the families up and escorted us to these large pontoon rafts like shown in the online pictures.  They are nice.  They are stocked with cans of lemonade and a big jug of water so you can refill your water bottles.  We did this several times due to the length of the trip and the heat.  Keep in mind it was only May 28th and temps were around 85-90 that day in the Canyon.  They raft ride was beautiful but a little too long.  We were on the boat for about 5 hours.  Could have done it 3 and that would have been enough for us all.  The scenery was beautiful, we stopped a couple of times to see different sights.  We put our feet in the Colorado River which was about 47 degrees.  We got back to the dock and they escorted us to a large motor coach for the 3 hours ride back to the Airport.  EVERYONE on the bus was exhausted.  I think everyone, including kids went to sleep.  That bus was as quite as a church.  We road about 1-1/2 hours and we stopped at a gift shop.  You could go to the restroom, get a snack or buy souvenirs.  We then drove to the Grand Canyon National Park to drop those who were staying there.  They took the rest of us to the airport right after.  We got back to our car around 6 I believe.  LONG day.   LOTS of great memories and pictures.  Glad we did it.  Would be a much better tour if the raft portion was continuous movement and a shorter time frame.

review_title: A great way to see the entire island
review_text: The staff is great and it's a great way to see the entire Island which you can't do with a car... However, if you are at all uneasy about flying, you should think twice about going up in a small plane. Also, I would suggest bringing a "real" camera and not just using an iPhone camera as you the plane doesn't really get close enough to many of the sites to get quality pictures.

This was really difficult to rate.  The experience itself (flying around Denali and landing on a glacier) is a full 5 star experience.  If there was no other operator in Talkeetna, I would have rated this company higher, just based on how cool the experience is.  (If you are wondering whether or not to splurge on a flight around Denali - do it, it's AMAZING).  But this is a review of Talkeetna Air Taxi - the tour operator, not just a review of the scenic flight, and honestly, I wasn't that impressed with TAT.

After reading all the positive reviews, I chose to book with Talkeetna Air Taxi.  I completed the online booking form and entered my credit card info.  When I received my confirmation a few days later, I noted I had been scheduled for a different day than requested.  Not the end of the world - I contacted the company, they apologized and rescheduled me for the correct day - but if I hadn't read my confirmation carefully, I'm sure it would been a much bigger deal to fix the day I was supposed to fly.  Then about a week later, I received a voicemail letting me know they had needed to change the time of my flight - but the time they told me it was changed to was the time they had told me in the first place.  Again, no big deal, but it did make me wonder how organized they were.

When my family arrived at the office on the day of our flight it was quite chaotic.  People were landing and trying to buy t-shirts, people were checking in and needing to fill out forms and get weighed.  When my turn to check in arrived, I asked how the weather was expected to be.  I received a curt - "your flight will be fine" in response.  I was asking, because we had planned to be in Talkeetna for a couple of days and had booked our flight right at the start so that we could postpone/reschedule if weather dictated.  I got the feeling they were just too busy to talk to me.

Our flight was delayed by about 10 minutes, again - not a big deal, but we were waiting outside in the cold rain for those 10 minutes and no one from the company provided us with any information.

There was heavy cloud cover when we took off.  During the first portion of our flight, the clouds completely enveloped the plane - nothing but white-out conditions outside my window.  I have to tell you - I was nervous!  Denali and the mountains around it stuck up out of the cloud cover and so the main portion of our flight was still amazing.  The return was also completely clouded in.  I do wish I had the opportunity to talk about the weather before the flight.  Maybe they would have convinced me this was still the best chance, given how changeable the weather is, but since I never got to discuss it with them, I just don't know.

My other big complaint was that the pilot provided almost no commentary during the flight.  He seemed a competent pilot, but he wasn't at all personable.  There were many points during the flight where I really didn't know what I was looking at.  I would have preferred an audio recording to the silence we mostly got.  It also would have been nice for him to give a reassuring "don't worry about the clouds around Talkeetna, you'll see Denali just fine," during the first portion of the flight.  I am particularly contrasting this experience to the wonder commentary provided by the pilot during my Misty Fjords scenic flight.

I know this review sounds fairly negative.  I wasn't really that bad, I'm just balancing it against how much the trip cost and how many other operators there are that offer the same service.  If you are anywhere near Talkeetna, you should definitely do a scenic flight around Denali and spend the extra to land on a glacier - it truly is an amazing experience.  My experience with Talkeetna Air Taxi was perfectly adequate, but that's all.

Recommended to us by a friend who said before you do anything else on the island you should see it by air first. 

On that note, I booked the trip and we arrived and checked in easily. Eric was our pilot. He was funny, laid back and got everyone ready

Being the tallest in the group, I ended up in the copilot seat. The experience was great!

We took off and flew for 60 minutes, saw the entire island, including: Waimea Canyon, Na Pali Coast and so much more! The trip was with 5 others and ice towels were provided to keep us cool as it gets warm in the plane. 

While, I actually love air travel, my anxiety flared up in the smaller plane, but I handled it and was still able to enjoy the trip. The pictures were awesome, the crew was awesome, and I would recommend this to anyone (unless you dislike small planes!)

Bill from Taquan Air was our pilot out to the Misty Fjords.  He was knowledgable and friendly and I wished we could have spent more time in the air and in the area. Beautiful country.

Whilst only short the opportunity to get out on the pontoon when you land for a look around is well worth while.

The experience itself was amazing. Beautiful views of the whole island, the pilot was knowledgeable and friendly. The pilot made sure both sides of the plane could see the views, too. Very thoughtful! Definitely worth the money! 

 The only drawback was that the flight was delayed about a half an hour and all we were told was it would be “soon.” If you go on this excursion, don’t book it back to back with another event. 

Photos taken through the glass window on an iPhone 14 pro

review_title: Grand Canyon was amazing, getting there not so much
review_text:
We did the connoisseur trip to the South Rim.  Our bus arrived exactly on time to take us to the airport.  The driver did seem like he was in a hurry & was short with some of the passengers but they were late so I guess that is to be expected.  We arrived at the airport & didn't have a long wait to check in.  Once checked in we had approx 30mins before our flight left which was enough time to get some food & water at the cafe in the airport.
Our pilot was nice & friendly.  The plane was very cramped which I guess is to be expected but if you are taller than 6 foot you will find it very cramped.  Also the day was very hot & the plane doesn't have aircon.  It was also a very turbulent flight which made my wife & I feel quite ill.  The upside to all this is the views from the aircraft are amazing from the Hover Damn through to different parts of the Canyon.  There is an audio tour of everything you are seeing which is great, however the music that goes with it is terrible.  
We arrived safely & then were directed to a bus to travel to the canyon.  The bus driver again was quite short with the other passengers who didn't speak a ton of english so I don't think they understand what was required anyway.  The driver was nice to us but I believe there should have been more direction on where to go once we arrived at the airport & how much time before we left on the bus, so people knew whether to rush to the toilet or not.  Once arriving at the canyon it was everything & more than we expected.  Our travel back on the bus was fine however the plane ride back (which is about 1hr) was very turbulent, after the rough flight we were made to wait on the tarmac for a couple of mins in the heat for no apparent reason which added to the sickness.  The bus ride back to our hotel was quick & we didn't need to wait long.
If I had to do it again, a helicopter ride would be my pick.

review_title: Amazing views, better value for money than helicopter flights
review_text: Check-in was smooth and departure was on time. Friendly pilot introduced us to the plane - I was expecting a twin otter that has very large windows (as per pictures on website) but ended up in a Cessna caravan. It was very comfortable on board but the windows are not as big. It was extremely turbulent, would be interested to know if the twin otter was more stable as it was a little uncomfortable at points. That said we almost had the plane to ourselves. This was a lot cheaper than the helicopter rides and in my mind worth the savings, you still get an absolutely amazing view - would recommend!

Flying over the Grand Canyon offered great views because you not only saw it from overhead, but also viewed different areas of the canyon. The plane held around 8-10 people and all seats were on a window. One side of the plane had a better view than the other based on the direction of the flight. We went counter-clockwise on the tour, so the left side was always looking at the canyon. It is a small plane, so the ride was very choppy.

Original plan was to fly around Denali and land with glacier landing.  Weather did not cooperate and we had to take a shorter route and forgo the landing but, the trip was very well worth it.  Saw many at base camp getting a more intimate view of the mountain but I will leave that to them, not much on the climbing it just because it is there.  Our sites were absolutely outstanding and a testament to nature. The pilot was great and very informative.  Flying in a radial engine powered plane was an additional treat.  Staff was equally wonderful and efficient.  If we get the chance to go back we will be using them again.

Execellent day and views that was an  awesome sight to behold from this flying machine!
We were so mesmerized that we did not run thr video,

Thanks to Bali Hai for their suggestions. 

will like to see a full lenghth video of this experience.

review_title: Good tour but not fully satisified.
review_text:
This tour was good but not excellent. We did a small aircraft flight to the grand canyon and then a helicopter flight over the canyon, followed by lunch at one of the viewpoints of the canyon. We felt that we never knew what was going to happen next, we were always getting off one mode of transport onto another with not much communication. The transfers were great and the staff were friendly. We just felt we were told go here do this, get on here, get off, run over here. Very rushed. The helicopter flight was disappointing, you actually fly on a Papillion helicopter. We were rushed through a safety briefing, then got told to go outside get on the aircraft. There was no commentary on the helicopter and was very quick. Probably only 10 or 15mins. My partner and I didn't have a great view from the helicopter either.  We didn't get the boxed lunch until 3.30pm. We were absolutely starving and thirsty. It was a great experience but just felt a bit rushed seeing as it was an all day tour.
If we were to do this again, we would try Papillion.

review_title: Got to see parts of Kauai that I never would have seen otherwise!
review_text: Got almost all the sights I wanted to see in one flight, and from an angel I never would have been able to manage on my own! Thanks Air Ventures!!

We arrived for our scheduled K-2 flight around Denali (green route) and were told that the full trip was not possible due to weather conditions.   We opted for the offered "orange" route instead.  Once above the cloud cover we got some great views of the mountain and were able to land on the glacier, which was awesome.  We enjoyed every minute of it.  My only disappointment was that they charged us for the "orange" route, but the flight did not take us on the path of that route due to cloud cover.  Instead, the pilot made a few extra zig-zags along the "blue" route flight path to add some extra time to the trip.  Unfortunately, neither the pilot or anyone else asked us if this substitution was o.k. with us.  They assumed that adding a few extra minutes flight time was a fair substitute for seeing more of the mountain....in my opinion it wasn't.
It was a beautiful way to see Kauai!  Our pilot was quiet but the views spectacular!  I appreciated that everyone had a window seat and the plane was turned so both sides saw each view.

review_title: Beautiful way to see the city. Can’t be beaten...
review_text: A bike ride over the Golden Gate Bridge, lunch on the waterfront in Sausalito, and a 30 min ride in a vintage aircraft on floats to see the city. This has to be the perfect way to see the city and finish the day. The pilot was a bit crusty round the edges, weary of doing the same thing 4 times a day and not interested in small-talk, while the office staff were snoozing in the corner but that sort of added to the charm. Expect no frills and enjoy the thrill of the seaplane and a beautiful city.

The tour itself is good, the Grand Canyon is definitely a sight to see - the problem is the company running the tour.

We had booked a Grand Canyon tour from Las Vegas. First problem was the pickup from our hotel - 45 minutes late, and after a phone call to see where they were. Then we arrive at Scenic, and are informed of another delay, this time over an hour. They blame the second delay on a traffic jam - of which there was no evidence on our commute to their offices. We suspect they forgot about us and shifted us on a later tour. The result of the above is that we missed the show that we had booked for the evening. 

Couple the above with their transportation managers unhelpful attitude and refusal to help us get a faster drop off, a tardy response to my written complaint (which seemed to be a standard response saying delays happen, but they take no responsibility), our overall impression is rather go with another company (and not Papillon as they are the same company)

review_title: Golden buzzer for being the WORST company
review_text: This company deserves to be given the golden buzzer award for being the worst company in Miami. We paid double the price to reach to the airport, we were left waiting with no one to meet us upon arrival. They had no office or any indication  of their presence that we  felt confused and not sure about the legitimacy of the company. We tried calling them but no one picked up which was very unprofessional. We waited at the reception until the pilot finally showed up however there was no introduction and just gave us a wavier to sign before being ushered onto the old, stinky and unpleasant smelling plane. They do not prioritize cleanliness or hygiene which only add to our discomfort. The flight was terrible that we could not wait for it to end. Overall we rate our experience as 0 out of 10

Cancelled via Mail a few ours before (in the late evening when we were sleeping. No Information given. We paid nearly 100$ to get to the airport and back. The pilot Didn’t showed up. Other aviation companys told us there are a Bad Company

Nick with this company completely wasted both my fiancé and my time while on our trip to the island in August 2012.  We set up a time with him, which he cancelled a few hours prior (not a huge deal, things happen).  He then rescheduled with us for the following day at 5pm.  We drove halfway across the island only to be stood up.  He didn't call or anything.  He didn't call us back when we called two of Tropical Biplanes numbers trying to figure out what was going on as we stood there at their counter with no one to help.  Time is precious when on vacation in Kauai and he wasted a good portion of ours.  He didn't even have the guts to call us back.

The plane was really old, the engine wasn't starting the first time, there was holes in the seats, there was trouble closing the doors, and it was overall very uncomfortable ride and the view wasn't good either. The model of this plane was 1973 with a very bad engine, I'm surprised how this plane is allowed to fly in this plane. The plane had rust inside and out, we are just happy to land safely on the ground.Waste of money and I don't recommend this to anyone!

review_title: You only have to read my comments
review_text:
To be fair, I want to say upfront that this review focuses not only on the provider but also on Trip Advisor (based on the comments of the owner/vendor that Trip Advisor is horrible to dealt with on his end) . Sadly I did not get to revisit a great experience. I took this tour 10 years ago with my late wife and it was truly wonderful. Please note at that time I weighed in excess of 300 pounds.
