My late wife 175 pounds. We had no issue at the time because our combined average weight met the vendors parameters. Now to 2022.  I booked this latest tour 20 days before our arrival, entered all of the pertinent information, including body weight,  on the Trip Advisor booking page and paid my $368, expecting to again have a wonderful experience. 25 hours before our appointed excursion I receive an email from the Vendor thru the Trip Advisor platform that they are not able to accommodate us based on my weight being in excess of 300 pounds, the maximum PER SEAT, but if I wanted to buy an additional  seat on the next day....... I stated that my wife weighs 170 so our combined weight of 490 for two seats equated to 245 pounds per seat. Deaf Ears. OK I get it, please refund my booking. "NO, we are not able to refund your booking and it is Trip Advisors fault". OK, You, Air Venture, are the entity denying my booking, yet you cannot refund my money even though YOU are the entity who is refusing to provide the contracted service. "It is Trip Advisor's fault". OK I entered my correct weight on the Trip Advisor site when I  booked. Do YOU not communicate your parameters to Trip Advisor? "It is Trip Advisors fault". OK, Isn't Trip Advisor your Agent, therefore an extension of Air Ventures? "It is Trip Advisors fault". OK, you do realize Air Ventures that I will be leaving a negative review on the said "Trip Advisor" based on this interaction? "DON'T THREATEN ME" and hung up. So, if you decide to book a trip with Air Ventures, I suggest you stay away from Trip Advisor or any other third party booking site as the owner of Air Venture will not work with you if there is an issue, even if it is his fault. 

You will note that this is the only truly negative review I have ever left on Trip Advisor. God Bless Air Ventures. I hope you survive in business with your superb customer service.
Booked air land and river through Bestof Kauai- had issue with  that but pilot  Eric was layed back and assuring during 60+ minute flight. Saw a few whales and the terrrain is s worth every cent.
They cancelled on us at last minute stating the weather. At the same time three other companies were still selling the air tour including their agent. We ended up booking with a diffrent company.

Had no chance to fly, even fully paid in advance. Reasoning gave by operator was that speedometer not working in a plane, so it can not fly. It has been passed to us couple hours before departure. In the meantime extra message fom Wings Over Kauai manager was that they are working to find an alerative plane for us. Finally they cancelled our filght, even other passangers has been rescheduled. WOK proposed to us flight 3:30 pm when weather conditions was expected to be worst = raining. We had also other bookings made, so there was no chance to flight in the afternoon.
All in one, I do not recommend Wings Over Kauai for Island flights. It was really bad suprise for all our group.
They shall pay more attantion for plains maintenance and customer care to avoid flights cancellation.
Br
Wojciech

review_title: No response after asking cancelation policy
review_text: I am thinking of booking the tour with my family mid of Mar since I saw so many good reviews here. Today I tried to chat through messenger with someone on the other side. First two questions regarding how they handle wind situation were answered. But when I asked about cancelation policy and everythihg stopped. I tried to text few more follow-up messages and waited for more than 30min without any response. This makes me nervous that they only care of booking not customer service.

I was traveling alone with my 3 kids all age 9, we were greeted kindly by Lindsey the sales person/manager and things "seemed" to be running smoothly and ethically. We boarded our small 4 seater plane with our young pilot and amazing hiking guide Craig from Aria, but halfway through the flight the pilot said we had to go back to the airport as we have a mechanical malfunction, which as a mom with her babies on board  this small plane with a very young pilot I was beyond anxious we were all going down.We got back and waited a while till they put us on another plane as the one that we were on could not be repaired, that was smooth and the pilot was experienced but the aerial tour that we paid for  to do over the grand canyon was "postponed" so we could get back on  their schedule.... After landing we were then put into a hummer to take us to the grand canyon to hike this company who owned the hummer was Buck Wild Adventures, the woman driver dropped us off on the side of the road as she said she could not get us to the trail head and to make sure we were there by 2pm (approx 3 hours later). We got back to the meeting place after an amazing hike (again the hiking guide was top notch) 10 minutes early and we waited and waited there is no cell service up there so we had no way to call for help. After waiting on the side of the road for an hour we finally had to walk more than an hour on a busy street with no sidewalk (with 3 kids!!!) until we could get phone reception, our hiking guide was so helpful and called his boss who quickly got in touch with Westwind and someone finally came and picked us up hours later than the 2pm meeting time. My kids had done a huge hike were exhausted and starving at this point.... when I mentioned the aerial tour the pilot said oh we'll do that now but at this point my kids were so tired they were asleep before the tour even began missing ALL of the sights! When we landed finally back at the Deer Valley Airport Lindsey had already left for the day with no call to check in or anything that evening... it was after 6pm when we landed and 7pm before finally getting a ride back to our hotel when we were supposed to be back between 1-2. I called the next morning to voice my disappointment and Lindsey did answer but unknowing to her she kept muting herself to talk to other people and every time she did it as music would blare (she had no idea this was happening)  so she wasn't listening to me at all. She blamed everything on other people and "promised" to make things right with some type of refund. It has been two weeks and I've yet to hear anything back from her even after emailing several times. Just can't believe businesses really run like this it's sad.

review_title: DIDNT BOTHER TO TELL US FLIGHT WAS CANCELLED !!!
review_text: WORST EXPERIENCE EVER !! We booked the Red Baron biplane at least 8 months in advance through a well known tour operator in Hawaii. On the day before we were to take the tour as a courtesy to us (we were on The Pride Of America cruise ship) the tour operator emailed the Red Baron biplane operator only to be informed our tour had already been cancelled but the operator of the biplane never bothered to email our tour operator to be told this. He said the plane was being serviced. Now I don't know about you but I do no that planes go in for service but have scheduled dates in advance for being serviced. Obviously the biplane operator knew this but not once did he bother to contact myself, or the tour operator. If she didn't email the day before, hubby and I would have been stuck in town waiting for a non existent tour. As it was we had to scramble with the cruise ship to get on a shore tour as almost everything was booked out. So we didn't end up seeing Kuaui by any airplane and it was meant to be our anniversary highlight. So thanks for nothing Red Barron and ruining our vist to Kuaui. If you had of emailed us as we booked over 6 months in advance, we could of booked through another company and had the opportunity to see Kuaui from the air. You know when your plane is scheduled for service and yet you didn't bother to contact us or the tour operator. Paying US $425 is a lot of money that took me weeks to save and you just flipped us off. I DO NOT RECOMMEND THIS COMPANY AS THEY DON'T CARE WHO'S HOLIDAY THEY RUIN. If you had of emailed us a few weeks before hand, I could forgive you, but to leave us almost stranded is atrocious, shame on you for not caring and ruining your reputation, I will not be recommending you to any of our friends and family D ---------- ......
Cancelled our tour, disappointing and not professional. Do not book with them and check other tour company better

review_title: Bad Business Practice - No Warning for Canceled Flight
review_text: Due to weather we were not able to do the flight we had booked, including landing on a glacier. I understand that the weather cannot be controlled. I do not understand however the thought process behind not informing us via email or call to let us know our options. We are in Alaska for 10 days with plans down to the minute each day. Had we known we wouldn’t be flying we wouldn’t have even stopped in Talkeetna. They want you to come to the office to check in anyways so they can try and sell you a different flight. Seems unethical. Let us know ahead of time so we can make our own decisions. It’s not like they just decided not to fly when we got there.

review_title: Maverick Helicopters Were great and  Honest, Tripadvisors not so much.
review_text: We booked the 45 minute flight, but all flights were cancelled at the last minute due to high winds. Maverick was very upfront about refunding our money on the spot, but could not since we booked through Tripadvisor ( who indicated no refunds for any reason).  There was no convenient way to even contact Tripadvisor.  Fortunately, Maverick persevered for us with Tripadvisor to get a refund.  We were still out about $30 for Tripadvisor fees, but did get $698 back.  No thanks to Tripadvisor, but due to the honest efforts by Maverick. I will think twice before ever using Tripadvisor again.

We booked tour months ago for our first Alaskan  Cruise.  Had been told seaplane tour was incredible and not to be missed.  We arrived dockside at meeting place. Had to wait 15 minutes past scheduled pick up. Then when bus didn't arrive, operator liasion asked us to sit down it would be another 10 minutes. Then they asked us to walk to to different cruise terminal as the bus was still on way and it would be easier for driver to pick us up there. Someone asked about what if couldn't walk that far. Said could make the driver come, but would take longer.  We got to the next cruise ship and bus wasn't there yet. When it arrived, the bus unloaded some passengers. Driver was talkative but not about Ketchikan or Alaska. He said we were lucky because he had left passengers at station to come get us. Laughed about it and said they'd have to wait.  Arrived at station to find out that one plane was taken to the hangar due to mechanical issues. Asked for six volunteers.  After rearranging dinners for some passengers, we were told they would go on 5:30 flight.  Okay, then we were told by Tiger that he needed two more volunteers because if weight limitations.  We volunteered as other remaining passengers were celebrating or had second tours.  We were told we would go at 3:30. After group was called for boarding, Tiger said it was the 4:00 departure. Why he lied inexplainable. When I asked him why he lied, he said that was "tour" time.  He said he couldn't control the planes and he couldn't control the FAA safety regulations.  Said if we had booked directly, he would be able to do something, but since we booked with cruise line, he couldn't compensate us for the wasted day.   Still waiting for the tour. Will post if we ever make it to the seaplane.

review_title: 2nd time for myself/ 1st for my adult daughter
review_text:
Went on the Canyon Spirit tour.. my daughter was in a good spot, got great pics & enjoyed every minute!! 
This was my second time with Maverick & I was a bit disappointed... the mikes on our headsets weren't working & the pilot got in, decided it was too warm & blasted the air con... I was not dressed for 50 mins of freezing air blowing on me & when asked if it could be adjusted, we had no reply.. I was also subjected to 50 mins of country music.. I don't hate country music, but it was loud, twangy & there was no choice given, headphones had to stay on. I enjoyed the actual flight & scenery, but was happy to get back, get warm & give my non country ears a break! Lol.

Amazing sights. Did helicopter tour and went to all the spots. Amazing. Ask for Chris Wiley as he is the best and most informed helicopter and plane pilot. Problem was that with the ticket you get free lunch and get to choose off an entire menu. But when you order you are only allowed a hotdog or nachos... Not the entire menu even though it's printed on the wall.

We booked the plane to the Grand Canyons in hopes of saving some time.

We were picked up from our hotel at 1030. After multiple stops on the strip and another shuttle transfer we arrived at the terminal around 1145. 

We then waited till about 1 to board our flight. 

The plane views were fantastic and provided pre recorded audio info on Hoover dam and canyon.

After landing we were transferred by bus to our viewing spots. We had a little over an hour at both spots. I felt this amount of time was sufficient with two young kids. 

Once back at the terminal we were asked to wait for less than 30 min. Not bad.

The bus ride back to hotel was again more than 1 hour itself. 

I realize issues with traffic, however they should have a better system for this portion of the trip. 

I feel with cost, the company should take care to upgrade their shuttle buses and employees! The buses looked so worn down, in my opinion that speaks volumes about the company. I did not feel the employees were prepared with guided information. Part of this adventure should be a guided information from employees. 

Part of the tour is the skywalk- not sure if this is very impressive. The glass on the bottom was not that clear and did not provide clear views.

review_title: for those visiting on a time budget--just be aware to have a plan B
review_text: I specifically booked on K2 for their reviews. Flew 7+hrs from houston to anchorage and this was supposed to be my highlight for my trip. i was booked with K2 for sat 9/3 for a tour+landing (they charge 1/2 on your CC and rest when you show up). Before leaving Anchorage called them at 803am that day to verify landing and the lady on the phone said "yes, we're landing this morning". Drove the slightly over 2 hours to talkeetna and during checkin at 1015am, the gentleman that was there (tall slim guy) mentioned they would fly for the tour but <1% chance of landing. When asked about other landings told to me on the phone, they said they never even landed that morning due to weather and also that its bad to land in the summer time. Clearly this was an expectation bummer to me from the first call that am to the reality check at the counter since i'm one of those that hate surprises. All they had to do was tell me the same on the phone that chances were looking slim to land today and that would have been more than enough warning to me to be atleast have planned for plan B incase this did not work. I asked for why the discrepancy over the phone with what the lady said just 2hrs ago vs. now at the counter and got absolutely NO apology for that. Yes, i did get my refund but again my point is for those on a time crunch since i visited alaksa for just the labor day weekend, beware that even if you do not get to land (if thats what you want, like i did) you may be still told on the phone to come in. (i wish that same gentleman i spoke to in person had answered the phone that morning saving me this review. It would'nt have been frustrating at all, had both the messages on the phone+in person were in sync). But obvisouly keeping safety in mind, it was best to not land (i'm just a little frustrated that the same could have been communicated over the phone to either help a customer avoid the road trip or have a plan B to do in talkeetna---that's all). The actual problem is as with any airline making $ from tourists, they would NOT like to say NO on the phone to any customer and K2 is no exception. Just be careful for those on a time budget, pls. try to check prior to your roadtrip as best you can since they do offer re-scheduling or atleast keep something else in talkeetna to do as plan B (which is what i did in the end taking the rapids cruise on the talkeetna river. i was lucky to find this on the spot there but i would suggest you plan for a plan B).

I have been to Kauai recently and had the air tour with wings over kauai. It's perplexing to see why this activity has got such a high rating. Helicopter tour is much better, you fly lower and go closure to everything comes you way ( canyon, cliff, waterfall etc..)
No doubt people running wings over kauai are very nice, give you good gifts, and do their best to make you happy. But we can't hide away from reality, plane tour is just not the way to see kauai. Only reason I see to go with the plane tour is to save some money ( $ 60 / person), but REALLY it's doesn't worth it.....Enjoy.

The pilots are excellent, friendly, knowledgeable, and skilled. 

But, don’t get your weight estimate wrong or Keith at the front desk will talk down to you as if you lied on purpose. I have family in aviation, so I understand the importance of weight distribution on an aircraft. But, when my wife’s weight came in above the number I had sent in, Keith had little to no sensitivity about it. 

So, in the end my wife and I were not able to be on the same helicopter. I was upset about that, but I understand. They want to keep us safe, and flying in high heat can be dangerous. But, what I don’t appreciate is the way Keith handled the situation. Repeating statements like “This number is WAY over the estimate given to us.” is nothing short of an emotional punch in the face to anyone who has ever struggled with weight issues. 

So, in the end, the stars I give are for the pilots. They are truly the 5 star champs of this company. But, my experience with Keith’s lack of sensitivity at the front desk quite literally ruined the experience for both of us. So, I would recommend that management coordinate some much needed sensitivity training for Keith. It would be a great improvement for your customer service.

Please be warned you spend 2 hours before you leave picking up guests from other hotels and then the same in return, so a 7.5 hour tour is really only 3. Tour is average and a lot of waiting around. The 30 minute helicopter tour (out of 7.5 hours) is fantastic and pilot excellent. All staff are very friendly. Generally I would suggest ask questions before you book - all sounds great but a lot of wasted time picking and dropping people off

Three of us signed up for the plane ride about a month in advance. There were really high winds that day (40 mph+), but the company didn't cancel so we went for the ride. 15 minutes in, another passenger started vomiting. Somehow the three of us survived the turbulence, which took all of the fun out of the amazing views and great narrations. About 30 minutes in we were wishing it was over- the turbulence was intolerable and quite frightening, and making us so sick we were doing all we could not to vomit. After getting off the plane we were so nauseated that we had to lay down at the airport for about an hour before getting back in the car. Go on a calm day- not worth the cost to be sick in a tiny plane in high winds.

Booked the Grand Canyon Discovery Tour and very unimpressed with how short the flight time was (less than ten minutes total) with a short photo op stop on a ridge in the canyon.  Our pilot appeared more interested in 'chatting up' his previous guests which he was flying back to Las Vegas after our tour.  He left us waiting 15 minutes at the gate with a very embarrassed hostess trying to get his attention, and then was abrupt and rushed us along, presumably to return to his previous guests.  We are a family of five, all adults, and were quite excited looking forward to what we thought would be a highlight of our trip.  Save your money and tour the rim.  Photos just as good.  As a comparison, we recently took a scenic flight over the Whistler Glaciers that was advertised as a 30 minute flight.  Our flight time was almost double and the pilot was engaged, providing an amazing narrative of what we were seeing.  So much better!

review_title: This is a two-for-one experience if you haven't ridden a helicopter and you havent been to the Grand Danyon
review_text:
We bought this tour through Viator for around $300 plus $49 fuel surcharge.  They picked us up from our hotel 1.5hrs before our scheduled flight since they also picked up other passengers from other hotels. We were weighed and were told the pilot will be the one to make the seating arrangements on board the helicopter. The ride was enjoyable and the picnic was passable (they served champagne in plastic dups and commercially-bought muffins. My family of four liked it except for the fact that our trip was supposed to include a pass over the LA strip and our pilot didn't do this. I felt short-changed because of this.. 
P.S. it was very difficult to converse on board as we had to wear headsets and talk through a mic that didn't seem to work properly..

review_title: Shame about the commentary and safety aspects
review_text:
I know this goes against the other reviews but our trip was marred by a lack of commentary either by the pilot or the pre recorded...I mentioned it to the pilot but it fell on deaf ears literally. We landed in the lake and got out on to the floats which was quite exhilarating but I did fear for the safety of us as you could quite easily slip off the floats into the freezing water ,
I would like to do it again with commentary as the views and scenery are fantastic as is the experience of landing on water

The flight was enjoyable but not earth shattering like promoted! Pilot Patrick was doing a job not actively enthusiastically participating so I’d rate that part as average. Without the glacier landing the flight would be Ho Hum! The bushfire smog affected visibility and it was obvious that we were unlucky flying in today’s conditions. Last point at approx A$500 for the experience I think time again I’d prefer a trip in winter when conditions were better for sight seeing

The float plane over the fjords was AMAZING. Adam was an awesome pilot and the views were incredible. The issue was the boat. The first half hour was phenomenal, beautiful scenery, nice water. The remaining 2 PLUS hours on the boat was choppy and boring. I highly recommend the float, but definitely skip the boat.

review_title: Expected more of the Connoisseur tour
review_text:
My husband and i booked our Connoisseur tour to go to the Grand Canyon South on the 19th and below is are overall experience:
Pros: 
- Beautiful views as promised 
- Very friendly staff - the bus driver at the Grand Canyon South was amazing! He blew us all away with his happiness, assisted us with answers and took amazing pictures of us and people on the tour with us. 
Cons:
- The flight was delayed. Upon my complain they gave me a picture for free, but still sucks as you make plans for the day arrive there way earlier and have to wait an hour because the pilot is in training.
- The flight on our way there was AWFUL! We all thought we would not make it. The win was extremely strong, which I understand its not their fault. We were informed that we could face some turbulence and even signed a document for that, but that was not SOME that was the WHOLE flight which made us all very sick and because of that we were not able to enjoy the tour as much. So I wish the staff would have informed us of the extremely bad winds and offered to possibly reschedule the flight or something.
- The food they give us is not Connoisseur... it was just okay. So bring some snacks just in case. 
- The last big complain was the windows. They were not as big as i saw in the pictures and expected. So maybe they flew us in another plane that had small windows which i did not like it at all especially with my husband being 6.4.

With all that said it is a good company, we might have just chosen a bad day.

review_title: Sights amazing, K2 not so much
review_text: The experience was 5 stars but K2 was not the reason. Paid for flyer with landing. flight time was 70mintues not 100. Pilot was not engaging. Very quiet flight.  Answered some questions. Obversely in a hurry to go home as he was in parking lot before we took off boots. But it was a safe trip.

review_title: Missed the highlight of the flight - too bad !
review_text: The pilot was good but the weather not good. So it was bumpy. the big frustration is that we could not see the Golden Gate Bridge at all. The company knew there was no visibility over the bridge and should have cancelled the flight. No refund or replacement flight proposed by Seaplane Adventure. Too bad !

This trip came highly recommended from good friends. Unfortunately we did not have the same good experience they had. It was a cloudy day and we received a call that the tour would be canceled due to poor visibility. Then a half hour later got a call that the pilot came back and said it was clear and the tour was back on. So we showed up. This was supposed to be the greater bay area tour. I was told when i booked it we would go up the coast toward Sonoma. In short our tour ended up being Emeryville, the Richmond Bridge and the prison. - basically the same as my commute to work. We did see a look of Mt Tam, but no SF sights at all and no coastline. Underwhelming. I think that the operators should have us back on a clear day so we can have a better experience for the $$$ we paid.
I was sitting on the left side of the plane - as was my husband. Saw very little as most of the scenery was on the right side of the plane.

review_title: Don't go if it's cloudy. Read other 'poor/average' for similar comments.
review_text:
This activity was a huge let down after reading the glowing reviews on here and numerous travel books stating this as a 'must-do' activity.  Then again not all must-do activities I've experienced were all great either.  

Weather plays a HUGE role in the type of experience you will get.  Not only does it dictate what you see, but also your mood as well (we all love that blue sky).  We had originally booked the Grand Denali tour but due to the cloudy weather it was cancelled and was rescheduled for the Mountain Voyager tour (that should have been my cue to bail with this activity! 

You do get some great views from the plane but it does fly quite high and the window is not super big.  We did see Mount Denali and some other mountains but only partial views due to clouds, which I understand is typical for high mountains.  But it was cloudy all over and the light level wasn't the best for taking photos.  We also landed on a glacier but there were several other planes and people all around taking photos.  It was hard to enjoy the surroundings with people talking and asking you to take their photo.  Because of the cloud cover on the glacier we had limited views of our surroundings as well.

I would NOT recommend this activity if it's cloudy.  Think about the amount of money you pay.  I do recommend going on a helicopter tour instead.  I did that in Valdez and WOW that was so much better.  You have much better views and you fly very close to the mountains and glaciers.  We also did a glacier landing and had glacier water.  In my opinion going via helicopter was a much better experience than going on an airplane. And besides we've all been on planes but being in a helicopter was an amazing experience.

Save your money and do a helicopter landing instead!

I really wanted to give a better review because the view was incredible. I was surprised we were offered a full refund because of cloud cover but they convinced us that we would see the mountains once we broke through. Indeed the scenery was outstanding and the pilot did a great job of making sure all passengers could see the mountain. However we were the first to arrive and the last to be placed on a plane. In addition to the usual 30-45 wait we stood in the cold for another hour. They changed our placement three times including once that when they did not inform us. My feet were cold prior to departure and only got worse on the flight which was freezing. The pilot admitted he was too hot so did not put the heat on. This company could communicate better and actually care about the customer and not just the money.

This company uses DeHavilland Beaver planes which in spite of being an old model have an awesome reputation of a reliable plane with great short take off and landing. That being said, it would be expected that a plane is upkept and modernized with all the new avionics technology available. Their planes have no modern technology, they are just the original from the 50's; headliner was falling apart, headsets were not working in the back seats, having to rely on yelling. The only reason why I'm not rating them terrible is because the pilot had good skills and pleasant personality. But if I wanted to see a piece of history, I would have gone to a museum.

Tour was great if you can handle the hot temp of the airplane cabin. After the tour we were asked by an employee if we enjoyed it. When we commented on the lack of air conditioning, she responded that she knew about the problem, it's a manufacturer defect! Would have been nice to have been told in advance and maybe offered another time for the plane with working AC! If there really is one as she indicated. Kind of ruined my first time in a small aircraft.

We booked the trip including drive, flight, helicopter and boat. The pickup was late in the morning then we had to wait another 20 minutes at another hotel for a transfer...so we got to the actual trip quite late. The worst part was on the return, when we were told to be at the airport at 2:00 pm. We were there at 1:40, checked in and were told the flight is scheduled for 2:30, so we waited for the flight back in the waiting room. At about 2:20 we were told that our plane just departed....and we will be scheduled for another later flight. How can this happen? How organized is this? 
The trip was an expensive trip and we spent a lot of time waiting....I guess we were lucky that the flight at 4:15 had 2 left seats and we returned with it. So instead of being back by 3 pm we got after 6 pm...and we did not have time to go to the show we had tickets to that evening.
What was supposed to be an amazing experience turned out to be a disappointment....waste of our money.
We tried reaching out to guestrelations@papilon.com but we got no answer back

review_title: Great views - not good for wildlife viewing!
review_text:
They sold me on flying low and being able to see lots of wildlife close up . . . 
We flew at about 500 - 650 feet above the grounds so any wildlife you see is minimum  600 fret away, more like 1000 feet away, basically not worth it for a wildlife viewing . . . 
People are very nice but not totally honest - over sold it big time  !
We saw 3 black bears or 3 black dots moving and Caribou. Again, it was very hard to see and we had an amazing clear sunny day. . . 
Better to go look at the Glaciers and the mountains which are 600 Feet away - looks like you are right there as they are massive  . . .
Awesome views! Pilot was awesome and gave a bunch of pointers and history behind some of the scenery.

We chose to fly with Wings over Kauai because their rates were very competitive (especially compared to the helicopter tour with the Pride of America!). I was greeted with a kukui nut lei (one per couple) and we were offered ginger candy and peppermints to help with motion sickness. Our pilot had great knowledge of the island and a perfect soundtrack to accompany the sites we were seeing out our windows. There was a cooler with cold drinks and towels as there was limited air circulation in the plane itself. I did get a little motion sick because I was taking too many pictures - there's a lot to see! The flight was a good length for me (1 hourish). I will say that helicopters seem to be able to get closer to the sites than planes, but other than that, highly recommended. When we got back, they gave us a pre-recorded DVD of some of the best sites from the Go-Pros all over the plane with a cover that featured a picture of us before the flight and the opportunity to purchase a DVD of our specific flight - we did purchase the DVD which was mailed to us about a week later - it's excellent quality.
Amazing trip!! 100% recommended, thank you for all Sergio!!👍🏻 They speak Spanish too, very communicative
